1-1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第32页／PDF第41页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 32 · PDF p. 41. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

参考方向与实际方向：用正负号判断Reference and actual directions: interpret the sign

题目原文Transcribed question

已知在如题图1-1所示电路的电压、电流参考方向下，u=5V，i=−2A，请标出电压、电流的实际方向。With the voltage and current references in Fig. 1-1, u=5V and i=−2A. Mark the actual voltage and current directions.

元件左端a、右端b；电流i参考箭头由a指向b；电压u左正右负。A two-terminal element has a at the left and b at the right. The reference current points from a to b, and voltage u is positive at a.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

参考方向是预先指定的坐标；正值表示与参考相同，负值表示相反。A reference is a chosen coordinate direction: a positive value agrees with it; a negative value reverses it.
这类题不需要另列电路方程。先把u解释为Va−Vᵦ，再把i的负号解释为箭头反向。No additional circuit equations are needed. Interpret u as Va−Vᵦ, then reverse the current arrow because i is negative.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

判断电压高低Determine the higher potential

u=Va−Vᵦ=5V>0，所以a端比b端高5V；电压降的实际方向为a→b，即左高右低。u=Va−Vᵦ =5V>0, so a is 5V above b. The actual voltage-drop direction is a→b.

u=Va−Vb=5V

反转负电流的箭头Reverse the negative current

i的参考方向为a→b，但i=−2A，故实际电流为2A，方向b→a。解答示意图给出了两个实际方向。The current reference is a→b, but i=−2A. The actual current is therefore 2A from b to a. The solution diagram shows both actual directions.

ia→b=−2A ⟺ ib→a=2A

实际方向示意：左端a电位较高、右端b较低，5V电压降向右；实际2A电流向左，由b流向a。Actual directions: a at left is higher than b at right. The 5V voltage drop points right; actual 2A current points left, from b to a.

电压：a高、b低，实际电压降a→b；电流：2A，由b→a。Voltage: a is higher and b lower, with a→b voltage drop. Current: 2A from b→a.

易错点Common errors

  • 负电流不是“没有电流”，而是与选定参考箭头相反。A negative current is not an absent current; it flows opposite the chosen reference arrow.
  • 电压的方向表示高低电位；不要把它误当作一定与电流同向。Voltage direction describes potential order and need not match the current direction.

核验依据Verification

独立参考反转核验：令Va=5V、Vᵦ=0，则Va−Vᵦ=5V；把电流坐标改为b→a，数值由−2变成+2A。与书第332页、PDF341页1-1一致。Independent reference-reversal check: Va=5V and Vᵦ = 0 reproduce u=5V. Reversing the current coordinate to b→a changes −2A into +2A. This matches answer 1-1 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第32页／PDF第41页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 32 · PDF p. 41. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

电荷求电流：正弦函数求导Current from charge: differentiate the sinusoid

题目原文Transcribed question

已知通过某二端元件的电荷q(t)=2sin(3t)C，t>0，求电流i(t)。The charge through a two-terminal element is q(t)=2sin(3t)C for t>0. Find i(t).

原书1-2完整题干，电荷为2sin(3t)C，时间范围t>0。The complete original 1-2 statement: q(t)=2sin(3t)C for t>0.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电流定义i=dqdt；复合函数求导；Cs=A。Current definition i=dqdt, the chain rule and Cs=A.
给的是电荷而不是电流。求电流只需对时间求导，正弦求导后的系数还要乘以内部的3。The given quantity is charge. Differentiate it with respect to time, including the inner factor 3.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写出定义Apply the definition

电流是沿同一参考方向的电荷变化率，单位为库仑每秒。Current is the rate of charge change in the same reference direction, measured in coulombs per second.

i(t)=dq(t)dt

应用链式法则Apply the chain rule

2sin(3t)求导后是2×3cos(3t)，其中3来自3t对t的导数。Differentiating 2sin(3t) gives 2×3cos(3t), where 3 is the derivative of the inner argument 3t.

i(t)=2·3cos(3t)=6cos(3t)A,t>0

i(t)=6cos(3t)A，t>0。i(t)=6cos(3t)A, t>0.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要漏掉链式法则中的3。Do not omit the chain-rule factor 3.
  • q是有符号的累计电荷，不要求在所有时刻为正。q is signed accumulated charge; it need not be positive at every instant.

核验依据Verification

独立积分核验：∫0t6cos(3τ)dτ=2sin(3t)=q(t)−q(0)。另在多个时间点对原始q做中心差分，与6cos(3t)相符，误差小于10−8A。与书第332页、PDF341页1-2一致。Independent integral check: ∫0t6cos(3τ)dτ=2sin(3t)=q(t)−q(0). Central differences of the original q at multiple times agree with 6cos(3t) to less than 10−8A. This matches answer 1-2 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-3全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第32页／PDF第41页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 32 · PDF p. 41. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

指数电荷求导：常数消失，指数不变Exponential charge: constants vanish and the exponent remains

题目原文Transcribed question

已知通过某二端元件的电荷q(t)=(10+5e−3t)C，t>0，求通过此元件的电流。The charge through a two-terminal element is q(t)=(10+5e−3t)C for t>0. Find the current through it.

原书1-3完整题干，指数清楚为−3t；q(t)=(10+5e−3t)C。The complete original 1-3 statement, clearly showing exponent −3t in q(t)=(10+5e−3t)C.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电流i=dqdt；指数函数链式法则；电荷守恒。i=dqdt, the chain rule for exponentials and charge conservation.
10C是常数项，其导数为0；e−3t求导只增加系数−3，不会把原指数改成别的数。The constant 10C differentiates to zero. Differentiating e−3t multiplies it by −3 without changing its exponent.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

对原题逐项求导Differentiate the original statement term by term

严格采用题干指数−3t：常数10的导数为0，5e−3t的导数为−15e−3t。Use the original exponent −3t. The derivative of 10 is zero and that of 5e−3t is −15e−3t.

i(t)=ddt(10+5e−3t)=−15e−3tA

用总电荷变化排除错误指数Reject a wrong exponent using total charge change

q(0+)=15C，q(∞)=10C，所以从0到∞的总电流积分必须为−5C。正确式积分为−153=−5C；附录−15e−5t的积分仅−3C，不能还原原题。q(0+)=15C and q(∞)=10C, so total integrated current must be −5C. The correct expression integrates to −153=−5C; the appendix expression −15e−5t integrates to only −3C and fails to reconstruct the given charge.

∫0∞i(t)dt=−153=−5C=q(∞)−q(0+)

i(t)=−15e−3tA，t>0。书后答案的指数−5t与原题不一致，应按题干−3t。i(t)=−15e−3tA for t>0. The appendix exponent −5t conflicts with the original statement; use −3t.

易错点Common errors

  • 求导会改变前面的系数，不会把e−3t改为e−5t。Differentiation changes the coefficient, not e−3t into e−5t.
  • 不能仅因书后印有答案就覆盖原题和积分守恒。Do not override the original statement and charge balance solely because an appendix answer is printed.

核验依据Verification

独立双重核验：对原q做多点中心差分，误差小于10−8A；正确电流从0到∞的积分为−5C，与15C降到10C完全相符。高分辨率核对题干第32页、PDF41页为−3t，附录第332页、PDF341页印为−5t，确认为附录指数错误。Two independent checks: central differences of the original q agree to less than 10−8A, and integrating current to infinity gives −5C, exactly the fall from 15C to 10C. High-resolution inspection confirms −3t in the statement on printed p. 32 and PDF p. 41 but −5t in the appendix on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341; the appendix exponent is wrong.

1-4全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第32页／PDF第41页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 32 · PDF p. 41. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

电荷波形到电流与功率：斜率和能量符号From charge to current and power: slopes and energy signs

题目原文Transcribed question

设通过题图1−2(a)所示元件的电荷波形如题图1−2(b)所示。若单位正电荷由a端移至b端时获得的能量为2J，求流过元件的电流i(t)及元件的功率p(t)，并画出i(t)与p(t)的波形。The charge waveform through the element in Fig. 1-2(a) is shown in Fig. 1-2(b). A unit positive charge gains 2J when moving from terminal a to b. Find current i(t) and element power p(t), and draw both waveforms.

a在左、b在右，i参考方向a→b，u左正右负。q由0到1s按5t2C增加到5C；1到2s保持5C；2到3s线性降至0。a is left, b right, reference i is a→b and u is positive at a. q rises as 5t2C from 0 to 1s, stays at 5C from 1 to 2s, then falls linearly to 0 at 3s.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

i=dqdt；电压为单位正电荷的电位能差；关联方向下p吸收=ui；分段函数单侧极限。i=dqdt, voltage as potential-energy difference per unit charge, absorbed power p=ui under passive references, and one-sided limits of piecewise functions.
先从“正电荷获得能量”判断b比a电位高，得到u=−2V；再逐段读取q的斜率求i，最后按原图关联参考方向相乘得到吸收功率。First interpret the gained energy: b is above a in potential, so u=−2V. Then differentiate each charge segment and multiply by u using the original passive references.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

把获得的能量换成图示电压Convert gained energy into the referenced voltage

单位正电荷从a到b获得2J，故Vᵦ−Va=2V；图示u=Va−Vᵦ，所以u=−2V。A unit positive charge gains 2J from a to b, so Vᵦ−Va=2V. The drawn voltage is u=Va−Vᵦ =−2V.

u=Va−Vb=−2V

分段写q并求导Write and differentiate the charge pieces

0<t<1时q=5t2；1<t<2时q=5；2<t<3时q=15−5t。对应斜率分别为10t、0、−5，单位A。For 0<t<1, q=5t2; for 1<t<2, q=5; for 2<t<3, q=15−5t. Their slopes are 10t, 0 and −5A.

i(t)={10tA,0<t<10,1<t<2−5A,2<t<3

求吸收功率并画波形Compute absorbed power and draw the waveforms

i从u正端流入，因此p=ui=−2i。第一段负功率表示元件提供能量；第三段正功率表示吸收能量。解答图中的虚线只提示跳变，不代表额外冲激。Current enters u’s positive terminal, so p=ui=−2i. Negative first-segment power means energy delivery; positive third-segment power means absorption. Dashed jump guides in the solution plot do not represent impulses.

pabs(t)={−20tW,0<t<10,1<t<210W,2<t<3

说明分段交界和图外延拓State the corner and extension conventions

在t=1、2、3处，q的斜率发生跳变，通常不为导数单独指定一个值，应按左右极限画图。q本身连续，因此电流没有冲激。若按图中3s后的零值水平线延拓，则t>3时i=p=0。At t=1, 2 and 3 the charge slope jumps, so use one-sided limits rather than assigning a unique derivative value. Charge is continuous, hence no current impulse. If the zero-charge horizontal continuation after 3s is used, i=p=0 for t>3.

两幅精确分段波形：i从0线性升到10A的左极限，在1s降到0，2s降到−5A，3s回0；p从0线性降到−20W的左极限，在1s回0，2s升到10W，3s回0。虚线为跳变提示，开圆为单侧极限。Exact piecewise plots: i rises linearly from 0 to the 10A left limit, drops to 0 at 1s, then to −5A at 2s and returns to 0 at 3s. p falls linearly to the −20W left limit, returns to 0 at 1s, rises to 10W at 2s and returns to 0 at 3s. Dashed lines guide jumps; open circles show one-sided limits.

u=−2V。i：0<t<1为10tA，1<t<2为0，2<t<3为−5A；p吸收依次为−20tW、0、10W。波形见解答图；交界点用单侧极限。u=−2V. i is 10tA for 0<t<1, 0 for 1<t<2 and −5A for 2<t<3. Absorbed power is respectively −20tW, 0 and 10W. See the solution plots; use one-sided limits at corners.

易错点Common errors

  • “电荷获得能量”给出Vᵦ−Va>0，图示u却是Va−Vᵦ。The gained energy implies Vᵦ−Va>0, whereas the drawn u is Va−Vᵦ.
  • q的恒定平台对应零电流，不是5A。A constant charge plateau means zero current, not 5A.
  • q连续但斜率跳变，只产生电流跳变，不产生电流冲激。Continuous q with a slope jump creates a current jump, not an impulse.

核验依据Verification

独立电荷、能量核验：三段电流积分为+5、0、−5C，总计0，重建q由0回到0；吸收能量为−10、0、+10J，总计0，等于uΔq。各非交界时间点对原q作差分也相符。附录第332页、PDF341页列出的各段电流、功率与此一致。Independent charge and energy checks: integrated segment currents are +5, 0 and −5C, totaling zero and reconstructing the return of q to zero. Absorbed energies are −10, 0 and +10J, totaling uΔq=0. Differentiation checks away from corners also agree. The appendix segment currents and powers on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 match.

1-5指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第32页／PDF第41页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 32 · PDF p. 41. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：1-5Assigned requirement: 1-5

参考方向与吸收功率Reference directions and absorbed power

题目原文Transcribed question

已知在题图1-3所示电压、电流参考方向下，元件A的电压、电流分别为u=−3V、i=5A，元件B的电压、电流分别为u=5V、i=−2mA，试求两元件吸收的功率。Under the voltage and current reference directions shown in Fig. 1-3, element A has u=−3V and i=5A, while element B has u=5V and i=−2mA. Find the power absorbed by each element.

A：电流参考方向由左向右，电压左正右负；B：电流参考方向由右向左，电压右正左负。两者电流箭头都流入电压正参考端。A: current points left to right, with voltage positive on the left. B: current points right to left, with voltage positive on the right. Both current references enter the positive voltage-reference terminal.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电压和电流参考方向；关联参考方向；功率符号与单位换算。Voltage and current reference directions; passive sign convention; power signs and unit conversion.
先看箭头是否流入标“+”的端子，再把带符号的数值代入公式。First check whether the current arrow enters the terminal marked +, then substitute the signed values.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确认参考方向Check the reference directions

A和B的电流参考方向都流入电压正参考端，因此两者吸收功率公式均为p=ui。For both A and B, the current reference enters the positive voltage-reference terminal, so absorbed power is p=ui.

pabs=ui

计算ACalculate A

A的电压为负，按给定参考方向直接代入。负吸收功率表示该元件实际提供功率。Substitute the signed voltage for A. A negative absorbed power means that the element delivers power.

pA=(−3)(5)=−15W

计算B并统一单位Calculate B and convert units

把−2mA换成−0.002A。B的吸收功率为−0.010W，即−10mW。Convert −2mA to −0.002A. B absorbs −0.010W, or −10mW.

pB=5(−2×10−3)=−0.010W=−10mW

A吸收−15W（提供15W）；B吸收−10mW（提供10mW）。A absorbs −15W (delivers 15W); B absorbs −10mW (delivers 10mW).

易错点Common errors

  • 不要因i为负而翻转箭头后仍代入原负值，避免重复改符号。Do not reverse the arrow for a negative current and then keep the original negative value; that would change the sign twice.
  • mA与A相差1000倍。mA and A differ by a factor of 1000.

核验依据Verification

按关联参考方向独立计算，并与书第332页（PDF341页）1-5参考答案逐项一致。Independently calculated using the passive sign convention and matched item by item to answer 1-5 on printed p. 332 (PDF p. 341).

1-6全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第32页／PDF第41页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 32 · PDF p. 41. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

局部电路KCL：允许未知电流取负Local KCL: allow a negative unknown current

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-4所示部分电路中的电流i1和i2。Find currents i1 and i2 in the partial circuit of Fig. 1-4.

左节点2A流入、5A流出；4A源从左到右；下方电阻i1参考向右。右节点8A流出、6A流入；i2参考从右下方流入。At the left node 2A enters and 5A leaves. A4A source points left to right, as does bottom reference i1. At the right node 8A leaves and 6A enters; i2 enters from the lower right.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

基尔霍夫电流定律；按参考箭头代数求和；整体边界电流守恒。Kirchhoff’s current law, algebraic currents in their reference directions and boundary-current conservation.
每个节点写一条“流入=流出”。未知量先按题目箭头保留，求出负值后再解释实际方向。Write entering = leaving at each node. Keep each unknown in the given reference, then interpret its actual direction after solving.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

左节点求i1Use the left node for i1

2A流入；5A、4A和参考i1流出，所以2=5+4+i1。2A enters; 5A, 4A and reference i1 leave, giving 2=5+4+i1.

2=5+4+i1⇒i1=−7A

右节点求i2Use the right node for i2

4A、参考i1、6A及i2流入，8A流出。代入i1=−7A，得到i2=5A。4A, reference i1, 6A and i2 enter; 8A leaves. Substituting i1=−7A gives i2=5A.

4+i1+6+i2=8⇒i2=5A

i1=−7A（实际由右向左7A）；i2=5A（按原图从右下方流入右节点）。i1=−7A, actually 7A right to left. i2=5A, entering the right node from the lower right as drawn.

易错点Common errors

  • i1在右节点参考流入，代入时必须保留−7A，不能改成+7而不改箭头。At the right node i1 is referenced inward; retain −7A unless you also reverse its arrow.
  • 4A是连接两个节点的内部电流，整体边界KCL中会相消。The 4A source is internal to the two-node region and cancels in the boundary KCL.

核验依据Verification

独立整体边界核验：外部总流入2+6+5=13A，总流出5+8=13A；内部4A和i1均相消。另独立联立两节点方程得到同样的−7、5A。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-6一致。Independent boundary check: external inflow 2+6+5=13A equals outflow 5+8=13A; internal 4A and i1 cancel. An independent simultaneous solve of both node equations gives −7 and 5A. This matches appendix 1-6 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-7指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第32页／PDF第41页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 32 · PDF p. 41. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：1-7Assigned requirement: 1-7

已知支路电流，结合KCL与KVL求未知电流Use KCL and KVL with known branch currents

题目原文Transcribed question

题图1-5所示电路为某电路的一部分，已知i1=6A，i2=−2A，求图中电流i。The circuit in Fig. 1-5 is part of a larger circuit. Given i1=6A and i2=−2A, find the current i shown in the figure.

三个左端口分别经3Ω电阻接入上、中、下节点，i1、i2、i3参考方向均向右。上、中节点间6Ω，中、下节点间18Ω，上、下节点间右支路12Ω；待求i沿12Ω向下。Three left ports connect through 3Ω resistors to the upper, middle, and lower nodes; i1, i2, and i3 all point right. There are 6Ω between upper and middle nodes, 18Ω between middle and lower nodes, and 12Ω in the right branch from upper to lower, with unknown i pointing downward.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、电阻关联参考方向。KCL, KVL, and the resistor passive sign convention.
已有两个注入电流，先用KCL把内部支路电流都写成i，再对两条上到下的路径列一次KVL；不用求三个左端口的电压。With two injection currents already known, use KCL to express the internal branch currents in terms of i, then equate the voltage drops along the two upper-to-lower paths. The left-port voltages are unnecessary.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

上节点列KCLApply KCL at the upper node

设6Ω中的电流向下为i6。流入的6A分成i和i6，所以i6=6−i。Let i6 point downward through 6Ω. The 6A entering the upper node splits into i and i6.

i6=6−i

中节点列KCLApply KCL at the middle node

设18Ω中的电流向下为i18。i2=−2A已经包含参考方向的信息，因此i18=i6+i2=4−i。Let i18 point downward through 18Ω. The value i2=−2A already includes its reference-direction sign, so i18=i6+i2=4−i.

i18=i6+i2=4−i

同起点、同终点的电压相等Equate voltage drops between the same nodes

上到下经12Ω的电压降为12i；经6Ω和18Ω的总电压降为6(6−i)+18(4−i)。The voltage drop from upper to lower is 12i through 12Ω and 6(6−i)+18(4−i) through the other path.

12i=6(6−i)+18(4−i)

解方程并解释方向Solve and interpret the direction

整理得36i=108，故i=3A。正号表示实际方向与图中向下的箭头一致。Rearranging gives 36i=108, so i=3A. The positive result agrees with the downward arrow.

i=3A

i=3A，沿12Ω电阻向下。i=3A, downward through the 12Ω resistor.

易错点Common errors

  • i2=−2A表示中间端口实际流出2A，KCL中保留负号。i2=−2A means 2A actually leaves the middle port; retain the negative sign in KCL.
  • 三个3Ω电阻的电流已给定或可由整体KCL确定，求i不需要先算它们的压降。The port currents are given or follow from overall KCL; their 3Ω voltage drops are unnecessary for finding i.

核验依据Verification

第二种方法：以下节点为0V独立列节点方程，得上节点36V、中节点18V，故i=3612=3A。内部电流i6=3A、i18=1A满足全部KCL；书第332页（PDF341页）答案亦为3A。Independent nodal check with the lower node at 0V gives upper 36V and middle 18V, hence i=3612=3A. Internal currents i6=3A and i18=1A satisfy every KCL equation. The answer on printed p. 332 (PDF p. 341) is also 3A.

1-8全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

复杂极性图：先赋节点电位A polarity-heavy figure: assign node potentials first

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-6所示电路中的电压u1、u2和u3。Find voltages u1, u2 and u3 in Fig. 1-6.

菱形节点T顶、B底、L左、R右。外10V源T正B负；左下10V为L正B负；右下6V为R正B负。u1为L正R负，u2为R正T负，u3为T正L负。Diamond nodes are T top, B bottom, L left and R right. Outer 10V is positive at T relative to B; lower-left 10V at L relative to B; lower-right 6V at R relative to B. u1=VL−VR, u2=VR−VT and u3=VT−VL.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点电位；电压等于正端电位减负端电位；KVL。Node potentials, voltage as positive-terminal potential minus negative-terminal potential, and KVL.
将底节点设为0V，可直接读出T、L、R三个电位。随后所有未知电压只需按图示极性相减，避免在斜边上反复判断符号。Set the bottom node to zero and directly read T, L and R. Obtain each unknown by subtracting the negative-terminal potential from the positive-terminal potential.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

选择参考节点Choose a reference node

令VB=0。三个已知电压分别给出VT=10V、VL=10V、VR=6V。Choose VB=0. The given voltages yield VT=10V, VL=10V and VR=6V.

VB=0,VT=10,VL=10,VR=6(V)

按三个未知量的正负端相减Subtract using each unknown polarity

u1左正右负；u2右节点为正、顶节点为负；u3顶节点为正、左节点为负。u1 is positive at L and negative at R. u2 is positive at R and negative at T. u3 is positive at T and negative at L.

u1=VL−VR=4V,u2=VR−VT=−4V,u3=VT−VL=0

u1=4V，u2=−4V，u3=0V。u1=4V, u2=−4V and u3=0V.

易错点Common errors

  • 原图斜向正号旋转后外形近似×，应结合两端极性看清位置。The rotated plus signs resemble ×; identify which end of each diagonal branch is positive.
  • 两端都有10V对地电位时，端间电压是0，不是20V。Two terminals each at 10V relative to ground have zero voltage between them, not 20V.

核验依据Verification

独立KVL核验：中央三边环路u1+u2+u3=4−4+0=0。节点差值同时重现外10V、左下10V及右下6V三个已知量。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-8一致。Independent KVL check: u1+u2+u3=4−4+0=0 around the central triangle. The potentials also reproduce all three given 10V, 10V and 6V differences. This matches appendix 1-8 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-9全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

各元件功率：先统一节点，再判断关联方向Element power: solve nodes, then use passive signs

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-7所示，已知i1=2A，i3=−3A，u1=10V，u4=−5V，试求各元件吸收的功率。In Fig. 1-7, i1=2A, i3=−3A, u1=10V and u4=−5V. Find the power absorbed by each element.

四元件：1在上方，u1左正右负而i1向左；2在左竖支路，u2上正下负；3在中竖支路，u3上负下正而i3向下；4在右竖支路，u4上正下负。底部为共节点。Element 1 is on top, with u1 positive left and i1 leftward. Element 2 is on the left, u2 positive at top. Element 3 is central, u3 positive at bottom and i3 downward. Element 4 is on the right, u4 positive at top. The bottom is common.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL；节点电位；关联方向p吸收=ui，非关联方向p吸收=−ui；总功率守恒。KCL, node potentials, absorbed p=ui for passive references or −ui for opposite references, and total power balance.
不能对所有元件机械使用ui。先由u4和u1求两个上节点电位，再用KCL补齐支路电流，逐个按“流入高参考端”的规则求吸收功率。Do not blindly use ui for every element. Determine the two upper potentials from u4 and u1, recover currents by KCL, then evaluate each absorbed power with its reference polarity.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

设底部为0V求节点电位Set the bottom to zero and recover potentials

令右上节点B、左上节点A。u4=VB=−5V，u1=VA−VB=10V，故VA=5V；于是u2=5V、u3=0−VB=5V。Let B be upper right and A upper left. u4=VB=−5V and u1=VA−VB=10V, so VA=5V. Therefore u2=5V and u3=0−VB=5V.

VB=−5,VA=5,u2=u3=5(V)

用KCL补齐元件2和4电流Use KCL for elements 2 and 4

元件2从A向下电流为i2=i1=2A。定义元件4向下为i4，B点流出代数和i1+i3+i4=0，所以i4=1A。Element 2 carries i2=i1=2A downward from A. Define i4 downward; the outgoing sum at B is i1+i3+i4=0, giving i4=1A.

i2=2A,i4=−(2−3)=1A

逐个计算吸收功率Compute each absorbed power

1和3的图示电流均从电压负参考端流入，故用−ui；2和4用ui。元件3应为−5×(−3)=15W。For 1 and 3 the drawn current enters the negative voltage-reference terminal, so use −ui. For 2 and 4 use ui. Element 3 absorbs −5×(−3)=15W.

p1=−u1i1=−20W,p2=u2i2=10W,p3=−u3i3=15W,p4=u4i4=−5W

用功率守恒审查答案Audit the answer with power balance

四元件吸收功率之和−20+10+15−5=0。1和4总共提供25W，2和3总共吸收25W。附录把元件3印成5W会使总和变成−10W，不满足守恒。The sum −20+10+15−5 = 0. Elements 1 and 4 deliver 25W, while 2 and 3 absorb 25W. The appendix value 5W for element 3 instead gives −10W total, violating conservation.

∑k=14pk=0

按元件1、2、3、4顺序：−20W、10W、15W、−5W。负值表示提供功率。附录第三个值5W有误。For elements 1, 2, 3 and 4: −20W, 10W, 15W and −5W. Negative values mean delivered power. The appendix’s third value 5W is wrong.

易错点Common errors

  • 元件3的u3上负下正、i3向下，属于非关联参考方向。For element 3u3 is positive at the bottom while i3 points down, so the references are nonpassive.
  • 有符号的i3=−3A要直接代入，不能丢掉负号。Substitute the signed i3=−3A without discarding its negative sign.

核验依据Verification

独立按物理支路首末节点计算p=(V起−V终)i，四项仍为−20、10、15、−5W；全部节点KCL和总功率残差均为0。题干和完整极性原图第33页、PDF42页清楚；附录第332页、PDF341页印第三项5W，与节点电位和功率守恒同时冲突。Independent physical branch calculation p=(Vstart−Vend)i gives −20, 10, 15 and −5W, with zero KCL residual at every node and zero power residual. The original statement and full polarity diagram on printed p. 33 and PDF p. 42 are clear. The appendix’s third value 5W on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 conflicts with both node potentials and power conservation.

1-10全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

对地电压求支路电流：分清4Ω与4SFrom node voltage to current: distinguish 4Ω from 4S

题目原文Transcribed question

电阻元件两端的对地电压如题图1-8所示，求通过各电阻元件的电流i。The terminal voltages relative to ground are shown in Fig. 1-8. Find current i through each resistive element.

(a)左端3V、右端1V，电阻4Ω，i参考向左。(b)左端u1、右端u2，标注电导4S，i参考向左。(a) Left terminal 3V, right 1V, resistance 4Ω, with i leftward. (b) Left terminal u1, right u2, conductance 4S, again with i leftward.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

欧姆定律i=ΔVR=GΔV；S为西门子，1S=1Ω−1；按电流箭头选电压差。Ohm’s law i=ΔVR=GΔV, Siemens 1S=1Ω−1, and the voltage drop along the current reference.
两图电流都由右向左，因此电压差都取“右端减左端”。(a)给电阻，除以4；(b)给电导，乘以4。Both currents are referenced right to left, so use right-terminal minus left-terminal voltage. Divide by 4 for the resistance in (a), but multiply by 4 for the conductance in (b).
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a)电阻形式(a): resistance form

沿i向左的电压降为1−3=−2V，除以4Ω得到−0.5A，实际电流向右。The voltage drop along leftward i is 1−3=−2V. Dividing by 4Ω gives −0.5A, actually rightward.

i=1−34=−0.5A

(b)电导形式(b): conductance form

图中4S是电导，不是4Ω。等效电阻为14Ω；因此i=G(u2−u1)=4(u2−u1)。The original 4S is conductance, not 4Ω. Its equivalent resistance is 14Ω, so i=G(u2−u1)=4(u2−u1).

G=4S,R=14Ω,i=4(u2−u1)Awhen voltages are in V

(a)i=−0.5A；(b)i=4(u2−u1)A（u1、u2以V计，原图给的是4S电导）。(a)i=−0.5A. (b)i=4(u2−u1)A for voltages in volts; the original figure gives 4S conductance.

易错点Common errors

  • S和Ω表示互为倒数的物理量，不能将(b)当成4Ω。S and Ω describe reciprocal quantities; do not read (b) as 4Ω.
  • 对地电位不能直接当电阻端电压，先沿参考箭头做两端差。A single ground-referenced potential is not the resistor voltage; take the terminal difference along the reference.

核验依据Verification

独立量纲与功率核验：(a)吸收功率(−2V)(−0.5A)=1W；(b)S×V=A，且p=4(u2−u1)2≥0；以等效R=0.25Ω计算得到相同电流。高分辨率原图确认4S，附录第332页、PDF341页两问均正确。Independent dimensional and power checks: (a) absorbs (−2V)(−0.5A)=1W. (b) has S×V=A and p=4(u2−u1)2≥0; using equivalent R=0.25Ω gives the same current. High-resolution inspection confirms 4S, and both appendix answers on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 are correct.

1-11全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

有分流的电阻链：从末端逐级累加电流A tapped resistor chain: accumulate current from the bottom

题目原文Transcribed question

电阻电路中各点对地电压及各支路电流如题图1-9所示，求各电阻的阻值。Ground-referenced node voltages and branch currents are shown in Fig. 1-9. Find all resistor values.

30V经R1至24V节点，该处向右流出10mA；R2下接12V节点，向右流出15mA；R3下接6V节点，向右流出20mA；R4下接0V，向下电流5mA。30V connects through R1 to 24V, which has 10mA outgoing. R2 leads to 12V with 15mA outgoing; R3 to 6V with 20mA outgoing; R4 to 0V carries 5mA downward.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL累加分流；电阻端电压为相邻节点差；mA换算。KCL with outgoing taps, adjacent-node voltage differences and mA conversion.
这不是四只电阻同流的简单串联链。每层有分流，应从已知最底5mA向上逐层加上流出的电流，再用各自压降除以各自电流。The four resistors do not share one current because taps draw current. Start from the given 5mA at the bottom, add each outgoing tap upward, then divide each voltage drop by its own current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从R4向上做KCLApply KCL upward from R4

R4电流为5mA；R3须另供20mA，故25mA；R2须另供15mA，故40mA；R1须另供10mA，故50mA。R4 carries 5mA. R3 must also supply 20mA, so it carries 25mA; R2 adds 15mA to reach 40mA; R1 adds 10mA to reach 50mA.

I4=5,I3=25,I2=40,I1=50(mA)

用相邻节点压降求RUse adjacent-node drops for R

各段压降依次为6、12、6、6V，除以各段电流50、40、25、5mA。The respective voltage drops are 6, 12, 6 and 6V. Divide by the corresponding currents 50, 40, 25 and 5mA.

R1=60.05=120Ω,R2=120.04=300Ω,R3=60.025=240Ω,R4=60.005=1200Ω

R1=120Ω，R2=300Ω，R3=240Ω，R4=1200Ω。R1=120Ω, R2=300Ω, R3=240Ω and R4=1200Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 每个节点有支路分流，不能令四只电阻电流相同。The node taps draw current, so the four resistor currents are unequal.
  • VmA直接给出kΩ；若答案写Ω，先把mA化为A。VmA gives kΩ; convert mA to A when reporting Ω.

核验依据Verification

独立逐节点回代KCL全部为0；源输入30×0.05=1.5W，电阻共吸收0.96W，三个外接端口带走24×0.01+12×0.015+6×0.02=0.54W，和为1.5W。高分辨率附录第332页、PDF341页R4实际印为1200Ω，与结果一致。Independent node-by-node substitution gives zero KCL residual. Input power is 30×0.05=1.5W; resistors absorb 0.96W and the three external ports take 24×0.01+12×0.015+6×0.02=0.54W, totaling 1.5W. High-resolution appendix inspection confirms R4=1200Ω on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341, matching the result.

1-12全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

理想电压源并联电阻：电压固定，源电流调整A resistor across an ideal voltage source: voltage fixed, source current adjusts

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-10所示，其中Us为理想电压源，试判断当外电路不变，仅电阻R变化时，将会引起电路中哪条支路电流的变化。In Fig. 1-10, Us is an ideal voltage source. With the external circuit unchanged, determine which branch current changes when only R changes.

理想电压源Us上正下负，与R并联，共同接到右侧外电路端口；端口u上正下负，外电流i由上端向右流出。An ideal top-positive voltage source Us is parallel with R and the right external port. Port u is positive at the top and external current i leaves the upper terminal to the right.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想电压源固定端电压；并联电压相同；KCL；固定外电路的工作点。Fixed ideal-source voltage, common parallel voltage, KCL and the operating point of an unchanged external circuit.
Us直接钳定外端口电压u=Us。R变化会改变自身电流，但外电路输入电压未变，因此其原工作电流i不变；理想源会补足R电流变化。Us directly fixes port voltage u=Us. Changing R changes its own current. The external circuit retains the same voltage and its operating current i; the ideal source supplies the extra resistor current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先固定端口电压Fix the port voltage first

理想电压源与外端口并联，故u始终等于Us。对工作点确定的固定外电路，i由这个固定端电压决定，因此不随R变化。The ideal voltage source is across the external port, so u remains Us. For an unchanged external circuit with a determined operating point, i is fixed by this voltage and does not change with R.

u=Us,iexternal unchanged

写出R支路及电源支路电流Write resistor and source currents

定义R中向下电流iR，电源从下向上供出电流is。则iR=UsR，节点KCL为is=i+iR。一般R变化时，iR和is都相应变化；端口i不变。Define iR downward through R and is upward supplied by the source. Then iR=UsR and KCL gives is=i+iR. In general both iR and is change as R changes, while external i remains fixed.

iR=UsR,is=i+UsR

补充附录简答省略的源电流Complete the appendix’s abbreviated statement

附录只写“电阻R支路的电流变化”，说明了R支路的变化，但若把电源支路也计入题目，电源电流必须同步调整，不能宣称其恒定。若Us=0等退化情况，具体变化由上述公式判断。The appendix states only that the resistor-branch current changes. This identifies R’s response, but if the source branch is included, its current must adjust as well. The formulas also cover degenerate cases such as Us=0.

一般R变化会使R支路电流iR=UsR变化，理想电压源供出电流is=i+iR也随之调整；外电路电流i不变。In general changing R changes iR=UsR and also the ideal source’s supplied current is=i+iR. External current i is unchanged.

易错点Common errors

  • 理想电压源固定的是电压，不是自身电流。An ideal voltage source fixes its voltage, not its current.
  • “外电路电流不变”不能推广成“源支路电流也不变”。Unchanged external current does not imply unchanged source current.

核验依据Verification

独立数值反例与功率核验：Us=10V，固定外负载10Ω。R从10Ω变到5Ω时，外电流保持1A；R电流1→2A，源电流2→3A。源功率20→30W，恰等于外负载10W加R功率10→20W。附录第332页、PDF341页定性简答省略了这项源电流调整，记录中已补全。Independent numerical and power check: with Us=10V and fixed external 10Ω load, changing R from 10 to 5Ω leaves external current at 1A, increases resistor current from 1 to 2A and source current from 2 to 3A. Source power rises from 20 to 30W, balancing the fixed 10W external load plus 10 to 20W in R. The qualitative appendix answer on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 omits the source-current adjustment, which is included here.

1-13全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

含源支路特性：下降斜率的绝对值就是RA source-containing branch: resistance is the negative slope

题目原文Transcribed question

一段含源支路及其u−i特性如题图1-11所示，图中3条直线对应于电阻R的3个不同数值R1、R2、R3，试根据该图判断各电阻的大小关系。A source-containing branch and its u−i characteristics are shown in Fig. 1-11. The three lines correspond to R1, R2 and R3. Determine their ordering.

串联电压源Us上正下负、上方电阻R，电流i向上并从正端口流出；端电压u上正下负。u−i图纵轴u、横轴i，R1线水平，R2缓降，R3陡降，共同纵截距Us。A top-positive source Us is series with R above it. Current i flows upward and leaves the positive port; u is top-positive. The plot has u vertical and i horizontal: R1 horizontal, R2 gently descending, R3 steeply descending, all intercepting Us.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KVL；含源支路端口特性；u−i图斜率dudi=−R。KVL, source-containing port characteristics and slope dudi=−R.
先按端口电流“流出正端”的参考方向写u=Us−Ri。电阻越大，曲线随电流下降越快；不要套用无源电阻的正斜率。Because current leaves the positive port, the branch law is u=Us−Ri. Greater resistance gives a steeper downward line; do not use the positive slope of a passive resistor reference.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从原图写端口关系Write the port law from the figure

电流从源正端向上流过R，电阻压降为Ri，端口剩余电压为Us−Ri。Current rises from the source’s positive terminal through R, dropping Ri. The remaining port voltage is Us−Ri.

u=Us−Ri,dudi=−R

用斜率绝对值比较RCompare negative-slope magnitudes

R1曲线水平，所以R1=0；R3比R2下降更陡，因此R3>R2>0。R1’s line is horizontal, giving R1=0.R3 descends more steeply than R2, so R3>R2>0.

R1=0<R2<R3

R1=0，且R1<R2<R3。R1=0 and R1<R2<R3.

易错点Common errors

  • 图的横轴为i、纵轴为u，斜率单位才是Ω；轴反过来则读的是电导。With i horizontal and u vertical, the slope has units Ω; reversed axes would describe conductance.
  • 此题电流流出正端口，特性斜率为−R，不能直接用+R。Here current leaves the positive port, so the slope is −R rather than +R.

核验依据Verification

独立固定正电流比较：三条线同截距Us，若i>0，则u1>u2>u3；由R=(Us−u)i即得R1<R2<R3。再以有限差分检查ΔuΔi=−R。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-13一致。Independent fixed-current comparison: all lines share intercept Us; for i>0, u1>u2>u3. Then R=(Us−u)i gives R1<R2<R3. A finite-difference check also gives ΔuΔi=−R. This matches appendix 1-13 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-14全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

电流源网络：外节点KCL直接确定电阻压降Current-source network: outer-node KCL fixes resistor drops

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-12所示电路中的uae、ube、ucf、udf、uef。Find uae, ube, ucf, udf and uef in Fig. 1-12.

外矩形节点a左下、b左上、c右上、d右下，内部e左、f右。电流源a→b为1A，b→c为2A，a→d为3A，d→c为4A。电阻b−e为5Ω、a−e为4Ω、c−f为10Ω、d−f为8Ω、e−f为20Ω。Outer nodes are a lower left, b upper left, c upper right, d lower right; inner e left and f right. Sources: a→b1A, b→c2A, a→d3A, d→c4A. Resistors: b−e5Ω, a−e4Ω, c−f10Ω, d−f8Ω, e−f20Ω.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL；电阻电压uxy=Vx−Vy；电流源方向；节点法与全电路功率守恒。KCL, uxy=Vx−Vy, source directions, nodal analysis and full-network power conservation.
四个外节点各只连一只电阻，另两支路是已知电流源，因此每只外围电阻的电流可以直接由KCL确定。再到e点求20Ω电流；无需先解大量未知电压。Each outer node has one resistor and two known current sources, so KCL directly determines each outer resistor current. Then use node e for the 20Ω current, avoiding an unnecessary large voltage calculation.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

左侧a、b节点Use left nodes a and b

a向外流出1+3=4A，故e→a为4A，uae=−4×4=−16V。b流入1A、流出2A，故e→b为1A，ube=−1×5=−5V。At a, sources take 1+3=4A outward, so e→a carries 4A and uae=−4×4=−16V. At b, 1A enters and 2A leaves, so e→b is 1A and ube=−1×5=−5V.

uae=−16V,ube=−5V

右侧c、d节点Use right nodes c and d

c收到2+4=6A，故c→f为6A，ucf=6×10=60V。d收到3A、流出4A，故f→d为1A，udf=−1×8=−8V。At c, sources deliver 2+4=6A, so c→f carries 6A and ucf=6×10=60V. At d, 3A enters and 4A leaves, so f→d is 1A and udf=−1×8=−8V.

ucf=60V,udf=−8V

e节点求中央20Ω压降Use node e for the central 20Ω drop

e向a、b分别流出4A、1A，总共5A，所以中央支路必须由f向e流入5A。uef=−5×20=−100V。e sends 4A to a and 1A to b, so 5A must enter from f. Therefore uef=−5×20=−100V.

ie→f=−5A,uef=−100V

建立一组节点电位用于回代Construct node potentials for substitution

取Ve=0，可得Va=−16、Vb=−5、Vf=100、Vc=160、Vd=92V。它们重现五个所求电压以及每个电流源节点的KCL。With Ve=0, obtain Va=−16, Vb=−5, Vf=100, Vc=160 and Vd=92V. These reproduce all five requested differences and source-node KCL.

(Va,Vb,Vc,Vd,Ve,Vf)=(−16,−5,160,92,0,100)V

uae=−16V；ube=−5V；ucf=60V；udf=−8V；uef=−100V。uae=−16V; ube=−5V; ucf=60V; udf=−8V; uef=−100V.

易错点Common errors

  • uae表示Va−Ve；不能只把电阻压降大小当作答案。uae means Va−Ve; the unsigned drop magnitude is insufficient.
  • d点电流源3A流入、4A流出，因此电阻实际电流必须由f流向d。At d the sources provide 3A inward but 4A outward, so the resistor current must run from f to d.

核验依据Verification

独立按原图搭建五节点电导矩阵，以有理数高斯消元求得Va=−16、Vb=−5、Vc=160、Vd=92、Vf=100V（Ve=0），全部节点残差精确为0。五电阻功率为5、64、360、8、500W，总937W；四源吸收功率−11、−330、−324、−272W，总−937W，全电路功率和0。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-14五项全部一致。An independent five-node conductance matrix stamped from the original topology and solved by exact rational Gaussian elimination gives Va=−16, Vb=−5, Vc=160, Vd=92 and Vf=100V with Ve=0; every nodal residual is exactly zero. Resistor powers 5, 64, 360, 8 and 500W total 937W. Source absorbed powers −11, −330, −324 and −272W total −937W, giving zero overall power. All five values match appendix 1-14 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-15全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

指定端电压反求电源：由固定电压逐层做KCLRecover the source from a target terminal voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-13所示，欲使uAB=5V，问电压源电压us应是多少？For Fig. 1-13, determine source voltage us so that uAB=5V.

B为底部公共节点、A为上节点。左源us上正下负，其上端经1Ω接A。A与中节点M之间5V源上正下负；M经1Ω接B。右支路A经1Ω接N、N经1Ω接B。10A源由M向右流入N。B is the bottom common node and A the top node. The top-positive left source us connects through 1Ω to A. A top-positive 5V source joins A to middle M; M connects through 1Ω to B. On the right A connects through 1Ω to N and N through 1Ω to B. A10A source runs from M to N.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第43页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点电位；理想电压源约束；KCL；按实际压降求源电压。Node potentials, ideal-source constraints, KCL and voltage drops.
目标uAB先给出A电位，5V源随即给出中节点电位。先对右中节点列KCL，再对A、M组成的超节点列KCL，可以直接反求左源。The target fixes A, and the 5V source then fixes M. Apply KCL first at the right-middle node, then to the A–M supernode to recover the left source.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

固定A、M电位Fix A and M potentials

取VB=0，目标uAB=5V给出VA=5V。5V源要求VA−VM=5V，因此VM=0，中央下方1Ω无电流。Choose VB=0. The target gives VA=5V. The 5V source imposes VA−VM=5V, so VM=0 and the center-bottom 1Ω carries no current.

VA=5,VM=VA−5=0(V)

右中节点求VNUse the right-middle node for VN

10A向N流入；从N流向A和B的电阻电流之和为10A。The 10A source enters N; the resistor currents from N to A and B total 10A.

VN−51+VN−01=10⇒VN=7.5V

超节点求左源电压Use the supernode for the left source

A、M超节点向外流出：(5−us)1、(5−7.5)1、01和10A。令其代数和为0，解得us=12.5V。Outgoing currents of the A–M supernode are (5−us)1, (5−7.5)1, 01 and 10A. Their algebraic sum is zero, giving us=12.5V.

(5−us)+(5−7.5)+0+10=0⇒us=12.5V

us=12.5V（原图上正下负）。us=12.5V, positive at the top as drawn.

易错点Common errors

  • 10A源由中央流向右侧，不能在N点按流出10A列式。The 10A source enters N from the center; do not count it as 10A leaving N.
  • uAB是A相对B的电压，参考节点可直接选B。uAB is A relative to B, so B is a convenient reference.

核验依据Verification

独立原拓扑MNA回代us=12.5V，得到A=5、M=0、N=7.5V，重现目标。四只电阻总耗散118.75W；5V源吸收50W，左源提供93.75W，10A源提供75W，吸收功率总和0。与第332页、PDF341页1-15的12.5V一致。Independent MNA of the original topology with us=12.5V gives A=5, M=0 and N=7.5V, reproducing the target. The four resistors dissipate 118.75W; the 5V source absorbs 50W, the left source supplies 93.75W and the 10A source supplies 75W, yielding zero total absorbed power. This matches 12.5V in appendix 1-15 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-16全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

串联电流源定电流：逐个判断吸收和提供Series current source: classify every element by passive power

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-14所示，若us>0，is>0，R>0，请指出电路中各元件是吸收功率还是提供功率。In Fig. 1-14, us>0, is>0 and R>0. State whether each element absorbs or supplies power.

单回路：左电压源us上正下负，顶端电阻R，右电流源is向上。电流由右上向左穿过R，再从电压源正端向下流过电压源。One loop contains a top-positive left voltage source us, upper resistor R and right current source is pointing up. Current runs right to left through R, then downward into the voltage source’s positive terminal.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第43页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

串联支路同流；电阻功率Ri2；电流流入正端为吸收；KVL。Equal series current, resistor power Ri2, passive sign convention and KVL.
电流源把全回路电流固定为is>0。顺着这个实际电流画方向，可以直接看出电压源的电流进入正端；电流源承担供给两者吸收功率。The current source fixes the loop current at positive is. Following that actual direction shows current entering the voltage source’s positive terminal. The current source supplies the power absorbed by the other two elements.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

电阻一定吸收The resistor absorbs

R>0且is>0，所以电阻耗散Ris2>0。R>0 and is>0 give positive resistor dissipation Ris2.

pR=Ris2>0

电压源也吸收The voltage source also absorbs

电流沿左支路向下，从us正端流入，故pUs=usis>0。电压源不一定供电，本题明确在吸收功率。Current goes downward in the left branch and enters the positive us terminal, giving pUs=usis>0. This voltage source absorbs power.

pUs=usis>0

电流源提供两者所需功率The current source supplies both loads

右源上端电位为us+Ris，电流却由下向上，因此其吸收功率为−(us+Ris)is<0，即提供相同大小的功率。The right source’s top potential is us+Ris, but current rises from bottom to top. Its absorbed power is −(us+Ris)is<0, so it supplies that magnitude.

pIs=−(us+Ris)is<0,pR+pUs+pIs=0

电阻R和电压源us吸收功率；电流源is提供功率。R and voltage source us absorb power; current source is supplies power.

易错点Common errors

  • 电源元件也可以吸收功率，不能只根据名称判断。A source element can absorb power; its name alone does not determine the power sign.
  • 先跟随is的向上箭头，顶端电阻电流是向左，不是向右。Follow the upward is arrow: current through the upper resistor is leftward.

核验依据Verification

独立符号功率平衡Ris2+usis−(us+Ris)is恒等于0。另以us=3V、is=2A、R=4Ω搭建原拓扑MNA，电阻、电压源、电流源吸收功率分别16、6、−22W，节点方程及功率残差精确为0。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-16一致。The symbolic power sum Ris2+usis−(us+Ris)is is identically zero. Independent original-topology MNA with us=3V, is=2A and R=4Ω gives absorbed powers 16, 6 and −22W for resistor, voltage source and current source, with exact zero residuals. This matches appendix 1-16 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-17全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第33页／PDF第42页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 33 · PDF p. 42. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

并联理想源的功率：电压源也会吸收Parallel ideal sources: a voltage source can absorb power

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-15所示，试验证该电路功率守恒。Verify power conservation for the circuit in Fig. 1-15.

三支路并联：左1V电压源上正下负，中1Ω电阻，右2A电流源向上。Three parallel branches: a left top-positive 1V source, central 1Ω resistor and right 2A source pointing up.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第43页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

并联共电压；欧姆定律；KCL确定电压源电流；有符号功率守恒。Common parallel voltage, Ohm’s law, KCL for voltage-source current and signed power balance.
先用1V源确定所有支路电压，再由电阻电流和2A注入电流求左源电流。只有把电压源的吸收功率也计入才能验证守恒。Use the 1V source to fix every branch voltage, then obtain the voltage-source current from resistor current and 2A injection. Include the voltage source’s absorbed power in the balance.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求电阻与电压源电流Find resistor and voltage-source currents

电阻上下电压1V，向下电流11=1A。右源向上注入2A，因此剩余1A从左电压源向下流回。The resistor has 1V top to bottom and carries 1A downward. The right source injects 2A upward, so the remaining 1A flows downward through the voltage source.

iR=1A,iV=2−1=1Adownward

按吸收功率统一记号Use absorbed power consistently

电阻吸收1W；电压源电流进入正端，吸收1W；电流源由低电位端向高电位端送2A，吸收功率−2W。The resistor absorbs 1W. Current enters the voltage source’s positive terminal, so it also absorbs 1W. The current source sends 2A from lower to higher potential, giving −2W absorbed.

pR=1,pV=1,pI=−2(W)

相加验证守恒Sum powers to verify conservation

全部吸收功率之和1+1−2=0；等价于电流源提供2W，电阻与电压源各吸收1W。Total absorbed power is 1+1−2 = 0. Equivalently, the current source supplies 2W and the resistor and voltage source each absorb 1W.

∑pabs=1+1−2=0

电阻吸收1W，1V电压源吸收1W，2A电流源提供2W；总吸收功率为0，功率守恒。The resistor absorbs 1W, the 1V source absorbs 1W and the 2A source supplies 2W. Total absorbed power is zero.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能遗漏1V源的电流；理想电压源的电流由KCL决定。Do not omit the 1V source current; KCL determines it.
  • 统一用吸收功率求和，提供功率应记负号。When summing absorbed power, record supplied power with a negative sign.

核验依据Verification

独立MNA解原三并联支路得到上节点1V、电压源向下1A；三元件功率1、1、−2W，KCL、KVL及功率残差精确为0。附录第332页、PDF341页从1-16跳到1-18，未列1-17答案，本题据原图独立完成。Independent MNA of the original three parallel branches gives top potential 1V and 1A downward through the voltage source. Powers 1, 1 and −2W give exact zero KCL and KVL and power residuals. The appendix on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 skips from 1-16 to 1-18, so 1-17 has no listed answer and is independently solved from the original figure.

1-18全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第34页／PDF第43页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

理想源并联电阻网络：电压源功率取决于负载Ideal sources in parallel: voltage-source power depends on load

题目原文Transcribed question

题图1-16所示电路中，若电压源us=10V，电流源is=1A，试说明电压源和电流源是否一定都在提供功率。In Fig. 1-16, us=10V and is=1A. Explain whether both sources necessarily supply power.

左1A电流源向上，中10V电压源上正下负，右侧为电阻网络；三者跨接同一上下节点。An upward 1A source, a top-positive 10V source and a resistor network are all parallel across common upper and lower nodes.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第43页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想电压源钳定电压；电阻网络等效电阻；KCL；源的功率正负。Ideal-source voltage clamping, equivalent network resistance, KCL and source power signs.
电压恒为10V，因此向上的1A源必定把电流送向高电位端，提供10W。电压源补充还是吸收剩余电流，取决于电阻网络需求是否超过1A。Voltage is fixed at 10V, so the upward 1A source always drives toward the higher potential and supplies 10W. The voltage source supplies a deficit or absorbs a surplus depending on whether the resistor network requires more or less than 1A.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

电流源一定提供10WThe current source always supplies 10W

电流源从下端向上端流1A，下到上电位升高10V，所以吸收功率为−10W，即提供10W。The current source carries 1A from bottom to top across a10V rise, so it absorbs −10W and supplies 10W.

PIs,supplied=10×1=10W

用等效电阻表示负载需求Express the load demand by equivalent resistance

设正常工作的正电阻网络等效为Req>0，其向下电流IR=10Req。定义电压源向上供出电流IV，则KCL给出IV=10Req−1。For an admissible positive equivalent resistance Req, the network draws downward IR=10Req. Define voltage-source supplied current IV upward; KCL gives IV=10Req−1.

IR=10Req,IV=10Req−1,PV,supplied=10(10Req−1)

分三种负载判断电压源Classify the voltage source in three cases

Req<10Ω时负载需超过1A，电压源提供功率；Req=10Ω时电压源电流为0；Req>10Ω时1A源供给过剩，电压源吸收功率。因此两源不一定都提供。If Req<10Ω, the load requires more than 1A and the voltage source supplies power. At 10Ω its current is zero. Above 10Ω the current source supplies a surplus and the voltage source absorbs it. Thus both sources need not supply power.

电流源一定提供10W；电压源不一定，随负载可提供、零功率或吸收功率，分界为Req=10Ω。The current source always supplies 10W. The voltage source may supply, exchange zero power or absorb power, with boundary Req=10Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 电压源保持10V，不意味着其电流或功率符号固定。Fixing 10V does not fix the voltage-source current or its power sign.
  • 并联理想电压源和电流源时，剩余电流由电压源承担。With parallel ideal voltage and current sources, the voltage source carries the remaining current.

核验依据Verification

独立原拓扑MNA分别取Req=5、10、20Ω，电压源提供功率分别10、0、−5W；电流源始终提供10W，电阻耗散20、10、5W，三种情况功率总和均精确为0。与附录第332页、PDF341页“电流源提供功率，电压源不一定”一致。Independent original-topology MNA for Req=5, 10 and 20Ω gives voltage-source supplied powers 10, 0 and −5W. The current source always supplies 10W; load dissipation is 20, 10 and 5W, with exact zero power residual in all cases. This matches the appendix statement on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 that the current source supplies power while the voltage source need not.

1-19全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第34页／PDF第43页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

电压源钳位与平衡桥：先求总负载电流Voltage clamp and balanced bridge: recover total load current

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-17所示电路中电流源和电压源提供的功率。Find the powers supplied by the current source and voltage source in Fig. 1-17.

左10A源向上，经顶端1Ω接20V上正下负源的上节点。该20V节点另接5Ω对地；右桥为10Ω20Ω左臂、20Ω40Ω右臂，两中点用30Ω相连。An upward 10A source feeds a top 1Ω into the positive node of a top-positive 20V source. That node also connects to ground through 5Ω and a bridge: 10Ω over 20Ω on the left, 20Ω over 40Ω on the right, joined at their midpoints by 30Ω.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第43页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想电压源固定负载电压；平衡桥；KCL；提供功率等于负吸收功率。Fixed load voltage, bridge balance, KCL and supplied power as negative absorbed power.
20V源直接固定右侧负载电压。电流源的10A全部先流过1Ω，因而源上端比20V节点再高10V；右侧桥臂比例相同，30Ω不取电流。The 20V source fixes the right load voltage. All 10A passes through 1Ω first, lifting the current-source top by 10V. The bridge ratios match, so the 30Ω branch carries zero current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求电流源电压与提供功率Find current-source voltage and supplied power

1Ω电流10A，从左向右压降10V；源上端电位为20+10=30V。电流从下向上，因此提供30×10=300W。The 1Ω resistor carries 10A left to right and drops 10V. The current-source top is 20+10=30V, so its upward current supplies 30×10=300W.

Vcurrent source=20+10(1)=30V,PI,supplied=300W

平衡桥求负载总电流Find total load current using bridge balance

1020=2040，故桥中点等电位，30Ω无电流。负载电流为205+2030+2060=4+23+13=5A。Since 1020=2040, the midpoints are equipotential and the 30Ω bridge has no current. Total load current is 205+2030+2060=4+23+13=5A.

Iload=205+2010+20+2020+40=5A

KCL确定20V源功率Use KCL for the 20V source power

流入顶节点10A，负载取5A，剩余5A向下流入20V源正端。因此电压源吸收100W，所问“提供功率”为−100W。10A enters the top node and the load takes 5A. The remaining 5A enters the 20V source’s positive terminal downward. It absorbs 100W, so its supplied power is −100W.

IV=10−5=5A downward,PV,supplied=−20(5)=−100W

电流源提供300W；电压源提供−100W，即吸收100W。The current source supplies 300W; the voltage source supplies −100W, meaning it absorbs 100W.

易错点Common errors

  • 提供功率可以为负，负值应解释成吸收，不应擅自改成+100W。Supplied power can be negative; interpret it as absorption rather than changing it to +100W.
  • 30Ω无电流来自桥臂比例相等，需要先检查平衡条件。The 30Ω carries no current because the bridge ratios match; check that condition first.

核验依据Verification

独立保留30Ω桥支路的完整MNA得到桥两中点均403V、源顶节点30V、电压源向下5A。1Ω耗散100W，右负载共100W，电压源吸收100W，恰等于电流源提供300W；全电路功率和0。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-19的300W、−100W一致。Independent full MNA retaining the 30Ω bridge gives both midpoints 403V, current-source top 30V and 5A down through the voltage source. The 1Ω resistor dissipates 100W, the right load 100W and voltage source absorbs 100W, balancing the 300W supplied by the current source. This matches 300W and −100W in appendix 1-19 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-20全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第34页／PDF第43页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

短接电流源串联电阻：右侧仍注入同样电流Bypass a resistor in series with a current source

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-18所示，试判断当开关S由打开到闭合时，电路中的电压u和电流i是否发生变化。In Fig. 1-18, determine whether voltage u and current i change when switch S closes.

左1A源向上，经左2Ω到顶节点T；S并联在左2Ω两端。中央T经2Ω到C、再经4Ω到底；右T经5Ω到D、再经4Ω到底。C、D间1V源左正右负。u为中央上2Ω上正下负；i为右下4Ω向下。An upward left 1A source connects through left 2Ω to top T, with S bypassing that resistor. T connects through center 2Ω to C, then 4Ω to bottom; through right 5Ω to D, then 4Ω to bottom. A1V source is positive at C relative to D. u is across upper center 2Ω, positive at T; i is downward through lower-right 4Ω.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第43页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想电流源固定注入电流；电流源串联电阻；超节点KCL；开关短接。Fixed current injection, a resistor in series with an ideal current source, supernode KCL and a shorting switch.
S只短接左源串联的2Ω。无论开关状态，理想源向右侧网络注入的净电流仍为1A；右侧元件和1V约束均未改变，因此其唯一稳态解中的u、i不变。S bypasses only the resistor in series with the left source. The ideal source still injects 1A into the right network in either state. With the right elements and 1V constraint unchanged, u and i retain the same unique steady-state values.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

识别固定的端口注入Identify unchanged port injection

开路时1A流经左2Ω后到T；闭合时1A改走开关到T，左2Ω被短路。右侧收到的总电流始终1A。With S open, 1A passes through left 2Ω to T. With S closed, it flows through the switch and the resistor is bypassed. The right network always receives 1A.

用右侧超节点求C、DUse the right-side supernode for C and D

取底部0V。C、D超节点向底部流出的电流之和等于注入1A，因此(VC+VD)4=1；1V源给VC−VD=1。解得VC=2.5、VD=1.5V。Take the bottom as zero. The C–D supernode sends the injected 1A to ground, so (VC+VD)4=1, while the source gives VC−VD=1. Thus VC=2.5V and VD=1.5V.

VC+VD=4,VC−VD=1⇒VC=52, VD=32

计算共同的u、i作为核验Compute the shared u and i as a check

T点KCL为(VT−2.5)2+(VT−1.5)5=1，得VT=5114V。故u=VT−VC=87V，i=VD4=38A，两种状态相同。KCL at T gives (VT−2.5)2+(VT−1.5)5=1, hence VT=5114V. Therefore u=VT−VC=87V and i=VD4=38A in either switch state.

u=87V,i=38Afor both states

u和i均不变；两种状态都为u=87V≈1.143V，i=38A=0.375A。Neither u nor i changes. Both states give u=87V≈1.143V and i=38A=0.375A.

易错点Common errors

  • 闭合S短接的是左侧2Ω，不是中央测u的2Ω。S bypasses the left 2Ω, not the central 2Ω across which u is measured.
  • 右侧u、i不变，不代表电流源端电压和左电阻功率不变。Unchanged right-side u and i do not imply unchanged current-source voltage or left-resistor power.

核验依据Verification

分别以开路原节点及闭合后合并节点建立独立MNA，两次都得到T=5114、C=52、D=32V及u=87V、i=38A，全部KCL、KVL精确满足。左源端电压开路7914V、闭合5114V，相差2V；左2Ω耗散由2W降为0，完整功率平衡两态均为0。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-20“不变”一致。Separate independent MNA models for the open topology and merged closed-switch node both give T=5114, C=52 and D=32V, with u=87V and i=38A, exactly satisfying KCL and KVL. Current-source voltage changes from 7914 to 5114V, and the bypassed resistor dissipation from 2W to zero; full power balance holds in both states. This matches “unchanged” in appendix 1-20 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-21全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第34页／PDF第43页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

部分电路的负电流箭头：逐节点传递到端电压Signed boundary arrows in a partial circuit

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-19所示部分电路中A、B两点间的电压UAB。Find UAB between A and B in the partial circuit of Fig. 1-19.

左上节点L经3Ω及8V左正右负源到A；L经5Ω到左下D，D经2Ω到中节点C；C经10Ω到开端B，并经2A源流向A。L的外引线箭头向外标−1A；D的外引线箭头向内标−1A。Upper-left L connects through 3Ω then an 8V left-positive source to A. L connects through 5Ω to lower-left D; D through 2Ω to C. C connects through 10Ω to open terminal B and through a2A source toward A. L has an outward boundary reference labeled −1A; D has an inward boundary reference labeled −1A.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第43页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

负参考电流的实际方向；局部KCL；开端支路电流0；电压沿路径相加。Actual directions of negative referenced currents, local KCL, zero current at an open terminal and voltage summation along a path.
先把两个−1A解释正确：上边界实际流入1A，下边界实际流出1A。A只有两条内部支路，2A源流入A后必从顶支路返回L；B为开端，10Ω压降为0。First interpret the boundary signs: 1A actually enters at the upper cut and leaves at the lower cut. A has two internal branches, so the 2A entering A returns through the upper branch to L. B is open, so the 10Ω drop is zero.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从A沿顶支路求相对电位Start at A and follow the upper branch

顶支路实际电流A→L为2A。令8V源左端为S，则VS−VL=2×3=6V，且VS−VA=8V，得到VA=VL−2V。The upper branch carries 2A from A to L. Calling the source’s left terminal S, VS−VL=2×3=6V and VS−VA=8V, so VA=VL−2V.

VA=VL+6−8=VL−2

沿左侧和下侧求CFollow the left and lower resistors to C

L收到上边界1A及顶支路2A，故5Ω向下3A，VD=VL−15V。D再由边界流出1A，故2Ω从D向C流2A，VC=VD−4=VL−19V。L receives 1A from the upper boundary and 2A from the top branch, so 3A flows down 5Ω and VD=VL−15V. At D, 1A leaves through the boundary, leaving 2A through 2Ω toward C. Thus VC=VL−19V.

I5Ω=3A,I2Ω=2A,VC=VL−15−4

利用B开端求UABUse the open B terminal

B没有外接通路，10Ω中电流0，所以VB=VC。于是UAB=VA−VB=(VL−2)−(VL−19)=17V。B has no external path, so current in 10Ω is zero and VB=VC. Hence UAB=VA−VB=17V.

UAB=17V

UAB=17V（A比B高17V）。UAB=17V; A is 17V above B.

易错点Common errors

  • 两个外引线都标−1A，但箭头相反，所以实际方向也相反。Both boundary references are labeled −1A, but their arrows differ, so their actual directions differ.
  • B是开端，10Ω不是“流入1A”的支路。B is an open terminal; the 10Ω branch does not carry 1A.

核验依据Verification

独立把两边界流量等效为D→L的1A转移源，仅用于核验原部分电路。精确MNA得VL=0、VA=−2、VD=−15、VC=VB=−19V；10Ω电流0，UAB=17V。内部电阻共耗散65W，内部2A源和8V源提供34+16=50W，边界净输入15W，恰平衡。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-21一致。For independent validation only, represent the two boundary flows as an equivalent 1A transfer D→L. Exact MNA gives VL=0, VA=−2, VD=−15 and VC=VB=−19V, yielding zero 10Ω current and UAB=17V. Internal resistors dissipate 65W; the internal sources supply 34+16=50W and the boundary supplies the remaining 15W. This matches appendix 1-21 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-22全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第34页／PDF第43页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

电流源端电压：沿两边固定电压定位端点Current-source voltage: determine both terminal potentials

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-20所示，求3A电流源两端的电压U。Find voltage U across the 3A current source in Fig. 1-20.

顶3A源由左节点A向右节点B，U左正右负。A经1Ω和6V上正下负源到底节点；中1A源由底向上流入B；右4V源上负下正连接B与底节点。The top 3A source runs from left A to right B, with U positive at A. A connects through 1Ω and a top-positive 6V source to bottom. A central 1A source runs upward into B; a right 4V source has its positive terminal at the bottom and negative at B.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第43页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

串联电流由KCL确定；电压源正负端；电阻沿电流压降；U=VA−VB。KCL for series current, source polarity, resistor drops and U=VA−VB.
底部设0V，右4V源的上端不是+4而是−4V。左1Ω为了给3A源供电，实际电流向上3A，左顶电位由6V减去3V得到。Set the bottom to zero. The top of the right 4V source is −4V. The left 1Ω supplies the 3A source with 3A upward, making its upper potential 6−3=3V.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定右端B电位Determine right-terminal potential B

右4V源下正上负，所以0−VB=4V，得VB=−4V。The 4V source is positive at the bottom, so 0−VB=4V and VB=−4V.

VB=−4V

确定左端A电位Determine left-terminal potential A

左6V源上端为6V。A节点向右流出3A，因此左1Ω向上流入3A；沿电流由6V节点到A降3V，VA=3V。The 6V source’s upper terminal is at 6V. Since A sends 3A rightward, the 1Ω carries 3A upward into A, dropping 3V from its lower terminal to A. Thus VA=3V.

VA=6−3(1)=3V

按U极性作差Apply U polarity

U左正右负，因此U=VA−VB=3−(−4)=7V。U is positive on the left, so U=VA−VB=3−(−4)=7V.

U=7V

U=7V（3A源左端比右端高7V）。U=7V, with the 3A source’s left terminal 7V above its right.

易错点Common errors

  • 右4V源的正端在下面，不能令VB=+4V。The right 4V source is positive at the bottom; do not set VB=+4V.
  • 左1Ω电流向上，电位沿向上电流降低3V。The left 1Ω current is upward, with a3V drop upward.

核验依据Verification

独立完整MNA得左顶3V、右顶−4V、6V源上端6V；U=7V。吸收功率：1Ω为9W、3A源21W、1A源4W、6V源−18W、4V源−16W，总和0。节点及源电压约束均精确满足。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-22的7V一致。Independent full MNA gives top-left 3V, top-right −4V and 6V at the left source’s upper terminal, hence U=7V. Absorbed powers are 9W in 1Ω, 21W in the 3A source, 4W in the 1A source, −18W in the 6V source and −16W in the 4V source, totaling zero. This matches 7V in appendix 1-22 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-23全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第34页／PDF第43页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

纯电源网络：先求电位，再补电压源电流A source-only network: find potentials, then source currents

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-21所示，求各个电源提供的功率。Find the power supplied by every source in Fig. 1-21.

底节点公共。左节点A由6V电压源Us2上正下负接底；2A源Is2由底向上流入A。右节点B由1A源Is3从底向上流入。A、B间10V源Us1左正右负；上3A源Is1由B向左流入A。Bottom is common. A connects to bottom through top-positive 6V source Us2 and receives upward 2A source Is2. B receives upward 1A source Is3. A10V source Us1 is positive at A relative to B; upper 3A source Is1 runs from B to A.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第43页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想电压源约束；KCL确定电压源电流；提供功率为−p吸收。Ideal voltage constraints, KCL for voltage-source currents and supplied power = −absorbed power.
两只电压源先固定A=6V、B=−4V。三个电流源的电压随即已知；最后对A、B做KCL求两只电压源电流。必须对五个电源全部作答。The voltage sources first fix A=6V and B=−4V. That determines all three current-source voltages. Then apply KCL at A and B for the two voltage-source currents and report all five powers.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定A、B电位Determine A and B potentials

令底部0V。Us2给VA=6V，Us1给VA−VB=10V，因此VB=−4V。Set the bottom to zero. Us2 gives VA=6V, while Us1 gives VA−VB=10V, hence VB=−4V.

VA=6,VB=6−10=−4(V)

三个电流源提供功率Find the three current-source supplied powers

Is1把3A从B送到A，电位升高10V，提供30W；Is2向A送2A，提供12W；Is3向−4V节点B送1A，提供−4W，即吸收4W。Is1 sends 3A from B to A through a10V rise and supplies 30W. Is2 supplies 6×2=12W. Is3 sends 1A to B at −4V, so it supplies −4W, meaning it absorbs 4W.

PIs1=30,PIs2=12,PIs3=−4(W, supplied)

求电压源电流及提供功率Find voltage-source currents and supplied powers

B点3A向左流出、1A从底流入，故Us1需由A向B送2A，从其正端流入，提供−20W。A点共流入3+2=5A，向B流出2A，剩余3A向下流过Us2正端，提供−18W。At B, 3A leaves to A while 1A enters from bottom, so Us1 sends 2A from A to B, entering its positive terminal and supplying −20W. At A, 5A enters and 2A leaves toward B, leaving 3A downward into Us2’s positive terminal, supplying −18W.

PUs1=−10(2)=−20W,PUs2=−6(3)=−18W

检验五电源功率总和Check the total of all five sources

30+12−4−20−18=0。该网络没有电阻，提供功率总和也为0；一部分源向另一部分源传能。30+12−4−20−18 = 0. There are no resistors, so the total supplied power is zero; some sources transfer energy to the others.

∑Psupplied=0

按Is1、Is2、Is3、Us1、Us2顺序，提供功率为30W、12W、−4W、−20W、−18W。后三项负值表示吸收。Supplied powers for Is1, Is2, Is3, Us1 and Us2 are 30W, 12W, −4W, −20W and −18W. Negative values mean absorption.

易错点Common errors

  • Is1的3A箭头向左，从右节点B流向左节点A。The 3AIs1 arrow points left, from B to A.
  • 没有电阻并不意味着每个源功率为0，只要求全电路功率守恒。Having no resistor does not make every source power zero; only the total must balance.

核验依据Verification

独立五源MNA得A=6V、B=−4V，Us1正端流入电流2A、Us2正端流入3A。逐源吸收功率取负后得到所列五个提供功率；KCL、KVL及总功率残差精确为0。附录第332页、PDF341页1-23五项全部一致。Independent five-source MNA gives A=6V and B=−4V, with 2A entering Us1’s positive terminal and 3A entering Us2’s. Negating each absorbed power gives the five supplied powers listed above, with exact zero KCL and KVL and power residuals. All five values match appendix 1-23 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-24指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第34页／PDF第43页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：1-24Assigned requirement: 1-24

先由电流求电阻压降，再求电流源端电压Find current-source voltages from resistor drops

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-22所示，求两个电流源两端的电压U1、U2。For the circuit shown in Fig. 1-22, find the voltages U1 and U2 across the two current sources.

左支路为3A向下电流源，U1上正下负。中支路为2Ω电阻串联5V电压源，电压源上正下负。上节点经过1Ω接右支路2A向下电流源，U2上正下负，其下串联3Ω回到底节点。Left branch: 3A current source downward, U1 positive at the top. Middle branch: 2Ω resistor in series with a5V source positive at the top. The upper node connects through 1Ω to a downward 2A current source with U2 positive at the top, followed by 3Ω to the lower node.

本题图在书第35页／PDF第44页。The source figure is on printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、节点电位与电压参考极性。KCL, KVL, node potentials, and voltage reference polarity.
电流源已经确定其支路电流。先对上下节点用KCL，再沿已知电压源的支路求节点电位，最后求两个电流源电压。The current sources fix their branch currents. Use KCL at the common nodes, find node potentials through the branch containing the known voltage source, then compute the source voltages.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先确定中支路电流Find the middle-branch current

取底节点为0V。3A和2A都向下流出顶节点，因此中支路向上电流为5A，即按向下参考方向为−5A。Set the lower node to 0V. The 3A and 2A branches both leave the upper node downward, so the middle branch carries 5A upward, or −5A under a downward reference.

im+3+2=0⇒im=−5A

求U1Find U1

5V电压源上端电位为5V；2Ω电阻按自上而下的压降为2×(−5)=−10V，所以顶节点电位为−5V。U1按上正下负，等于−5V。The upper terminal of the 5V source is at 5V. The downward voltage drop across 2Ω is 2(−5)=−10V, making the upper node −5V. Since U1 is referenced positive at the top, U1=−5V.

U1=5+2(−5)=−5V

求U2Find U2

右支路电流为2A。1Ω电阻压降2V，故电流源上端电位为−7V；3Ω电阻上端电位为6V。按U2的上正下负参考极性相减。The right branch carries 2A. The 1Ω resistor drops 2V, so the source upper terminal is at −7V. The upper terminal of 3Ω is at 6V. Subtract according to U2’s top-positive polarity.

U2=(−5−2×1)−(2×3)=−13V

U1=−5V，U2=−13V；两者实际电压极性均与图示参考极性相反。U1=−5V and U2=−13V. Both actual voltage polarities oppose the indicated reference polarities.

易错点Common errors

  • 电流源并不自动规定其端电压为正；电流箭头和电压极性是不同的参考信息。A current source does not force its terminal voltage to be positive; the current arrow and voltage polarity are separate references.
  • 题干在书第34页，图在第35页，必须同时查看。The statement is on printed p. 34 and the figure on p. 35; both pages are required.

核验依据Verification

右支路KVL：2+(−13)+6=−5V，与U1一致。三电阻耗散50+4+12=66W；3A源、2A源和5V源吸收功率分别为-15、-26、−25W，合计−66W，功率守恒。书第332页（PDF341页）给出相同的−5V、−13V。Right-branch KVL gives 2+(−13)+6=−5V, matching U1. The resistors dissipate 50+4+12=66W; the 3A, 2A, and 5V sources absorb -15, -26, and −25W, totaling −66W. Power balances. Printed p. 332 (PDF p. 341) gives the same −5V and −13V.

1-25全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第34页／PDF第43页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 34 · PDF p. 43. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

指定支路电流反求电压源：先分流再做KVLRecover source voltage from a specified branch current

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-23所示，求电流I=0.5A时的Us。For Fig. 1-23, find Us when I=0.5A.

左2A源向上注入顶节点；中3Ω从顶到底。右支路顶节点经3Ω和Us上正下负电压源到底。I在右支路顶线参考向右，即沿右支路向下。An upward left 2A source injects into the top node. A central 3Ω runs to bottom. The right branch contains series 3Ω and top-positive Us to bottom. I points right along the upper-right wire, hence downward through the right branch.

本题图在书第35页／PDF第44页。The source figure is on printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL分流；并联共端电压；串联电阻压降与源电压相加。KCL current division, common parallel voltage and series resistor and source voltage addition.
右支路规定取0.5A，左源总注入2A，因此中间3Ω承担其余1.5A。先由它定顶节点电压，再减去右3Ω的1.5V压降。The right branch takes 0.5A from the 2A injection, leaving 1.5A in the central 3Ω. Use this to determine the top voltage, then subtract the 1.5V right-resistor drop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

KCL求中央电阻电流Use KCL for the central current

Im+I=2A，所以中央3Ω向下电流为2−0.5=1.5A。Im+I=2A, so the central 3Ω current is 1.5A downward.

Im=2−0.5=1.5A

求顶节点电压并做右支路KVLFind top voltage and apply right-branch KVL

底部设0V，顶节点电压VT=3×1.5=4.5V。右支路电阻压降3×0.5=1.5V，故Us=4.5−1.5=3V。With bottom zero, VT=3×1.5=4.5V. The right resistor drops 3×0.5=1.5V, leaving Us=4.5−1.5=3V.

Us=3(2−I)−3I=6−6I=3V(I=0.5A)

Us=3V（原图上正下负）。Us=3V, positive at the top as drawn.

易错点Common errors

  • I=0.5A只指右支路，不是中间3Ω的电流。I=0.5A is the right-branch current, not the central 3Ω current.
  • 右支路电压等于电阻压降加Us，不能把4.5V直接作为Us。Right-branch voltage is the resistor drop plus Us; 4.5V is not Us itself.

核验依据Verification

独立原拓扑MNA恢复Us=3V，解得顶节点4.5V、右支路电流(4.5−3)3=0.5A，重现条件。两电阻耗散6.75+0.75=7.5W，电压源吸收1.5W，2A源提供9W，总功率平衡。与附录第332页、PDF341页1-25的3V一致。Independent MNA restoring Us=3V yields top potential 4.5V and right current (4.5−3)3=0.5A, reproducing the condition. The resistors dissipate 6.75+0.75=7.5W, the voltage source absorbs 1.5W and the 2A source supplies 9W, balancing power. This matches 3V in appendix 1-25 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-26指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第35页／PDF第44页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：1-26Assigned requirement: 1-26

受控电压源：把控制关系与KVL一起列出Controlled voltage source: combine its law with KVL

题目原文Transcribed question

电路题图1-24所示，求在下列条件下受控源的电压：(1)us=2V；(2)us=8V。For the circuit in Fig. 1-24, find the controlled-source voltage for (1)us=2V and (2)us=8V.

左侧独立电压源us上正下负；上方2Ω电阻电压u1左正右负；右侧受控电压源3u1上正下负，三者组成单回路。The independent voltage source us on the left is positive at the top. The upper 2Ω resistor has u1 positive on the left. The right controlled voltage source is 3u1, positive at the top. All three form one loop.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KVL；电压控制电压源的控制关系。KVL and the voltage-controlled voltage-source relation.
受控源的电压不是额外给定的常数。将3u1作为同一未知量的倍数，整圈只剩一个电压未知量。The controlled-source voltage is not an independent constant. Writing it as 3u1 leaves only one unknown voltage in the loop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

列回路电压关系Write the loop voltage relation

从左下沿顺时针绕行：独立源提供电压上升us，随后两段压降为u1与3u1。Going clockwise from the lower left, the independent source gives a rise us, followed by drops u1 and 3u1.

us−u1−3u1=0

先得到通用式Obtain a general expression

因此u1=us4；题目要求的是受控源电压3u1，而不是电阻电压u1。Thus u1=us4. The requested voltage is 3u1 across the controlled source, not u1 across the resistor.

ud=3u1=34us

代入两个条件Substitute both conditions

us=2V时，u1=0.5V，受控源电压1.5V；us=8V时，u1=2V，受控源电压6V。For us=2V, u1=0.5V and the controlled-source voltage is 1.5V. For us=8V, u1=2V and the controlled-source voltage is 6V.

ud(1)=1.5V,ud(2)=6V

(1)1.5V；(2)6V，均按图示上正下负参考极性。(1)1.5V; (2)6V, with the indicated top-positive polarity.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要把受控源当成独立源另设任意数值，也不要把u1作为最终答案。Do not treat the dependent source as an arbitrary independent value or report u1 as the requested answer.

核验依据Verification

分别回代KVL：0.5+1.5=2V，2+6=8V；同时满足受控关系ud=3u1。书第332页、PDF341页1-26给出相同的1.5V、6V。Substitution gives 0.5+1.5=2V and 2+6=8V, and both satisfy ud=3u1. Answer 1-26 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 gives the same 1.5V and 6V.

1-27全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第35页／PDF第44页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

受控电流源反馈：负解必须保留参考方向Controlled-current feedback: retain a negative reference result

题目原文Transcribed question

电路题图1-25所示，求在下列条件下受控源的电流：(1)is=1A；(2)is=3A。For Fig. 1-25, find the dependent-source current when (1)is=1A and (2)is=3A.

三支路并联：左独立电流源is向上，中2Ω电阻控制电流i1向下，右受控电流源参考向上、数值4i1。Three parallel branches: independent is upward, central 2Ω with control current i1 downward, and dependent current 4i1 upward.

本题图在书第35页／PDF第44页。The source figure is on printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL；受控源关系；负值表示反参考方向；欧姆定律。KCL, dependent-source control law, negative references and Ohm’s law.
受控源不是另一个独立已知电流。将其4i1与电阻中的i1一起代入同一节点KCL，先求控制量，再求受控输出。The dependent source is not a separately known current. Substitute 4i1 in the same node KCL as i1, solve the control current first, then the output.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

按原图方向列KCLWrite KCL using the original references

顶节点流入为is和4i1，流出为i1。因此i1=is+4i1，得到i1=−is3。At the top, is and 4i1 enter while i1 leaves. Thus i1=is+4i1 and i1=−is3.

i1=is+4i1⇒i1=−is3,idep=4i1=−4is3

分别代入两个条件Evaluate both conditions

is=1A时，受控源向上参考电流为−43A；is=3A时为−4A。两个负值都表示实际向下，不能改负号而保留原箭头。For is=1A, the upward-reference dependent current is −43A; for is=3A it is −4A. Both actually flow downward.

(1) idep=−43A;(2) idep=−4A

(1)−43A；(2)−4A，均按原图受控源向上参考方向，实际分别向下43A、4A。(1)−43A; (2)−4A in the original upward reference, actually downward with those magnitudes.

易错点Common errors

  • 受控源4i1与独立源is箭头都向上，不能在KCL中给它们相反的参考符号。Both source reference arrows point up; do not assign them opposite KCL signs.
  • 先求i1，再乘4；不能把is直接当控制电流。Solve i1 before multiplying by 4; is is not the control current.

核验依据Verification

独立原拓扑MNA在2Ω支路串入零伏电流传感器，严格按向下i1控制向上4i1；两条件分别得到i1=−13、−1A，输出−43、−4A。令公共电压u=2i1，电阻、独立源、受控源吸收功率分别2is29、2is23、−8is29，总和0。附录第332页、PDF341页两问一致。Independent original-topology MNA uses a zero-volt sensor in the 2Ω branch, measuring downward i1 to control upward 4i1. The two cases give i1=−13 and −1A, and outputs −43 and −4A. With common u=2i1, absorbed powers are 2is29, 2is23 and −8is29, totaling zero. Both parts match the appendix on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-28全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第35页／PDF第44页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

受控电压源功率：先定控制电流，再定源电流Controlled-voltage power: find control and output currents

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图1-26所示，求：(1) 当R=2Ω时受控源提供的功率；(2) 欲使受控源吸收4W的功率，则电阻R应为多少？For Fig. 1-26, find (1) the power supplied by the dependent source when R=2Ω; (2)R for which it absorbs 4W.

左12V源上正下负，顶端经R接中央4V上正下负源，控制电流I从左经R向右；中央顶节点经1Ω到右受控电压源上端。受控源电压2I，上正下负。所有下端共节点。A top-positive 12V source connects through R to a top-positive 4V source, with control I rightward through R. The 4V node connects through 1Ω to a top-positive dependent voltage source 2I; all lower terminals are common.

本题图在书第35页／PDF第44页。The source figure is on printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想电压源定节点电位；受控电压2I；KCL确定源电流；区分提供与吸收。Ideal-source node voltages, dependent voltage 2I, KCL for source current and supplied versus absorbed power.
12V和4V直接固定R两端电压8V，先得到I=8R。受控源端电压随后已知，但其功率还需通过右侧1Ω求实际电流。The 12V and 4V sources fix 8V across R, giving I=8R. This fixes dependent voltage, but power also requires its current through the right 1Ω.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

建立受控源的电压与电流Write dependent voltage and current

控制电流I=8RA，受控源上端VD=2I=16RV。定义受控源向下电流iD，则iD=(4−VD)1。Control I=8RA sets VD=2I=16RV. Define dependent-source current iD downward; then iD=(4−VD)1.

I=8R,VD=16R,iD=4−16R,pD,abs=VD(4−VD)

(1) 求提供功率(1): supplied power

R=2Ω时I=4A，VD=8V，iD=−4A，即实际向上4A。吸收功率8×(−4)=−32W，提供功率为32W。At R=2Ω, I=4A, VD=8V and iD=−4A, actually upward. Absorbed power is −32W, so supplied power is 32W.

PD,supplied=−pD,abs=32W

(2) 按吸收4W列方程(2): impose absorption of 4W

VD(4−VD)=4可改写为(VD−2)2=0，只得VD=2V。因此16R=2，R=8Ω。此时iD=2A向下，确为吸收4W。VD(4−VD)=4 becomes (VD−2)2=0, so VD=2V and R=8Ω. Then iD=2A downward, indeed absorbing 4W.

VD(4−VD)=4⇒(VD−2)2=0⇒R=8Ω

(1) 受控源提供32W；(2)R=8Ω。(1) The dependent source supplies 32W. (2)R=8Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 右侧菱形是受控电压源，2I是电压，不是支路电流。The diamond is a controlled voltage source: 2I is its voltage, not its current.
  • 第一问求提供功率、第二问给吸收功率，两者符号相反。Part (1) asks supplied power while part (2) specifies absorbed power; their signs are opposite.

核验依据Verification

独立CCVSMNA用零伏传感器按R中向右电流控制2I电压。R=2Ω时受控源吸收−32W，R=8Ω时吸收4W；两条件下全部节点、控制约束及全电路功率和精确为0。第二问平方方程证明正电阻解唯一。附录第332页、PDF341页32W、8Ω均一致。Independent CCVSMNA uses a zero-volt sensor for rightward R current and dependent voltage 2I. It gives −32W absorbed at R=2Ω and +4W at R=8Ω; all node and control constraints and full power sums are exactly satisfied. The squared equation establishes uniqueness. Both 32W and 8Ω match the appendix on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-29全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第35页／PDF第44页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

受控电流源吸收功率：负值表示提供Dependent-current absorbed power: a negative result means delivery

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-27所示电路中受控电流源吸收的功率。Find the power absorbed by the dependent current source in Fig. 1-27.

底部共节点。左2Ω上端A电压ux上正下负；右14V源上端B为正。A、B间并联2Ω和由A向B的受控电流源6ux；u1左正右负。Bottom is common. Left 2Ω has upper node A and top-positive control ux. A top-positive 14V source fixes B. Between A and B are parallel 2Ω and dependent current 6ux from A to B; u1 is positive at A.

本题图在书第35页／PDF第44页。The source figure is on printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点法；VCCS控制ux；电流流入电压正参考端时p吸收=ui；总功率。Nodal analysis, VCCS control ux, passive power p=ui and total power balance.
ux就是A相对底部的电位。对A列KCL即可求它；然后用源左右端电压差乘以源向右电流，得到有符号吸收功率。ux is A relative to the bottom. KCL at A determines it, then left-minus-right source voltage times rightward current gives signed absorbed power.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

对控制节点A列KCLApply KCL at control node A

A向底部、向B电阻、向B受控源的流出电流相加为0。B=14V，故ux2+(ux−14)2+6ux=0，得ux=1V。Sum currents leaving A through its ground resistor, A–B resistor and dependent source. With B=14V, ux2+(ux−14)2+6ux=0, yielding ux=1V.

ux2+ux−142+6ux=0⇒ux=1V

计算吸收功率Compute absorbed power

受控电流为6A向右，左正右负电压u1=1−14=−13V。电流从u1正参考端流入，所以p吸收=u1·6=−78W。The source current is 6A rightward and u1=1−14=−13V. Current enters the positive reference terminal, so absorbed power is u1×6=−78W.

iD=6A,u1=−13V,pD,abs=−78W

受控源吸收功率为−78W，即实际提供78W。The dependent source absorbs −78W, meaning it supplies 78W.

易错点Common errors

  • u1是A相对B，不能只用左支路ux=1V作源电压。The source voltage is A relative to B, not simply ux=1V.
  • 题目问吸收功率，负答案应保留，并解释为提供。Keep a negative absorbed-power answer and explain it as supplied power.

核验依据Verification

独立VCCS原拓扑MNA得A=1V、B=14V、受控源6A。两电阻共耗散0.5+84.5=85W，14V源吸收−7W，受控源吸收−78W，总和0；全部节点与控制约束精确满足。与附录第332页、PDF341页−78W一致。Independent original-topology VCCSMNA gives A=1V, B=14V and source current 6A. The resistors dissipate 0.5+84.5=85W; the 14V source absorbs −7W and dependent source −78W, totaling zero. All constraints are exact. This matches −78W in the appendix on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-30指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第35页／PDF第44页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：1-30Assigned requirement: 1-30

受控电流源功率：先电流，后端电压Controlled current-source power: find current and voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

题图1-28所示电路中各参数已给定，试求受控电流源的功率，并说明是吸收功率还是提供功率。All parameters of the circuit in Fig. 1-28 are given. Find the power of the controlled current source and state whether it absorbs or delivers power.

底部为公共节点。左节点经1Ω接底部；左、中节点间2Ω，中、右节点间4Ω，左、右节点间上支路3Ω。中节点经上正下负的6V电压源接底部，I1参考向上。右节点向下先经过上负下正的12V源，再经过大小I13、方向向下的受控电流源到底部。The bottom is common. The left node connects to it through 1Ω. There are 2Ω between left and middle, 4Ω between middle and right, and 3Ω between left and right. A6V source, positive at the middle node, connects middle to bottom, with I1 upward. From the right node downward, a12V source is negative at the top and positive at the bottom, followed by a downward controlled current source I13.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、受控电流源；关联参考方向下的功率。KCL, KVL, controlled current sources, and passive-sign power.
6V源先给出中节点电位。受控源电流由I1决定，端电压则须把右节点电位与12V源极性一起计算，不能只用I13求功率。The 6V source fixes the middle-node potential. The dependent-source current follows from I1, but its voltage also depends on the right-node potential and 12V source polarity.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

定义电位和控制电流Define node potentials and control current

取底节点为0V，左、右节点分别为vL、vR，中节点为6V。中节点KCL把I1写成两个电阻电流之和。以下电压用V、电阻用Ω。Set the bottom to 0V, the left and right potentials to vL and vR, and the middle potential to 6V. Middle-node KCL expresses I1 as the sum of two resistor currents. Voltages are in V and resistances in Ω.

I1=6−vL2+6−vR4

对左右节点列KCLApply KCL at the left and right nodes

左节点的三条电阻支路电流相加为0；右节点向下支路电流由受控源固定为I13。Sum the three resistor currents at the left node. At the right node, the downward branch current is fixed to I13 by the controlled source.

vL1+vL−62+vL−vR3=0,vR−vL3+vR−64+I13=0

消元求电流Eliminate variables and find current

将I1代入右节点方程，化为(vR−vL)2=0，故vR=vL。左节点方程随后给出vL=vR=2V。于是I1=2+1=3A，受控源电流为1A向下。Substituting I1 in the right-node equation reduces it to (vR−vL)2=0. Hence vR=vL; the left-node equation gives both as 2V. Then I1=2+1=3A and the controlled source carries 1A downward.

vL=vR=2V,I1=3A,Id=1A

根据12V源极性求端电压和功率Use the 12V polarity to find voltage and power
