来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（图论与基本分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: graph theory and basic analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

独立KCL、KVL数：先数节点与支路Independent KCL and KVL counts: vertices and branches first

题目原文Transcribed question

对题图2−1(b)连通图所对应的电路，可写出的独立KCL、KVL方程数分别是多少？For the circuit represented by connected graph Fig. 2-1(b), how many independent KCL and KVL equations can be written?

有5个实心节点、8条编号支路，顶弧线3是单独一条支路，中间节点不在该弧线上。There are five filled vertices and eight numbered branches. Upper arc 3 is a separate branch and does not pass through the middle vertex.

本题图在书第61页／PDF第70页。The source figure is on printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

连通图关联矩阵秩n−1；独立回路数b−n+1。Connected incidence rank n−1 and cycle-space dimension b−n+1.
先数图上真正的节点n=5和支路b=8。不要把参考箭头、弧线或分支标号当新节点。Count actual vertices n=5 and edges b=8. Arrows, curves and labels do not create vertices.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

独立KCL数Independent KCL count

n个节点的全部KCL有一条总和为0的依赖关系，故独立方程n−1=4。The n node KCL equations have one sum dependency, leaving n−1=4 independent equations.

NKCL=n−1=5−1=4

独立KVL数Independent KVL count

生成树含n−1=4条边，其余b−(n−1)=4条连支分别生成4个基本回路。A tree has four twigs; the remaining four chords each generate a fundamental loop.

NKVL=b−n+1=8−5+1=4

独立KCL方程4个；独立KVL方程4个。Four independent KCL equations and four independent KVL equations.

易错点Common errors

  • “共有几个节点”与“独立KCL几个”相差1。The independent KCL count is one less than the vertex count.
  • KVL数是独立回路数，不是把所有能画出的回路全数一遍。Count independent loops, not every possible cycle.

核验依据Verification

独立构造原图5×8有向关联矩阵，精确消元秩4，零空间维数8−4=4；与树、连支计数法独立吻合。附录第333页、PDF342页为4、4。Independent exact elimination of the original 5×8 oriented incidence matrix gives rank 4 and nullity 4, matching the tree and chord count. The appendix gives 4,4.

2-6全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（图论与基本分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: graph theory and basic analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

完整2b方程：3条KCL、3条KVL、6条元件约束Complete 2b system: 3 KCL, 3 KVL, 6 branch laws

题目原文Transcribed question

试列出题图2-4所示电路的2b方程。Write the 2b equations for the circuit in Fig. 2-4.

4节点a顶、b中左、c中右、d底。R1支路a→b，R2支路b→d，R3支路c→d；左us源a正d负，电流i4沿d→a；is1从b→c，is2从c→a。Four nodes a top, b middle-left, c middle-right, d bottom. R1 current a→b, R2b→d, R3c→d. Left us is positive at a relative to d, with i4d→a. Sources is1 go b→c and is2c→a.

本题图在书第61页／PDF第70页。The source figure is on printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

2b法以每条支路的电流、电压为未知；n−1独立KCL、b−n+1独立KVL；各元件约束。The 2b method uses every branch current and voltage; n−1 KCL, b−n+1 KVL and one law per branch.
本图6条支路，所以未知量为6个电流与6个电压。保留原电流方向，补定义各支路电压为沿电流的关联参考方向；尤其左源电流向上，其关联电压u4=−us。There are six branches and twelve unknowns. Preserve original current directions and define each voltage in the passive reference along its current; the upward left-source current then has u4=−us.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

定义12个未知量Define the twelve unknowns

按支路1至6依次为R1、R2、R3、us源、is1源、is2源。i5参考b→c、i6参考c→a；电压依次u1=Va−Vb、u2=Vb−Vd、u3=Vc−Vd、u4=Vd−Va、u5=Vb−Vc、u6=Vc−Va。Branches 1–6 are R1, R2, R3, us, is1 and is2. Define i5b→c and i6c→a. Voltages are Va−Vb, Vb−Vd, Vc−Vd, Vd−Va, Vb−Vc and Vc−Va.

(i1,…,i6, u1,…,u6),b=6,2b=12

三条独立KCLThree independent KCL equations

分别在a、b、c列KCL，d节点的KCL由它们相加得到，不再重复列。Apply KCL at a, b and c. Node d is dependent and is not repeated.

i4+i6−i1=0,i1−i2−i5=0,i5−i3−i6=0

三条独立KVLThree independent KVL equations

取树支1、2、3，以连支4、5、6各生成一个基本回路。按各连支方向绕行，电压相加为0。Choose tree branches 1,2,3 and form one loop per chord 4,5,6. Follow each chord reference for loop traversal.

u4+u1+u2=0,u5+u3−u2=0,u6+u1+u2−u3=0

六条支路元件约束Six branch constitutive equations

三只电阻用欧姆定律；左源关联电压与题给us反向；两个电流源固定各自支路电流。Use Ohm’s law for the resistors, opposite polarity for the left source’s passive voltage and fixed currents for the two current sources.

u1=R1i1,u2=R2i2,u3=R3i3,u4=−us,i5=is1,i6=is2

检查方程数量Check completeness

共3+3+6=12个方程，对应12个未知。电流源电压u5、u6并非0，而是由整个电路决定，必须保留为未知。There are 3+3+6 = 12 equations for twelve unknowns. Current-source voltages u5 and u6 are not zero; the circuit determines them.

取上述支路方向，完整系统为所列3条KCL、3条KVL及6条元件约束，共12个方程。特别u4=−us、i5=is1、i6=is2。With the defined references, the listed 3 KCL, 3 KVL and 6 branch laws form the complete twelve-equation system. In particular u4=−us, i5=is1 and i6=is2.

易错点Common errors

  • u4沿d→a关联定义，所以等于−us；不能忽略原电压源极性。u4 is passively referenced d→a and equals −us.
  • 只列KCL和KVL还不够，2b方程还包括每支路的元件关系。KCL and KVL alone are insufficient; include every branch constitutive relation.
  • 理想电流源固定电流，不固定为零电压。An ideal current source fixes its current, not zero voltage.

核验依据Verification

独立把上述12式组装成12×12有理数系统，3组正电阻及正负源参数均秩12。另按原图独立搭建节点MNA，恢复出的全部6电流、6电压逐项完全相同，∑ukik=0及全电路功率和精确为0。附录未列2-6，完整方程与独立原拓扑检查提供依据。The twelve equations independently form a full-rank 12×12 exact-rational system for three sets of positive resistors and signed sources. Separately stamped original-node MNA reproduces all six currents and six voltages exactly, with ∑ukik=0 and zero full power residual. The appendix omits 2-6; completeness and independent topology checks support the answer.

2-7全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（图论与基本分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: graph theory and basic analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

支路电流法：两个回路与顶节点KCLBranch-current method: KCL and loop-voltage equality

题目原文Transcribed question

试用支路电流法求解题图2-5所示电路中各支路的电流。Use the branch-current method to find all branch currents in Fig. 2-5.

底部公共。左6V源上正下负，上端经2Ω接顶中节点M，i1从左向M。右4V源上正下负，上端经4Ω接M，i2从右向M。中间1A源由底向上流入M。Bottom is common. A top-positive 6V source connects through 2Ω to middle-top M, with i1 toward M from the left. A top-positive 4V source connects through 4Ω toward M from the right, with i2 toward M. A central 1A source injects upward into M.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

支路电流法；KCL；KVL；负电流的实际方向；电源吸收功率。Branch-current analysis, KCL, KVL, actual directions of negative currents and absorbed source power.
i1、i2都按图流入顶节点，1A源也流入，因此两未知必有负值。先按参考方向列KCL，再用左右路径计算同一顶节点电压，联立两式。Both i1 and i2 are referenced into the top node, as is the 1A source, so negative unknowns are expected. Apply KCL, then equate the middle voltage found from left and right paths.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

顶节点KCLTop-node KCL

三个参考电流均流入M，所以i1+i2+1=0，即i1+i2=−1A。All three reference currents enter M, so i1+i2+1=0.

i1+i2=−1

左右路径KVLKVL through left and right paths

从底部经左6V源和2Ω到M，VM=6−2i1；从右4V源和4Ω到M，VM=4−4i2。相等得2i1−4i2=2。The left path gives VM=6−2i1 and right path VM=4−4i2. Equality gives 2i1−4i2=2.

6−2i1=4−4i2⇒2i1−4i2=2

联立求解并说明全部支路Solve and state all branch directions

解得i1=−13A、i2=−23A。实际从M向左流13A、向右流23A，然后均经各自电压源向下回到底部；中央源仍向上1A。Solving gives i1=−13A and i2=−23A. Actual currents leave M leftward by 13A and rightward by 23A, then pass downward through the voltage sources; the middle source remains 1A upward.

i1=−13A,i2=−23A,is=1A upward

i1=−13A，i2=−23A；实际分别从顶中节点向左13A、向右23A。中央支路为1A向上。i1=−13A and i2=−23A, actually outward from the middle node leftward and rightward. The central branch is 1A upward.

易错点Common errors

  • i2的原箭头向左、指向M，不能当成由M向右。The original i2 arrow points leftward toward M.
  • 负答案应保留，再另述实际方向，不要只取绝对值。Retain negative referenced values and state actual directions separately.

核验依据Verification

独立原图MNA得M=203V，大于左6V与右4V，故实际确从M向两侧流。两电阻共耗散2W，6V源吸收2W、4V源吸收83W，1A源提供203W，功率完全平衡。支路方程和MNA结果一致，附录第333页、PDF342页为−13、−23A。Independent original-topology MNA gives M=203V, above both 6V and 4V, confirming outward actual currents. Resistors dissipate 2W, the voltage sources absorb 2 and 83W, and the current source supplies 203W. Branch equations and MNA agree with the appendix values −13 and −23A.

2-8全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（支路与节点分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: branch and nodal analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

先用已知源电流列KCL，再比较并联路径电压Use the source current in KCL, then equate parallel-path voltages

题目原文Transcribed question

试用支路电流法求题图2-6所示电路中的电流i1和i2。Use the branch-current method to find i1 and i2 in Fig. 2-6.

左支路10A电流源向上，经顶部1Ω接公共上节点A。中支路从A向下依次为R1=1Ω和上正下负2V电源，i1向下。右支路R2=1Ω，i2向下，底部共地。A10A source drives upward through the upper 1Ω resistor into node A. The middle path from A to ground contains R1=1Ω and a top-positive 2V source, with i1 downward. R2=1Ω is the right downward i2 path.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

支路电流法、KCL、KVL、理想电流源端电压与吸收功率。Branch-current analysis, KCL, KVL, current-source voltage and absorbed power.
左侧串联1Ω不改变理想源注入的10A。两条向下路径同起点同终点，但中支路多一个2V电压升降，因此不能直接把10A平均分配。The upper series resistor does not alter the imposed 10A. Both downward paths have common terminals, but the middle path includes a2V source, so the current does not split equally.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

公共上节点KCLKCL at the upper node

上方输入10A，两个所求电流均按图向下流出。The incoming 10A equals the two downward reference currents.

i1+i2=10A

用两条路径表示同一电压Express the same voltage along both paths

以底部为零，中支路节点电压为电阻压降加2V；右支路只有电阻压降。With the bottom grounded, the middle path gives a resistor drop plus 2V; the right path gives only its resistor drop.

(1Ω)i1+2V=(1Ω)i2

联立并解释方向Solve and interpret directions

由i2−i1=2A和总电流10A得i1=4A、i2=6A，均与图示向下方向一致。公共上节点6V；电流源上端还要再加顶部1Ω的10V压降，故为16V。The difference is 2A and sum 10A, yielding 4A and 6A downward. Node A is 6V. The current-source upper terminal is another 10V higher because of its series resistor.

i1=4A,i2=6A,VA=6V,Vsource=16V

i1=4A、i2=6A，均向下。i1=4A and i2=6A, both downward.

易错点Common errors

  • 中支路的2V源不能省略；相同电阻不代表相同支路电流。Do not omit the middle voltage source; equal resistor values do not imply equal branch currents.
  • 顶部1Ω用于确定电流源端电压与功率，但不改变理想电流源规定的10A。The upper 1Ω sets the source terminal voltage and dissipation, not its imposed current.

核验依据Verification

独立按原图完整MNA得源顶16V、A点6V、2V源电流4A，与支路法相同。三电阻共耗散152W，2V源吸收8W，10A源提供160W，功率精确平衡。第333页附录2-8为4A、6A。Independent full-topology MNA gives source top 16V, A=6V and 4A through the 2V source. The resistors dissipate 152W and the voltage source absorbs 8W, balanced by 160W supplied by the current source. Appendix 2-8 lists 4A and 6A.

2-9全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（支路与节点分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: branch and nodal analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

先求两个节点电位，再按标注极性做差Find two node potentials, then subtract in the stated polarity

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图2-7所示电路中的电压u1、u2和u3。Find u1, u2 and u3 in Fig. 2-7.

底部公共。左上A与右上B间1Ω，u2左正右负。A到底部1Ω，u1上正下负；B到底部1Ω，u3上正下负。左2A源向上注入A，右3A源向上注入B。Bottom is common. A and B are linked by 1Ω, with u2 positive at A. Each node has a1Ω resistor to ground, with u1 and u3 top-positive. The 2A and 3A sources inject upward into A and B respectively.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点电压法、跨节点电压的极性、全电路功率。Nodal analysis, polarity of a node-to-node voltage, and power balance.
u1、u3直接是节点电位；u2不是其中任一节点对地电压，而是左电位减右电位。先固定这一关系，再写KCL。u1 and u3 are the node potentials. u2 is the left potential minus the right, rather than either node’s voltage to ground.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

把电压与节点对应Identify the node voltages

底部选地，A、B节点电位分别记作VA、VB。Ground the bottom and name the node potentials VA and VB.

u1=VA,u3=VB,u2=VA−VB

两个节点分别列KCLWrite KCL at each node

左源2A等于左对地电流与从左到右电流之和；右源3A同理。At each node, its injected source current equals the current to ground plus that toward the other node.

VA1Ω+VA−VB1Ω=2A,VB1Ω+VB−VA1Ω=3A

求解并保留u2负号Solve and retain the sign of u2

线性方程解得左节点73V、右节点83V，右边略高，所以按左正右负定义的u2为负。The right node is slightly higher: the potentials are 73V and 83V. Thus the left-positive u2 is negative.

u1=73V,u2=−13V,u3=83V

u1=73V，u2=−13V，u3=83V。u1=73V, u2=−13V, u3=83V.

易错点Common errors

  • 负u2只说明实际右节点较高，不表示KCL符号应重写。Negative u2 means B is higher; keep the original references.
  • 上方1Ω不是接地电阻，电流必须用两节点电位差。The upper resistor connects two unknown nodes, so use their voltage difference.

核验依据Verification

独立对三个1Ω电阻和两个向上电流源作节点盖章，复得同一组电位。三电阻耗散总和383W；两个电流源合计提供383W，KCL与功率余量均为零。第333页附录2-9三个值及负号相符。A separately stamped three-resistor, two-source nodal system reproduces both potentials. Resistors dissipate 383W, exactly balanced by the two sources. All KCL and power residuals are zero; all three values and the negative sign match Appendix 2-9.

2-10全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：考试范围（支路与节点分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: required: branch and nodal analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

受控电压源接未知节点：先处理超节点An unknown-node voltage source requires a supernode

题目原文Transcribed question

按照指定的参考节点，列出题图2-8所示电路的节点电压方程。Using the specified reference node, write the nodal-voltage equations for Fig. 2-8.

节点1经2Ω接节点2，i1由1指向2；节点2经4Ω接节点3。上方1A源由1指向3。节点3经1Ω接底部地，u=V3。节点2由下向上受控源3i1注入。左2u受控电压源上正下负，从节点1接左下L，L再经1Ω接地。Node 1 connects through 2Ω to node 2, with i1 from 1 to 2; 4Ω joins nodes 2 and 3.A1A source runs from 1 to 3. Node 3 has 1Ω to ground and u=V3. A dependent source injects 3i1 upward into node 2.A top-positive 2u voltage source connects node 1 to lower-left L, which has 1Ω to ground.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

超节点、受控源控制方程、节点电压法、先列方程后求解。Supernodes, dependent-source constraints, nodal analysis, and defining controls before solving.
2u电压源的下端不是地，不能直接写V1=2u。将节点1与L合并成超节点；先用u=V3和i1=(V1−V2)(2Ω)写控制关系，再消去VL。The lower terminal of the 2u source is not grounded, so V1 is not 2u. Form a supernode containing 1 and L; define both control variables before eliminating VL.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先写控制关系Define the controlling quantities

右侧u以地为负端；i1按2Ω电阻箭头从1到2。电压源约束给出VL=V1−2V3。u is top-positive at node 3; i1 runs from 1 to 2. The dependent voltage-source constraint determines VL.

u=V3,i1=V1−V22Ω,V1−VL=2V3

节点1与L构成超节点Supernode containing 1 and L

超节点向外流出的电流为2Ω支路、上方1A源和下方1Ω支路。内部受控电压源电流不出现在超节点KCL中。The supernode’s external currents are those through 2Ω, the upper 1A source and the lower 1Ω resistor. Its internal voltage-source current cancels.

V1−V22Ω+1A+VL1Ω=0

节点2与3的KCLKCL at nodes 2 and 3

3i1向上流入节点2，列流出总和时取负；上方1A流入节点3，也取负。The controlled 3i1 enters node 2 and the 1A source enters node 3; each has a negative sign in an outgoing-current sum.

V2−V12Ω+V2−V34Ω−3i1=0,V3−V24Ω+V31Ω−1A=0

消去控制量，给出指定节点的方程Eliminate controls to obtain the requested system

以下以电压的伏特数值为未知量，电阻取欧姆数值。得到3个指定非参考节点的独立方程。额外自检可解得V1=V2=V3=1V、VL=−1V。With voltages expressed numerically in volts and resistances in ohms, the reduced independent system uses the three designated node voltages. An optional check gives V1=V2=V3=1V and VL=−1V.

{32V1−12V2−2V3=−1−8V1+9V2−V3=0−V2+5V3=4

节点电压以伏特数值计，可写为32V1−12V2−2V3=−1，−8V1+9V2−V3=0，−V2+5V3=4；控制关系与超节点过程见上。With voltages numerically in volts: 32V1−12V2−2V3=−1, −8V1+9V2−V3=0, −V2+5V3=4. Control definitions and supernode construction are shown above.

易错点Common errors

  • 控制电压u不跨左受控源；右侧1Ω上的u才是控制量。The controlling u is across the right 1Ω resistor, not the dependent source itself.
  • 受控源不能在列方程前关掉；本题i1=0只是求解后的结果。Keep the dependent sources active; i1=0 is a solved result, not an initial assumption.

核验依据Verification

独立用4节点加受控电压源电流的5×5完整MNA盖章，得到V1=V2=V3=1V、VL=−1V，与上述3元系统一致。两只1Ω各耗1W，受控电压源提供2W；上方1A源两端等电位，受控电流源电流为0，功率平衡。第333页附录未列2-10，未声称与其对照。An independent full 5×5MNA system retains four nonreference nodes and the dependent-voltage-source current. It gives V1=V2=V3=1V and VL=−1V. The two 1Ω resistors each dissipate 1W, supplied by 2W from the controlled voltage source. The upper current source has zero voltage and the controlled current is zero. Appendix p. 333 does not list 2-10.

2-11指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2-11Assigned requirement: 2-11

节点法：先列注入电流，再求端口电压差Nodal analysis: injections first, port difference last

题目原文Transcribed question

试用节点电压法求题图2-9所示电路中的电压u。Use nodal-voltage analysis to find voltage u in Fig. 2-9.

底左公共节点接地，15V源上正下负，其上端经3Ω接节点1。节点1经6Ω接地，经2Ω接节点2；另有5A源从节点1指向节点2。节点2经2Ω接节点3，节点3经2Ω接地。输出u按节点2正、节点3负。The lower-left common node is ground. A15V source positive at the top connects through 3Ω to node 1. Node 1 connects to ground through 6Ω and to node 2 through 2Ω, with a5A source also pointing from 1 to 2. Node 2 connects through 2Ω to node 3, which connects through 2Ω to ground. Output u is positive at node 2 and negative at node 3.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点电压法；电流源的注入符号；电压等于节点电位差。Nodal analysis, current-source injection signs and voltage as a node-potential difference.
5A在节点1流出、节点2流入，两条方程右端符号相反。输出端负极是节点3，不能直接把节点2电位当输出。The 5A source leaves node 1 and enters node 2, so its injection signs oppose. The output negative terminal is node 3, not ground.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

节点1列KCLKCL at node 1

取节点电压为v1、v2、v3，源上端已知15V。节点1电阻流出电流之和等于−5A。Let node potentials be v1, v2 and v3. The source upper terminal is at 15V. Resistor currents leaving node 1 sum to −5A.

v1−153+v16+v1−v22=−5

节点2、3列KCLKCL at nodes 2 and 3

节点2注入5A，节点3没有外部注入。Node 2 receives 5A; node 3 has no external injection.

v2−v12+v2−v32=5,v3−v22+v32=0

消元求各节点电位Solve node potentials

第一式化为v2=2v1，第三式给v2=2v3；代入第二式，得到v1=v3=5V、v2=10V。The first equation gives v2=2v1 and the third gives v2=2v3. Substitution into the second gives v1=v3=5V and v2=10V.

v1=5V,v2=10V,v3=5V

按输出参考极性取电位差Take the referenced output difference

输出u的正端是2，负端是3。The positive output terminal is 2 and the negative terminal is 3.

u=v2−v3=10−5=5V

u=5V。u=5V.

易错点Common errors

  • 同一个5A源在两个节点的注入符号相反，不能两处都写+5。The same 5A source has opposite injection signs at nodes 1 and 2.
  • 节点3不是地，u=v2−v3，而非v2。Node 3 is not ground: u=v2−v3, not v2.

核验依据Verification

独立源变换复核：节点1左侧15V3Ω与6Ω网络等效为10V串联2Ω；节点1到2的5A∥2Ω变为使节点2升高10V的串联源。外回路总电阻2+2+4=8Ω，电流(10+10)8=2.5A，故节点2为10V、节点3为5V，输出5V。书第333页、PDF342页2-11亦为5V。Independent source-transformation check: the left 15V3Ω and 6Ω network becomes 10V in series with 2Ω. The 5A parallel 2Ω between nodes 1 and 2 becomes a10V rise toward node 2 in series with 2Ω. The loop current is (10+10)(2+2+4)=2.5A, giving node 2 at 10V and node 3 at 5V, hence u=5V. Answer 2-11 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 agrees.

2-12指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2-12Assigned requirement: 2-12

受控电压源：先读正负端，再写约束Controlled voltage source: polarity before constraints

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图2-10所示电路中的电流i。Find current i in the circuit of Fig. 2-10.

上下为公共节点。左支路4Ω，i参考向上；第二支路为3A向上源；第三支路为电压5i的受控电压源（上负下正）串联2Ω；最右支路12Ω。The upper and lower nodes are common. The left branch is 4Ω with i upward. The next is a3A upward source. The third has a controlled voltage source 5i, negative at the top and positive at the bottom, in series with 2Ω. The right branch is 12Ω.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点法；电流控制电压源；控制电流的参考方向。Nodal analysis, current-controlled voltage sources and current reference direction.
全电路只有一个公共上节点电位，但受控源与2Ω之间还要写一个电压约束。i向上，因此i=−v4。There is one common upper-node potential, with an additional constraint at the junction of the controlled source and 2Ω. Since i points upward, i=−v4.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

定义节点并写控制关系Define potentials and the control relation

底节点为0V，上节点为v，受控源下端与2Ω上端连接点为vx。左支路i向上；受控源正端在下方。Set the bottom to 0V, the upper potential to v and the source and resistor junction to vx. Current i is upward, and the controlled source is positive at its lower terminal.

i=−v4,vx−v=5i⇒vx=v+5i

上节点列KCLApply KCL at the upper node

三条非独立电流源支路的向下电流分别为v4、vx2和v12，它们之和等于3A向上注入。The downward currents in the three other branches are v4, vx2 and v12. Their sum equals the 3A upward injection.

v4+v+5i2+v12=3

代入控制关系并求解Substitute and solve

代入i=−v4后，vx=−v4，KCL化为5v24=3。故v=14.4V，i=−3.6A。Substituting i=−v4 gives vx=−v4. KCL becomes 5v24=3, so v=14.4V and i=−3.6A.

v=725=14.4V,i=−185=−3.6A

i=−3.6A，即4Ω支路实际电流3.6A向下。i=−3.6A: the actual current through 4Ω is 3.6A downward.

易错点Common errors

  • 原图受控源上负下正，必须写vx−v=5i，不能写v−vx=5i。The source is negative at the top and positive below: write vx−v=5i, not v−vx=5i.
  • 负的i同时影响受控源电压，不应在代入时去掉负号。The signed current also controls the source voltage; do not discard its negative sign.

核验依据Verification

独立支路与功率核验：vx=−3.6V，中间支路向下电流−1.8A；上节点向下电流3.6−1.8+1.2=3A。电阻耗散51.84+6.48+17.28=75.6W；3A源吸收−43.2W，受控源上到下电压18V、向下电流−1.8A，吸收−32.4W，总和0。书第333页、PDF342页2-12为−3.6A。Independent branch and power check: vx=−3.6V and the middle downward current is −1.8A. Downward currents sum to 3.6−1.8+1.2=3A. Resistor powers total 51.84+6.48+17.28=75.6W. The 3A source absorbs −43.2W; the controlled source has an 18V top-to-bottom drop with −1.8A downward, absorbing −32.4W. Total power is zero. Answer 2-12 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 is −3.6A.

2-13全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：考试范围（支路与节点分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: required: branch and nodal analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

控制电流用节点电压表示，再代入受控电压源Express the controlling current before eliminating a dependent source

题目原文Transcribed question

按照题图2-11所示电路中给定的节点，列出电路的节点电压方程。Write the circuit’s nodal-voltage equations using the nodes indicated in Fig. 2-11.

左2V源上正下负，经1Ω接节点1。节点1向下14Ω支路电流i1；节点1与2之间12Ω。节点2经13Ω接地，并经12Ω接右受控电压源D，上正下负、值(12)i1。底部共地。A top-positive 2V source connects through 1Ω to node 1. Its downward 14Ω branch carries i1; 12Ω joins nodes 1 and 2. Node 2 has 13Ω to ground and 12Ω to the top-positive dependent voltage source D of value (12)i1. Bottom is grounded.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点电压法、分数电阻的电导、跨阻型受控电压源。Nodal analysis, conductances of fractional resistances and a transresistance-controlled source.
节点1对地电阻是14Ω，电导为4S。故向下控制电流为4V1，再乘受控源的12Ω跨阻，右端电位为2V1。这个正号必须按原图保留。The 14Ω branch has conductance 4S. Its downward current controls a positive 12Ω transresistance, making the right terminal voltage 2V1.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

消去控制电流Eliminate the controlling current

受控电压源下端接地，上正下负，因此右端节点D可直接用V1表示。The dependent source is bottom-grounded and top-positive, so its terminal voltage follows directly from V1.

i1=V1(14)Ω,VD=(12Ω)i1=2V1

节点1方程Node 1 equation

三条流出支路分别去往已知2V、地和节点2。The three outgoing branches connect to the known 2V node, ground, and node 2.

V1−2V1Ω+V1(14)Ω+V1−V2(12)Ω=0

节点2方程Node 2 equation

节点2右支路电位差为V2−2V1，不能误当V2或V2−V1。The right branch drop is V2−2V1, not V2 or V2−V1.

V2−V1(12)Ω+V2(13)Ω+V2−2V1(12)Ω=0

整理成两节点线性系统Collect the two-node system

以伏特数值为未知量，整理后与附录相同；题目只要求列式。可用V1=1437V、V2=1237V作自检。Using numerical volt values gives the system below. Only the equations are requested; V1=1437V and V2=1237V provide an optional check.

{7V1−2V2=2−6V1+7V2=0

以伏特数值计：7V1−2V2=2，−6V1+7V2=0。With voltages numerically in volts: 7V1−2V2=2, −6V1+7V2=0.

易错点Common errors

  • 分数欧姆电阻求电流时要除以整个分数，不能把14Ω写成4Ω。Divide by the entire fractional resistance; 14Ω is not 4Ω.
  • 受控源电压是正的2V1，符号由原图上正下负及i1向下共同决定。The controlled voltage is positive 2V1 under the original polarity and current arrow.

核验依据Verification

完整原拓扑6×6MNA保留已知源节点、受控源端点及两源电流，得到V1=1437V、V2=1237V、VD=2837V、i1=5637A。电阻耗散53361369W，两电压源合计提供同值，精确为零的总功率余量独立通过。附录2-13的两条方程逐项吻合。Independent full-topology 6×6MNA retains both source terminals and currents. It gives V1=1437V, V2=1237V, VD=2837V and i1=5637A. Resistor dissipation is 53361369W, exactly supplied by the two voltage sources. Both equations match Appendix 2-13.

2-14全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：考试范围（支路与节点分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: required: branch and nodal analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

先认清交叉不连接，再算上方支路电流Identify unconnected crossings before finding the upper branch current

题目原文Transcribed question

试用节点电压法求题图2-12所示电路中的电流i。Use nodal-voltage analysis to find current i in Fig. 2-12.

底部整条导线为地。左10V源上正，经1Ω到A；右2V源上正，经3Ω到B；上方2Ω从A到B，i向右。A经左竖2Ω及斜2Ω分别接地；B经右竖6Ω及斜6Ω分别接地。斜线交叉处无节点。The entire lower wire is grounded. A top-positive 10V source connects through 1Ω to A; a top-positive 2V source connects through 3Ω to B. Upper 2Ω joins A to B, with i rightward. A has two separate 2Ω paths to ground, one vertical and one diagonal; B similarly has two 6Ω paths. The diagonal crossing is unconnected.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

按节点识别并联、交叉不连接、节点电压法与电源吸收功率。Recognizing parallel branches by endpoints, unconnected crossings, nodal analysis and absorbed source power.
两条斜线相交不表示短接A与B。下端本来共地，所以A的两个2Ω并联，B的两个6Ω并联；上方2Ω仍是两未知节点之间的支路。The crossing does not short A to B. Because the lower endpoints are grounded, A’s two 2Ω branches are parallel and B’s two 6Ω branches are parallel. The upper 2Ω still links the unknown nodes.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

原图直接列两节点KCLWrite KCL from the original branches

保留两条对地支路分别列电流，有助于避免把斜接支路漏掉。Keep both ground branches explicitly to avoid omitting either diagonal.

VA−10V1Ω+VA2Ω+VA2Ω+VA−VB2Ω=0

右节点KCL与化简Right-node KCL and reduction

右源上端已知为+2V；右节点到该端的电流是(VB−2V)(3Ω)。以下化简式按伏特数值。The right source’s upper terminal is +2V. Use the drop from B to that terminal. The reduced equations use numerical volt values.

VB−2V3Ω+VB6Ω+VB6Ω+VB−VA2Ω=0⇒{5VA−VB=20−3VA+7VB=4

求节点电位并回到所求支路Return from node potentials to the requested branch

联立得A=4.5V、B=2.5V，上方2Ω从左到右压降2V，故电流1A。The potentials are 4.5V and 2.5V. The upper 2Ω has a left-to-right 2V drop.

VA=92V,VB=52V,i=VA−VB2Ω=1A

i=1A，方向与图示一致，从左向右。i=1A, rightward as indicated.

易错点Common errors

  • 两条斜线交叉处没有连接点，不要新增节点。Do not add a node at the unconnected diagonal crossing.
  • 右侧2V源会吸收功率，不必强行规定所有电源都供能。The right 2V source absorbs power; a source need not deliver it.

核验依据Verification

完整MNA保留两只竖直和两只斜接电阻，独立复得4.5V、2.5V及1A。10V源提供55W，2V源吸收13W，七只电阻共耗散1643W，功率严格平衡。第333页附录2-14为1A。Full MNA retains all four ground branches and reproduces 4.5V, 2.5V and 1A. The 10V source supplies 55W, the 2V source absorbs 13W, and the seven resistors dissipate 1643W. Power balances exactly and Appendix 2-14 lists 1A.

2-15全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：考试范围（支路与节点分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: required: branch and nodal analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

电阻零功率先变成零节点电压Convert zero resistor power into a zero node potential

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图2-13所示，欲使3Ω电阻的功率为零，则R应取何值？For Fig. 2-13, what value of R makes the 3Ω resistor dissipate zero power?

底部地。左节点A经3Ω接地，并由7A源向上注入。A到B之间有R，另有1A源由A到B。B右侧7A源向下到地；中支路从B经1Ω到6V源上端C，电源上负下正，故C=−6V。Bottom is grounded. A has 3Ω to ground and a7A upward source. R joins A to B in parallel with a1A source from A to B. A right 7A source runs downward from B to ground. The middle branch is 1Ω from B to C, followed by a bottom-positive 6V source, so C=−6V.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

正电阻零功率条件、节点KCL、反向极性的已知电位。Zero-power condition for a positive resistor, nodal KCL and a reversed known-voltage source.
3Ω为有限正电阻，其功率为VA2(3Ω)，零功率必须使VA=0。先施加这个条件，再用节点电流求R；不要把3Ω删成开路。A finite positive 3Ω resistor has zero power only when VA=0. Impose that condition and use KCL to design R; do not replace the resistor with an open circuit.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由零功率得到节点条件Impose the zero-power condition

3Ω的下端接地，所以电压就是VA。6V源下正上负，故上端C是−6V。The 3Ω voltage is VA. The reversed 6V source fixes C at −6V.

P3Ω=VA23Ω=0⇒VA=0,VC=−6V

节点A求R支路电流Find the R−branch current at A

7A进入A，其中1A经上方源流向B；3Ω中电流为零，剩下6A只能经R由A流向B。Of the 7A entering A, 1A takes the upper source and zero takes the 3Ω resistor. The remaining 6A must flow from A to B through R.

VA3Ω+VA−VBR+1A−7A=0⇒−VBR=6A

节点B确定电位Determine B from its KCL

R与1A源共向B送入7A，恰好被右侧向下7A源取走，因此中间1Ω支路电流为零，B与C等电位。The R branch and upper source deliver 7A to B, exactly removed by the right current source. Hence the middle 1Ω branch carries zero current and B equals C.

−6A−1A+7A+VB+6V1Ω=0⇒VB=−6V

由欧姆定律得到唯一正电阻Obtain the unique positive resistance

R上电压为0−(−6)=6V，电流6A，故R=1Ω。原图3Ω保留在电路内，只是其电压和电流均为零。R has 6V across it and carries 6A, giving 1Ω. The 3Ω remains physically connected with zero voltage and current.

R=VA−VB6A=6V6A=1Ω

R=1Ω。此时3Ω两端电压与电流均为零。R=1Ω; the 3Ω resistor then has zero voltage and current.

易错点Common errors

  • 6V源上端是−6V；误读为+6V会得出错误的负R。The upper terminal is −6V; reversing it incorrectly produces a negative R.
  • 零功率条件不等于把该电阻开路或把整个电路电流置零。Zero resistor power does not mean disconnecting it or setting every circuit current to zero.

核验依据Verification

独立对任意正R保留全部元件列节点方程，按R的欧姆数值得VA=18(R−1)R+4V，只在R=1Ω时为0；另以R=12、1、2、7Ω做精确MNA复核。R=1Ω时R耗36W，上方1A源吸收6W，右7A源提供42W，其他元件功率为0，总功率为0。第333页附录2-15为1Ω。Independent original-circuit nodal equations give VA=18(R−1)R+4V when R is numerical in ohms, vanishing uniquely at positive R=1Ω. Exact MNA checks R=12, 1, 2 and 7Ω. At the design point, R dissipates 36W, the upper 1A source absorbs 6W and the right 7A source supplies 42W; all other powers vanish. Appendix 2-15 agrees.

2-16全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：考试范围（节点与网孔分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: required: nodal and mesh analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

平衡电桥：先找两节点等电位Balanced bridge: identify equal node potentials

题目原文Transcribed question

在题图2-14所示电路中，已知Ro2=RaRb，试用节点电压法证明：u34u14=RoRo+Ra=RbRo+Rb。For Fig. 2-14, given Ro2=RaRb, prove by nodal analysis that u34u14=RoRo+Ra=RbRo+Rb.

节点1到2及2到3均为Ro，2到4为Rb，1到3为Ra，3到4为Ro；左支路为电压源us串联Ro。Ro links 1 to 2 and 2 to 3; Rb links 2 to 4, Ra links 1 to 3, and Ro links 3 to 4. The left source us is in series with Ro.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
以4为地，把u14作为已知端口电压，不要把它误当成串联电源us。平衡条件使节点2与3等电位。Ground node 4 and regard u14 as the port voltage, which differs from the series source us. The balance condition makes nodes 2 and 3 equipotential.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写两条节点方程Write two nodal equations

令U=u14，正电阻取有限值。只对节点2、3写KCL即可。Let U=u14 and assume finite positive resistances. Apply KCL at nodes 2 and 3.

V2−URo+V2−V3Ro+V2Rb=0,V3−URa+V3−V2Ro+V3Ro=0

用平衡条件构造解Construct the balanced solution

由Ro2=RaRb可交叉相乘证明下列两个分压系数相等。令两个节点都等于kU，代回两式分别为零。Cross multiplication proves the two divider ratios equal. Substituting V2=V3=kU satisfies both equations.

k=RoRo+Ra=RbRo+Rb,V2=V3=kU

说明唯一性和比值边界Uniqueness and the zero-input boundary

正电阻网络的接地节点矩阵正定，因此构造出的解唯一。U非零时可相除；U为零时应写电压传输关系，避免零除。The grounded positive-resistance nodal matrix is positive definite, so this solution is unique. Divide only when U is nonzero; otherwise use the linear relation.

u34=ku14,u14≠0 ⇒ u34u14=k

u34=RoRo+Rau14=RbRo+Rbu14。u34=RoRo+Rau14=RbRo+Rbu14.

易错点Common errors

  • 中间Ro中电流为零是平衡后的结果，不能在证明前直接删掉。Zero current in the bridge resistor is a consequence of balance; establish it before removing the branch.

核验依据Verification

两节点符号代回均恒为零；另用三组不同正有理电阻及正负激励精确求解原节点系统，均复得相等节点电位。附录未列2-16。Both symbolic nodal residuals vanish. Three independent rational bridge designs with positive and negative excitations reproduce the balanced potentials by exact elimination. Appendix 2-16 is not listed.

2-17全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：考试范围（节点与网孔分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: required: nodal and mesh analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

先认源的类型，再算吸收功率Identify the controlled source type before its power

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图2-15所示，试列出电路的节点电压方程求受控源的功率。For Fig. 2-15, write the nodal-voltage equations and find the dependent-source power.

左4V源上正；节点1经1S接2、经上方1S接3。节点2到3上路2S，下路2S串联向左2A源。节点2到地的菱形源标正负，是电压I1的受控电压源，I1=(V1−V2)·1S。节点3经1S接上负下正2V源。Node 1 is fixed by a top-positive 4V source. Conductances: 1S between 1–2 and 1–3, 2S between 2–3, and a second 2S in series with a leftward 2A source. The central diamond has voltage polarity marks and voltage I1 under the implied 1Ω transresistance. The right lower source fixes its upper terminal at −2V.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
菱形里的正负号表示电压源，不能把标注I1当成电流源；其跨阻系数隐含为1Ω。2A源箭头向左。The polarity marks identify a voltage source. Its label I1 implies a1Ω transresistance, not an imposed current. The 2A source points left.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

用受控约束确定节点2Determine node 2 from the control

按SI数值列式，V1=4，V2=I1=4−V2；右下已知端电位为−2。Use SI numerical values: V1=4, V2=I1=4−V2, and the lower-right terminal is −2.

V1=4,I1=V1−V2,V2=I1⇒V2=2, I1=2

节点3及受控源支路KCLKCL at node 3 and the controlled branch

2A从节点3流向节点2，节点3流出总和取正2。用J表示受控源从正端向下的电流。The 2A leaves node 3 toward node 2. Let J enter the positive terminal of the controlled source.

(V3−4)+2(V3−V2)+2+(V3+2)=0,(V2−4)+2(V2−V3)−2+J=0

功率按关联参考方向Use the passive sign convention

解得V3=1V、J=2A；电流流入正端，所以是吸收功率。Solving gives V3=1V and J=2A. Current enters the positive terminal, so power is absorbed.

P=V2J=(2V)(2A)=4W

受控源吸收4W。The dependent source absorbs 4W.

易错点Common errors

  • S是电导单位，2S对应电阻12Ω；源的控制量与该源自身支路电流不是同一个未知量。S denotes conductance; 2S corresponds to 12Ω. A controlling current is not automatically the source branch current.

核验依据Verification

完整MNA保留串联2A源与2S间的节点，得V1=4、V2=2、V3=1、串联中间节点3V，受控源向下2A；所有元件总功率精确为零，与附录4W一致。Full MNA retains the node between the 2A source and 2S conductance: potentials are 4, 2, 1 and 3V. The controlled source carries 2A downward, with zero total power residual. The result matches the listed 4W.

公共电阻写网孔电流之差Shared resistors carry differences of mesh currents

题目原文Transcribed question

列出题图2-16所示电路的网孔电流方程。Write the mesh-current equations for Fig. 2-16.

上网孔im1、左下im2、右下im3均顺时针；上路R1与左正右负us1，中央左正右负us2和R2，左竖R3、中央竖R4、右竖上正下负us3。All three mesh currents are clockwise: upper m1, lower-left m2 and lower-right m3. The upper branch has R1 and a left-positive us1; the middle has left-positive us2 and R2. Vertical branches are R3, R4 and top-positive us3.

本题图在书第63页／PDF第72页。The source figure is on printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
同向网孔在公共电阻中反向，电阻压降用本孔电流减邻孔电流。电源项按沿网孔的电压升单独判断。Clockwise meshes oppose in shared branches. Use own current minus the adjacent current; determine source signs from actual voltage rises.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

上方网孔Upper mesh

沿上路从左到右穿过us1为压降，中央从右到左穿过us2为电压升。The upper traversal crosses us1 as a drop and us2 as a rise.

(R1+R2)im1−R2im3=us2−us1

左下网孔Lower-left mesh

沿中央电源从左到右为压降；R4与右下网孔共用。The middle source is a drop in this traversal, and R4 is shared with the lower-right mesh.

(R3+R4)im2−R4im3=−us2

右下网孔Lower-right mesh

R2、R4分别与上孔、左下孔共用；右侧源从上到下为压降。R2 and R4 are shared with the upper and lower-left meshes; the right source is a downward voltage drop.

−R2im1−R4im2+(R2+R4)im3=−us3

以上三式即所求网孔电流方程。The three equations above are the requested mesh system.

易错点Common errors

  • 没有共用电阻的两网孔互阻为零；不要凭“顺时针”统一给所有电源同一符号。Meshes without a shared resistor have zero mutual resistance. Clockwise orientation does not give all sources the same sign.

核验依据Verification

三组不同电阻和正负电源的网孔解，分别与保留全部源端点的完整MNA所得每条电阻支路电流相符；各例全电路功率余量为零。附录未列2-18。Three resistor and source sets, including reversed source values, give mesh currents matching every resistor current in independently stamped MNA; each power residual is zero. No appendix answer is listed.

含边界电流源的网孔先直接定值Set the boundary-current-source mesh first

题目原文Transcribed question

试用网孔分析法求题图2-17所示电路中的电压u。Use mesh analysis to find u in Fig. 2-17.

左上2A向上经顶部2Ω到上节点；中线两个3Ω串联，右侧3Ω跨上下节点。左中到中点5Ω；左下4V源上负下正，再经1Ω接下节点。A2A source drives upward through the upper 2Ω. Two central 3Ω resistors are in series; a right 3Ω spans the upper and lower nodes. A5Ω links the left middle node to the center. The 4V source is bottom-positive and in series with the bottom 1Ω.

本题图在书第63页／PDF第72页。The source figure is on printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
按左上、左下、右侧三个网孔顺时针命名。电流源只属于左上孔，可直接令该孔2A，不需要为它编造电压。Use clockwise upper-left, lower-left and right meshes. The source belongs only to the upper-left mesh, fixing it at 2A.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

固定已知网孔Fix the known mesh

以M1、M2、M3表示三孔电流；其数值以下以安培计。Denote the three currents by M1, M2, M3, numerically in amperes.

M1=2

另两孔KVLKVL for the remaining meshes

左下孔总电阻5+3+1，4V沿上行是压降；右孔含三个3Ω。The lower-left self-resistance is 5+3+1, with a4V drop traversed upward. The right mesh contains three 3Ω resistors.

9M2−5M1−3M3=−4,9M3−3M1−3M2=0

由独占支路得到电压Use the exclusive right branch

代M1=2后解得M2=M3=1A；右侧3Ω电流就是M3。Substitution yields M2=M3=1A. The rightmost resistor carries M3 alone.

M2=M3=1A,u=(3Ω)M3=3V

u=3V，上正下负。u=3V, top-positive.

易错点Common errors

  • 左下4V源与常见上正下负接法相反；顶部2Ω不出现在另外两孔的KVL中。The lower-left source polarity is reversed. The upper 2Ω is absent from the other two mesh equations.

核验依据Verification

独立完整MNA得上节点3V；两未知网孔均1A，与原图全电路零功率余量及附录3V相符。Independent original-topology MNA gives the upper node 3V and both unknown meshes 1A, with zero power residual; Appendix 2-19 agrees.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第63页／PDF第72页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2-20Assigned requirement: 2-20

网孔法遇电流源：超网孔加电流约束A current source in mesh analysis: supermesh plus constraint

题目原文Transcribed question

试用网孔分析法求题图2-18所示电路中的电流i1、i2和i3。Use mesh analysis to find currents i1, i2 and i3 in Fig. 2-18.

底部公共节点，左2V源上负下正，经上方4Ω接顶中节点，4Ω电流i1向右；顶中经5Ω接右30V源上端，i2向右，30V源也上负下正。顶中与底部之间另有2Ω电阻（i3向下）和3A向下电流源两条并联支路。The bottom is common. The left 2V source is negative at the top and connects through upper 4Ω to the middle-top node, with i1 rightward. A5Ω resistor carries i2 rightward from this node to the upper terminal of the right 30V source, also negative at the top. A2Ω resistor with i3 downward and a3A downward current source separately connect middle-top to bottom.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

顺时针网孔电流；共享支路电流差；超网孔。Clockwise mesh currents, differences in shared branches and supermeshes.
电流源位于两个相邻网孔的公共边，其端电压未知，不能写成电阻压降。把这两个网孔合成超网孔，再补电流源约束。The current source lies between adjacent meshes and has an unknown voltage. Form a supermesh around those meshes and add the current constraint.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

定义三个网孔电流Define three mesh currents

从左到右，三个最小网孔取顺时针电流j1、j2、j3。则i1=j1，i2=j3，2Ω中向下电流i3=j1−j2。Take clockwise mesh currents j1, j2 and j3 from left to right. Then i1=j1, i2=j3 and the downward 2Ω current is i3=j1−j2.

i1=j1,i2=j3,i3=j1−j2

左网孔KVLLeft-mesh KVL

左2V源从下向上经过是从正端到负端，为2V压降。Traversing the left 2V source upward goes from positive to negative, producing a2V drop.

2+4j1+2(j1−j2)=0⇒6j1−2j2=−2

中右超网孔与电流约束Middle and right supermesh and current constraint

超网孔绕过3A源，经过5Ω、30V源和2Ω。右30V源从上向下是电压上升。3A向下等于中网孔向下减右网孔向上。The supermesh bypasses the 3A source and passes through 5Ω, the 30V source and 2Ω. Traversing the 30V source downward is a voltage rise. The downward 3A equals the middle mesh current minus the right mesh current.

5j3−30−2(j1−j2)=0,j2−j3=3

联立并还原支路电流Solve and recover branch currents

解得j1=2A、j2=7A、j3=4A。因此i1=2A、i2=4A、i3=−5A；i3实际向上5A。Solving gives j1=2A, j2=7A and j3=4A. Thus i1=2A, i2=4A and i3=−5A; its actual direction is 5A upward.

i1=2A,i2=4A,i3=−5A

i1=2A，i2=4A，i3=−5A（按图示参考方向）。i1=2A, i2=4A and i3=−5A, using the figure reference directions.

易错点Common errors

  • i3是共享支路电流差，不是某一个网孔电流。i3 is a difference of mesh currents, not a single mesh current.
  • 两个电压源均上负下正，绕行时必须逐个判定电压升降。Both voltage sources are negative at the top; determine each voltage rise or drop from the traversal direction.

核验依据Verification

独立节点法：取底部0V，则左端−2V、右端−30V。顶中节点V满足(V+2)4+V2+(V+30)5+3=0，得V=−10V。于是i1=[−2−(−10)]4=2A、i2=[−10−(−30)]5=4A、i3=−102=−5A；KCL也有2=4−5+3。书第333页、PDF342页2-20三项完全相同。Independent nodal check: with bottom at 0V, the left and right upper terminals are −2V and −30V. The middle-top V satisfies (V+2)4+V2+(V+30)5+3=0, giving V=−10V. Then i1=[−2−(−10)]4=2A, i2=[−10−(−30)]5=4A and i3=−102=−5A. KCL gives 2 = 4−5+3. Answer 2-20 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 matches all three.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第63页／PDF第72页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2-21Assigned requirement: 2-21

网孔法中的受控电压源与电流源约束Mesh analysis with controlled voltage and current-source constraints

题目原文Transcribed question

试用网孔分析法求题图2-19所示电路中的电流i。Use mesh analysis to find current i in Fig. 2-19.

左、右上节点由顶端导线直接相连，顶导线电流i1向右。中间横支路依次为2Ω和1Ω，中间节点经3A向上的电流源接底节点。左侧10V源、右侧受控电压源2i1均上正下负，接在上节点与底节点间。所求i在左下导线上向左。The upper left and upper right nodes are directly joined by a top wire carrying i1 rightward. A middle path contains 2Ω then 1Ω; their junction connects to the bottom through a3A upward current source. The left 10V source and right controlled voltage source 2i1 are both positive at the top. The requested i points left along the lower-left wire.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

网孔电流与共享支路；超网孔；受控源控制关系。Mesh currents and shared branches, supermeshes, and controlled-source relations.
顶导线压降为0，却仍可能有非零电流。受控源的控制量就是这条导线电流i1；遇到3A源，要加电流差约束而不是给它指定电压。The top wire has zero voltage drop but can carry nonzero current. Its current i1 controls the voltage source. The 3A source supplies a mesh-current difference constraint, not a specified voltage.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

定义网孔与支路电流Define mesh and branch currents

上方、左下、右下三个最小网孔分别取顺时针电流j1、j2、j3。顶导线只有上网孔经过，所以i1=j1；左下导线只有左下网孔经过，所以i=j2。3A向上对应j3−j2。Assign clockwise currents j1, j2 and j3 to the upper, lower-left and lower-right meshes. Only j1 traverses the top wire, so i1=j1. Only j2 traverses the lower-left wire, so i=j2. The upward 3A is j3−j2.

i1=j1,i=j2,j3−j2=3

上网孔列KVLApply KVL to the upper mesh

上网孔顺时针从顶导线到右端，再经1Ω、2Ω返回左端。两段电阻电流均为相邻网孔电流之差。Traverse the upper mesh clockwise along the top wire, then return through 1Ω and 2Ω. Each resistor current is the difference of adjacent mesh currents.

(j1−j3)+2(j1−j2)=0⇒3j1−2j2−j3=0

列下方超网孔Write the lower supermesh equation

绕过3A源，沿左下和右下网孔的外边界：依次经过2Ω、1Ω、受控电压源，再经10V源从负到正。受控源压降必须保留为2j1。Bypass the 3A source and traverse the lower supermesh boundary through 2Ω, 1Ω, the controlled voltage source, then the 10V source from negative to positive. Retain the controlled-source drop as 2j1.

2(j2−j1)+(j3−j1)+2j1−10=0⇒−j1+2j2+j3=10

联立求解Solve the system

将前两条KVL相加可得2j1=10，故j1=5A；再用电流源约束和上网孔方程解得j2=4A、j3=7A。Adding the two KVL equations gives 2j1=10 and j1=5A. Using the current-source constraint and upper-mesh equation then gives j2=4A and j3=7A.

(j1,j2,j3)=(5,4,7)A,i=4A

i=4A，方向与图中向左的参考方向相同。i=4A, in the indicated leftward direction.

易错点Common errors

  • 理想导线电压为0并不意味着电流为0。Zero voltage across an ideal wire does not imply zero current.
  • 受控源不能在写超网孔时去掉；其控制量是顶导线电流，不是所求i。Keep the controlled source in the supermesh. Its control current is the top-wire current, not the requested i.

核验依据Verification

独立节点、功率核验：底节点取0V，左右上节点均为10V；中间节点KCL给出(V−10)2+(V−10)=3，得V=12V。顶导线i1=102=5A，左节点有中间流入1A、顶导线流出5A，所以10V源向上4A，即i=4A。电阻耗散6W；10V源、受控源和3A源吸收功率依次−40、70、−36W，总和0。精确有理数MNA复核相同。书第333页、PDF342页2-21为4A。Independent nodal and power check: set the bottom to 0V. Both upper nodes are 10V; middle-node KCL gives (V−10)2+(V−10)=3, so V=12V. The controlled relation gives i1=102=5A. At the left node, 1A enters from the middle and 5A leaves along the wire; the 10V source therefore supplies 4A upward, equal to i. Resistors dissipate 6W; the 10V, controlled and 3A sources absorb −40, 70 and −36W, totaling zero. Exact-rational MNA agrees. Answer 2-21 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 is 4A.

超网孔加受控电流约束A supermesh needs the controlled-current constraint

题目原文Transcribed question

试列出题图2-20所示电路的网孔电流方程，并计算受控源吸收的功率。Write mesh equations for Fig. 2-20 and calculate the dependent source’s absorbed power.

上方2A源向右；左4V源上正。中央横线左2Ω右1Ω，i向右流过1Ω；中央向下受控电流源2i；右3Ω接地。三网孔均顺时针。The upper source is 2A rightward; the left 4V source is top-positive. Middle resistors are 2Ω and 1Ω, with i rightward through 1Ω. A central dependent source carries 2i downward; the right resistor is 3Ω. All meshes are clockwise.

本题图在书第63页／PDF第72页。The source figure is on printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
i不是右下网孔电流本身，而是右下减上孔。受控源跨两孔，用一个电流约束和一个绕外边的超网孔KVL。The control current is lower-right minus upper mesh current. The shared controlled source requires a current constraint plus outer supermesh KVL.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

源约束Source constraints

按图im1、im2、im3记三孔；以下电流取安培数值。Use the three labeled mesh currents; currents below are numerical amperes.

im1=2,i=im3−im1,im2−im3=2(im3−im1)

绕过中间电流源Bypass the current source

超网孔经过2Ω、1Ω、3Ω和左4V源，不经过受控源。The outer lower supermesh includes 2Ω, 1Ω, 3Ω and the 4V source.

2(im2−im1)+(im3−im1)+3im3=4⇒im2=75, im3=95

回原支路求功率Return to the original branch for power

i=−15A，受控源电流2i=−25A；中央节点电位为4−2(im2−im1)=265V。The control is −15A and source current −25A. The source top potential is 4−2(im2−im1)=265V.

P=265(−25)W=−5225W=−2.08W

受控源吸收功率−2.08W，即提供2.08W。Absorbed power is −2.08W, so the source supplies 2.08W.

易错点Common errors

  • 负吸收功率是供能，不应去掉负号；源电压必须回到原电路计算。Negative absorbed power denotes delivery; retain the sign and determine voltage in the original circuit.

核验依据Verification

独立原拓扑MNA得到中央265V、右端275V，受控源功率−5225W，且所有元件功率严格平衡，与附录一致。Independent MNA gives center 265V, right 275V and controlled-source power −5225W. Total power balances exactly and the appendix agrees.

2-23全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第63页／PDF第72页。范围状态：考试范围（节点与网孔分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72. Coverage: required: nodal and mesh analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

两个电流源分开写约束Give each current source its own constraint

题目原文Transcribed question

用网孔分析法求题图2-21所示电路中的电流i。Use mesh analysis to find i in Fig. 2-21.

左12V源上正，左节点A到中节点B有1Ω与向右2u受控电流源并联；B到右节点C有1Ω与向右6A源并联。B到地3Ω电压u上正，C到地2Ω，i向下。A is fixed at 12V. A–B has 1Ω parallel with a rightward 2u source; B–C has 1Ω parallel with a rightward 6A source. B has 3Ω to ground with u top-positive; C has 2Ω with i downward.

本题图在书第63页／PDF第72页。The source figure is on printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
取四个顺时针孔：AB上小孔M1、BC上小孔M2、左下M3、右下M4。所求i=M4，控制电压u=3(M3−M4)。Choose four clockwise meshes: AB upper M1, BC upper M2, lower-left M3 and lower-right M4. Then i=M4 and u=3(M3−M4).
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

把源写成约束Write the source constraints

2u是受控电流，隐含跨导2S；6A在M4与M2的共用支路。以下取SI数值。The control has an implied 2S transconductance. The 6A source is shared by M4 and M2. Use SI numerical values.

M1=2u=6(M3−M4),M4−M2=6

左孔与右超网孔Left mesh and right supermesh

左下孔经过12V源、AB的1Ω和3Ω；右超网孔绕过6A，经过BC上方1Ω、2Ω和3Ω。The lower-left mesh uses the 12V source, AB resistor and 3Ω. The right supermesh bypasses 6A via the upper BC resistor, 2Ω and 3Ω.

4M3−M1−3M4=12,M2−3M3+5M4=0

消元并解释负方向Eliminate and interpret the negative result

化简为−2M3+3M4=12、−3M3+6M4=6，解得M3=−18、M4=−8。Reduction gives −2M3+3M4=12 and −3M3+6M4=6, hence M3=−18 and M4=−8.

i=M4=−8A,u=3(M3−M4)=−30V

i=−8A，实际向上8A。i=−8A, physically 8A upward.

易错点Common errors

  • 2u受控源不可在列式时关掉，u也不是右侧2Ω上的电压。Keep the dependent source active; u is the 3Ω voltage, not the right resistor voltage.

核验依据Verification

原节点盖章独立得到B=−30V、C=−16V，C经2Ω电流−8A，全功率余量为零，与附录相符。Independent original-node stamping gives B=−30V, C=−16V, hence −8A through 2Ω; power balances and the appendix agrees.

同时保留受控电压与电流关系Retain both controlled voltage and current relations

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图2-22所示，试列出其网孔电流方程。Write the mesh-current equations for Fig. 2-22.

左3V源上正。上支路2Ω串联左负右正受控电压u；中支路左2Ω电压u左正右负、右1Ω；中央受控电流源2u向下。右支路1Ω串上正下负6V源。The left source is top-positive 3V. Upper branch: 2Ω plus a right-positive controlled voltage u. Middle: left 2Ω with u left-positive, then 1Ω. The central current source 2u points down. The right branch has 1Ω and a top-positive 6V source.

本题图在书第63页／PDF第72页。The source figure is on printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
另定义上孔M1、左下M2、右下M3均顺时针。u同时控制两个源，先用同一条2Ω支路表示它。Define clockwise upper M1, lower-left M2 and lower-right M3. Express u once from the middle 2Ω because it controls both sources.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

控制量与源约束Controls and source constraint

以下用SI数值。中间受控源电流为M2−M3，u为2(M2−M1)。Use SI numerical values. The central source current is M2−M3 and u is 2(M2−M1).

u=2(M2−M1),M2−M3=2u

上网孔KVLUpper-mesh KVL

沿上支路受控电压源由负到正是电压升，应以−u计入压降和。The upper source is traversed negative-to-positive, so its voltage drop is −u.

2M1−u+(M1−M3)+2(M1−M2)=0

下方超网孔与整理Lower supermesh and reduced system

超网孔绕过中央电流源；左3V为升、右6V为降，净电压升−3V。Bypass the central current source. The 3V source is a rise and 6Va drop, giving net rise −3V.

2(M2−M1)+(M3−M1)+M3=−3⇒{7M1−4M2−M3=04M1−3M2−M3=0−3M1+2M2+2M3=−3

所求为上述三元网孔方程；以安培计，自检解M1=37、M2=97、M3=−157。The three-equation system is the requested result; a check gives M1=37, M2=97 and M3=−157 amperes.

易错点Common errors

  • 源2u的系数是跨导，源u的系数是无量纲；二者类型不同，不能互换。The 2u source has a transconductance; the u source has a dimensionless voltage gain. Their types differ.

核验依据Verification

独立完整MNA给中央97V、右277V，与网孔解逐支路一致；受控源和独立源一起计入后总功率为零。附录未列此题。Independent full MNA gives center 97V and right 277V, matching all mesh branch currents. Including all sources gives zero total power. No appendix answer is listed.

2-25全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第63页／PDF第72页。范围状态：电路课程范围外拓展（2.6回路电流法）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72. Coverage: Circuit extension: section 2.6 loop-current method.

选电流源为连支，只留一个回路KVLChoose current sources as links to leave one KVL

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图2-23所示，试选一棵树，使之只需要一个回路方程即能解出电流i，并确定i的值。Choose a tree for Fig. 2-23 so that only one loop equation is needed to determine i, and find i.

A到B为5Ω，i从A向B；B到地30Ω，C到地20Ω。上支路A经10Ω及左正右负10V源到C；左电流源参考向上但值−1A；B到C受控电流源1.5i向右。A–B is 5Ω, with i from A to B. B has 30Ω to ground and C has 20Ω. Upper A–C branch: 10Ω and left-positive 10V. The left source is labeled −1A upward; a1.5i dependent current source points B to C.

本题图在书第63页／PDF第72页。The source figure is on printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
将串联10Ω与10V源视作一条支路，取5Ω、30Ω、20Ω三支为树。两电流源为连支，其电流已给定或由i控制，只有上支路连支需要KVL。Treat the series 10Ω and 10V as one branch. Use 5Ω, 30Ω and 20Ω as the tree. Current-source links already have known or controlled currents; only the upper link needs KVL.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由树的KCL表达所有电流Express tree currents by KCL

令上支路从A到C的电流J，30Ω向下为I30，20Ω向下为I20。−1A向上即1A向下。Let J run A to C, with I30 and I20 downward. A source of −1A upward is 1A downward.

J=−1−i,I30=−12i,I20=−1+12i

唯一未知回路KVLThe single unknown loop KVL

沿A→上支路→C→地→B→A，保留10V压降。所有电流以下以安培计。Traverse A through the upper branch to C, ground, B and A. Keep the 10V drop. Currents are numerical amperes.

10J+10+20I20−30I30−5i=0

代入求解Substitute and solve

代入KCL表达式只剩一个未知量。Substituting the KCL expressions leaves one unknown.

10(−1−i)+10+20(−1+12i)−30(−12i)−5i=0⇒10i−20=0

i=2A，从左向右。i=2A, left to right.

易错点Common errors

  • 树不能包含闭合回路；若保留10V源内部节点，可把该电压源也加入树，拓扑结论不变。A tree has no cycles. If the series source’s internal node is retained, add the voltage source to the tree; the conclusion is unchanged.

核验依据Verification

原拓扑MNA保留上支路内部节点，得A=−20V、B=−30V、C=0，因此i=2A；功率余量精确为零，附录同为2A。Original-topology MNA retains the internal source node and gives A=−20V, B=−30V, C=0, hence i=2A. Power residual is zero and the listed answer agrees.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第63页／PDF第72页。范围状态：电路课程范围外拓展（2.6～2.8）；运放题可联系模电第2章复习。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72. Coverage: Circuit extension beyond 2.5; op-amp topics overlap Analog chapter 2.

同相放大三小问逐一代入Apply the non-inverting relation to all three cases

题目原文Transcribed question

对题图2-24所示电路，试计算在下列情况下的输出电压uo：（1）uin=300mV,R1=10Ω,R2=75Ω；（2）uin=1.5V,R1=R2=1MΩ；（3）uin=−1V,R1=3.3kΩ,R2=4.7kΩ。Find uo in Fig. 2-24 for (1) uin=300mV,R1=10Ω,R2=75Ω; (2) uin=1.5V,R1=R2=1MΩ; (3) uin=−1V,R1=3.3kΩ,R2=4.7kΩ.

理想运放同相端接uin，反相端由R1接地、R2接输出；负载RL由输出接地。The ideal non-inverting input is uin; R1 connects the inverting input to ground and R2 to the output. RL is an output-to-ground load.

本题图在书第64页／PDF第73页。The source figure is on printed p. 64 · PDF p. 73.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
反相端接收负反馈，理想线性模型中虚短、虚断可用。负载只改变输出电流，不改变理想电压增益。Negative feedback permits ideal virtual equality and zero input current. The load changes output current but not the ideal voltage gain.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从反相节点KCL推公式Derive the gain from input-node KCL

虚短给V−=uin，虚断使流经R1的电流等于反馈电流。Virtual equality gives V−=uin and zero input current equates the resistor currents.

uinR1+uin−uoR2=0⇒uo=(1+R2R1)uin

前两小问First two cases

300mV先换成0.300V；第二问两个兆欧电阻之比为1。Convert 300mV to 0.300V; the two equal megohm resistors give a ratio of one.

uo1=(1+7510)0.300=2.55V,uo2=2(1.5)=3V

第三问及附录差异Third case and appendix discrepancy

原文明确为3.3kΩ及4.7kΩ；按原参数求值，不为贴合附录−2.45V修改电阻。The source states 3.3kΩ and 4.7kΩ. Retain these values rather than altering them to match the appendix’s−2.45V.

uo3=−(1+4.73.3)V=−8033V≈−2.42424V

（1）2.55V；（2）3V；（3）−8033V≈−2.42424V。(1) 2.55V; (2) 3V; (3) −8033V≈−2.42424V.

易错点Common errors

  • 虚短不是导线短接；真实运放还需满足输出摆幅与电流限制，题设未给电源时这里只求理想线性结果。Virtual equality is not a physical short. Actual swing and current limits require supply information absent from the ideal problem.

核验依据Verification

独立解输入约束与节点KCL，精确得到5120、3、−8033V。前两问与附录相符；第3问原题高分辨率核读3.3kΩ与4.7kΩ，附录−2.45V与其不一致。Independent ideal-input constraints and KCL give exactly 5120, 3 and −8033V. The first two agree with the appendix. High-resolution source inspection confirms 3.3kΩ and 4.7kΩ, inconsistent with the listed −2.45V.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第63页／PDF第72页。范围状态：电路课程范围外拓展（2.6～2.8）；运放题可联系模电第2章复习。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72. Coverage: Circuit extension beyond 2.5; op-amp topics overlap Analog chapter 2.

虚地旁的电阻电流为零A resistor across virtual ground carries zero current

题目原文Transcribed question

计算题图2-25所示电路的输出电压uo。Calculate uo in Fig. 2-25.

同相端接地；反相端有向上1mA源与150Ω并联接地，并经2.2kΩ反馈电阻接输出。The non-inverting input is grounded. At the inverting input, an upward 1mA source is parallel with 150Ω to ground; the feedback resistor is 2.2kΩ.

本题图在书第64页／PDF第73页。The source figure is on printed p. 64 · PDF p. 73.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
反相节点为虚地，150Ω两端零压，1mA全部流向反馈支路；不是流进运放输入。The inverting node is at virtual ground. The 150Ω has zero voltage and all 1mA flows through feedback, not into the input.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定虚地Identify virtual ground

在负反馈理想线性模型下，两输入电压都为零。Under ideal linear negative feedback, both input potentials are zero.

V−=V+=0,I150=0150Ω=0

反相节点KCLInverting-node KCL

电流源送入1mA，反馈电阻流出同样的电流。The source injects 1mA and the feedback resistor carries it out.

0−uo2.2kΩ=1mA

求值并验极性Evaluate and check polarity

输出要低于虚地，电流才能从节点流向输出。The output must be below virtual ground to accept this current.

uo=−(1mA)(2.2kΩ)=−2.2V

uo=−2.2V。uo=−2.2V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不可把150Ω与2.2kΩ简单并联分流；两只电阻的另一端电位不同。Do not use simple parallel current division: the far ends of the two resistors have different potentials.

核验依据Verification

将150Ω保留在原节点方程，联立理想输入条件精确解得−115V，与附录−2.2V一致。Keeping 150Ω in the original KCL and imposing ideal input equality gives exactly −115V, matching the appendix.

输出串联小电阻也要计入压降Include the small series output resistor

题目原文Transcribed question

计算题图2-26所示电路中的电压u1。Calculate u1 in Fig. 2-26.

同相端由向上1μA源与4MΩ并联驱动。反相端经1kΩ接3V源上端，经17kΩ到节点X；X经100Ω到运放输出Y。Y经75kΩ接地，经300kΩ到开路测量端u1。The non-inverting node has an upward 1μA source and 4MΩ to ground. The inverting node connects to 3V through 1kΩ and to X through 17kΩ. X connects through 100Ω to output Y. Y has 75kΩ to ground and 300kΩ to the open measurement terminal u1.

本题图在书第64页／PDF第73页。The source figure is on printed p. 64 · PDF p. 73.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
反馈取自输出经过100Ω及17kΩ的支路。测量端开路使300kΩ无压降；100Ω却有反馈电流，不能同样忽略。The feedback path contains both 100Ω and 17kΩ. The open terminal gives no drop across 300kΩ; 100Ω does carry feedback current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求同相端及反相端电位Find the two input potentials

输入电流为零，1μA全经4MΩ，得4V；负反馈令反相端也为4V。Zero input current sends all 1μA through 4MΩ, giving 4V at both inputs.

V+=V−=(1μA)(4MΩ)=4V

反相端KCL求反馈中点Find the feedback intermediate node

1kΩ中电流从4V节点流向3V端，为1mA；17kΩ须从X向反相端提供1mA。The 1kΩ carries 1mA from 4V toward 3V; 17kΩ must supply that current from X.

4−31kΩ+4−VX17kΩ=0⇒VX=21V

补上100Ω压降，判断测量端Add the 100Ω drop and use the open terminal

100Ω中同为1mA，由Y流向X；Y比X高0.1V。300kΩ没有电流，测量端电压等于Y。The same 1mA flows from Y to X through 100Ω, making Y0.1V higher. No current in 300kΩ means u1=Y.

VY=21+(1mA)(100Ω)=21.1V,u1=VY

按原图17kΩ、100Ω计算，u1=21.1V；附录列21.2V，与原参数不符。With the original 17kΩ and 100Ω, u1=21.1V. The appendix’s21.2V is inconsistent with these values.

易错点Common errors

  • 75kΩ由理想输出驱动，改变供电电流但不改变上述反馈解。这里未给电源轨，只能给理想线性结果。The 75kΩ load changes output current but not the ideal feedback solution. Supply rails are unspecified, so this is an ideal linear result.

核验依据Verification

独立联立五个输入、X、Y、开路端方程，精确得到4、4、21、21110、21110V；输入KCL与100Ω压降吻合。附录21.2V单列为差异。An independent five-variable input and X and Y and open-terminal system gives exactly 4, 4, 21, 21110 and 21110V, satisfying input KCL and the 100Ω drop. The 21.2V appendix value is documented as a discrepancy.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第64页／PDF第73页。范围状态：电路课程范围外拓展（2.6～2.8）；运放题可联系模电第2章复习。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 64 · PDF p. 73. Coverage: Circuit extension beyond 2.5; op-amp topics overlap Analog chapter 2.

由负载功率反推同相增益Work backward from load power to non-inverting gain

题目原文Transcribed question

在题图2-27所示电路中，如果要求传递给10kΩ电阻的功率为150mW，则电阻R应取何值？What value of R in Fig. 2-27 delivers 150mW to the 10kΩ resistor?

同相端接上正下负5V源，反相端经R接地，经1kΩ接输出；输出经10kΩ接地。The non-inverting input is fixed at +5V. R connects the inverting input to ground; 1kΩ provides output feedback. The load is 10kΩ to ground.

本题图在书第64页／PDF第73页。The source figure is on printed p. 64 · PDF p. 73.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
功率先给输出电压绝对值；正电阻同相闭环增益为正，输入+5V选正根，再反解R。Power determines output magnitude. A positive-resistance non-inverting amplifier with +5V input selects the positive root; then solve for R.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

功率转电压Convert power to voltage

将150mW换成0.150W，电阻取10000Ω。Convert 150mW to 0.150W and the load to 10000Ω.

uo=+PRL=0.150×10000V=1015V

由输入KCL求RUse input KCL to solve for R

反相端为5V，对地R的电流由1kΩ反馈支路提供。The inverting node is at 5V; the feedback resistor supplies the current through R.

5R+5−uo1000=0⇒R=1000215−1Ω

数值与模型边界Numerical value and model boundary

理想输出约38.73V；真实器件必须具有足够的输出摆幅。题设未给电源或型号，不凭空指定饱和值。The ideal output is about 38.73V. A real device needs sufficient swing; no supply or device is specified, so do not invent a saturation value.

R≈148.2375Ω,uo≈38.7298V

R≈148.24Ω（附录取148Ω）。R≈148.24Ω (148Ω rounded in the appendix).

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把150mW直接当150W；不应在求根后保留与+5V同相增益不相容的负输出。Do not treat 150mW as 150W. Reject the negative output root incompatible with the positive non-inverting gain.

核验依据Verification

把所求R代回独立输入节点KCL及uo2(10000Ω)，功率数值余量小于10−14W；精确表达式与附录148Ω的舍入一致。Substitution into input KCL and the independent load-power equation leaves less than 10−14W numerical residual. The exact expression rounds to the listed 148Ω.

2-30全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第64页／PDF第73页。范围状态：电路课程范围外拓展（2.6～2.8）；运放题可联系模电第2章复习。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 64 · PDF p. 73. Coverage: Circuit extension beyond 2.5; op-amp topics overlap Analog chapter 2.

先求形式解，再检查反馈稳定性Find the formal solution, then check feedback stability

题目原文Transcribed question

在题图2-28所示含有理想运放的电路中，已知R1=R3=R4=1kΩ，R2=R5=2kΩ，ui=1V，求i5。For the ideal-op-amp circuit in Fig. 2-28, let R1=R3=R4=1kΩ, R2=R5=2kΩ and ui=1V. Find i5.

反相端由R1接输入ui、R2接输出；同相端由R3接地、R4接输出。R5从输出接地，i5向下。R1 links the input to the inverting node, with feedback R2 from output. The non-inverting node is between output resistor R4 and ground resistor R3. R5 is the output load, i5 downward.

本题图在书第64页／PDF第73页。The source figure is on printed p. 64 · PDF p. 73.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL、KVL、控制变量与题设理想模型；先按端点和方向识图。KCL, KVL, control definitions and the stated ideal model; identify endpoints and references first.
两端都接输出，不能只看到反相端反馈就判为稳定负反馈。先按教材理想线性约束求形式平衡，再检查输出对差模输入的净反馈。Both inputs receive output feedback. Do not assume negative feedback merely from R2. First find the textbook formal linear equilibrium, then check net differential feedback.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

两个输入节点分别列式Write KCL at both inputs

输入电流均为零，用kΩ和mA配套；电压取伏特数值。Both input currents vanish. Use kΩ with mA and numerical volt values.

V−−11+V−−uo2=0,V+1+V+−uo1=0

理想虚短给形式解Virtual equality gives a formal solution

联立V−=V+得到输出4V，两输入均2V。该结果对应教材线性代数解。Imposing V−=V+ gives output 4V and both inputs 2V. This is the textbook algebraic linear solution.

V−=2+uo3,V+=uo2,uo=4V,i5=4V2kΩ=2mA

说明形式解的稳定性边界State the equilibrium’s stability limitation

固定输入时，输出增大会使差模输入也增大，净正反馈系数为16。普通正开环增益、单极点动态模型中此线性平衡不稳定；实际饱和值需电源轨等信息。At fixed input, an output increase raises the differential input: net positive feedback is 16. With an ordinary positive-gain one-pole dynamic model, this linear equilibrium is unstable. Actual saturation needs supply information.

∂(V+−V−)∂uo=12−13=16>0

教材理想线性形式解为i5=2mA。该点为净正反馈下的不稳定平衡；未给电源和动态条件，不能把它直接称作真实稳定工作点。The textbook formal linear solution is i5=2mA. It is an unstable equilibrium under net positive feedback; without supply and dynamic conditions it is not a guaranteed physical steady operating point.

易错点Common errors

  • 虚短必须有适用条件；不能从代数相等反过来证明负反馈稳定。Virtual equality has conditions of use. Algebraic equality alone does not prove stable negative feedback.

核验依据Verification

独立三元输入KCL系统精确给2、2、4V及1500A，与附录2mA相同；另外计算输出到差模输入系数+16，单列稳定性限制，未虚构饱和值。An independent three-variable input-KCL system gives exactly 2, 2, 4V and 1500A, agreeing with 2mA in the appendix. The separate +16 differential-feedback calculation records the stability limit without inventing saturation values.

3-1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

梯形电路从负载向前推Work backward through the resistive ladder

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-1所示电路中，已知us=20V，求电流i。欲使电流i=0.25A，电源电压us应为多少？For Fig. 3-1, find i when us=20V. What us makes i=0.25A?

从左到右三个串联10Ω；三个节点分别以25Ω、20Ω、30Ω接地，i为最右30Ω向下电流；电源上正。Three 10Ω series resistors form a ladder with shunts 25Ω, 20Ω and 30Ω from left to right. i is downward through 30Ω; the source is top-positive.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第96页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
只含一项独立激励，电流与电压成正比。以所求末端电流i为起点向前推，比不断合并分数更直接。There is one independent excitation, so current is proportional to source voltage. Work backward from the requested terminal current to avoid repeated equivalent-resistance fractions.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从右端推到中节点Work backward from the right node

以下以安培、伏特、欧姆数值列式。右端电压30i；相邻中节点须再加10i，故为40i。Use SI numerical values. The right potential is 30i; adding the adjacent 10Ω drop gives 40i at the middle node.

VC=30i,VB=40i,I20=2i

继续向左，用KCL累计电流Continue left using KCL

第二个10Ω携带3i，所以左节点为70i；25Ω分走14i5，最左串联电流为29i5。The middle 10Ω carries 3i, giving left-node potential 70i. The 25Ω draws 14i5, so the source current is 29i5.

VA=40i+10(3i)=70i,us=70i+10(295i)=128i

完成两问Answer both cases

第一问用20除128，第二问将目标电流代入同一传输关系。Divide 20 by 128 for the first case and substitute the desired current for the second.

i=20128A=0.15625A,us=128(0.25)V=32V

i=0.15625A；目标0.25A需us=32V。i=0.15625A; 0.25A requires us=32V.

易错点Common errors

  • 各段10Ω电流不同，不能把三只10Ω直接串联合并；附录0.156A只是舍入。The three 10Ω currents differ; they are not a simple series chain. The listed 0.156A is rounded.

核验依据Verification

完整原拓扑MNA分别在20V和32V下求解，末端电流精确为532A与14A，全部元件功率余量为零，与附录0.156A、32V一致。Full original-topology MNA at 20V and 32V gives exactly 532A and 14A, with zero power residual in both cases, agreeing with the rounded appendix values.

3-2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

从输出电压向输入电流倒推Infer source current from the terminal voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-2所示电路中，已知u2=6V，求电流源的电流is。如果is=1A，则u2是多少？For Fig. 3-2, find is when u2=6V. If is=1A, find u2.

源电流向上注入左节点；左节点以2kΩ接地，经500Ω接中节点，中节点以3kΩ接地，经1kΩ接右节点，右节点2kΩ电压u2上正。The upward source injects into a left node with 2kΩ to ground. A500Ω links it to a middle node with 3kΩ to ground. A1kΩ leads to the right 2kΩ load with u2 top-positive.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第96页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
由右侧已知电压先定负载电流，然后逐段补压降和分流。单源线性关系允许第二问直接缩放。Start with the right load current, then add voltage drops and shunt currents leftward. Single-source linearity permits scaling for the second case.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求中节点Find the middle node

右2kΩ流3mA，1kΩ同流3mA，中节点9V；3kΩ也流3mA。The right load and 1kΩ carry 3mA, giving a9V middle potential and another 3mA through 3kΩ.

IL=6V2kΩ=3mA,VB=9V,I500=6mA

左节点KCL求源电流Use left-node KCL

500Ω压降3V，左节点12V，左2kΩ流6mA；源电流为两路总和。The 500Ω drop is 3V, giving left-node voltage 12V and a6mA shunt current.

VA=12V,is=6mA+6mA=12mA

按单源比例缩放Scale by the single-source relation

传输电阻为6V除12mA，即500Ω。The transresistance is 6V divided by 12mA, or 500Ω.

u2=(500Ω)is⇒is=1A: u2=500V

is=12mA；当is=1A时，u2=500V。is=12mA; for is=1A, u2=500V.

易错点Common errors

  • 第二问明确是1A，不是1mA；理想电流源可提供所需端电压，本题未限定实际源顺从电压。The second case is 1A, not 1mA. The ideal source has no specified compliance limit.

核验依据Verification

独立完整MNA以12mA与1A激励分别得到右端6V与500V；两个解均严格满足原节点方程和功率平衡，与附录一致。Independent full MNA at 12mA and 1A yields 6V and 500V, with exact nodal and power balance in both cases, matching the appendix.

3-3全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

分源求电流，再代数相加Superpose signed branch currents

题目原文Transcribed question

利用叠加定理求题图3-3所示电路中的电流i。Use superposition to find i in Fig. 3-3.

左6V及右12V均上正，分别经2Ω接中节点；中节点以2Ω接地，另有3A源向上注入。i在左2Ω由左向右。Top-positive 6V and 12V sources each connect through 2Ω to a center node, which has 2Ω to ground and an upward 3A source. i runs rightward through the left resistor.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第96页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
一次只保留一个独立源：电压源置零为短路，电流源置零为开路。每次沿同一个i参考方向求贡献。Keep one independent source at a time: short zeroed voltage sources and open zeroed current sources. Keep the same current reference in every subproblem.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

6V单独作用6V acting alone

三条2Ω支路中的中节点电位为2V；左支路由6V流向2V。The center potential is 2V, so the left current flows from 6V toward 2V.

VA(6)=2V,i(6)=6−22A=2A

12V及3A分别作用12V and 3A acting separately

12V单独作用时中节点4V，左端为地；3A单独作用时三只2Ω并联，中节点2V。With 12V alone the center is 4V and the left terminal is grounded. With 3A alone, three parallel 2Ω resistors give center voltage 2V.

i(12)=0−42=−2A,i(3)=0−22=−1A

代数相加并复核Add algebraically and check

总贡献为−1A。直接带全源列节点方程得中点8V，也给出同一左支路电流。The contributions sum to −1A. A full-source nodal equation gives center potential 8V and the same current.

i=2−2−1=−1A,6−82=−1A

i=−1A，实际向左1A。i=−1A, physically 1A leftward.

易错点Common errors

  • 叠加的是带符号的电流，不是电流绝对值；各分电路也不能删掉电阻。Superpose signed currents, not magnitudes; all resistors remain in every subcircuit.

核验依据Verification

四次独立MNA保留相同原拓扑，分别得到2A、−2A、−1A和全源−1A，每次全功率余量为零，与附录相符。Four independently stamped original-topology MNA runs give 2A, −2A, −1A and full-source −1A, each with zero power residual; the appendix agrees.
