来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-4Assigned requirement: 3-4

叠加电流，再用总电流计算功率Superpose currents, then use the total current for power

题目原文Transcribed question

利用叠加定理求题图3-4所示电路中的电流i及电流i所在支路电阻消耗的功率。Use superposition to find current i in Fig. 3-4 and the power dissipated by the resistor in its branch.

左4V源上正下负，顶端经2Ω到节点A。A经竖直2Ω接左下节点，i向下；A经顶端10Ω到节点B。B经竖直10Ω接右下节点C，另有4A源从C向上到B。左下节点经2A向右的电流源到C。The left 4V source is positive at the top and connects through 2Ω to node A. A connects through vertical 2Ω to the lower-left node, with i downward, and through upper 10Ω to node B. B connects through vertical 10Ω to lower-right node C, in parallel with a4A source directed from C to B. A2A current source points from the lower-left node to C.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

叠加定理；独立电压源置零短路，独立电流源置零开路；电阻功率。Superposition; short a zeroed independent voltage source and open a zeroed current source; resistor power.
本题有三个独立源，应分别求三个带符号电流贡献。右侧4A源单独作用时，电流只在其并联10Ω支路形成局部回路，对所求i的贡献为0。There are three independent sources, so find three signed current contributions. With only the right 4A source active, its current circulates through the parallel 10Ω resistor and contributes zero to i.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

4V源单独作用The 4V source acting alone

将2A、4A源开路。右侧两只10Ω形成通向悬空节点的支路，无电流。左侧两个2Ω串联，所求支路向下电流为1A。Open the 2A and 4A sources. The right pair of 10Ω resistors leads to a floating node and carries no current. The two left 2Ω resistors are in series, giving 1A downward in the requested branch.

i(4V)=42+2=1A

2A源单独作用The 2A source acting alone

将4V源短路、4A源开路。2A从右侧经两只10Ω流到节点A，再经过左侧两个并联2Ω返回左下节点。两只2Ω均分电流，所求向下电流为1A。Short the 4V source and open the 4A source. The 2A current returns from the right through both 10Ω resistors to A, then through the two parallel left 2Ω resistors. They share equally, giving 1A downward in the requested branch.

i(2A)=222+2=1A

4A源单独作用The 4A source acting alone

将4V源短路、2A源开路。右下节点只连接4A源与其并联10Ω，4A由该10Ω返回。顶端10Ω中无电流，因此所求i的贡献为0。Short the 4V source and open the 2A source. The lower-right node connects only to the 4A source and its parallel 10Ω resistor, which returns all 4A. The upper 10Ω carries no current, so this contribution to i is zero.

i(4A)=0

叠加后计算功率Add currents before calculating power

三个贡献按图示参考方向相加。功率必须由总电流求得，不能把各独立作用下的功率相加。Add the three contributions with their signs. Compute power from the total current; powers for separate source excitations do not superpose.

i=1+1+0=2A,P=i2(2Ω)=8W

i=2A（向下）；该2Ω电阻消耗8W。i=2A downward; the 2Ω resistor dissipates 8W.

易错点Common errors

  • 功率不是源激励的线性函数，12×2+12×2=4W并非正确总功率。Power is nonlinear in source excitation; 12×2+12×2=4W is not the total power.
  • 电流源置零应开路，不是短路。A zeroed ideal current source is an open circuit.

核验依据Verification

独立完整电路节点法：左下取0V，左上4V，设A、B、C为图示节点；右侧KCL给出B−A=20V、C−B=−20V，A点KCL为(A−4)2+A2+(A−B)10=0，得A=4、B=24、C=4V，故i=2A。电阻总耗散88W，2A与4A源分别提供8W、80W，4V源电流0，功率平衡。精确MNA同时复核三个分量为1、1、0A。书第334页、PDF343页3-4为2A、8W。Independent full-circuit nodal check: set the lower-left node to 0V and upper-left to 4V. Right-side KCL gives B−A=20V and C−B=−20V. At A, (A−4)2+A2+(A−B)10=0, yielding A=4, B=24 and C=4V, hence i=2A. Resistors dissipate 88W; the 2A and 4A sources supply 8 and 80W, while the 4V source carries zero current. Exact MNA also verifies the three contributions as 1, 1 and 0A. Answer 3-4 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 2A and 8W.

3-5全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

时变源也按瞬时线性叠加Superpose the instantaneous waveform

题目原文Transcribed question

用叠加定理求题图3-5所示电路中的电压u。Use superposition to find u in Fig. 3-5.

左9V源上正并联4Ω；左上经6Ω及左正右负3costV源接右上节点。右节点3Ω接地、1A源向上注入，u上正。A top-positive 9V source is parallel with 4Ω. A6Ω and left-positive 3costV source connect the left upper node to the output. At the output, 3Ω goes to ground and a1A source injects upward; u is top-positive.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第96页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
电路只有电阻和理想源，任意时刻都是线性代数关系。9V并联4Ω不改变被钳定的左节点电位。With only resistors and ideal sources, the circuit obeys instantaneous linear algebra. The 4Ω parallel resistor does not change the left node fixed by the ideal voltage source.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

9V单独作用9V acting alone

交流电压源置零短路，1A源开路，6Ω和3Ω分压。Short the waveform source and open the current source; 6Ω and 3Ω form a divider.

u(9)=936+3V=3V

时变源和电流源贡献Waveform-source and current-source contributions

3cost源单独作用时极性使输出为负；1A单独作用时右端等效电阻为6Ω与3Ω并联。The waveform source polarity gives a negative contribution. For the current source alone, the output resistance is the parallel combination of 6Ω and 3Ω.

u(c)=−3cost36+3V=−costV,u(I)=(1A)(2Ω)=2V

合成波形Combine the waveform

三项相加；也可令时变源左端电位为u+3cost直接写KCL。Add all three contributions. A direct KCL check uses u+3cost at the waveform source’s left terminal.

u=(5−cost)V,u+3cost−96+u3−1=0

u(t)=(5−cost)V。u(t)=(5−cost)V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把3costV源的正负方向倒置；在此纯电阻电路中不需要额外引入相移。Keep the waveform source polarity; this purely resistive network introduces no additional phase shift.

核验依据Verification

独立原拓扑MNA分别给9V、3cost幅值、1A贡献3、−1、2V，并在cost=±1处复得4V及6V；所有功率余量为零，与附录一致。Independent original-topology MNA gives source contributions 3, −1 and 2V and reproduces 4V and 6V at cost=±1, with zero power residuals. The appendix agrees.

3-6全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

含源黑箱用仿射关系Use an affine relation for an active black box

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-6所示电路中，N为线性含源网络，当Us=10V时，测得I=2A；当Us=20V时，测得I=6A；试求当Us=−20V时，I为多少？In Fig. 3-6, N is a linear active network. Measurements give I=2A at Us=10V and I=6A at Us=20V. Find I for Us=−20V.

电压源Us接黑箱N左端，右端接固定负载R，I由N流向R。Us excites the left port of active network N; a fixed resistor R loads its right port, with I flowing from N into R.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第96页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
内部独立源保持不变，输出包含固定偏置，关系为I=aUs+b而非必然过原点。Internal independent sources remain fixed, so the output includes an offset: I=aUs+b, not necessarily a line through the origin.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由差分求斜率Find the slope from a difference

两次测量相减可消去内部源贡献。Subtracting the two measurements eliminates the internal-source contribution.

a=6−220−10AV=0.4AV

回代偏置Recover the offset

用第一组数据求Us=0时的输出。Use the first measurement to find the output at zero applied voltage.

b=2−0.4(10)=−2A,I=(0.4AV)Us−2A

代入负电压Apply the negative voltage

输入负号只改变可控激励项，内部偏置不随之反号。Only the applied-source contribution reverses; the internal offset does not.

I=0.4(−20)−2=−10A

I=−10A。I=−10A.

易错点Common errors

  • 线性含源网络的端口响应可为仿射；直接把20V、6A同时反号会漏掉内部源。An active linear network can have an affine port response; reversing 20V and 6A together incorrectly reverses the internal sources.

核验依据Verification

独立用两个观测方程精确高斯消元得a=25、b=−2，代回两组原数据均成立，再算−20V得−10A，与附录一致。Independent exact elimination of the two observation equations gives a=25 and b=−2, reproducing both measurements and yielding −10A at −20V, as listed.

3-7全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

两源同步放大可整体缩放Scale the whole response when both sources scale together

题目原文Transcribed question

某线性非时变电路中含有两个独立电源us1和us2，已知当us1=2V,us2=5V时，某条支路电流i=2.5A；当us2=1V单独作用时，i=0.3A。求当us1=10V,us2=25V时该支路的电流。A linear time-invariant circuit has two independent sources. At us1=2V,us2=5V, a branch current is i=2.5A. With us2=1V acting alone, i=0.3A. Find the current for us1=10V,us2=25V.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
题设两独立激励都变为原值5倍，可直接用齐性得到总响应5倍；额外数据可以作独立分源核验。Both independent excitations are multiplied by five, so homogeneity scales the whole response by five. The extra measurement provides an independent source-by-source check.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先识别共同倍数Recognize the common multiplier

无需先拆成两源贡献，只要两源都按同一倍数改变且没有别的固定独立源。No source decomposition is needed when all independent excitations scale by the same factor.

102=255=5,i=5(2.5)=12.5A

用额外数据反算系数Recover coefficients as a check

以伏特、安培数值写i=aus1+bus2。单独作用数据给b，联合数据给a。Using numerical volts and amperes, write i=aus1+bus2. The isolated measurement determines b and the combined measurement determines a.

b=0.3,2a+5(0.3)=2.5⇒a=0.5

独立分源复算Recompute source by source

两项贡献分别5A与7.5A。The two contributions are 5A and 7.5A.

i=0.5(10)+0.3(25)=12.5A

i=12.5A。i=12.5A.

易错点Common errors

  • 只改变其中一个源时不能整体缩放；“单独作用”要求另一个独立源置零。If only one source changes, whole-response scaling is invalid. Acting alone means the other independent source is zeroed.

核验依据Verification

独立精确解两源系数为12与310，既复现2.5A及0.3A测量，又与整体5倍缩放同得252A，附录一致。Exact independent coefficient fitting yields 12 and 310, reproduces both measurements and agrees with the overall fivefold scaling: 252A, matching the appendix.

3-8全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

两路外源加内部偏置Two applied sources plus an internal offset

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-7所示电路中，N为线性含源网络，已知当Is=0,Us=0时，电流I=1A；当Is=0,Us=8V时，电流I=4A；当Is=3A,Us=0时，电流I=2A。试写出I与Is,Us的关系式。For active linear network N in Fig. 3-7, I=1A at Is=Us=0; I=4A at Is=0,Us=8V; and I=2A at Is=3A,Us=0. Express I in terms of the sources.

线性含源网络N上方跨接电阻R，I参考向右；左外接Us电压源，右外接Is电流源。R bridges the upper terminals of active network N, with I referenced rightward. External sources are voltage Us on the left and current Is on the right.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第96页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
先用两外源都为零的数据确定内部偏置，再从其他数据扣除该偏置求增量系数。Determine the internal offset from the zero-applied-source measurement, then subtract it before fitting incremental coefficients.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

保留内部源项Retain the internal-source offset

把关系写成I=aUs+bIs+c。零外源不等于内部独立源也被关闭。Write I=aUs+bIs+c. Zero applied sources do not deactivate the sources inside N.

c=1A

拟合两项增量Fit both incremental contributions

电压源8V只使电流增加3A；外加3A电流源只使电流增加1A。An applied 8V increases I by 3A; an applied 3A increases it by 1A.

a=4−18=38AV,b=2−13=13

写出带单位关系Write the dimensional relationship

将有量纲的跨导系数和无量纲电流增益区分。Distinguish the dimensional transconductance from the dimensionless current gain.

I=(38AV)Us+13Is+1A

按伏特、安培数值，I=38Us+13Is+1。Using numerical volts and amperes, I=38Us+13Is+1.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能直接用48或23作系数，那会把同一内部源偏置重复计入。Using 48 or 23 directly counts the internal offset more than once.

核验依据Verification

独立三元观测系统精确解得38、13、1，三组数据余量均为零，与附录关系式一致。Exact solution of the independent three-observation system gives 38, 13 and 1, with zero residual in all measurements, matching the appendix.

3-9全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

电流倍数平方才是功率倍数Square the current scale factor for power

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-8所示电路中，N0为无源线性电阻网络。已知5Ω电阻吸收的功率为0.8W，若电流源电流由3A增加为12A，则5Ω电阻吸收的功率为多少？N0 in Fig. 3-8 is a passive linear resistive network. The 5Ω resistor absorbs 0.8W when the source is 3A. What power does it absorb when the source becomes 12A?

3A理想电流源接无源线性电阻网络N0左端，右端固定5Ω负载。A3A ideal source drives the left port of passive linear resistive network N0; a fixed 5Ω loads the right port.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第96页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
单源无源线性网络使全部电压、电流缩放4倍；功率是电流平方乘电阻，因此缩放16倍。A single-source passive linear network scales all voltages and currents by four; resistor power scales by sixteen.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先确定幅值倍数Determine the amplitude ratio

固定网络与负载不变。The network and load remain unchanged.

k=12A3A=4

从功率定义得到平方倍数Use the power definition

不要对功率直接使用叠加或齐性的一次比例。Power is quadratic; do not apply first-power homogeneity to it.

P2=R(ki1)2=k2P1

求值Evaluate

把初始0.8W乘16。Multiply the initial 0.8W by sixteen.

P2=16(0.8)W=12.8W

P2=12.8W。P2=12.8W.

易错点Common errors

  • N0无内部独立激励是整体比例成立的关键；有固定内部源时不能直接这样缩放。The absence of internal independent excitation is essential. A fixed internal source would invalidate this simple scaling.

核验依据Verification

以有理数独立计算(123)2·(45)=645W；由负载电流平方定义复核，与附录12.8W相同。Independent rational evaluation of (123)2·(45) gives 645W, consistent with the load-current power definition and the listed 12.8W.

3-10指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-10Assigned requirement: 3-10

替代定理：把指定电流的电阻换成电流源Substitution theorem: replace a specified-current resistor by a source

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图3-9所示，欲使支路电流I=2A，试用替代定理求电阻R的值。For the circuit in Fig. 3-9, use the substitution theorem to find R such that branch current I=2A.

左12V源上正下负，经上方3Ω到节点A；A经6Ω接底部公共节点。A到节点B之间有1Ω及向右4A源并联。B经3Ω和待求R分别接底部；R中电流I向下。题干在第87页，原图在第88页。The left 12V source is positive at the top and connects through upper 3Ω to A. A connects through 6Ω to the common bottom node. Between A and B are parallel 1Ω and rightward 4A branches. B connects to the bottom through 3Ω and unknown R; I points downward through R. The statement is on printed p. 87 and the figure on p. 88.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第97页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

替代定理；节点KCL；欧姆定律。Substitution theorem, nodal KCL and Ohm’s law.
已知R中应通过2A，就用同方向2A理想电流源替代R，先求这条支路需要的端电压，再用R=UI还原。Since R must carry 2A, replace it by a2A source in the same direction. Find the required branch voltage, then recover R=UI.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

替代并定义节点Substitute and define nodes

取底部为0V，左源上端12V。用B向下到地的2A源替代R，设其上端电位为vB，左侧节点为vA。Take the bottom as 0V and the left source top as 12V. Replace R by a2A source directed from B to ground, with upper potential vB. Let the other internal potential be vA.

对A列KCLWrite KCL at A

取离开A为正。包括经3Ω、6Ω、1Ω的电流以及向B流出的4A。Take currents leaving A as positive, including the 3Ω, 6Ω and 1Ω paths and the 4A source toward B.

vA−123+vA6+(vA−vB)+4=0⇒32vA−vB=0

对B列KCL并求电压Write KCL at B and solve for voltage

B处4A流入，替代源2A流出，另外有1Ω和3Ω支路。联立两式得到vA=2V、vB=3V。At B, 4A enters and the substituted 2A leaves, alongside the 1Ω and 3Ω branches. The two equations give vA=2V and vB=3V.

(vB−vA)+vB3+2−4=0⇒−vA+43vB=2

还原电阻Recover the resistance

R的上正下负端电压为3V，向下电流为2A，二者关联，故R为正。R has a3V top-positive voltage and a2A downward current, using passive references, so R is positive.

R=vBI=32Ω=1.5Ω

R=1.5Ω。R=1.5Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 替代支路的方向必须与指定I一致；替代后求出的电压是R的端电压。The substituted source must follow the specified I direction; its resulting voltage is the original resistor voltage.
  • 替代定理不是“将电阻删除”，也不要求改变其他电源。Substitution does not simply delete the resistor or change the other sources.

核验依据Verification

独立回代原电路：将1.5Ω接回后，B=3V时R向下2A，旁路3Ω向下1A，1Ω向左1A，合计4A正好等于源流入；A处(2−12)3+26+(2−3)+4=0。原电路精确有理数MNA也给出A=2、B=3V。电阻共耗散44W，12V源提供40W、4A源提供4W，平衡。书第334页、PDF343页3-10为1.5Ω。Independent original-circuit check: restore 1.5Ω. At B=3V, R carries 2A down, the parallel 3Ω carries 1A down, and the 1Ω carries 1A left, matching the incoming 4A. At A, (2−12)3+26+(2−3)+4=0. Exact-rational MNA of the restored circuit gives A=2 and B=3V. Resistors dissipate 44W; the 12V and 4A sources supply 40 and 4W. Answer 3-10 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 1.5Ω.

3-11全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

网络供能先求端口电压Find the port voltage before delivered power

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-10所示电路中，已知电流i=6A，试求网络N提供的功率。For Fig. 3-10, given i=6A, find the power delivered by network N.

左18V源上正，经3Ω到节点A；A经6Ω接地，经9Ω到N上端。i沿上支路由N向左，N下端接地。A top-positive 18V source connects through 3Ω to A. A has 6Ω to ground and 9Ω to N’s upper terminal. i flows leftward out of N; its lower terminal is grounded.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第97页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
6A从N流出，端口上端电位须比A高9×6V；先KCL求A，再算N输出端电压，不能只用9Ω压降。The 6A exits N, so its port is 9×6V above A. Determine A by KCL before computing delivered power.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

节点A的KCLKCL at A

将从N进入A的6A放在流入一侧。Place the 6A entering A from N on the injection side.

VA−18V3Ω+VA6Ω=6A⇒VA=24V

端口电压Port voltage

从A沿电流反方向回到N，电位升高54V。Moving from A against the current toward N raises potential by 54V.

UN=VA+(9Ω)(6A)=78V

供能符号与功率Delivered-power sign

电流从N的正电压端流出，所以提供功率为正；若求吸收功率则取负。Current exits N’s positive terminal, so delivered power is positive; absorbed power has the opposite sign.

Pdelivered=UNi=(78V)(6A)=468W

网络N提供468W。N delivers 468W.

易错点Common errors

  • 左18V电源在此会吸收功率，并非所有独立源都一定供能。The 18V source absorbs power here; an independent source does not always supply it.

核验依据Verification

独立原拓扑端口注入MNA得A=24V、N=78V；三电阻耗散432W、18V源吸收36W，与N提供468W严格平衡，附录一致。Independent port-injection MNA gives A=24V and N=78V. Resistors dissipate 432W and the 18V source absorbs 36W, exactly balanced by N’s468W delivery, matching the appendix.

3-12全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

保留两级分流求电流比例Keep both stages of current division

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-11所示电路中，N为含源单口网络，欲使流经电阻R的电流为网络N端口电流I的16，则R的取值应为多少？In Fig. 3-11, N is an active one-port. Choose R so its current equals one-sixth of N’s port current I.

N向左上节点A注入I，A经3Ω接地，经5Ω接B；B经1Ω及R分别接地，R中电流为I6向下。N injects I into A; A has 3Ω to ground and 5Ω to B. B has parallel 1Ω and R to ground, with desired downward R current I6.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第97页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
比例由外部无源网络决定，与N内部具体结构无关。设R上电压V，用两个KCL把I与V联系。The ratio is determined by the external passive network. Let V be the R voltage and use KCL at both stages.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从右节点向左推Work backward from the right node

右侧两支电流分别V(1Ω)及VR，合计流经5Ω。以下用欧姆数值。The right currents are V(1Ω) and VR; their sum crosses 5Ω. Use numerical ohm values below.

VA=V+5(V+VR)=6V+5VR

写出端口电流和比例Write the port current and ratio

端口电流还要加上左3Ω分走的电流。Include the current diverted through the left 3Ω.

I=VA3+V+VR=3V+8V3R,IRI=39R+8

求电阻Solve for R

对非零测试激励令比例为16，零激励只是两电流同时为零，不能据此定R。For a nonzero test excitation, impose 16.A zero-excitation equality alone cannot determine R.

39R+8=16⇒R=109Ω

R=109Ω。R=109Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能只在右侧1Ω与R之间分流，端口电流还有一部分先流过左3Ω。Do not use only the right parallel divider; the port current first splits through the left 3Ω.

核验依据Verification

原拓扑1V测试源MNA保留所有电阻，以R=109Ω精确得到IRI=16；功率余量为零，与附录一致。A1V original-topology MNA test with R=109Ω gives exactly IRI=16 and zero power residual, agreeing with the appendix.

3-13全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

由端口直线读两种等效源Read both equivalent sources from the port line

题目原文Transcribed question

已知某单口网络的端口u−i特性曲线如题图3-12所示，试求出该单口网络的等效电路。The one-port has the u–i characteristic in Fig. 3-12. Find its equivalent circuit.

横轴uV，纵轴iA；直线过u=0时i=5A和i=0时u=10V，斜率为负。The horizontal axis is uV and vertical axis iA. The descending line crosses i=5A at u=0 and u=10V at i=0.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第97页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
按输出端正电压、向负载提供的电流为正的约定，横截距是开路电压，纵截距是短路输出电流。原曲线未另画端口电流箭头，需把约定写清楚。Take positive voltage at the output terminal and positive current delivered to a load. Then the intercepts give open-circuit voltage and short-circuit delivered current. The graph alone does not separately draw the port-current arrow, so state this convention.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由两截距写直线Write the line from its intercepts

先读数再求斜率，不把斜率绝对值直接当作电阻。Read both intercepts and form the slope before converting it to resistance.

i=5A−(12AV)u

改写戴维南形式Convert to Thevenin form

按向外输出电流约定写u=Uoc−Ri。With delivered current positive, write u=Uoc−Ri.

u=10V−(2Ω)i⇒Uoc=10V, Req=2Ω

给出诺顿等效与参考方向Norton form and reference direction

诺顿电流源从负端指向正端，与2Ω并联；若改取流入正端的电流为正，应在端口方程中替换i为−i。The Norton source points from the negative to the positive terminal, parallel with 2Ω. If current is instead defined inward, replace i by −i in the port equation.

Isc=10V2Ω=5A

输出电流约定下：10V电压源串联2Ω；等价为5A电流源并联2Ω。With delivered current positive: a10V source in series with 2Ω, equivalently a5A source parallel with 2Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 必须连同电压极性、电流参考方向一起给出等效源；若原图i被另行规定为流入端口，符号关系需相应改变。Specify voltage polarity and current reference with the equivalent source. An externally imposed inward-current convention changes the sign relation.

核验依据Verification

等效关系在u=−4、0、5、10、12V处代回原直线均精确吻合。附录未列3-13，结果以图示截距和明确输出电流约定为依据。Substitution at u=−4, 0, 5, 10 and 12V exactly reproduces the plotted line. No appendix answer is listed; the result rests on the intercepts and the stated delivered-current convention.

3-14全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

一次开路加一次已知负载即可定等效源Use open-circuit and known-load measurements

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-13所示电路中，N为含源线性电阻网络，当开关S打开时，Uab=3V；当开关S合上时，Uab=2V，求网络N的戴维南等效电路的参数Uoc和Req。N in Fig. 3-13 is an active linear resistive network. With S open, Uab=3V; with S closed, Uab=2V. Find its Thevenin parameters.

端口a、b接开关S串5Ω负载；Uab为a相对b电压。A switch S connects a5Ω load across terminals a and b; Uab is the potential of a relative to b.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第97页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
断开负载时端口电压直接是开路电压；闭合后用实际负载电流算内部压降。The unloaded terminal voltage is Uoc. Under load, use the actual current to determine the internal voltage drop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

开路条件Open-circuit condition

S打开时没有负载电流。With S open, the load current is zero.

Uoc=3V

负载条件Loaded condition

S闭合时5Ω得到2V，电流0.4A。Closing S gives 2V across 5Ω, or 0.4A.

IL=2V5Ω=25A

内部压降反推等效电阻Infer resistance from internal drop

开路3V到负载2V的下降为1V。The internal drop from 3V to 2V is 1V.

Req=Uoc−UabIL=1V(25)A=2.5Ω

Uoc=3V，Req=2.5Ω，电源正端在a。Uoc=3V, Req=2.5Ω, positive source terminal toward a.

易错点Common errors

  • 只知道开路电压不能确定内部电阻；第二次测量提供了必要的负载信息。Open-circuit voltage alone does not determine internal resistance; the loaded measurement supplies the second independent condition.

核验依据Verification

独立解两条端口方程得3V与52Ω，回代分压3×5(5+2.5)=2V，与附录一致。Independent solution of both port equations yields 3V and 52Ω; the loaded divider returns exactly 2V, matching the appendix.

3-15全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

测试端口电流，保留受控源Apply a port current and keep the dependent source

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图3-14所示单口网络的戴维南等效电路。Find the Thevenin equivalent of the one-port in Fig. 3-14.

20V源上正，经2kΩ到中节点B，再经2kΩ到端口a；受控电流源0.5i从a向B，与右2kΩ并联。端口电流i规定从a流入网络；b接源负端。A top-positive 20V source connects through 2kΩ to B, then through 2kΩ to a. A0.5i source points from a to B in parallel with the right resistor. Port current i enters the network at a; b is the source negative terminal.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第97页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
端口i已给流入方向，直接写u=Uoc+Reqi，受控源不能关闭。右2kΩ只有i的一半经过。With inward port current, use u=Uoc+Reqi. Keep the dependent source active; only half the port current uses the right resistor.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

端口KCLPort KCL

进入a的i在电阻与0.5i受控源之间分配。The inward i splits between the resistor and the controlled source.

IR,right=i−0.5i=0.5i,u−VB=(2kΩ)(0.5i)

中节点KCL和左电阻压降Middle-node KCL and left drop

两路流入B的总电流仍是i，全部经左2kΩ流向20V端。The total current entering B from the two branches is i and flows through the left 2kΩ toward the 20V terminal.

VB=20V+(2kΩ)i

辨认端口关系Read the port relationship

两段压降相加得到等效串联电阻，而不是简单的4kΩ。Adding both drops gives the equivalent series resistance, which is not the simple sum 4kΩ.

u=20V+(3kΩ)i⇒Uoc=20V, Req=3kΩ

20V电压源（a侧为正）串联3kΩ。A20V source, positive toward a, in series with 3kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • 将独立20V源置零可求测试电阻，但0.5i必须保留，否则会错误得到4kΩ。Zeroing the independent 20V source is allowed for a resistance test; removing 0.5i would incorrectly give 4kΩ.

核验依据Verification

原拓扑MNA用端口电流0、1mA、−2mA分别测试，端口电压20、23、14V，满足u=20+3000i且所有功率余量为零，附录同为20V、3kΩ。Original-topology MNA tests with port currents 0, 1mA and −2mA yield 20, 23 and 14V, satisfying u=20+3000i with zero power residuals. The listed 20V and 3kΩ agree.

3-16指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-16Assigned requirement: 3-16

含受控源的戴维南等效：开路电压加测试源Thévenin equivalent with a controlled source: open circuit plus test source

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图3-15所示单口网络的戴维南等效电路。Find the Thévenin equivalent of the one-port network in Fig. 3-15.

4V独立源上正下负，上端经2Ω到中间节点c；c经竖直2Ω接底节点b，竖直电阻电压U上正下负。c经受控电压源3U到端口a，受控源左负右正。b为端口下端。The 4V independent source is positive at the top and connects through 2Ω to middle node c. A vertical 2Ω joins c to bottom terminal b, with U positive at c. A controlled voltage source 3U connects c to terminal a, negative on the left and positive on the right.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

戴维南等效；开路电压；含受控源网络的外加测试源法。Thévenin equivalent, open-circuit voltage and test-source resistance for controlled-source networks.
受控源右正左负意味着va−U=3U，即端口电压是4U。求等效电阻时只将4V独立源短路，受控源及其控制关系必须保留。The controlled source is positive on the right, so va−U=3U and the port voltage is 4U. For equivalent resistance, short only the independent 4V source and retain the controlled source and its law.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

开路求电压Find the open-circuit voltage

端口a开路，受控源中电流为0。两个2Ω对4V等分，故U=2V；端口电压在此基础上再升高3U。With a open, no current flows through the controlled source. The two 2Ω resistors divide 4V equally, giving U=2V. The port voltage rises by a further 3U.

Uth=U+3U=4(2)=8V

独立源置零，保留受控源Zero the independent source and retain the dependent source

将4V源短路后，中间节点c到b有两个2Ω并联。在a、b间外加上正下负的测试电压Vt，由受控源关系有Vt=4U。After shorting the 4V source, two 2Ω resistors connect c to b in parallel. Apply a top-positive test voltage Vt across a,b. The controlled relation remains Vt=4U.

U=Vt4

求流入网络的测试电流Find test current entering the network

从a流入的测试电流经受控源到c，再通过两个2Ω流出，所以It=U2+U2。The test current entering a passes through the controlled source to c, then through both 2Ω resistors.

It=U2+U2=U=Vt4,Rth=VtIt=4Ω

画出等效关系State the equivalent relation

戴维南电压源8V正端朝a，与4Ω串联。若用从a向外流出的负载电流IL表示端口特性，电压随电流以4Ω的斜率下降。The equivalent is an 8V source, positive toward a, in series with 4Ω. For load current IL leaving a, port voltage falls with slope 4Ω.

vab=8−4IL

戴维南等效：8V电压源（a端正）串联4Ω。Thévenin equivalent: an 8V source, positive toward a, in series with 4Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 受控源不是独立源，求Rth时不能把它短路。A controlled source is not an independent source; do not short it when finding Rth.
  • 受控源极性右正左负，端口电压是U+3U，不是U−3U。The dependent source is positive on the right, making the port voltage U+3U, not U−3U.

核验依据Verification

独立完整端口方程：设I为从a流入网络的电流，c节点KCL为(U−4)2+U2−I=0，得U=2+I，故vab=4U=8+4I；改用流出电流IL=−I，得到8−4IL。另以精确MNA分别检验开路8V、独立源置零后1V测试电压对应14A流入、端口短路电流2A流出，均与Rth=82=4Ω一致。书第334页、PDF343页3-16为8V、4Ω。Independent full port law: let I enter the network at a. KCL at c gives (U−4)2+U2−I=0, hence U=2+I and vab =4U=8+4I. With outward IL=−I, this becomes 8−4IL. Exact MNA separately gives 8V open circuit, 14A entering under a1V test after independent-source suppression, and a2A short-circuit current outward, all consistent with Rth=82=4Ω. Answer 3-16 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 8V and 4Ω.

3-17指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-17Assigned requirement: 3-17

受控源诺顿等效：短路电流与测试电阻Norton equivalent with a controlled source: short-circuit current and test resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图3-16所示单口网络的诺顿等效电路。Find the Norton equivalent of the one-port network in Fig. 3-16.

左20V源上正下负，顶端经2Ω到端口a，2Ω电压u1左正右负。a向下先经上正下负的受控电压源2u1，再经4Ω接底端b。The left 20V source is positive at the top and connects through 2Ω to terminal a. The 2Ω voltage u1 is positive on the left. A downward branch from a contains a controlled voltage source 2u1, positive at the top, followed by 4Ω to bottom terminal b.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

诺顿等效；短路电流；受控源网络测试法。Norton equivalent, short-circuit current and test-source analysis with dependent sources.
端口短路时u1=20V，受控源电压仍为40V，并不会一起变成0。它使4Ω上端为−40V，因此该支路实际向端口提供电流。Shorting the port gives u1=20V, so the controlled source remains at 40V. It places the 4Ω upper terminal at −40V, making this branch supply current toward the port.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

短路求诺顿电流Short the port to find Norton current

将a、b短路，取b为0V，故a也为0V。左2Ω向a送入(20−0)2=10A。受控源2u1=40V，使其下端c为−40V，4Ω中向下电流−10A，即向a再送入10A。Short a,b and set b to 0V, so a is also 0V. The left 2Ω sends (20−0)2=10A into a. The controlled source is 2u1=40V, placing its lower node c at −40V. The downward 4Ω current is −10A, supplying another 10A to a.

Isc=10+10=20A

置零独立源并加测试电压Suppress the independent source and apply test voltage

仅把20V源短路，在端口加Vt。此时u1=−Vt，受控源关系Vt−vc=2u1=−2Vt，故vc=3Vt。Short only the 20V source and apply Vt at the port. Then u1=−Vt and the controlled law is Vt−vc=2u1=−2Vt, so vc=3Vt.

vc=3Vt

求诺顿电阻与方向Find Norton resistance and source direction

流入端口的测试电流分为经2Ω到地与经受控源、4Ω到地两部分。诺顿源方向从b向a，才能使外部短路电流从a流向b。The entering test current splits between the 2Ω path and the controlled-source and 4 Ω path. The Norton source points from b to a, giving an external short-circuit current from a to b.

It=Vt2+3Vt4=54Vt,RN=VtIt=45Ω=0.8Ω

诺顿等效：20A电流源（从b向a）并联0.8Ω。Norton equivalent: a20A source from b to a in parallel with 0.8Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • a、b短路只令端口电压为0，不令受控源的控制电压u1为0。Shorting a,b zeros the port voltage, not the controlling voltage u1.
  • 测试时u1的参考极性左正右负，因此u1=−Vt。During the test, u1 is positive on the left, so u1=−Vt.

核验依据Verification

独立完整端口法：端口电压v时u1=20−v，受控源下节点vc=v−2(20−v)=3v−40。流入网络的电流I=(v−20)2+(3v−40)4=5v4−20，故向外电流为20−v0.8。开路v=16V，1620=0.8Ω。精确MNA以0.8Ω负载检验得v=8V、负载电流10A；总电阻耗散216W，两个源提供216W，功率平衡。书第334页、PDF343页3-17为20A、0.8Ω。Independent full port law: at voltage v, u1=20−v and the lower controlled-source node is vc=v−2(20−v)=3v−40. Entering current is I=(v−20)2+(3v−40)4=5v4−20, so outward current is 20−v0.8. Open circuit gives v=16V and 1620=0.8Ω. Exact MNA with a0.8Ω load gives 8V and 10A; resistors dissipate 216W, exactly supplied by the two sources. Answer 3-17 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 20A and 0.8Ω.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

受控源诺顿等效要做测试Test the Norton resistance with the dependent source active

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图3-17所示单口网络的诺顿等效电路。Find the Norton equivalent of the one-port in Fig. 3-17.

左12V源上正，经6Ω接上端口a，i1由左向右进入a；a以3Ω接b；受控电流源9i1从b向a。A top-positive 12V source feeds a through 6Ω, with i1 flowing toward a. A3Ω resistor connects a to b; a dependent source 9i1 points b to a.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第97页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
短路求诺顿电流；等效电阻用端口斜率或独立源置零后的测试源，受控源始终保留。Short the port for Norton current. Obtain resistance from the port slope or a test source with the independent source zeroed, keeping the dependent source active.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写出任意端口电压下的输出电流Write delivered current at arbitrary port voltage

令u=Va−Vb，输出电流为左支路和受控源注入减去3Ω分流。Let u=Va−Vb. Delivered current equals the two injections minus the 3Ω shunt current.

i1=12V−u6Ω,Iout=i1+9i1−u3Ω=20A−(2S)u

短路电流Short-circuit current

端口短路u=0。电流源箭头从b向a，向外提供20A。At u=0, the equivalent source points b to a and delivers 20A.

IN=Isc=20A

测试电阻Resistance test

12V源短路，给端口1V时，6Ω中i1=−16A，受控源实际向下1.5A，加3Ω和6Ω两路，总吸收2A。Zero the 12V source and apply 1V. Then i1=−16A and the dependent source draws 1.5A downward. Together with both resistor currents, the port absorbs 2A.

RN=1V2A=0.5Ω,Uoc=INRN=10V

20A电流源（b→a）并联0.5Ω。A20A source directed b→a, parallel with 0.5Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把6Ω与3Ω直接并联当作等效电阻；受控源改变测试电流。Do not simply parallel 6Ω and 3Ω; the dependent source changes the test current.

核验依据Verification

独立完整MNA分别测开路10V、短路20A、独立源置零后1V端口吸收2A；三个工作情形的全功率均平衡，与附录20A、0.5Ω相符。Independent full MNA gives open-circuit 10V, short-circuit 20A and 2A absorbed under a deactivated-source 1V test. Power balances in all three cases; the appendix agrees.

3-19指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-19Assigned requirement: 3-19

戴维南法：先移开负载，再求端口等效Thévenin method: remove the load before finding the port equivalent

题目原文Transcribed question

应用戴维南定理求题图3-18所示电路中的电流i。Use Thévenin’s theorem to find current i in Fig. 3-18.

底部公共节点。左节点A经1Ω接底部，A到中节点B有24V源，左正右负；B经上正下负的4V源接底部。A到右节点C经顶端5Ω，B到C经2Ω；C经右侧4Ω负载接底部，电流i向下。The bottom is common. Left node A connects through 1Ω to the bottom. A24V source from A to middle node B is positive on the left. B connects through a top-positive 4V source to the bottom. A connects to right node C through upper 5Ω; B connects to C through 2Ω. The right 4Ω load joins C to the bottom, with i downward.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

戴维南定理；开路端口KCL；独立电压源置零短路。Thévenin’s theorem, open-port KCL and suppression of independent voltage sources.
将右侧4Ω视为负载移开。两个理想源先固定B=4V、A=28V，左1Ω只影响源电流，不改变这些节点电位。Remove the right 4Ω load. The ideal sources fix B=4V and A=28V. The left 1Ω affects source currents but cannot change those fixed potentials.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

负载开路求UthRemove the load and find Uth

取底部0V，B=4V，A−B=24V，所以A=28V。设负载开路后C点电位为Uth，对C列KCL。Take the bottom as 0V. Then B=4V and A−B=24V, so A=28V. Let the open-circuit potential at C be Uth and apply KCL.

Uth−285+Uth−42=0⇒Uth=767V

独立源置零求RthSuppress independent sources to find Rth

将24V、4V源均短路，A、B与底节点合并，1Ω被短路。端口C到地只剩5Ω与2Ω并联。Short the 24V and 4V sources. A, B and the bottom merge, bypassing the 1Ω resistor. The port sees only 5Ω in parallel with 2Ω.

Rth=5∥2=107Ω

接回4Ω负载Reconnect the 4Ω load

戴维南源与Rth、负载串联；电压源正端朝C，因此负载电流向下为正。The Thévenin source, Rth and load are in series. The source is positive toward C, giving positive downward load current.

i=UthRth+4=767107+4=2A

i=2A，沿右侧4Ω向下。i=2A downward through the right 4Ω resistor.

易错点Common errors

  • 开路时移去的是右侧4Ω负载，不是中间2Ω。Remove the right 4Ω load, not the middle 2Ω resistor.
  • 24V源左正右负，因此A=B+24，不是B−24。The 24V source is positive on the left, so A=B+24, not B−24.

核验依据Verification

独立直接节点法：接回负载后C满足(C−28)5+(C−4)2+C4=0，得C=8V，i=84=2A。C点流入4A经5Ω，流出2A经2Ω、2A经4Ω，KCL成立。精确MNA同时复核开路767V与接载8V。完整电路电阻耗散888W，24V、4V源分别提供768W、120W，功率平衡。书第334页、PDF343页3-19为2A。Independent direct nodal check: with the load restored, (C−28)5+(C−4)2+C4=0 gives C=8V and i=84=2A. At C, 4A enters through 5Ω and 2A leaves through each of the 2Ω and 4Ω branches. Exact MNA also verifies the open-circuit 767V and loaded 8V. Resistors dissipate 888W, supplied as 768W and 120W by the 24V and 4V sources. Answer 3-19 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 2A.

3-20全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：考试范围（齐性、叠加与等效源；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: required: homogeneity, superposition and equivalents; course plan 3.1–3.5.

先移除6Ω负载，再做诺顿等效Remove the 6Ω load before forming the Norton equivalent

题目原文Transcribed question

试用诺顿定理求题图3-19所示电路中6Ω负载电阻消耗的功率。Use Norton’s theorem to find the power dissipated by the 6Ω load in Fig. 3-19.

右侧最外6Ω为负载，接上节点T和右下参考点。T经3Ω到A，经内侧6Ω到C；A经横向3Ω到C并由4A源向下接左下D；C由上正12V源接参考点；D经5Ω接参考点，10A源从D向上注入T。The outer right 6Ω is the load from T to the lower-right reference. T connects through 3Ω to A and inner 6Ω to C; A connects through 3Ω to C and through a downward 4A source to D. C is fixed at +12V; D has 5Ω to reference and a10A source from D to T.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第97页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性、KCL、KVL、端口参考方向与题设条件。Linearity, KCL, KVL, port references and the stated assumptions.
图区有两只6Ω，只移除最外侧负载。取右下为地，C=12V；左下D不是地。There are two 6Ω resistors: remove only the outer load. Ground the lower-right node, so C=12V; D is a distinct node.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

移除负载求开路端电压Find open-circuit voltage without the load

A的KCL给2A−T=0；T的KCL给3T−2A=72。以下以SI数值写节点电位。KCL at A gives 2A−T=0 and at T gives 3T−2A=72, using SI numerical node values.

VA−VT3+VA−123+4=0,VT−VA3+VT−126=10⇒Uoc=36V

求电阻和诺顿电流Find resistance and Norton current

独立电流源开路、12V源短路；端口看见内6Ω与两只3Ω串联支路并联。左下5Ω因电流源开路而悬空，不贡献端口电流。Open independent current sources and short 12V. The port sees the inner 6Ω in parallel with two series 3Ω resistors. The 5Ω terminates at an isolated node and carries no test current.

RN=6∥(3+3)=3Ω,IN=36V3Ω=12A

接回负载分流，再算功率Reconnect the load and calculate power

12A在诺顿3Ω及负载6Ω之间分流，负载电流4A。The 12A divides between the Norton 3Ω and the 6Ω load, giving 4A through the load.

IL=1233+6A=4A,PL=IL2RL=42(6)W=96W

PL=96W。PL=96W.

易错点Common errors

  • 源置零仅用于求等效电阻，不能在求开路电压或短路电流时把它们一并删除。Source deactivation applies to the resistance calculation, not to the open-circuit or short-circuit calculations.

核验依据Verification

独立完整原图MNA验证开路36V、短路12A，接6Ω后端电压24V、负载功率96W；三种情况下全元件功率余量均为零，与附录一致。Independent full original-topology MNA verifies open-circuit 36V, short-circuit 12A, and loaded voltage 24V with 96W load power. All three power balances are exact, agreeing with the appendix.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第89页／PDF第98页。范围状态：考试范围（等效源与最大功率；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98. Coverage: required: equivalents and maximum power; course plan 3.1–3.5.

两次激励测量确定输出等效源Identify an output equivalent from two excitations

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图3-20所示，网络N0由线性电阻构成。已知当us=4V,is=0时，u=3V；当us=0,is=2A时，u=2V，试求ab左端的戴维南等效电路。当us=1V，电流源用2Ω的电阻替代后，电压u为多少？N0 in Fig. 3-20 consists of linear resistors. At us=4V,is=0, u=3V; at us=0,is=2A, u=2V. Find the Thevenin equivalent to the left of ab. Then find u with us=1V and a2Ω resistor replacing the current source.

us从左激励N0，ab端电压u上正；外接电流源is由b向a，注入网络。us excites N0 from the left. Port voltage u is positive at a, and the external source is points b to a, injecting into the network.

本题图在书第89页／PDF第98页。The source figure is on printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口KCL、线性关系、源置零规则及参考方向。Port KCL, linear relations, source-deactivation rules and reference directions.
is=0使端口开路，第一组给源到开路电压的增益；us=0时独立源短路，第二组直接给端口测试电阻。Zero is opens the port, so the first observation gives open-circuit voltage gain. Zero us shorts the voltage source; the second observation is a resistance test.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求开路电压Find open-circuit voltage

仅由左源产生的开路电压随us线性缩放。The open-circuit voltage due to the left source scales linearly with us.

Uoc=34us

求等效电阻和端口关系Find resistance and the port relation

外电流源方向是向端口注入，故其增加的端电压是+Reqis。The applied current enters the port, so its voltage contribution is +Reqis.

Req=2V2A=1Ω,u=34us+(1Ω)is

换成电阻后用分压Use voltage division after replacing the source

us=1V使内部等效源为0.75V；外接2Ω与内部1Ω分压。At us=1V the equivalent source is 0.75V, divided between 1Ω internally and 2Ω externally.

u=3421+2V=0.5V

Uoc=34us，Req=1Ω；换接2Ω后u=0.5V。Uoc=34us, Req=1Ω; the replacement 2Ω load gives u=0.5V.

易错点Common errors

  • 电流源置零是开路而非短路；题中3V是us=4V时的开路电压，不是对所有us固定3V。Zeroing a current source opens it. The 3V open-circuit result applies at us=4V and is not constant for all source voltages.

核验依据Verification

独立两项线性拟合复得34与1Ω，代回两组测量及新2Ω负载均相符；附录列3V、1Ω、0.5V，其中3V对应原4V激励。Independent linear fitting yields 34 and 1Ω, reproduces both measurements and gives 0.5V with the new load. The listed 3V open-circuit value refers to the original 4V excitation.

3-22指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第89页／PDF第98页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-22Assigned requirement: 3-22

由两次负载读数反推单口网络Identify a one-port from two loaded measurements

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-21所示电路中，N为线性含源电阻网络。已知当开关S1、S2均打开时，电压表的读数为6V；当开关S1闭合、S2打开时，电压表的读数为4V。试求当开关S1打开、S2闭合时电压表的读数。In Fig. 3-21, N is a linear resistive network containing sources. The voltmeter reads 6V with S1 and S2 both open, and 4V with S1 closed and S2 open. Find its reading with S1 open and S2 closed.

网络N的上下端口外接永久6Ω并联支路；另有4Ω串S1、2Ω串S2两条可切换并联支路。右侧电压表跨接端口，上正下负，按理想电压表处理。Across N are a permanent 6Ω branch, a4Ω branch in series with S1, and a2Ω branch in series with S2. The voltmeter is across the port, positive at the top, and is treated as ideal.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性含源单口的戴维南模型；负载并联；电压分配。Thévenin modeling of a linear source-containing one-port, parallel loads and voltage division.
两个开关打开时6Ω仍接在端口，6V不是N的开路电压。用两次“端电压、总负载电流”测量建立U=Uth−RthI，再预测第三种负载。The 6Ω remains connected with both switches open, so 6V is not the open-circuit voltage of N. Use the two voltage and current measurements in U=Uth−RthI, then predict the third load.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

第一状态给出一条端口方程Form the first port equation

S1、S2均打开，负载只有6Ω。理想电压表不取电流，因此N向外供电流66=1A。With both switches open, the only load is 6Ω. The ideal voltmeter draws no current, so N supplies 66=1A.

6=Uth−Rth(1)

第二状态给出另一条方程Form the second port equation

S1闭合、S2打开，负载为6Ω与4Ω并联。端电压4V时总电流46+44=53A。With S1 closed and S2 open, 6Ω and 4Ω are parallel. At 4V, total load current is 46+44=53A.

4=Uth−Rth53

求N的等效参数Identify N’s equivalent parameters

两式相减得到2=(23)Rth，再回代第一式。Subtract the equations to get 2=(23)Rth, then substitute into the first equation.

Rth=3Ω,Uth=9V

预测第三状态Predict the third state

S1打开、S2闭合时负载为6Ω与2Ω并联，即1.5Ω。用戴维南电压分配。With S1 open and S2 closed, the load is 6Ω in parallel with 2Ω, or 1.5Ω. Apply voltage division to the identified Thévenin circuit.

RL=6∥2=1.5Ω,U=91.53+1.5=3V

电压表读数为3V（上正下负）。The voltmeter reads 3V, positive at the top.

易错点Common errors

  • 不可把第一状态误认为开路：6Ω始终接入。Do not treat the first state as an open circuit; the 6Ω is always connected.
  • 第二状态总电流应包含6Ω支路和4Ω支路。The second-state current includes both the 6Ω and 4Ω branches.

核验依据Verification

独立等效检验：也可先将固定6Ω并入N，形成新单口，其开路电压就是6V；接4Ω时降为4V，所以新单口内阻2Ω。再接2Ω得到6×2(2+2)=3V，与前法相同。原N参数9V、3Ω回代两次已知状态分别给6V、4V，第三状态供电流0.5+1.5=2A且9−3×2=3V。精确MNA三种状态均相符。书第334页、PDF343页3-22为3V。Independent equivalent check: include the permanent 6Ω inside an enlarged one-port. Its open-circuit voltage is 6V; attaching 4Ω reduces it to 4V, so its resistance is 2Ω. Attaching 2Ω therefore gives 6×2(2+2)=3V. The original 9V, 3Ω model reproduces the known 6V and 4V states; the third supplies 0.5+1.5=2A and satisfies 9−3×2=3V. Exact MNA verifies all three states. Answer 3-22 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 3V.

受控源可使端口增量电阻为负A dependent source can produce negative port resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

写出题图3-22所示单口网络的电压、电流关系式。Write the voltage–current relationship of the one-port in Fig. 3-22.

左2V源上正，经1Ω到B；B经2Ω接地，经另一2Ω接上端口a；受控电流源3U从B向a，与右2Ω并联。端口U上正，I从a流入网络。A top-positive 2V source connects through 1Ω to B, which has 2Ω to ground and 2Ω to terminal a. A dependent source 3U points B to a, parallel with the right resistor. U is top-positive and I enters at a.

本题图在书第89页／PDF第98页。The source figure is on printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口KCL、线性关系、源置零规则及参考方向。Port KCL, linear relations, source-deactivation rules and reference directions.
I与U采用关联参考方向；受控源提供额外能量，端口斜率不必为正。先用B节点KCL消去内部节点。I enters the positive−U terminal. The dependent source can supply energy, so the port slope need not be positive. Eliminate B using its KCL.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

内部节点KCLInternal-node KCL

按SI数值列式，3U隐含跨导3S，方向从B流向a。Use SI numerical values. The 3U source has implicit transconductance 3S and leaves B toward a.

(VB−2)+VB2+VB−U2+3U=0⇒VB=1−54U

端口KCLPort KCL

从a流入的I等于电阻向B电流减去从B注入a的受控电流。The inward I equals resistor current toward B minus the controlled injection into a.

I=U−VB2−3U=−158U−12

整理成电压表达式Solve for voltage

固定端口方向后保留负斜率，不强行改成正电阻。Retain the negative slope under the stated reference directions.

U=−815I−415(SI numerical values)

以伏特和安培数值计，U=−815I−415；端口增量电阻为−815Ω。Numerically in volts and amperes, U=−815I−415; incremental port resistance is −815Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 含受控源网络并非无源电阻，负端口电阻不自动表示计算错误。A dependent-source network is not necessarily passive; a negative port resistance is not automatically an error.

核验依据Verification

独立原拓扑MNA以端口0、1、−2V测试，反算流入电流，均满足该端口关系且全功率余量为零；附录方程一致。Original-topology MNA at port voltages 0, 1 and −2V independently reproduces the relation from inward currents, with zero power residuals. The appendix agrees.

固定激励后叠加开路与短路状态Combine open and short states at the same excitation

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-23所示电路中，NR是不含独立源的线性电阻网络，电阻R1可变。已知当us=12V,R1=0时，i1=5A,iR=4A；当us=18V,R1=∞时，u1=15V,iR=1A。求当us=6V,R1=3Ω时的iR。NR in Fig. 3-23 is a linear resistive network with no independent sources. R1 is variable. At us=12V,R1=0, i1=5A,iR=4A; at us=18V,R1=∞, u1=15V,iR=1A. Find iR at us=6V,R1=3Ω.

NR左端由us激励，右端接固定R，iR向右；上端两点间接可变R1，u1左正右负，i1从左向右流经R1。us drives the left port; a fixed R loads the right port with iR rightward. Variable R1 bridges upper terminals, with u1 left-positive and i1 through R1 left to right.

本题图在书第89页／PDF第98页。The source figure is on printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口KCL、线性关系、源置零规则及参考方向。Port KCL, linear relations, source-deactivation rules and reference directions.
先把两次观测都缩放到同一个6V激励，再在R1端口构造等效源；此时iR也随该端口电流线性变化。First scale both observations to the same 6V excitation. Then identify the R1−port equivalent and interpolate iR against its port current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一到6VNormalize both states to 6V

不含内部独立源，全部响应可按外源缩放。No internal independent source is present, so all responses scale with the applied source.

short: i1s=52A, iRs=2A;open: u1o=5V, iRo=13A

求R1支路电流Find the R1 current

R1端口等效内阻5(52)=2Ω，接3Ω后总阻5Ω。The R1−port resistance is 5(52)=2Ω; adding 3Ω gives total 5Ω.

Req=2Ω,i1=5V(2+3)Ω=1A

对输出作仿射插值Interpolate the output affinely

开路与短路状态权重分别35和25，总和为1，故左侧激励仍是6V；同时满足u1=3Ω·i1。Open and short weights are 35 and 25, summing to one to preserve the 6V source, while satisfying u1=3Ω·i1.

iR=iRo+(iRs−iRo)i1i1s=13+(2−13)152=1A

iR=1A。iR=1A.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能直接混合12V短路与18V开路状态来求6V负载；先统一外部激励。Do not combine the 12V short state and 18V open state without normalizing their excitation first.

核验依据Verification

独立有理数计算端口开短路参数与响应插值；状态权重35、25保持左源6V，给u1=3V、i1=1A并满足3Ω负载，输出1A。附录未列此题。Independent rational open and short reconstruction uses weights 35 and 25, preserving the 6V source and giving u1=3V, i1=1A, satisfying the 3Ω link and output 1A. No answer is listed in the appendix.

最大功率匹配端口等效电阻Match the load to the port resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

在题图3-24所示电路中，电阻R取何值时可获得最大功率？What value of R in Fig. 3-24 receives maximum power?

10A源向上与1Ω并联到左节点；左节点经上1Ω到右节点；右节点有固定2Ω及可变负载R并联接地。An upward 10A source is parallel with a1Ω shunt at the left node. A series 1Ω links the right node, which has a fixed 2Ω shunt and variable load R.

本题图在书第89页／PDF第98页。The source figure is on printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口KCL、线性关系、源置零规则及参考方向。Port KCL, linear relations, source-deactivation rules and reference directions.
先移除R，将独立电流源开路，求从R两端看到的等效电阻。Remove R, open the independent current source, and find the resistance seen at the load port.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

关源求等效电阻Deactivate the source for port resistance

固定2Ω与两只1Ω串联支路并联。The fixed 2Ω is parallel with the series pair of 1Ω resistors.

Rth=2∥(1+1)=1Ω

保留源求开路电压Find open-circuit voltage with source active

R移除时左节点等效阻1Ω与3Ω并联，电压7.5V，再在1Ω与2Ω间分压。With R removed, the left node sees 1Ω parallel with 3Ω, giving 7.5V; divide across the series 1Ω and 2Ω.

Uoc=10(1×31+3)21+2V=5V

应用最大功率条件Apply the maximum-power condition

正电阻负载最大功率条件为R=Rth；附带给出最大功率供自检。For a positive resistive load, maximum power occurs at R=Rth. The power is included as a check.

Ropt=1Ω,Pmax=Uoc24Rth=254W

R=1Ω。R=1Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 匹配的是整个网络的端口电阻，不是图中某一只相邻电阻。Match the entire driving network’s port resistance, not an arbitrary nearby resistor.

核验依据Verification

独立MNA得开路5V，1V测试源吸收1A，接1Ω负载耗254W；全部功率余量为零，附录R=1Ω一致。Independent MNA gives open-circuit 5V, 1A absorbed under a1V test, and 254W at a1Ω load, with exact power balance. The listed R=1Ω agrees.

3-26全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第89页／PDF第98页。范围状态：考试范围（等效源与最大功率；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98. Coverage: required: equivalents and maximum power; course plan 3.1–3.5.

由最大功率工作点还原戴维南参数Recover Thevenin parameters from a matched-load point

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图3-25所示，N为线性含源电阻网络，当负载RL=1Ω时，IL=1A，且此时电阻获得最大功率，试求网络N的戴维南等效电路。N in Fig. 3-25 is a linear active resistive network. At RL=1Ω, IL=1A and the load receives maximum power. Find its Thevenin equivalent.

N输出接1Ω负载，IL从N正输出端流向负载。The 1Ω load is connected to N’s output, with IL delivered from the positive output terminal.

本题图在书第89页／PDF第98页。The source figure is on printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口KCL、线性关系、源置零规则及参考方向。Port KCL, linear relations, source-deactivation rules and reference directions.
已知有限正负载处有最大值，题设隐含正的等效内阻。匹配条件先给Rth，再由回路压降求Uoc。A finite maximum at a positive load implies positive Thevenin resistance. Match first, then infer the source voltage from the loop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

最大值条件Maximum condition

在正等效内阻模型下，唯一最大值在RL=Rth。For positive equivalent resistance, the unique maximum is at RL=Rth.

Rth=RL=1Ω

由负载电流求源电压Infer source voltage from load current

流过负载及串联内阻的电流相同。The same current crosses the load and internal series resistance.

Uoc=IL(RL+Rth)=(1A)(2Ω)=2V

验证为全局最大Verify the global maximum

下面非负平方恒等式说明任意其他正负载均不超过匹配时功率。The nonnegative-square identity proves no other positive load exceeds the matched power.

Pmax−P(R)=Uoc2(R−Rth)24Rth(R+Rth)2≥0

2V电压源串联1Ω，电源正端朝负载电流流出端。A2V source in series with 1Ω, positive toward the delivered-current terminal.

易错点Common errors

  • 负载端电压为1V，不是开路电压；最大功率时一半源电压落在内阻。The loaded voltage is 1V, not Uoc; at the matched point half the source voltage drops internally.

核验依据Verification

代回2V、内阻1Ω、负载1Ω得电流1A与功率1W；非负平方恒等式独立确认最大值，附录2V、1Ω一致。Substitution gives exactly 1A and 1W with the 2V source and two 1Ω resistances; the nonnegative-square identity independently confirms maximality, matching the appendix.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第89页／PDF第98页。范围状态：考试范围（等效源与最大功率；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98. Coverage: required: equivalents and maximum power; course plan 3.1–3.5.

负载最大功率不等于源提供功率Maximum load power differs from source power

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-26所示电路中，RL=2Ω时获得最大功率为2W，求此时电流源提供的功率。In Fig. 3-26, RL=2Ω receives a maximum of 2W. Find the power supplied by the current source at this point.

4A源向上，与电阻R并联接左节点；左节点经1Ω接负载RL到地。An upward 4A source is parallel with R at the left node; a series 1Ω then feeds RL to ground.

本题图在书第89页／PDF第98页。The source figure is on printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口KCL、线性关系、源置零规则及参考方向。Port KCL, linear relations, source-deactivation rules and reference directions.
先用最大功率条件确定未知R，再从负载功率求支路电流与电流源端电压。Use matching to determine R, then infer branch current and source terminal voltage from the load power.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

匹配求RDetermine R by matching

电流源开路后，负载看到R与1Ω串联。Opening the current source makes the port resistance R+1Ω.

R+1Ω=2Ω⇒R=1Ω

由负载功率求电压Infer voltage from load power

负载电流绝对值为1A；4A源向上且电阻均正，取向负载流动的正电流。The load-current magnitude is 1A. With the upward source and positive resistances, current flows toward the load.

IL=2W2Ω=1A,Vs=IL(1+2)Ω=3V

求源提供的总功率Find total source delivery

4A从源正电压端流出，供能12W；还需供给并联R及串联1Ω损耗。The 4A exits the positive source terminal, delivering 12W, including both internal resistor losses.

Ps=(4A)(3V)=12W=9W+1W+2W

电流源提供12W。The current source supplies 12W.

易错点Common errors

  • 最大功率传输条件不代表电源总效率必为50%；原网络本身还有其他耗散路径。Matching does not imply 50% efficiency for the original source; the original network has additional dissipative paths.

核验依据Verification

独立原节点MNA得源端3V、负载端2V，源功率−12W，三只电阻耗散9、1、2W，总功率严格为零；附录一致。Independent original-node MNA gives source 3V, load 2V and source absorbed power −12W. Resistors dissipate 9, 1 and 2W, balancing exactly and matching the appendix.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第89页／PDF第98页。范围状态：考试范围（等效源与最大功率；课程纲领3.1～3.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98. Coverage: required: equivalents and maximum power; course plan 3.1–3.5.

先标出负载的两个真实端点Identify both actual load terminals first

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-27所示电路中，试确定R取何值时可获得最大功率及最大功率值。For Fig. 3-27, determine R for maximum power and the maximum power value.

左50V源上正并联7Ω；左上经20Ω到负载上端A，A以5Ω接地。地经左正右负6V源接负载下端B，因此B=−6V；B再经上正9V源和30Ω回地。A top-positive 50V source is parallel with 7Ω. A20Ω links its top to load terminal A, which has 5Ω to ground. A left-positive 6V source fixes lower load terminal B at −6V. B also connects through a top-positive 9V source and 30Ω to ground.

本题图在书第89页／PDF第98页。The source figure is on printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口KCL、线性关系、源置零规则及参考方向。Port KCL, linear relations, source-deactivation rules and reference directions.
负载下端不是地。开路时上端由20Ω、5Ω分压得10V，下端由理想6V源固定为−6V，负载开路电压为16V。The lower load terminal is not ground. Open-circuit A is 10V by division, while B is fixed at −6V; the port voltage is 16V.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

保留源求开路电压Find open-circuit voltage with sources active

7Ω不改变左上50V；9V与30Ω支路不改变被6V源固定的B电位。The 7Ω cannot change the ideal 50V node; the 9V and 30Ω branch cannot change B fixed by the 6V source.

VA=50520+5V=10V,VB=−6V,Uoc=16V

关源求端口电阻Deactivate sources for port resistance

全部独立电压源短路后，B接地，端口看见20Ω与5Ω并联；其余支路被理想短路隔离于端口测试。Shorting all independent voltage sources grounds B. The port sees 20Ω parallel with 5Ω; the other branches do not contribute to the port test.

Rth=20∥5=4Ω

匹配与最大功率Match and calculate maximum power

R为有限正负载，按戴维南正内阻匹配。For a finite positive load, match the positive Thevenin resistance.

Ropt=4Ω,Pmax=1624(4)W=16W

R=4Ω，Pmax=16W。R=4Ω, Pmax=16W.

易错点Common errors

  • 负载开路电压不是10V；必须取A减B。不能把9V又直接加到负载端电压中。The port voltage is A minus B, not 10V. Do not add the 9V source directly to the load voltage.

核验依据Verification

独立原拓扑MNA保留三只电压源及7Ω、30Ω，开路端差16V，关源1V测试电流14A，接4Ω耗16W；所有功率余量为零，附录一致。Full original-topology MNA retains all sources and resistors: open-circuit difference 16V, deactivated 1V test current 14A, and 16W at 4Ω. All power residuals vanish and the appendix agrees.

指定要求：3-29Assigned requirement: 3-29

最大功率与受控源：先求真实端口电阻Maximum power with a controlled source: find the actual port resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

试确定题图3-28所示电路中负载电阻RL取何值时可获得最大功率。Determine the load resistance RL that receives maximum power in Fig. 3-28.

左侧15V独立源上正下负，上端经4Ω到节点c，4Ω中控制电流I向右。c经上正下负的受控电压源6I接底部公共节点；c经2Ω到负载上端a，RL从a接到底部。The left 15V independent source is positive at the top and connects through 4Ω to c, with control current I rightward. A controlled voltage source 6I, positive at c, connects c to the bottom. A2Ω resistor joins c to load terminal a, and RL joins a to the bottom.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

最大功率传输定理；含受控源的戴维南等效；测试源法。Maximum-power transfer, Thévenin equivalents with dependent sources and test-source analysis.
受控电压源直接限定中间节点电位，所以从负载看进去并非4Ω与2Ω简单串联。先保留控制关系求Rth，再令正电阻负载RL=Rth。The controlled voltage source fixes the middle-node voltage, so the load does not simply see 4Ω and 2Ω in series. Retain its control law to find Rth, then match the positive load resistance to Rth.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

开路求端口电压Find the open-circuit voltage

移去RL，2Ω中无电流，端口a电位等于c。左回路有4I+6I=15，得到I=1.5A、c点电位6I=9V。Remove RL. No current flows through 2Ω, so a and c have equal potentials. The left loop gives 4I+6I=15, hence I=1.5A and c=6I=9V.

I=154+6=1.5A,Uth=9V

独立源置零，求测试电阻Suppress the independent source and find test resistance

只把15V源短路，保留6I受控源。设c点电位为vc，则I=(0−vc)4，同时vc=6I。两式只能给vc=0，因此外加端口测试电压全部落在2Ω上。Short only the 15V source and retain the 6I source. If c is at vc, I=(0−vc)4 while vc=6I. These force vc=0, so an applied port test voltage falls entirely across 2Ω.

vc=6−vc4⇒vc=0,It=Vt2,Rth=2Ω

使用最大功率条件Apply the maximum-power condition

等效内阻为正，电阻负载在RL=Rth时获得最大功率。题目只要求负载值；最大功率可作为额外核验。The equivalent resistance is positive, so the resistive load receives maximum power at RL=Rth. The question asks only for RL; the maximum power is a supplementary check.

RL=Rth=2Ω,Pmax=Uth24Rth=818W

RL=2Ω时获得最大功率。Maximum power occurs at RL=2Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 求内阻时不能将受控源置零，也不能直接写4+2=6Ω。Do not suppress the controlled source or assume a resistance of 4+2=6Ω.
  • 控制电流I仍按图示从左向右，独立源置零后I=−vc4，负号不能漏。The control current remains referenced left to right, so after source suppression I=−vc4.

核验依据Verification

独立完整负载关系：无论RL取何正值，左回路仍给c=9V，所以PL=81RL(RL+2)2，导数为81(2−RL)(RL+2)3；RL<2时为正，RL>2时为负，唯一最大值在2Ω。此时负载电压4.5V、电流2.25A、功率818W。精确MNA在该负载与多个邻近负载上复核，并检验完整功率平衡：4Ω、2Ω、负载耗散9+10.125+10.125W，两源提供22.5+6.75W，合计0。书第334页、PDF343页3-29为2Ω。Independent full load law: for every positive RL, the left loop still fixes c=9V, so PL=81RL(RL+2)2. Its derivative is 81(2−RL)(RL+2)3, positive below 2 and negative above 2, giving the unique maximum at 2Ω. The load then has 4.5V, 2.25A and 818W. Exact MNA verifies this load and several neighboring values, plus full power balance: the 4Ω, 2Ω and load dissipate 9+10.125+10.125W, supplied as 22.5+6.75W by the sources. Answer 3-29 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 2Ω.

含受控源的匹配电阻用测试源求Use a test source for matching with a dependent source

题目原文Transcribed question

试确定题图3-29所示电路中RL取何值时可获得最大功率，最大功率是多少？For Fig. 3-29, find the value of RL for maximum power and the maximum power.

12V源上正，经1Ω接A。A以4Ω接地，i1向下；A经3Ω到B，B以2Ω接地；受控电流源4i1由地向B。负载RL从A接到右侧接地导线。A top-positive 12V source connects through 1Ω to A. A has 4Ω to ground, i1 downward, and 3Ω to B. B has 2Ω to ground and a dependent injection 4i1 upward. RL connects A to the grounded right wire.

本题图在书第90页／PDF第99页。The source figure is on printed p. 90 · PDF p. 99.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口KCL、线性关系、源置零规则及参考方向。Port KCL, linear relations, source-deactivation rules and reference directions.
负载跨A与地，不是跨B与地。4i1=(1S)VA，因此B节点受控注入能改变端口等效电阻。The load spans A to ground, not B to ground. The controlled injection is 4i1=(1S)VA and changes the port resistance.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

开路时消去内部节点Eliminate the internal node with load open

B的KCL给VB=8VA5，再代A节点求开路电压。以下按SI数值。KCL at B gives VB=8VA5; substitute into A’s KCL for the open-circuit voltage, using SI numerical values.

VB−VA3+VB2−VA=0,(VA−12)+VA4+VA−VB3=0⇒Uoc=807V

独立源置零后的测试Test with the independent source zeroed

将12V短路，给A端1V，仍保持受控源；B为85V，端口输入电流为2120A。Short 12V and impose 1V at A, retaining the dependent source. B is 85V and the absorbed test current is 2120A.

It=1+14+1−853=2120A,Rth=2021Ω

求匹配功率Find the matched power

等效内阻正，可对正电阻负载应用最大功率公式。The equivalent resistance is positive, so the maximum-power condition applies to positive loads.

RL,opt=2021Ω,Pmax=(807)24(2021)W=2407W

RL=2021Ω≈0.95238Ω，Pmax=2407W≈34.2857W。RL=2021Ω≈0.95238Ω, Pmax=2407W≈34.2857W.

易错点Common errors

  • 关掉受控源会得错误内阻；测试时i1仍由4Ω上实际电压决定。Removing the dependent source gives the wrong resistance. During a test, i1 remains set by the actual 4Ω voltage.

核验依据Verification

完整原拓扑精确MNA独立给开路807V、关源1V测试吸收2120A，接2021Ω负载耗2407W，功率余量为零，与附录相符。Independent exact original-topology MNA gives open-circuit 807V, test current 2120A at 1V after deactivation, and 2407W at a2021Ω load. Power balances and the appendix agrees.

用互易双线性关系跨工作状态Relate operating states by reciprocity

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图3-30所示，N0为无源线性电阻网络。当R2=4Ω,U1=10V时，I1=2A,I2=1A；当R2=1Ω,U1=24V,I1=6A时，求此时的I2。N0 in Fig. 3-30 is a passive linear resistive network. At R2=4Ω,U1=10V, I1=2A,I2=1A. At R2=1Ω,U1=24V,I1=6A, find I2.

两端口电流I1、I2均指向N0内部，端口电压均上正。右侧负载R2使U2=−R2I2。Both port currents I1 and I2 point into N0 and both voltages are top-positive. The right load therefore imposes U2=−R2I2.

本题图在书第90页／PDF第99页。The source figure is on printed p. 90 · PDF p. 99.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口KCL、线性关系、源置零规则及参考方向。Port KCL, linear relations, source-deactivation rules and reference directions.
无源线性电阻网络满足互易性，不同工作状态的端口量满足交叉功率恒等式。右口电流方向与负载电流相反，必须保留负号。A passive linear resistor network is reciprocal, so two operating states obey a cross-power identity. Right-port current opposes load current; retain that sign.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写两个状态的端口量Write both port states

状态a右口U2a=−4V；状态b令I2b=x，则U2b=−xV。State a has U2a=−4V. In state b, set I2b=x, giving U2b=−xV.

Ua=(10,−4),Ia=(2,1),Ub=(24,−x),Ib=(6,x)

应用互易交叉关系Apply the reciprocal cross relation

对称端口导纳矩阵给UaᵀIb=UbᵀIa；这不是普通功率的跨状态叠加。A symmetric port-admittance matrix gives UaᵀIb=UbᵀIa. This is not ordinary power superposition across states.

10(6)+(−4)x=24(2)+(−x)(1)⇒x=4

说明条件与方向State conditions and direction

所得正值沿题图I2向左流入网络。互易性依赖纯无源电阻网络；一般含受控源网络不能直接使用。The positive answer points leftward into N0, as drawn. Reciprocity relies on the passive resistor-network assumption and cannot be imposed on arbitrary dependent-source networks.

I2=4A,U2=−4V

I2=4A，方向如图。I2=4A, in the indicated direction.

易错点Common errors

  • 若把U2=+R2I2代入会错；负载电阻的流入正端电流是−I2。Using U2=+R2I2 is incorrect; the load’s passive-sign-convention current is −I2.

核验依据Verification

独立构造对称正定端口导纳矩阵[[27,314],[314,27]] S，精确复现原状态(10,−4) V→(2,1) A及新状态(24,−4) V→(6,4) A，并验证交叉关系，附录4A一致。An independent symmetric positive-definite admittance matrix [[27,314],[314,27]] S exactly reproduces both states: (10,−4) V→(2,1) A and (24,−4) V→(6,4) A. The cross relation and listed 4A agree.

图a左端10V源，右5Ω电阻电压2V上正；图b左端短路，I1在短路线向下，右电流源4A向上，源两端20V上正。In (a), port 1 has 10V and port 2 has a5Ω load at 2V, top-positive. In (b), port 1 is shorted with I1 downward in the short; port 2 has an upward 4A source at 20V.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

无源线性电阻网络、互易性、端口参考方向及功率。Passive linear resistor networks, reciprocity, port references and power.
两状态取端口电流流入N0为正。图a右端口电流−0.4A；图b左端口电流是所求短路电流的负值。Take both port currents inward. State (a) has right-port current −0.4A; state (b) has left-port inward current −I1.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写出端口数据Write port data

把电阻功率的关联方向与网络端口方向分开。Distinguish the load’s passive direction from the network’s inward port direction.

Ua=(10,2),I2a=−25;Ub=(0,20),Ib=(−I1,4)

代入互易双线性关系Apply reciprocal cross-products

UaᵀIb=UbᵀIa，未知的原状态左电流因U1b=0而消去。In UaᵀIb=UbᵀIa, the unknown original input current disappears because U1b=0.

10(−I1)+2(4)=20(−25)

求解Solve

结果沿题图向下短路方向为正。The result is positive along the indicated downward short.

I1=85A=1.6A

I1=1.6A，向下。I1=1.6A downward.

易错点Common errors

  • 互易关系比较的是同一个电阻网络，不能把外部5Ω也固定算入N0。Reciprocity compares the same internal network; do not absorb the external 5Ω into N0 in only one state.

核验依据Verification

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-32所示电路中，N0为无源线性电阻网络。当1—1′端口接10V电压源、2—2′端口短路时，如图(a)，测得I1=5A,I2=1A；当2—2′端口接20V电压源、1—1′端口接2Ω电阻时，如图(b)，试问Iˆ1为多少？N0 in Fig. 3-32 is a passive linear resistor network. With 10V at port 1 and port 2 shorted as in (a), I1=5A and I2=1A. With 20V at port 2 and a2Ω load at port 1 as in (b), find the downward load current Iˆ1.

图a右短路电流1A向下流出N0；图b左2Ω负载电流向下，右20V源上正。State (a) has 1A downward out of the shorted right port. State (b) has a downward left 2Ω load current and a top-positive 20V source at the right port.

读出所需参数Identify the required parameters

两端口电流流入为正，所以原右端口电流为−1A。Take currents inward, so the original right-port current is −1A.

y11=510S=12S,y12=y21=−110S

新负载端KCLKCL at the new loaded port

新左端口向内电流为−U1(2Ω)，右端电压20V。The inward left-port current is −U1(2Ω), with 20V at the right port.

−U12=12U1−110(20)⇒U1=2V

求负载电流Find load current

负载电流沿图示向下为正。The indicated downward load current is positive.

Iˆ1=2V2Ω=1A

原图数据的无源一致性检查Check the original data for passive consistency

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-33所示电路中，N0为无源线性电阻网络。若电路改接为题图3−33(b)所示形式，试求其中的电压Uˆ2。N0 in Fig. 3-33 is a passive linear resistor network. After reconnecting it as in (b), find Uˆ2.

原图(a)：左12V、输入3A，右向外2A流过5Ω。原图(b)：左1A源向上，端电压8V，右10Ω电阻，上端电压Û2为正。Original (a): left 12V with 3A input, right 2A delivered through 5Ω. Original (b): an upward 1A left source with terminal voltage 8V and a right 10Ω load with top-positive Û2.

本题图在书第90页／PDF第99页。The source figure is on printed p. 90 · PDF p. 99.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

无源线性电阻网络、互易性、端口参考方向及功率。Passive linear resistor networks, reciprocity, port references and power.
先抄全图示数字，再检查它们能否同时属于同一个无源电阻网络。互易关系和能量不等式必须同时满足。Transcribe all diagram values, then check whether one passive resistor network can realize them. Reciprocity and passivity must hold simultaneously.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

互易关系的形式结果Formal reciprocal result

状态a右电压10V、向内电流−2A；状态b右向内电流−Û210。State a has right voltage 10V and inward current −2A. State b has inward right current −Û210.

12(1)+10(−Uˆ210)=8(3)+Uˆ2(−2)⇒Uˆ2=12V

无源能量条件矛盾Passivity contradiction

若该形式值成立，状态b左源仅输入8W，右负载却消耗14.4W，网络本身须净供6.4W，与无源电阻网络矛盾。At that formal value, state b supplies only 8W but the load consumes 14.4W. The internal network would deliver 6.4W, contradicting passivity.

PN,b=8(1)−12210=−6.4W<0

给出可负责的结论State the supported conclusion

因此原题全部数字不能同时成立。附录3V也不满足互易方程：左侧9W、右侧18W。未确定哪个数字有误前不擅自改题。The stated numbers cannot all be valid. The listed 3V also fails the reciprocal relation: 9W on the left versus 18W on the right. Do not silently alter an unidentified datum.

Uˆ2=3V:12−3=9≠24−6=18

按所提供原图，条件不自洽，无法给出满足全部条件的无源电阻网络解。12V只是互易方程的形式值，并非有效的无源工作点；附录3V也不满足给定数据。The supplied diagram is inconsistent: no passive resistor-network solution satisfies all conditions. 12V is only a formal reciprocal value, not a valid passive operating point; the listed 3V also fails the stated data.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要把“能解出一个数”当成题设成立。这里应保留矛盾说明，待勘误或教师确认。An algebraic number does not establish consistent assumptions. Retain the discrepancy until an erratum or instructor clarification identifies the incorrect datum.

核验依据Verification

独立反求形式导纳矩阵[[1332,−316],[−316,140]] S，行列式−140为负，进一步证明无法为无源电阻端口；状态b总吸收功率−325W与能量检查一致。Independent reconstruction gives formal admittance [[1332,−316],[−316,140]] S with negative determinant −140, incompatible with passive resistors. Its state−b absorbed power −325W confirms the independent energy contradiction.

前置知识Prerequisites

无源线性电阻网络、互易性、端口参考方向及功率。Passive linear resistor networks, reciprocity, port references and power.
一般功率不能叠加；本题是两种源组之间的总电阻交叉项恰好为零。必须证明交叉项，不能直接套电流叠加。Power is not generally superposable. This special total-network result holds because the cross term between the two source-type groups vanishes; prove that term explicitly.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

叠加电流并展开功率Superpose currents and expand power

以IkV和IkI分别表示只保留电压源组、只保留电流源组时的电阻电流。Let IkV and IkI be resistor currents under voltage-group-only and current-group-only excitation.

P=∑kRk(IkV+IkI)2=PV+PI+2∑kRkIkVIkI

用跨状态拓扑恒等式Use a cross-state topological identity

同一网络中，一个状态的电压和另一个状态的电流满足特勒根恒等式。选电流源组状态电压、与电压源组状态电流配对。电压源支路前者为零；电流源支路后者为零。For one topology, Tellegen’s identity pairs voltages from one state with currents from another. Pair current-group-state voltages with voltage-group-state currents. Voltage-source branches have zero voltage in the former; current-source branches have zero current in the latter.

∑all branchesvbIibV=0⇒∑kRkIkIIkV=0

消去交叉项并说明范围Remove the cross term and state the scope

代回功率展开式即得结论。这是全体电阻的总功率；单只电阻交叉项通常不为零。Substitution proves the result for total resistor power. A single resistor’s cross term need not vanish.

P=PV+PI

网络总电阻吸收功率满足P=PV+PI；不能据此推断任意单个电阻的功率也可叠加。Total resistor absorption satisfies P=PV+PI; this does not imply power superposition for each individual resistor.

易错点Common errors

  • 组内的多个同类源必须保留在一起；不能扩展成任意多个电压源各自功率直接相加。Keep each same-type source group together; the result does not extend to separately adding powers from arbitrary individual voltage sources.

核验依据Verification

跨状态特勒根恒等式严格证明交叉项为零；另在三组不同正电阻、正负电压及电流激励下用精确有理数复核加权电流内积为零、全功率等于两组功率之和。附录未列本题。The cross-state Tellegen identity proves zero cross term. Three independent rational resistor and source examples, including reversed excitations, verify zero weighted current inner product and exact total-power equality. No appendix answer is listed.

交换源与响应支路后出现平衡电桥Source exchange reveals a balanced bridge

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图3-35所示，试用互易定理求支路电流i1。Use reciprocity to find branch current i1 in Fig. 3-35.

左40V源上正。左上S经2Ω到B，经上5Ω到C；B经3Ω到C、经4Ω到D；C经9Ω到D；D经6Ω到源负端。i1在上5Ω由右向左。A top-positive 40V source fixes S. S connects through 2Ω to B and upper 5Ω to C. B connects through 3Ω to C and 4Ω to D; C has 9Ω to D, and D has 6Ω to the source negative terminal. i1 is right-to-left in the upper 5Ω.

本题图在书第91页／PDF第100页。The source figure is on printed p. 91 · PDF p. 100.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

无源线性电阻网络、互易性、端口参考方向及功率。Passive linear resistor networks, reciprocity, port references and power.
将40V源移到5Ω支路中串联，原源位置短路，源极性选为驱动原i1方向。互易性把所求电流变成原电源支路向上电流。Move the 40V source in series with 5Ω, short its original position, and orient it to drive the original i1 reference. Reciprocity maps i1 to upward current in the original source branch.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

交换后识别平衡桥Identify balance after exchange

原源短路使S与左下同电位；从S到C的两支分别2+3与6+9，桥臂比23=69，所以B、D等电位，4Ω无电流。The original short joins S to the lower-left node. The S–C paths are 2+3 and 6+9; their ratios match, so B and D are equipotential and the 4Ω carries no current.

23=69,RSC=(2+3)∥(6+9)=154Ω

交换电源总电流与分流Exchanged source current and division

串联5Ω与154Ω，总电流327A。6+9支路分得四分之一，即87A。The source sees 5Ω plus 154Ω, giving 327A. One quarter takes the 6+9 branch, or 87A.

Itotal=405+154A=327A,I6+9=14Itotal=87A

回到原参考方向Return to the original reference

交换后原电源短路线电流实际向下87A，与原电源参考向上相反；互易还原后i1为负。In the exchanged circuit, 87A travels downward through the original source short, opposite its upward reference. Thus the reciprocal original i1 is negative.

i1=−87A≈−1.142857A

i1=−87A，实际向右；附录取−1.14A。i1=−87A, physically rightward; the appendix rounds to −1.14A.

易错点Common errors

  • 交换的是激励与响应位置，5Ω电阻必须保留；原40V源位置改为短路。Exchange excitation and response positions while keeping 5Ω. Short the original source position.

核验依据Verification

独立完整MNA分别解原电路和交换电路，原上支路右向左电流与交换后原源支路向上电流均−87A；交换电路B=D=−487V，4Ω功率为零，两次全功率严格平衡，附录舍入一致。Independent full MNA gives −87A in both reciprocal references. In the exchanged circuit B=D=−487V and the 4Ω power is zero. Both total-power residuals vanish, agreeing with the rounded appendix.

接负载后用互易关系求输入变化Use reciprocity to find the input change under loading

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-36所示电路中，N0为无源线性电阻网络，Req为电压源置零后ab端的等效电阻，10V为ab端的开路电压。若在ab端接2Ω电阻，则图中4A的电流将变为多少安培？（提示：先用戴维南定理求通过2Ω的电流，然后用电流源置换之，再用叠加定理、互易定理求解。）N0 in Fig. 3-36 is a passive linear resistor network. Req is the ab resistance with the voltage source zeroed, and 10V is the ab open-circuit voltage. After connecting a2Ω load, what does the indicated 4A input current become? Hint: find the load current using Thevenin, replace it by a current source, then use superposition and reciprocity.

左20V源上正，开路输入4A；右ab开路10V上正，关左源后端口等效电阻3Ω。A top-positive 20V source draws 4A with the right port open. Its open-circuit output is 10V; output resistance with the input source zeroed is 3Ω.

本题图在书第91页／PDF第100页。The source figure is on printed p. 91 · PDF p. 100.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

无源线性电阻网络、互易性、端口参考方向及功率。Passive linear resistor networks, reciprocity, port references and power.
先求输出负载电流和新端电压，再将开路与带载两状态放进同一互易交叉式；右端口流入电流是负负载电流。First find load current and loaded voltage. Then relate open and loaded states by reciprocity, taking inward output current as negative delivered load current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

戴维南求负载状态Find the load state using Thevenin

10V源、3Ω内阻、2Ω负载给电流2A、负载电压4V。The 10V source with 3Ω internal and 2Ω external resistance gives 2A and 4V.

IL=10V(3+2)Ω=2A,Uab=4V

两个状态的互易关系Reciprocity between both states

开路状态端口量为(20,10) V、(4,0) A；带载状态为(20,4) V、(Inew,−2) A。The open state has voltages (20,10) V and inward currents (4,0) A. The loaded state has (20,4) V and (Inew,−2) A.

20Inew+10(−2)=20(4)+4(0)

求新的输入电流Find the new input current

输出取电使输入电流增加1A，成为5A。Loading increases input current by 1A, giving 5A.

Inew=5A

原4A输入电流变为5A。The original 4A input current becomes 5A.

易错点Common errors

  • 输出电流增加2A，不表示输入也必增加2A；转移系数由网络互易关系确定。A2A output-current increase does not imply the same input increase; the network’s transfer relation determines it.

核验依据Verification

独立对称正定导纳矩阵[[1760,−16],[−16,13]] S复现原开路20V、4A、10V和关源3Ω端口电阻；接2Ω后直接解得输出4V、输入5A，与互易式及附录一致。An independent symmetric positive-definite admittance matrix [[1760,−16],[−16,13]] S reproduces the original open data and deactivated 3Ω output resistance. Direct loading gives output 4V and input 5A, agreeing with reciprocity and the appendix.

短路测量确定参数Identify parameters from the short test

原右口流入电流为−2A，左端输入1A，端电压4V。The inward right current is −2A and the left current is 1A at 4V.

y11=14S,y12=y21=−12S

带5Ω负载的左口KCLKCL at the 5Ω loaded port

令左端口电压V1，向内电流为−V15，右端电压12V。Let the left voltage be V1; its inward current is −V15, with 12V at port 2.

−V15=14V1−12(12)⇒V1=403V

求电阻电流Find load current

正值沿图中向下方向。The positive result follows the drawn downward reference.

I=V15Ω=83A≈2.66667A

I=83A，向下。I=83A downward.

易错点Common errors

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-38所示电路中，图(a)和图(b)中的网络NR相同，且仅由线性电阻组成。求图(b)中电阻R等于何值时可获得最大功率，并求此最大功率。The identical NR in both circuits of Fig. 3-38 contains only linear resistors. Find R for maximum power in (b), and that maximum power.

图a左2A源向上，左端电压10V，右口开路5V。图b右8A源向上激励，左口接可变R。In (a), an upward 2A source gives left voltage 10V and open right voltage 5V. In (b), an upward 8A source excites the right port and a variable R loads the left port.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口参考方向、理想元件约束及独立一致性检查。Port references, ideal-element constraints and independent consistency checks.
原右口开路，能直接得到阻抗参数z11与z21。互易性使z12=z21，正好能求新左口戴维南源。The original open right port directly identifies z11 and z21. Reciprocity gives z12=z21, enough to identify the new left-port Thevenin equivalent.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求开路阻抗参数Identify open-circuit impedance parameters

端口电流均取流入网络为正。Use inward port currents.

z11=10V2A=5Ω,z12=z21=5V2A=2.5Ω

新左口等效源Equivalent source at the new left port

左口开路时8A乘互阻得20V；右电流源置零为开路，左口内阻仍z11。The open left voltage is 8A times transfer resistance. Zeroing the right current source opens port 2, leaving left resistance z11.

Uoc=(2.5Ω)(8A)=20V,Rth=5Ω

最大功率匹配Match for maximum power

R=Rth时负载端电压为10V，功率20W。Matching gives load voltage 10V and power 20W.

Ropt=5Ω,Pmax=2024(5)W=20W

R=5Ω，Pmax=20W。R=5Ω, Pmax=20W.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把原测得5V直接当作图b的新开路电压；交换激励幅值也从2A变为8A。The original 5V is not the new open voltage; the excitation also changes from 2A to 8A.

核验依据Verification

独立对称正定阻抗矩阵[[5,52],[52,5]] Ω复现原2A观测；新8A下接5Ω精确得10V和20W，附录一致。An independent symmetric positive-definite impedance matrix [[5,52],[52,5]] Ω reproduces the original measurements and gives 10V, 20W for the new 8A excitation with 5Ω, matching the appendix.
