区分端口等效与图示开路电流比Separate the port equivalent from the open-port current ratio

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图3-39所示含有理想运放电路ab端口的诺顿等效电路及电流比i1i4。Find the Norton equivalent at ab and the ratio i1i4 for the ideal-op-amp circuit in Fig. 3-39.

同相端由理想us源固定；R1从us节点到输出a，i1向右。反相端经R2接地、经R3接b；R4从a接b，原图i4向下。端口ab未外接负载。The ideal source fixes the non-inverting input at us. R1 links that node to output a, with i1 rightward. The inverting node has R2 to ground and R3 to b. R4 links a to b, with i4 downward. No external load is attached at ab.

本题图在书第91页／PDF第100页。The source figure is on printed p. 91 · PDF p. 100.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口参考方向、理想元件约束及独立一致性检查。Port references, ideal-element constraints and independent consistency checks.
理想负反馈给V−=us、输入零电流。b点电压固定，而端口电压变化会改变R4电流；电流比须按原图开路条件与箭头求。Ideal negative feedback gives V−=us and zero input current. Node b is fixed, while port voltage changes the R4 current. Evaluate the ratio with the drawn open-port condition and references.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由输入节点确定b电位Determine node b from input KCL

反相输入不吸收电流，R3从b送来的电流等于R2向地电流。The current from b through R3 equals that through R2 to ground.

usR2+us−VbR3=0⇒Vb=us(1+R3R2)

写端口输出电流Write delivered port current

令U=Va−Vb，外部电流Iout由a流出并回到b。b的KCL直接给诺顿形式。Let U=Va−Vb and external Iout leave a and return to b. KCL at b gives Norton form.

Iout=usR2−UR4⇒IN=usR2 (b→a),RN=R4

原图开路时的带符号比值Signed ratio in the drawn open circuit

开路Iout=0，故i4=usR2；Va=Vb+R4i4，原图i1=(us−Va)R1。两电流方向不同，保留负号。Open circuit gives i4=usR2. Use Va=Vb+R4i4 and the drawn i1=(us−Va)R1; retain their opposite signs.

i1i4=−R3+R4R1(us≠0)

诺顿源usR2由b指向a，并联R4。按原图开路及向下i4，i1i4=−(R3+R4)R1；附录正号与原箭头不符。The Norton source usR2 points b→a, parallel with R4. For the drawn open port and downward i4, i1i4=−(R3+R4)R1; the appendix’s positive sign disagrees with the arrows.

易错点Common errors

  • 改变i4参考方向会改变比值符号；外接任意负载后该开路比值一般不再成立。us=0时两电流为零，不能直接做00。Reversing i4 reverses the ratio sign. An arbitrary external load changes this open-port ratio; at us=0 both currents vanish, so the ratio is understood as a nonzero-excitation gain.

核验依据Verification

三组不同正电阻与正负us，独立联立理想输入约束、b节点KCL及三个端口电压测试，均复得Iout=usR2−UR4；开路数值电流比均带负号。附录诺顿参数相符，但电流比正号不符。Three resistor and source sets, including negative us, independently solve ideal-input constraints, b−node KCL and three port-voltage tests, reproducing Iout=usR2−UR4. All open-port ratios are negative under the drawn references. Norton parameters agree with the appendix; the ratio sign does not.

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-40所示开关电路中，R1和R2是两个继电器线圈的等效电阻，R1=5kΩ,R2=6kΩ，VD1和VD2是理想二极管。理想二极管具有单向导电性，当其正向偏置时导通、相当于短路；反向偏置时截止、相当于开路。当流过继电器线圈的电流大于2mA时继电器接通，试问图示电路中两个继电器能否接通？In Fig. 3-40, relay coils have equivalent resistances R1=5kΩ and R2=6kΩ. VD1 and VD2 are ideal unilateral diodes: a forward-biased diode is a short and a reverse-biased diode is open. A relay energizes when its current exceeds 2mA. Determine whether each relay energizes.

公共节点V分别经40kΩ到+40V、20kΩ到+200V、30kΩ到−100V。VD1允许从V向下经R1到地；VD2允许从地经R2向上到V。Node V connects through 40kΩ to +40V, 20kΩ to +200V and 30kΩ to −100V. VD1 permits current downward from V through R1 to ground; VD2 permits current upward from ground through R2 to V.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

端口参考方向、理想元件约束及独立一致性检查。Port references, ideal-element constraints and independent consistency checks.
两个二极管方向相反，公共电位的正负决定哪条线圈支路可能导通。解完线性电路后还必须检查导通电流和截止偏置。The opposite diode orientations make the node-voltage sign decisive. After each linear-mode solution, check forward-current and reverse-bias conditions.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

试VD1通、VD2断Test VD1 on and VD2 off

此时R1并入节点方程，R2支路无电流。用kΩ和mA配套。Include R1 in the nodal equation and leave R2 open. Use kΩ with mA.

V−4040+V−20020+V+10030+V5=0⇒V=92037V

复核理想二极管条件Validate the ideal-diode mode

V约24.865V为正，VD1向下电流为正，VD2阳极经无电流R2接地，比其阴极V低，确为反偏。V is positive, making VD1’s downward current positive. VD2’s anode is at ground through its unexcited coil and below its cathode V, so it is reverse-biased.

IR1=V5kΩ=18437mA≈4.97297mA,IR2=0

与动作阈值比较Compare against the relay threshold

R1电流大于2mA，R2为零。其他三个二极管状态不能同时满足其电流与偏置符号。R1 exceeds 2mA while R2 is unexcited. None of the other three modes satisfies all current and bias signs.

IR1>2mA,IR2<2mA

继电器R1接通，R2不能接通。Relay R1 energizes; relay R2 does not.

易错点Common errors

  • 二极管导通仅将二极管本身短路，不能把串联的线圈电阻一并短掉；题设为理想二极管，不附加0.7V。Only the conducting diode is shorted; its series coil remains. Use the stated ideal model rather than adding 0.7V.

核验依据Verification

独立枚举全部四个二极管状态，用完整源节点MNA精确计算并检查各管偏置、电流符号；只有VD1通、VD2断有效，V=92037V，所有有效元件总功率余量为零，与附录继电器结论一致。Independent enumeration of all four modes uses full source-node MNA and checks each bias and current inequality. Only VD1 on, VD2 off is valid, with V=92037V and zero total-power residual, agreeing with the appendix’s relay conclusion.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第140页／PDF第149页。范围状态：考试范围（储能元件、换路及一阶响应；纲领5.1～5.9）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 140 · PDF p. 149. Coverage: required: storage, switching and first-order responses; course plan 5.1–5.9.

电荷先除电压，再算储能Divide charge by voltage, then calculate energy

题目原文Transcribed question

某电容元件充电到12V时，其电荷为6×10−3C，试求其电容值和此时的储能。A capacitor charged to 12V stores 6×10−3C. Find its capacitance and stored energy.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
电容量由q=Cu确定；储能不是qu，而是其一半。Use q=Cu. Stored energy is one-half of qu, not qu.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由电荷定义求CFind C from charge

保持电荷用库仑、电压用伏特，结果为法拉。Use coulombs and volts to obtain farads.

C=qU=6×10−312F=500μF

两种能量表达式交叉核对Cross-check two energy expressions

电压从0充至12V所对应的场能为二次函数。The field energy is quadratic in voltage.

WC=12CU2=12qU=36×10−3J

C=500μF，WC=36mJ。C=500μF, WC=36mJ.

易错点Common errors

  • 电荷单位C和电容量符号C含义不同，答案电容单位是F。The unit C for charge differs from the capacitance symbol C; capacitance is measured in F.

核验依据Verification

精确有理数计算C=12000F，分别由qU、2和CU22得9250J，与附录500μF、36 mJ一致。Exact rational calculation gives C=12000F and energy 9250J from both qU and 2 and CU22, matching the appendix.

5-2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第140页／PDF第149页。范围状态：考试范围（储能元件、换路及一阶响应；纲领5.1～5.9）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 140 · PDF p. 149. Coverage: required: storage, switching and first-order responses; course plan 5.1–5.9.

电压在衰减，电容电流带负号A decaying capacitor voltage gives negative current

题目原文Transcribed question

某电容元件的电容值为2F，求当其两端电压u(t)=4e−t2V时的电容电流i(t)（假设电压、电流为关联参考方向）。Find i(t) for a2F capacitor with u(t)=4e−t2V, using passive voltage and current references.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
关联方向直接用i=Cdu、dt；指数求导还要乘−12。Under the passive reference use i=Cdudt, including the exponential derivative factor −12.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先求电压导数Differentiate the voltage

时间t按秒计。Time t is in seconds.

dudt=−2e−t2Vs

乘电容量并解释功率Multiply by capacitance and interpret power

电流为负意味着能量从电容释放，与电压衰减相符。Negative current indicates energy release, consistent with the voltage decay.

i(t)=−4e−t2A,p=ui=−16e−tW

i(t)=−4e−t2A。i(t)=−4e−t2A.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能只把指数保留下来而漏掉链式法则的−12。Do not omit the chain-rule factor −12.

核验依据Verification

在三个独立衰减幅值下精确检查Cdu、dt=i及d(Cu22)dt=ui；初始储能16J与总释放能量一致，附录电流相符。Three exact decay-amplitude checks verify Cdu and dt=i and the energy derivative equals ui. Initial 16J equals released energy; the appendix current agrees.

5-3全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第140页／PDF第149页。范围状态：考试范围（储能元件、换路及一阶响应；纲领5.1～5.9）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 140 · PDF p. 149. Coverage: required: storage, switching and first-order responses; course plan 5.1–5.9.

由斜率和电流辨认电容Identify a capacitor from slope and current

题目原文Transcribed question

已知某元件的u(t)和i(t)波形如题图5-1所示，且二者为关联参考方向。试判断此元件是何种电路元件，其参数值是多少？Identify the element and its parameter from the passive-reference u(t), i(t) waveforms in Fig. 5-1.

电压在0～1s由0线性升到1V，1～2s线性降到0；电流前一段+12A，后一段−12A。Voltage rises from 0 to 1V during 0–1s and falls to 0 during 1–2s. Current is +12A on the rising segment and −12A on the falling segment.

本题图在书第140页／PDF第149页。The source figure is on printed p. 140 · PDF p. 149.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
分段常电流对应分段线性电压，适合i=Cdu、dt。用上升、下降两段都验一次同一C。Piecewise constant current with linear voltage suggests i=Cdu and dt. Check the same C on both segments.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

上升段求参数Use the rising segment

上升斜率1Vs，电流12A。The slope is 1Vs and current is 12A.

C=idudt=121F=0.5F

下降段反证符号Check the falling segment

下降斜率−1Vs且电流−12A，商仍为正0.5F。Both slope and current reverse, leaving the same positive capacitance.

−12−1F=0.5F

该元件为电容，C=0.5F。The element is a capacitor with C=0.5F.

易错点Common errors

  • 仅依据图中0～2s两段作判断，不擅自补画图外的电流；电压连续折点不会产生冲激电流。Use the plotted 0–2s intervals without extrapolating current beyond the graph. Continuous voltage corners do not imply impulse current.

核验依据Verification

用两段独立有理斜率分别反求，均给12F，与附录一致。电阻要求ui恒定、理想电感要求u=Ldi、dt，均不符合这两段波形。Both independent slope ratios yield 12F, matching the appendix. The required resistor or inductor laws do not fit these two intervals.

5-4全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第140页／PDF第149页。范围状态：考试范围（储能元件、换路及一阶响应；纲领5.1～5.9）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 140 · PDF p. 149. Coverage: required: storage, switching and first-order responses; course plan 5.1–5.9.

电流脉冲积分后保持电压Integrate a current pulse into a held voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

已知某电容元件的电容值为1F，通过的电流i(t)波形如题图5-2所示，假设电压、电流为关联参考方向，且uC(0)=0，试画出电容两端电压uC(t)的波形。A1F capacitor carries the current in Fig. 5-2 with passive references and uC(0)=0. Draw uC(t).

电流在0～1s为1A，1s后为零。Current is 1A for 0–1s and zero after 1s.

本题图在书第140页／PDF第149页。The source figure is on printed p. 140 · PDF p. 149.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
电压等于初值加电流面积除C；电流归零后电压不会自动归零。Voltage equals its initial value plus current area divided by C. Zero current afterward holds, rather than erases, voltage.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

脉冲持续期间During the pulse

用C=1F积分常电流。Integrate the constant current with C=1F.

uC(t)=1C∫0t1dτ=tV(0≤t≤1s)

脉冲结束后After the pulse

总注入电荷1C，电压保持1V。解析图给出连续转折。The delivered charge is 1C, so voltage holds at 1V. The analytic plot shows the continuous corner.

uC(t)={tV0≤t≤1(t in s)1Vt≥1s

由本题解析式绘制的波形；时间单位见横轴，虚线为终值，开关时刻以竖虚线标出。Waveforms drawn from the derived analytic expressions; time units are on the axis, dashed horizontal lines mark final values and the vertical dotted line marks switching.

电压从0以1Vs线性升到1V，随后保持1V。Voltage rises linearly from 0 to 1V at 1Vs, then holds at 1V.

易错点Common errors

  • 矩形电流的边沿对应电压斜率改变，电压本身保持连续。Current edges change voltage slope while voltage remains continuous.

核验依据Verification

独立面积检查∫idt=1C，故CΔu=1C；最终储能12J。附录未列5-4，结果按初值、积分及连续性核验。Independent area gives 1C and CΔu=1C, with final energy 12J. No appendix answer is listed; the result is checked by integration, initial value and continuity.

斜率先换成每秒，再乘微法Convert the slope to per second before multiplying microfarads

题目原文Transcribed question

某电容元件及其电压波形如题图5-3所示，求当t=3ms时的电容电流。Find capacitor current at t=3ms for the element and voltage in Fig. 5-3.

电容2μF，上正，电流流入上端。电压0～5ms从0升至10V，5～10ms保持10V，10～15ms降至0。The 2μF capacitor is top-positive with current entering the upper terminal. Voltage rises 0–10V over 0–5ms, holds during 5–10ms, then falls to zero during 10–15ms.

本题图在书第141页／PDF第150页。The source figure is on printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
3ms落在第一段恒定正斜率内，不能把该时刻电压值直接除电容量。3ms lies on the first constant positive slope. Use the derivative rather than dividing voltage by capacitance.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

读取上升斜率Read the rising slope

10V在5ms内上升，斜率为2000Vs。10V over 5ms is 2000Vs.

dudt=10V5×10−3s=2000Vs

用关联方向求电流Find current under the passive reference

电压上升且电流流入正端，电流为正。附图同时给出完整分段导数。Rising voltage gives positive current into the positive terminal. The plot also displays the full piecewise derivative.

i(3ms)=(2×10−6F)(2000Vs)=4mA

由本题解析式绘制的波形；时间单位见横轴，虚线为终值，开关时刻以竖虚线标出。Waveforms drawn from the derived analytic expressions; time units are on the axis, dashed horizontal lines mark final values and the vertical dotted line marks switching.

i(3ms)=4mA。i(3ms)=4mA.

易错点Common errors

  • 用105得到的是Vms，必须与μF的数量级一起换算；不要漏掉毫秒因子。105 is Vms, not Vs; keep the millisecond conversion.

核验依据Verification

精确单位换算给1250A；上升段电荷20μC等于CΔu，峰值能量100μJ，附录4mA一致。Exact conversion gives 1250A. Rising charge 20μC equals CΔu and peak energy is 100μJ; the listed 4mA agrees.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第140页／PDF第149页。范围状态：考试范围（储能元件、换路及一阶响应；纲领5.1～5.9）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 140 · PDF p. 149. Coverage: required: storage, switching and first-order responses; course plan 5.1–5.9.

电容串并联按端点识别Identify capacitor series and parallel connections by endpoints

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图5-4所示电路ab端的等效电容。Find the equivalent capacitance at ab in Fig. 5-4.

ab直接有1F；另一支路从a经4F，再经右1F回b。A direct 1F spans ab. A second path from a to b contains 4F in series with the right 1F.

本题图在书第141页／PDF第150页。The source figure is on printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
右侧4F和1F的公共浮置节点没有其他支路，可先串联；再与左1F并联。The floating junction between the right 4F and 1F has no other branch, so reduce that series pair first.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先串联Reduce the series pair

电容串联取倒数和，不是直接相加。Series capacitances combine by reciprocal addition.

Cs=4×14+1F=45F

再并联并测试Then parallel and test

左1F直接与串联支路并联。对零初始电荷网络施加1V时，右中点为45V。Add the direct 1F. Under a1V, initially uncharged test, the intermediate node is 45V.

Ceq=1+45=95F=1.8F

Ceq=1.8F。Ceq=1.8F.

易错点Common errors

  • 任意非零初始电荷还需要相应的初始状态信息；本题求的是端口等效电容量。Arbitrary precharge requires separate initial-state information; this question asks for the port capacitance.

核验依据Verification

独立浮置节点电荷方程给Vx=45V，端口电荷95C；三电容总能量910J也等于Ceq2，附录一致。An independent floating-node charge equation gives Vx=45V and port charge 95C. Total energy 910J equals Ceq2, matching the appendix.

5-7指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第140页／PDF第149页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 140 · PDF p. 149. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-7Assigned requirement: 5-7

电容网络分压：先串并联，再回到每只电容Capacitor voltage division: reduce, then recover each voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

试求题图5-5所示电路中各电容上的电压，已知ab端的电压为uab=12V。Find the voltage across each capacitor in Fig. 5-5, given uab=12V.

C1=12μF接a、c；C2=3μF接c、b；C3=4μF接c、d；C4=12μF接d、b。下方b为公共节点。题干在印刷页140，原图在页141。C1=12μF lies between a,c; C2=3μF between c,b; C3=4μF between c,d; and C4=12μF between d,b. Terminal b is the common bottom node. The statement is on printed p. 140 and figure on p. 141.

本题图在书第141页／PDF第150页。The source figure is on printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电容串并联；串联电荷相等；uxy=vx−vy。Series and parallel capacitors, equal series charge and uxy=vx−vy.
先看节点：C3与C4串联，再与C2并联，最后与C1串联。按本题通常约定，中间浮置导体初始净电荷为0；如果预先存有任意净电荷，仅给端电压不能唯一确定各电压。Read the nodes: C3 and C4 are series, their equivalent is parallel with C2, and that group is series with C1. Use the exercise’s usual assumption of zero initial net charge on floating internal conductors; arbitrary trapped net charge would require additional initial data.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

逐级求等效电容Reduce the capacitor network

C3与C4串联得3μF，与C2并联后c、b间为6μF。它再与C1的12μF串联。C3 and C4 in series give 3μF; in parallel with C2 this gives 6μF between c,b. This is in series with C1=12μF.

C34=4·124+12=3μF,Ccb=3+3=6μF,Cab=12·612+6=4μF

求第一层分压Find the first voltage division

串联组电荷Q=Cab×12V=48μC，因此C1电压为4V，c、b间电压为8V。C2直接跨接c、b。The series charge is Q=Cab×12V=48μC. Thus C1 has 4V and the c,b group has 8V. C2 is directly across c,b.

uac=4812=4V,ucb=486=8V

求C3、C4各自分压Recover C3 and C4 voltages

C3、C4串联组跨接8V，其电荷Q34=3μF×8V=24μC。电容越小，在相同电荷下电压越大。The C3,C4 series pair is across 8V, with charge Q34=3μF×8V=24μC. The smaller capacitance has the larger voltage for equal charge.

ucd=244=6V,udb=2412=2V

C1：uac=4V；C2：ucb=8V；C3：ucd=6V；C4：udb=2V，均按下标顺序取正端、负端。C1: uac=4V; C2: ucb=8V; C3: ucd=6V; C4: udb=2V. Each subscript order defines the positive and negative terminals.

易错点Common errors

  • 串联电容按电容量倒数分压，不按容量大小正比分压。Series capacitor voltages vary inversely with capacitance.
  • C1电荷48μC不等于C3的24μC；中间并联支路会分配电荷。C1 carries 48μC while C3 carries 24μC; charge splits between the middle parallel branches.

核验依据Verification

采用本章串并联电容的通常条件：各内部孤立导体原先净电荷为0（例如所有电容由未充电状态接入）。如果内部导体预先带有未知净电荷，仅给uab不足以唯一决定四个电压。Use the usual condition for the chapter’s series and parallel capacitor model: each internal isolated conductor initially has zero net charge, as when all capacitors are connected uncharged. If unknown trapped charges are present, uab alone does not determine the four voltages uniquely.

独立节点电荷核验：取b=0、a=12V，则c=8、d=2V。c导体净电荷12(8−12)+3×8+4(8−2)=0μC；d导体净电荷4(2−8)+12×2=0μC。总储能为288μJ，与等效4μF在12V下的½CU2相同。书第335页、PDF344页5-7四个电压完全一致。Independent node-charge check: set b=0 and a=12V, giving c=8 and d=2V. The c conductor has net charge 12(8−12)+3×8+4(8−2)=0μC; d has 4(2−8)+12×2=0μC. Total energy is 288μJ, equal to ½CU2 for the 4μF equivalent at 12V. All four voltages match answer 5-7 on printed p. 335 and PDF p. 344.

磁链除电流给电感Divide flux linkage by current for inductance

题目原文Transcribed question

已知电感元件的磁链Ψ与电流i取右手螺旋参考方向。若i=5A,Ψ=0.8Wb，求该电感元件的电感值。Flux linkage Ψ and current i use a right-hand reference. Given i=5A and Ψ=0.8 Wb, find the inductance.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
在线性电感模型下磁链Ψ=Li。不要把磁链直接当作电感或磁通变化率。For the stated linear inductor, Ψ=Li. Flux linkage is neither inductance nor its time derivative.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

应用定义Apply the definition

参考方向使正电流对应正磁链。The reference makes positive current correspond to positive linkage.

L=Ψi=0.8Wb5A=0.16H

检查单位和能量Check units and energy

韦伯每安培即亨利；可附带检查储能为正。Wb and A is H; stored energy is positive.

WL=12Li2=2J

L=0.16H。L=0.16H.

易错点Common errors

  • 使用Ψ而非单匝磁通；若元件非线性，单点Ψ、i不等于所有工作点的微分电感。Use linkage, not single-turn flux. For a nonlinear element, a single Ψ and i does not determine differential inductance everywhere.

核验依据Verification

精确计算L=425H，储能2J为正，与附录0.16H一致。Exact calculation gives 425H and positive energy 2J, matching the appendix.

5-9全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第141页／PDF第150页。范围状态：考试范围（储能元件、换路及一阶响应；纲领5.1～5.9）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150. Coverage: required: storage, switching and first-order responses; course plan 5.1–5.9.

积分电感电压必须带初值Integrate inductor voltage with its initial current

题目原文Transcribed question

已知电感元件的电感值为3H，初始电流i(0)=0，两端电压u(t)=4e−2tV，电压与电流为关联参考方向，试求i(t)。A3H inductor has i(0)=0 and passive-reference voltage u(t)=4e−2tV. Find i(t).

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
电感电流由电压积分确定，初始电流是积分常数。最终电压归零并不要求理想电感最终电流也归零。Current is the voltage integral plus its initial value. Vanishing final voltage does not require zero final current in an ideal inductor.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写带初值的积分Write the initial-value integral

时间按秒计，u=Ldi、dt。With t in seconds, use u=Ldi and dt.

i(t)=i(0)+1L∫0t4e−2τdτ

积分并检查端点Integrate and check endpoints

t=0电流为零，t趋无穷电流为23A。The result starts at zero and tends to 23A.

i(t)=23(1−e−2t)A(t≥0)

i(t)=23(1−e−2t)A。i(t)=23(1−e−2t)A.

易错点Common errors

  • 积分指数带12因子；不能写成i=uL。Integration introduces a factor 12; i=uL is not the inductor law.

核验依据Verification

三个独立幅值下检查Ldi、dt=u和磁能导数ui；输入总功23J等于最终磁能23J，与附录一致。Three independent amplitude checks verify Ldi and dt=u and magnetic-energy derivative ui; total input work and final magnetic energy both equal 23J, matching the appendix.

5-10全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第141页／PDF第150页。范围状态：考试范围（储能元件、换路及一阶响应；纲领5.1～5.9）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150. Coverage: required: storage, switching and first-order responses; course plan 5.1–5.9.

无耦合电感像电阻一样串并联Reduce uncoupled inductors by series and parallel rules

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图5-6所示电路ab端的等效电感。Find the equivalent inductance at ab in Fig. 5-6.

a先经3H到上节点，上节点以两只3H并联接b；图中未给磁耦合。A3H series inductor leads from a to two parallel 3H inductors connected to b; no magnetic coupling is specified.

本题图在书第141页／PDF第150页。The source figure is on printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
无互感条件下，两竖直3H先并联，再与左侧3H串联。Without mutual coupling, parallel the two vertical inductors, then add the left series inductance.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

并联部分Parallel part

以相同端电压、支路电流相加推得并联公式。Equal branch voltage and summed currents give the parallel rule.

Lp=3×33+3H=1.5H

串联相加Add the series part

串联电流相同，电压相加。Series currents are equal and voltages add.

Leq=3+1.5=4.5H

Leq=4.5H。Leq=4.5H.

易错点Common errors

  • 若存在磁耦合，不能无条件使用此公式；本题按原图未标耦合处理。Magnetic coupling would change the rule; none is marked in this diagram.

核验依据Verification

独立1A兼容状态中两并联支路各12A，总磁能为94J，等于Leq·122，与附录4.5H一致。In an independent compatible 1A state, each parallel branch carries 12A; total magnetic energy 94J equals Leq2, matching the appendix.

5-11指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第141页／PDF第150页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-11Assigned requirement: 5-11

换路初始值：同时保留电容电压与电感电流Switching initial values: retain capacitor voltage and inductor current

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-7所示电路原已处于稳态，在t=0时刻开关S打开，求i(0+)。The circuit in Fig. 5-7 is initially in steady state. Switch S opens at t=0. Find i(0+).

左4A向上电流源与5Ω并联，其上节点经开关S连接1F电容上端。电容下端接底部公共节点。电容上端经另一5Ω到右节点，i向右。右节点经0.5H电感和3Ω分别接底部，两者并联。A4A upward source is parallel with left 5Ω. Their upper node connects through S to the upper terminal of a1F capacitor; its lower terminal is common bottom. Another 5Ω connects capacitor top to the right node, with i rightward. The right node connects to bottom through parallel 0.5H and 3Ω branches.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

直流稳态电容开路、电感短路；换路定则；瞬时节点KCL。Open capacitors and short inductors in DC steady state, switching continuity and instantaneous KCL.
题目只求0+瞬间，无需求整个LC暂态。先求0−的uC、iL，再在换路后的电路用同值电压源、电流源表示这两个初始状态。Only the instant 0+ is requested, so the complete LC transient is unnecessary. Find uC and iL at 0−, then impose those states on the post-switch circuit.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求换路前的状态Find the pre-switch state

S原来闭合。稳态时1F开路、0.5H短路，右节点为0V，3Ω无电流。两只5Ω从电流源上节点看去并联，4A均分。S is initially closed. In steady state, the capacitor is open and inductor shorted. The right node is 0V and 3Ω carries no current. The two 5Ω branches are parallel and share 4A equally.

uC(0−)=4(5∥5)=10V,iL(0−)=2A

施加换路定则Apply continuity at switching

开关打开只断开左侧激励。没有冲激激励，故电容电压仍10V、电感电流仍向下2A。Opening S disconnects the left excitation. With no impulsive excitation, capacitor voltage remains 10V and downward inductor current remains 2A.

uC(0+)=10V,iL(0+)=2A

用右节点KCL求电流Use right-node KCL

设右节点瞬时电压v。左边5Ω送入(10−v)5，右侧3Ω与电感流出v3+2。解得v=0，因此所求电流2A。Let the instantaneous right-node voltage be v. The 5Ω supplies (10−v)5, while the 3Ω and inductor draw v3+2. This gives v=0 and the requested current 2A.

10−v5=v3+2⇒v=0,i(0+)=105=2A

i(0+)=2A，方向向右。i(0+)=2A rightward.

易错点Common errors

  • 电容电流和电感电压可以突变；保持连续的是uC和iL。Capacitor current and inductor voltage may jump; uC and iL are the continuous states.
  • 换路后电感不能笼统当短路，必须先用其已知初始电流列方程。本题得到0+电压恰好为0，是计算结果。Do not automatically short the inductor after switching. Impose its initial current; its zero voltage at 0+ is a result here.

核验依据Verification

独立约束检查：0−电流源KCL为105+105=4A；0+右节点KCL为2=2+0，电容电压、电感电流均满足连续性。换路瞬间总储能为½×1×102+½×0.5×22=51J，切换前后相同，没有状态跳变所需的冲激能量。书第335页、PDF344页5-11为2A。Independent constraints: before switching, source-node KCL is 105+105=4A; afterward, right-node KCL is 2 = 2+0 and both states are continuous. Stored energy is ½×1×102+ ½×0.5×22=51J on both sides of switching. Answer 5-11 on printed p. 335 and PDF p. 344 is 2A.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第141页／PDF第150页。范围状态：考试范围（储能元件、换路及一阶响应；纲领5.1～5.9）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150. Coverage: required: storage, switching and first-order responses; course plan 5.1–5.9.

零初压的瞬间短路与直流终态开路Use initial capacitor shorts and final DC opens

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-8所示电路，uC1(0−)=uC2(0−)=0，t=0时开关S闭合，求iC1(0+),iC2(0+),uC1(∞)和uC2(∞)。In Fig. 5-8, both capacitor voltages are initially zero. S closes at t=0. Find the two initial capacitor currents and both final capacitor voltages.

Us经开关及R1接A，A以C1接地，经R2接B；B以C2与R3分别接地。电容电压上正，电流向下。Us feeds A through S and R1. C1 connects A to ground and R2 connects A to B. C2 and R3 connect B to ground. Capacitor voltages are top-positive and currents downward.

本题图在书第141页／PDF第150页。The source figure is on printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
这题只问初瞬和终态，虽有两个储能元件，也不必先解二阶全过程。零初压使两节点初瞬均为零。Only initial and final values are requested; no second-order transient solution is needed. Zero initial voltages fix both nodes to zero at 0+.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

初瞬按连续性固定电压Fix initial voltages by continuity

两节点同为零，R2电流为零，R1送入的电流全部进入C1。Both nodes are zero, so R2 carries no current; all R1 current enters C1.

iC1(0+)=UsR1,iC2(0+)=0

终态两电容开路Open both capacitors at final DC

终态R1、R2、R3串联，C1跨后两只电阻，C2只跨R3。At final DC, R1, R2 and R3 are in series. C1 spans the last two resistors and C2 spans R3.

uC1(∞)=R2+R3R1+R2+R3Us,uC2(∞)=R3R1+R2+R3Us

初瞬电流为UsR1和0；终态电压分别为(R2+R3)Us(R1+R2+R3)及R3Us(R1+R2+R3)。Initial currents are UsR1 and zero; final voltages are (R2+R3)Us(R1+R2+R3) and R3Us(R1+R2+R3).

易错点Common errors

  • 零电压替代仅描述0+伴随模型，不表示电容之后始终短路。Zero-voltage substitution describes the initial companion model, not a permanent short.

核验依据Verification

三组不同电源与正电阻参数，初瞬KCL给上述电流；完整原拓扑DC MNA复得两终值并满足全功率平衡。附录列出的四个结果一致。Three source and resistor sets verify initial KCL; full original-topology DC MNA reproduces final values with exact power balance. All four expressions also agree with the listed appendix results.

闭合短路开关后只经50Ω放电After the shunt closes, discharge through 50Ω

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-9所示电路在开关S闭合前已达稳态，t=0时开关S闭合，求闭合后的电容电压uC(t)并给出其波形。The circuit in Fig. 5-9 is initially steady. S closes at t=0. Find uC(t) afterward and draw its waveform.

20μF电容上正，经50Ω接右节点；右节点有200Ω、开关S及向上0.1A源三条并联支路到地。A top-positive 20μF capacitor connects through 50Ω to a node with parallel 200Ω, switch S and an upward 0.1A source to ground.

本题图在书第141页／PDF第150页。The source figure is on printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
闭合前电容开路，无50Ω压降，初压由0.1A乘200Ω；闭合后右节点直接接地，200Ω被短路，放电电阻只剩50Ω。Before closure the capacitor is open at DC, so the initial voltage is 0.1A times 200Ω. Closure grounds the right node, bypassing 200Ω and leaving only 50Ω in the discharge path.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定初值与终值Determine endpoints

电容电压连续，初始20V，闭合后最终为零。Capacitor voltage is continuous: 20V initially and zero finally.

uC(0+)=uC(0−)=20V,uC(∞)=0

求时间常数Find the time constant

开关短路后由电容端看见50Ω。The capacitor sees 50Ω with S closed.

τ=(50Ω)(20μF)=1ms

写响应并画图Write and plot the response

从20V单调指数降至零，t按秒计时指数系数为1000。The voltage decays monotonically from 20V; when t is in seconds the coefficient is 1000.

uC(t)=20e−1000tV(t≥0)

由本题解析式绘制的波形；时间单位见横轴，虚线为终值，开关时刻以竖虚线标出。Waveforms drawn from the derived analytic expressions; time units are on the axis, dashed horizontal lines mark final values and the vertical dotted line marks switching.

uC(t)=20e−1000tV。uC(t)=20e−1000tV.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把200Ω算进闭合后的时间常数，也不能把闭合后的电容电压立即置零。Do not include the bypassed 200Ω in τ or force capacitor voltage to jump to zero.

核验依据Verification

原后电路KCL Cdu、dt+u、50=0在三个独立幅值下精确成立；电容初始4 mJ全部变为50Ω损耗，附录20e−1000t一致。The original post-switch KCL Cdu and dt+u and 50=0 holds exactly at three amplitudes. Initial capacitor energy 4 mJ equals the 50Ω loss; the appendix agrees.

断开电源后经100Ω放电Disconnect the source and discharge through 100Ω

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-10所示电路在开关S打开前已达稳态，t=0时开关S打开，求打开后的电容电压uC(t)和电流i(t)，绘出二者的波形。The circuit in Fig. 5-10 is initially steady. S opens at t=0. Find and plot uC(t) and i(t) afterward.

10V源经开关接0.01F电容上端，电容上正；同一节点经10Ω与右90Ω串联接地，i沿上10Ω向右。A10V source connects through S to the top-positive 0.01F capacitor. A10Ω and 90Ω series branch connects that node to ground, with i rightward through 10Ω.

本题图在书第141页／PDF第150页。The source figure is on printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
开关仅断开电源，电容与两只串联电阻仍组成放电回路。电容初压由原理想电源固定为10V。Opening disconnects only the source. The capacitor remains connected to both series resistors and starts at 10V.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

初值、终值与时间常数Initial value, final value and time constant

两电阻串联100Ω，最终电压零。The two resistors total 100Ω and final voltage is zero.

uC(0+)=10V,uC(∞)=0,τ=(100Ω)(0.01F)=1s

电压及支路电流Voltage and branch current

i按电容正端向电阻流出，与电容关联电流方向相反。i leaves the capacitor’s positive node through the resistors, opposite to the capacitor’s passive current.

uC(t)=10e−tV,i(t)=uC(t)100Ω=0.1e−tA

由本题解析式绘制的波形；时间单位见横轴，虚线为终值，开关时刻以竖虚线标出。Waveforms drawn from the derived analytic expressions; time units are on the axis, dashed horizontal lines mark final values and the vertical dotted line marks switching.

uC(t)=10e−tV，i(t)=0.1e−tA，t≥0。uC(t)=10e−tV, i(t)=0.1e−tA, for t≥0.

易错点Common errors

  • 不可只用90Ω求时间常数；i不是流入电容正端的电流，因此不直接等于Cdu、dt。Do not omit 10Ω from τ. The indicated i is not the capacitor’s passive current, so it does not equal Cdu and dt.

核验依据Verification

独立原回路检查Cdu、dt+i=0；初始储能12J等于100Ω总损耗积分，附录两式一致。Independent original-loop checking verifies Cdu and dt+i=0. Initial energy 12J equals integrated resistor loss, matching both appendix expressions.

指定要求：5-15Assigned requirement: 5-15

受控源初始充电与断开后的RC放电Controlled-source charging and RC discharge after opening

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-11所示电路在开关S打开前已达稳态，t=0时刻开关打开，求开关打开后的电容电压uC(t)。The circuit in Fig. 5-11 is in steady state before switch S opens at t=0. Find the capacitor voltage uC(t) after opening.

左10V源上正下负，向上参考电流i，经S和5kΩ到节点x。x经上正下负的受控电压源104i接底部，并经20kΩ到2μF电容上端。电容下端接底部，uC上正下负。原图明确标20kΩ与2μF。The left 10V source is positive at the top, with upward current i, and connects through S and 5kΩ to node x. A top-positive controlled voltage source 104i joins x to bottom. A20kΩ resistor connects x to the top of a2μF capacitor, with uC top-positive. The original figure explicitly labels 20kΩ and 2μF.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

受控源关系；电容电压连续性；RC零输入响应；单位换算。Controlled-source relations, capacitor-voltage continuity, RC zero-input response and unit conversion.
先用闭合时的受控关系求初始充电电压。打开后控制电流i因断路而为0，所以受控源电压成为0，电容仅经20kΩ放电。这里源变为0是控制量计算结果。First find the initial charge using the closed-switch control law. After opening, i is zero because its branch is broken; the controlled voltage becomes zero and the capacitor discharges through 20kΩ. The dependent source becomes zero as a consequence of its control current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

换路前求电容电压Find the pre-switch capacitor voltage

稳态电容开路，20kΩ无电流，因此uC(0−)=vx。由左回路和受控源可得i=(10−vx)5000、vx=10000i。In steady state, the capacitor is open and 20kΩ carries no current, so uC(0−)=vx. The left loop and source law give i=(10−vx)5000 and vx=10000i.

vx=2(10−vx)⇒uC(0−)=203V

换路后的三要素Find the three post-switch parameters

电容电压连续；开关打开后i=0，vx=0，最终电压0。电容看入电阻为20kΩ，时间常数须将μF化为10−6F。Capacitor voltage is continuous. After opening, i=0 and vx=0; the final voltage is zero. The capacitor sees 20kΩ. Convert μF to 10−6F when calculating the time constant.

uC(0+)=203V,uC(∞)=0,τ=20000(2×10−6)=0.04s

写出正确响应并核对附录State the response and compare the appendix

因此衰减系数为1τ=25s−1。原书附录写6.67e−2·5t，按本题原图参数指数小了10倍；这里采用满足原电路方程的25s−1，并明确保留此差异。The decay rate is 1τ=25s−1. The printed appendix gives 6.67e−2.5t, whose exponent is ten times too small for the supplied figure. Use 25s−1, which satisfies the original circuit equation, and retain the discrepancy explicitly.

uC(t)=203e−25tV,t≥0

uC(t)=(203)e−25tV，t≥0，t以秒计。附录的−2.5t与原图参数不符。uC(t)=(203)e−25tV for t≥0 in seconds. The appendix exponent −2.5t is inconsistent with the figure parameters.

易错点Common errors

  • 20kΩ×2μF=0.04s，不是0.4s。20kΩ×2μF=0.04s, not 0.4s.
  • 不得为了匹配附录而改读原图的电容或电阻值。Do not reinterpret the figure values just to match the appendix.

核验依据Verification

独立微分方程核验：2×10−6duCdt+uC20000=0，代入e−25t时两项严格抵消，代入e−2·5t则不成立。储能核验：初始½C(203)2=122500J，积分∫0∞uC220000dt恰为同值，且最终电压0。原图20kΩ、2μF及附录第335页、PDF344页的−2.5t已分别放大目视确认。附录初值6.67是203的舍入，但指数存在实质不一致。Independent ODE check: 2×10−6duCdt+uC20000=0. Substitution of e−25t cancels exactly, while e−2.5t does not. Energy check: the initial ½C(203)2 is 122500J, exactly equal to ∫0∞uC220000dt; final voltage is zero. The figure’s20kΩ and 2μF and the appendix exponent −2.5t on printed p. 335 and PDF p. 344 were each visually enlarged and checked. Its 6.67 initial value is ordinary rounding, but the exponent is materially inconsistent.

换接后电感在2Ω与12Ω回路中衰减After transfer, the inductor decays through 2Ω and 12Ω

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-12所示电路，开关S在位置1闭合已久，t=0时开关S由1合向2，求t≥0+后的电感电流iL，绘出其波形。In Fig. 5-12, S has been at position 1 for a long time and transfers to position 2 at t=0. Find and plot iL for t≥0+.

位置1接5A源并联8Ω的上节点；开关动端经2Ω接3H电感到地，iL向下；位置2接12Ω上端，其下端接地。Position 1 connects to a5A source parallel with 8Ω. The moving contact feeds 2Ω then 3H to ground with iL downward. Position 2 connects to the top of 12Ω to ground.

本题图在书第141页／PDF第150页。The source figure is on printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
换接前电感短路，用8Ω与2Ω分流求初流；换接后源被隔离，电感经2+12Ω形成闭合回路。Before transfer the inductor is a DC short; use current division between 8Ω and 2Ω. After transfer the source is isolated and the discharge loop contains 2+12Ω.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

原稳态电流Original steady current

5A在8Ω与2Ω之间分流，所求2Ω支路电流为4A。The 5A splits between 8Ω and 2Ω, giving 4A in the inductor branch.

iL(0+)=iL(0−)=588+2A=4A

新回路时间常数New-loop time constant

无源放电，终流为零；电感看见串联14Ω。The discharge is source-free with final current zero, and the inductor sees 14Ω.

τ=3H14Ω=314s,iL(t)=4e−14t3A

由本题解析式绘制的波形；时间单位见横轴，虚线为终值，开关时刻以竖虚线标出。Waveforms drawn from the derived analytic expressions; time units are on the axis, dashed horizontal lines mark final values and the vertical dotted line marks switching.

iL(t)=4e−14t3A，t≥0。iL(t)=4e−14t3A, t≥0.

易错点Common errors

  • 位置2不是开路；12Ω与2Ω都留在换接后的电感回路中。Position 2 is not an open contact; both 12Ω and 2Ω remain in the inductor loop.

核验依据Verification

原稳态完整MNA独立给4A；新回路Ldi、dt+14i=0成立，初始磁能24J等于回路电阻总耗能，附录一致。Full initial-state MNA independently gives 4A. The new-loop equation Ldi and dt+14i=0 holds and initial 24J equals total discharge resistor loss, matching the appendix.

电感电流连续，开关电流可以跳变Inductor current is continuous; switch current may jump

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-13所示电路在开关S闭合前已达稳态，t=0时开关S闭合，求闭合后的电感电流iL和通过开关的电流isw，绘出二者的波形。The circuit in Fig. 5-13 is initially steady. S closes at t=0. Find and plot iL and the downward switch current isw afterward.

9V源上正，经左1kΩ到中节点；中节点经右1kΩ与4mH电感串联接地，iL向下；开关闭合将中节点接地，isw向下。A top-positive 9V source feeds the center through 1kΩ. A second 1kΩ and 4mH inductor run to ground with iL downward. Closing S grounds the center, with isw downward.

本题图在书第142页／PDF第151页。The source figure is on printed p. 142 · PDF p. 151.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
原稳态两只1kΩ串联，电感初流4.5mA；闭合后左源持续送9mA，右电感在独立1kΩ回路中释放能量。Initially the two 1kΩ resistors are in series, giving 4.5mA. After closure the left source sends 9mA while the right inductor discharges through its own 1kΩ loop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

电感初流及微秒时间常数Initial current and microsecond time constant

4mH除1kΩ是4μs，不能误算成4ms。4mH divided by 1kΩ is 4μs, not 4ms.

iL(0+)=4.5mA,τ=4mH1kΩ=4μs

电感电流Inductor current

时间按秒写指数系数250000。With t in seconds the decay coefficient is 250000.

iL(t)=4.5e−250000tmA

由中节点KCL求开关电流Find switch current from KCL

左侧9mA分为电感支路电流与开关电流，开关电流在0+为4.5mA并趋9mA。The 9mA divides into the inductor and switch currents. The switch jumps to 4.5mA and tends to 9mA.

isw(t)=(9−4.5e−250000t)mA

由本题解析式绘制的波形；时间单位见横轴，虚线为终值，开关时刻以竖虚线标出。Waveforms drawn from the derived analytic expressions; time units are on the axis, dashed horizontal lines mark final values and the vertical dotted line marks switching.

iL=4.5e−250000tmA，isw=(9−4.5e−250000t)mA，t≥0。iL=4.5e−250000tmA, isw=(9−4.5e−250000t)mA for t≥0.

易错点Common errors

  • 只有理想电感电流必须连续；开关电流可从0跳到4.5mA，不能要求它也连续。Only the ideal inductor current must remain continuous; switch current can jump from zero to 4.5mA.

核验依据Verification

独立检查新节点KCL及4mH回路KVL；初始磁能40.5 nJ等于右1kΩ耗能。附录指数−25×104t与−250000t相同。Independent checks verify node KCL and the 4mH loop KVL. Initial energy 40.5 nJ equals the right 1kΩ loss. The appendix exponent −25×104t is identical.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第141页／PDF第150页。范围状态：考试范围（储能元件、换路及一阶响应；纲领5.1～5.9）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150. Coverage: required: storage, switching and first-order responses; course plan 5.1–5.9.

负极性电源使电容充到负电压The reversed source charges the capacitor negatively

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-14所示电路在t=0时开关S闭合，开关闭合前电容无储能，求t≥0+时的uC(t)并给出其波形。S closes at t=0 in Fig. 5-14. The capacitor is initially unenergized. Find and plot uC(t) for t≥0+.

10μF电容上正，与2kΩ并联；上节点另经2kΩ接100V源上负端，源下正端经开关闭合接地。A top-positive 10μF capacitor is parallel with 2kΩ. Its top node connects through another 2kΩ to the negative upper terminal of a100V source; the positive lower terminal is grounded when S closes.

本题图在书第142页／PDF第151页。The source figure is on printed p. 142 · PDF p. 151.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
右源上端是−100V，不是+100V。两只2kΩ分压给−50V终值，关源后并联等效1kΩ。The source upper terminal is −100V. Equal resistors give final −50V; deactivation leaves 1kΩ in parallel equivalent resistance.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

初值与终值Initial and final voltages

无初始储能给uC(0+)=0；终态电容开路。No initial energy gives zero initial voltage; open the capacitor for final DC.

uC(0+)=0,uC(∞)=−50V

时间常数与三要素式Time constant and endpoint formula

等效1kΩ乘10μF得10ms。1kΩ times 10μF gives 10ms.

τ=10ms,uC(t)=−50(1−e−100t)V

由本题解析式绘制的波形；时间单位见横轴，虚线为终值，开关时刻以竖虚线标出。Waveforms drawn from the derived analytic expressions; time units are on the axis, dashed horizontal lines mark final values and the vertical dotted line marks switching.

uC(t)=−50(1−e−100t)V，从0单调趋向−50V。uC(t)=−50(1−e−100t)V, decreasing from zero toward −50V.

易错点Common errors

  • 负电压不等于负电容；只是相对于指定上正下负参考方向的结果。Negative voltage does not mean negative capacitance; it reflects the assigned reference polarity.

核验依据Verification

三个独立衰减幅值下，直接原节点方程Cdu、dt+u、(2kΩ)+(u+100)、(2kΩ)=0精确成立；初始斜率−5000Vs、最终能量12.5 mJ，附录一致。At three independent amplitudes the original-node equation Cdu and dt+u and (2kΩ)+(u+100) and (2kΩ)=0 holds exactly. Initial slope is −5000Vs and final energy 12.5 mJ, matching the appendix.

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-15所示电路在t<0时已处于稳态，t=0时开关S闭合，求t≥0+时的iL(t)并给出其波形。The circuit in Fig. 5-15 is initially steady. S closes at t=0. Find and plot iL(t) for t≥0+.

10V源经开关和6Ω到上节点；该节点以2Ω及3H电感分别接地，iL向下。A10V source feeds the top node through S and 6Ω. The node has parallel 2Ω and 3H branches to ground, iL downward.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

动态元件关联参考方向、初始条件、KCL及能量。Passive references for storage elements, initial conditions, KCL and energy.
初始无源电感电流为零。终态电感短路使2Ω无电流，但求时间常数时仍须将2Ω保留并与6Ω并联。Initial source-free current is zero. At final DC the inductor shorts 2Ω, but the resistance test must retain 2Ω parallel with 6Ω.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

初值和终值Initial and final currents

最终全部106A流入电感。At final DC all 106A flows through the inductor.

iL(0+)=0,iL(∞)=106A=53A

测试电阻和时间常数Resistance seen and time constant

独立电压源短路后，6Ω与2Ω都从电感端接地。After shorting the voltage source, both resistors connect the inductor terminal to ground.

Rth=6∥2=1.5Ω,τ=3H1.5Ω=2s

写响应并检查初始斜率Write response and check initial slope

初瞬电感电压为10×2(6+2)=2.5V，故初始斜率56As。The initial inductor voltage is 2.5V, so the initial slope is 56As.

iL(t)=53(1−e−t2)A

由本题解析式绘制的波形；时间单位见横轴，虚线为终值，开关时刻以竖虚线标出。Waveforms drawn from the derived analytic expressions; time units are on the axis, dashed horizontal lines mark final values and the vertical dotted line marks switching.

iL(t)=53(1−e−t2)A，t≥0。iL(t)=53(1−e−t2)A, t≥0.

易错点Common errors

  • 用6Ω单独求τ会出错；终态短路模型与时间常数关源测试模型用途不同。Using 6Ω alone gives the wrong τ. The final-DC short model and the deactivated-source resistance test serve different purposes.

核验依据Verification

三个独立衰减幅值下，原节点源电流等于电感电流加2Ω电流，并满足源功率=两电阻损耗+磁能导数；最终磁能256J，附录一致。Three independent decay-amplitude checks verify original-node KCL and source power equals both resistor losses plus magnetic-energy derivative. Final energy is 256J; the appendix agrees.

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图5-16所示电路在下列条件下t≥0+时的iL(t)：(1) us(t)=0,iL(0−)=3A；(2) us(t)=10V,iL(0−)=0；(3) us(t)=20V,iL(0−)=−1A。Find iL(t) for t≥0 in Fig. 5-16: (1)us=0, iL(0−)=3A; (2)us=10V, iL(0−)=0; (3)us=20V, iL(0−)=−1A.

建立同一微分方程Derive one common ODE

节点方程给i=2iL。L=1H，R=1Ω，数值以秒、安培、伏特计。KCL gives i=2iL. Use seconds, amperes and volts with L=1H, R=1Ω.

diLdt+2iL=us,τ=12s,iL(∞)=us2Ω

分别代三组初值Insert the three initial states

每组使用终值加初终差的指数项，不能把第(3)问负初值改为正。Use final value plus initial-to-final difference. Retain the negative initial value in case (3).

iL(t)={3e−2tAcase (1)5(1−e−2t)Acase (2)(10−11e−2t)Acase (3)

三问依次为3e−2t、5(1−e−2t)、10−11e−2t A，t以秒计。The three currents are 3e−2t, 5(1−e−2t), and 10−11e−2t A, with t in seconds.

易错点Common errors

  • 第(3)问电流先从−1A上升再过零，过零时刻为ln(1.1)2s；受控源使等效衰减电阻不是原1Ω。Case (3) starts at −1A and crosses zero at ln(1.1)2s. The dependent source changes the effective decay resistance from the physical 1Ω.

题图5-17所示电路在开关S打开前已达稳态，t=0时开关S打开，求t≥0+时的uab(t)并给出其波形。The circuit in Fig. 5-17 is initially steady with S closed. S opens at t=0. Find and plot uab(t) for t≥0.

2V源经1Ω到a，a以1F接地；S连接a、b，b以2Ω和1H分别接地。A2V source feeds a through 1Ω; 1F connects a to ground. S links a to b, where 2Ω and 1H each connect to ground.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
开关断开使两个储能元件分属独立子电路，uab是两个节点电压之差，不必解耦合二阶方程。Opening separates the two storage elements. uab is a difference of two independent node voltages, so no coupled second-order solution is needed.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

闭合稳态给初值Read the initial closed-switch DC state

电感短路把a、b拉到零；电源经1Ω送2A进入电感。The inductor short grounds both nodes and carries 2A from the 1Ω branch.

uC(0+)=0,iL(0+)=2A

分别写左右响应Write both separate responses

左侧RC充电时间常数1s；右侧RL放电时间常数12s，b电压为负。The left RC charges with τ=1s. The right RL decays with τ=12s and negative node−b voltage.

Va=2(1−e−t)V,iL=2e−2tA,Vb=LdiLdt=−4e−2tV

相减并检查非单调波形Subtract and inspect the nonmonotonic waveform

uab从0−的0V跳到0+的4V，先降到74V，再回升到2V。储能电压、电流仍分别连续。uab jumps from 0 to 4V, falls to 74V and then rises to 2V; capacitor voltage and inductor current remain continuous.

uab=2−2e−t+4e−2tV,tmin=ln4s

uab(t)=(2−2e−t+4e−2t)V，最小值1.75V在t=ln4s。uab(t)=(2−2e−t+4e−2t)V; its 1.75V minimum occurs at t=ln4s.

易错点Common errors

  • uab不是电容本身的电压，可以跳变；右侧电感电流向下而其上端电压为负。uab is not a capacitor voltage and may jump. The decaying downward inductor current has a negative top-node voltage.

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图5-18所示，开关S在t=0时刻闭合。已知uC(0−)=1V，t≥0+时us(t)=1V，求电路中2Ω电阻上的电压uo(t)的零输入响应、零状态响应和全响应，并绘出它们的波形。In Fig. 5-18, S closes at t=0, uC(0−)=1V and us(t)=1V for t≥0. Find and plot the zero-input, zero-state and full voltages across the 2Ω resistor.

输入左端经并联的1Ω与2F接输出右端，输出通过2Ω接地；uC左正右负，uo上正。A parallel 1Ω and 2F links the source node to the output, which has 2Ω to ground. uC is positive left-to-right and uo top-to-bottom.

本题图在书第142页／PDF第151页。The source figure is on printed p. 142 · PDF p. 151.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

先把状态选为电容电压，输出uo=us−uC。零输入只去掉独立源，零状态只清掉初始储能。Choose capacitor voltage as the state: uo=us−uC. Zero-input removes the independent source; zero-state removes initial energy.

建立状态方程Derive the state equation

并联1Ω电流与电容电流相加后流入右2Ω。The 1Ω and capacitor currents sum into the 2Ω branch.

2duCdt+uC=us−uC2⇒duCdt+34uC=14us,τ=43s

分别求两种分量Find both components

零输入uC从1V衰减，输出取相反号；零状态uC从0升到13V，输出一开始即为1V。For zero input the initially 1V capacitor decays and output has the opposite sign. In zero state uC rises to 13V, while output starts at 1V.

uo,ZI=−e−3t4V,uo,ZS=(23+13e−3t4)V

相加并核对初值Superpose and check the initial value

两个分量在0+分别−1V与+1V，恰好抵消。The −1V and +1V component initial values cancel exactly.

uo=23(1−e−3t4)V

解析式波形，时间与纵轴单位分别标明；分段边界和储能变量连续性可直接对照。Analytic waveforms with explicit time and vertical-axis units, showing segment boundaries and storage-state continuity.

零输入−e−3t4 V；零状态(2+e−3t4)3 V；全响应2(1−e−3t4)3 V。Zero-input: −e−3t4 V; zero-state: (2+e−3t4)3 V; full: 2(1−e−3t4)3 V.

易错点Common errors

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-19所示电路中uC(0−)=2V，求uC(t)的零输入响应、零状态响应和全响应，并绘出它们的波形。In Fig. 5-19, uC(0−)=2V. Find and plot its zero-input, zero-state and full responses.

向上的2ϵ(t)A电流源与4Ω、1F并联，电容上正。An upward 2ϵ(t)A source is parallel with 4Ω and a top-positive 1F capacitor.

本题图在书第142页／PDF第151页。The source figure is on printed p. 142 · PDF p. 151.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
零输入保留2V初值；零状态由2A×4Ω确定8V终值，时间常数都是4s。Zero input retains the 2V initial condition; zero state approaches 2A×4Ω=8V. Both use τ=4s.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定方程与极点Determine the ODE and pole

电容向下电流加电阻向下电流等于源输入。Downward capacitor and resistor currents equal the injected source current.

duCdt+uC4=2,τ=4s

写分量与总响应Write components and full response

总响应从2V单调升至8V，两个分量相加可逐点检查。The full response rises monotonically from 2 to 8V; the plotted components sum at every time.

uC,ZI=2e−t4V,uC,ZS=8(1−e−t4)V,uC=(8−6e−t4)V

解析式波形，时间与纵轴单位分别标明；分段边界和储能变量连续性可直接对照。Analytic waveforms with explicit time and vertical-axis units, showing segment boundaries and storage-state continuity.

依次为2e−t4 V、8(1−e−t4) V、(8−6e−t4) V。The responses are 2e−t4 V, 8(1−e−t4) V and (8−6e−t4) V.

易错点Common errors

  • 零输入的初值为2V，零状态的初值为0；全响应系数8−2=6，而不是直接把两个终值相加。The component initial values are 2V and zero. The full exponential difference is 8−2=6.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第142页／PDF第151页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 142 · PDF p. 151. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-24Assigned requirement: 5-24

三种初态下的零输入、零状态与全响应Zero-input, zero-state and full responses for three initial states

题目原文Transcribed question

对题图5-20所示电路。 (1) 若Us=18V，uC(0−)=−6V，求电容电压的零输入响应、零状态响应和全响应。 (2) 若Us=18V，uC(0−)=−12V，求全响应uC(t)。 (3) 若Us=36V，uC(0−)=−6V，求全响应uC(t)。For the circuit in Fig. 5-20: (1) With Us=18V and uC(0−)=−6V, find the zero-input, zero-state and full capacitor-voltage responses. (2) With Us=18V and uC(0−)=−12V, find the full uC(t). (3) With Us=36V and uC(0−)=−6V, find the full uC(t).

Us独立源上正下负，上端经6Ω到电容上节点；该节点经3Ω与14F电容分别接底部公共节点。uC上正下负。The top-positive Us source connects through 6Ω to the capacitor’s top node. Parallel 3Ω and 14F branches connect this node to common bottom. uC is positive at the top.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

RC三要素法；零输入响应保留初态；零状态响应初态为0；线性叠加。The three-parameter RC method, retained initial state for zero-input response, zero initial state for zero-state response, and linear superposition.
三问拓扑相同，所以时间常数相同。源大小决定最终值，电容初态决定指数项幅度。第一问先把两个响应写清，再叠加。All three parts share the topology and time constant. The source fixes the final value, while the capacitor initial state fixes the exponential amplitude. In part (1), write both component responses before adding them.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一求时间常数和最终值Find the common time constant and final value

独立源置零后，电容看到6Ω与3Ω并联为2Ω。稳态电容开路，3Ω分得源电压的13。With the independent source suppressed, the capacitor sees 6Ω parallel with 3Ω, or 2Ω. In steady state the capacitor is open, and 3Ω receives one third of the source voltage.

τ=(6∥3)14=12s,uC(∞)=Us3

第一问分别写两个分量Write both components in part (1)

零输入时仅保留−6V初态；零状态时源18V有效、初态0，最终值6V。相加后初态为−6V、最终值6V。The zero-input response retains only the −6V initial state. The zero-state response uses the 18V source and zero initial state, approaching 6V. Their sum starts at −6V and approaches 6V.

uzi=−6e−2t,uzs=6(1−e−2t),uC=6−12e−2t(V)

第二问改变初态Change the initial state in part (2)

最终值仍6V，初态改为−12V，所以指数项系数为−12−6=−18V。The final value remains 6V, but the initial value is −12V. The exponential amplitude is −12−6=−18V.

uC(2)(t)=6−18e−2t(V)

第三问改变激励Change the source in part (3)

源36V使最终值变为12V，初态仍−6V，指数项系数为−6−12=−18V。全部公式适用于t≥0且t以秒计。The 36V source makes the final value 12V. The initial value remains −6V, giving amplitude −6−12=−18V. All formulas apply for t≥0 in seconds.

uC(3)(t)=12−18e−2t(V)

(1) 零输入−6e−2tV；零状态6(1−e−2t)V；全响应6−12e−2tV。 (2)6−18e−2tV。 (3)12−18e−2tV。(1) Zero input: −6e−2tV; zero state: 6(1−e−2t)V; full: 6−12e−2tV. (2)6−18e−2tV. (3)12−18e−2tV.

易错点Common errors

  • 三问初始电压都有负号；第二问是−12V，不是+12V。The initial voltages are signed; part (2) has −12V, not +12V.
  • 时间常数用源置零后的6Ω∥3Ω，不是6+3。Use 6Ω∥3Ω after source suppression, not 6+3Ω, for the time constant.

核验依据Verification

独立原电路方程为¼duCdt+(uC−Us)6+uC3=0，即duCdt+2uC=(23)Us。逐一代入三个全响应，常数项和指数项残差均严格为0；初始值分别−6、−12、−6V，最终值分别6、6、12V，初始斜率分别24、36、36Vs。第一问零输入储能4.5J，恰等于在等效2Ω中的总耗散。书第336页、PDF345页5-24全部小问一致。The independent original-circuit equation is ¼duCdt+(uC−Us)6+uC3=0, or duCdt+2uC=(23)Us. Each full response gives exactly zero constant and exponential residuals. Their initial values are −6, −12 and −6V; final values 6, 6 and 12V; initial slopes 24, 36 and 36Vs. The part (1) zero-input energy is 4.5J, equal to the total loss in equivalent 2Ω. Every part matches answer 5-24 on printed p. 336 and PDF p. 345.

两开关换源，初始电流来自原电流源Two switches exchange sources without resetting current

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-21所示电路在t=0时已处于稳态，t=0时刻开关S1闭合、S2打开。(1)求t≥0+时iL的零输入响应、零状态响应和全响应，并绘出它们的波形。(2)若电路中电压源改为60V，求t≥0+时iL的全响应。In Fig. 5-21 the circuit is initially steady. At t=0, S1 closes and S2 opens. (1) Find and plot the zero-input, zero-state and full iL responses. (2) Replace the voltage source by 60V and find the full response.

30V源经S1和2kΩ接中点，中点以2kΩ接地，经另一2kΩ接3mH电感；15mA向上源经S2接中点。A30V source feeds the midpoint through S1 and 2kΩ. The midpoint has a2kΩ shunt and a2kΩ–3mH branch. An upward 15mA source joins it through S2.

本题图在书第143页／PDF第152页。The source figure is on printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
原电压源被S1隔离，初始电流由15mA在两只2kΩ间平分。换成60V也不改变这个初值。S1 initially isolates the voltage source. The 15mA source splits equally into two 2kΩ branches, so replacing 30V by 60V does not change initial current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

原稳态求初值Find the initial steady state

原S2闭合、S1打开，电感在直流下短路。Initially S2 is closed, S1 open and the inductor is a DC short.

iL(0+)=7.5mA

新电路求终值和时间常数Find the new final value and time constant

电感端戴维南电压为15V，电阻为2kΩ加2kΩ并联2kΩ。The inductor sees a15V Thevenin source and 2kΩ plus the parallel pair of 2kΩ resistors.

Rth=3kΩ,τ=3mH3kΩ=1μs,iL(∞)=5mA

第(1)问三种响应Three responses for part (1)

t以秒计。全响应从7.5mA降到5mA。With t in seconds, the full response falls from 7.5 to 5mA.

iL,ZI=7.5e−106tmA,iL,ZS=5(1−e−106t)mA,iL=(5+2.5e−106t)mA

第(2)问只改变终值Change only the final value in part (2)

60V使终值翻倍为10mA，时间常数和7.5mA初值均不变。60V doubles the final value to 10mA while τ and the 7.5mA initial value stay fixed.

iL=(10−2.5e−106t)mA

解析式波形，时间与纵轴单位分别标明；分段边界和储能变量连续性可直接对照。Analytic waveforms with explicit time and vertical-axis units, showing segment boundaries and storage-state continuity.

第(1)问如上三式；第(2)问iL=(10−2.5e−106t)mA。τ=1μs。Part (1) is given by the three expressions above; part (2) is iL=(10−2.5e−106t)mA. τ=1μs.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把原15mA源留在换路后，也不能直接用3mH除2kΩ；等效电阻须从电感端完整看入。Remove the disconnected 15mA source after switching and find resistance from the inductor port, rather than using just one 2kΩ resistor.

受控电压源不是一只普通串联电阻A controlled voltage source is not an ordinary series resistor

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-22所示含受控源的电路原已处于稳态，t=0时刻控制系数r突然由10Ω变为5Ω，求t≥0+时的uC(t)。The dependent-source circuit in Fig. 5-22 is initially steady. At t=0, control coefficient r changes from 10Ω to 5Ω. Find uC(t) for t≥0.

20V源、10Ω及左正右负的ri受控电压源串联接电容上节点；5Ω与0.4F电容并联，控制电流i只通过5Ω向下。A20V source, 10Ω and a left-positive ri source feed the capacitor node. The 5Ω and 0.4F are parallel; control i is only the downward 5Ω resistor current.

本题图在书第143页／PDF第152页。The source figure is on printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
控制电流是uC5，而不是给电容充电的总输入电流。先按原r求初值，再按新r写KCL。The control current is uC5, not the total charging current. Find the initial state with old r, then write KCL with new r.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

原直流状态Original DC state

电容开路后整个串联通路电流为20(10+10+5)=0.8A。With the capacitor open at DC, current is 20(10+10+5)=0.8A.

uC(0+)=uC(0−)=4V

新r下直接写原拓扑方程Write the original-topology equation with new r

源支路电流由20−uC−r(uC5)除10得到。The source branch current is [20−uC−r(uC5)] divided by 10.

0.4duCdt+uC5=20−uC−5(uC5)10⇒duCdt+uC=5

测试源复核时间常数Cross-check τ with a port test

独立20V源置零、受控源保留。端口加1V，5Ω吸0.2A，左支路再吸0.2A，因此等效电阻2.5Ω。Zero the independent source and retain control. A1V port test draws 0.2A through 5Ω plus 0.2A through the left path, giving 2.5Ω.

Req=2.5Ω,τ=(0.4F)(2.5Ω)=1s,uC(t)=(5−e−t)V

解析式波形，时间与纵轴单位分别标明；分段边界和储能变量连续性可直接对照。Analytic waveforms with explicit time and vertical-axis units, showing segment boundaries and storage-state continuity.

uC(t)=(5−e−t)V，从4V升到5V，τ=1s。uC(t)=(5−e−t)V, rising from 4 to 5V with τ=1s.

易错点Common errors

  • 若把r当普通串联电阻，会错误算出τ=1.5s；该错误忽略了电容支路与控制支路电流不同。Treating r as a series resistor gives an incorrect 1.5s time constant because capacitor and control-branch currents differ.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第143页／PDF第152页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-27Assigned requirement: 5-27

理想电压源将RL与RC暂态分开An ideal voltage source separates RL and RC transients

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-23所示电路在开关S闭合前已经达到稳态，t=0时刻开关闭合，求开关闭合后的电流i(t)。The circuit in Fig. 5-23 reaches steady state before S closes at t=0. Find current i(t) after closing.

左支路为25V源上正下负，向上经5Ω、再经顶端0.5H电感到节点A。A经顶端10Ω到右节点B，B经竖直10Ω接地；B还经0.2F电容及上正下负40V源串联接地。S闭合后把A接到上正下负10V源上端，所求i(t)沿S和10V源向下。The left top-positive 25V source connects upward through 5Ω and then upper 0.5H to node A. A connects through upper 10Ω to B, which connects through vertical 10Ω to ground. Another B−to-ground branch contains a0.2F capacitor followed by a top-positive 40V source. Closing S connects A to the top of a top-positive 10V source. Requested i(t) flows down through S and that 10V source.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

直流稳态；电感电流、电容电压连续；分别求RL、RC响应；节点KCL。DC steady state, inductor-current and capacitor-voltage continuity, separate RL and RC responses and nodal KCL.
开关闭合后A被理想10V源固定为10V，使左右动态支路各自成为一阶电路。先分别求电感流入A的电流和A流向右侧的电流，再相减得到开关支路电流。After closing, the ideal 10V source fixes A at 10V, making the left and right dynamic branches independently first order. Find current entering A from the inductor and current leaving A to the right, then subtract.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求换路前的两个状态Find both pre-switch states

S打开稳态时电感短路、电容开路。25V通过5Ω、10Ω、10Ω串联，电流1A，故A=20V、B=10V。电容下端是40V，所以上正下负电容电压为−30V。With S open in steady state, short the inductor and open the capacitor. The 25V source drives 1A through series 5Ω, 10Ω and 10Ω, giving A=20V and B=10V. The capacitor lower terminal is at 40V, so its top-positive voltage is −30V.

iL(0+)=1A,uC(0+)=−30V,vB(0+)=10V

求左RL支路Solve the left RL branch

取电感电流由左向右流入A。换路后A=10V，25V与10V之差15V作用在5Ω、0.5H上。最终电流3A，时间常数0.1s。Reference inductor current leftward-to-right into A. With A=10V, 15V drives 5Ω and 0.5H. The final current is 3A and time constant 0.1s.

τL=0.55=0.1s,iL(t)=3−2e−10t(A)

求右RC节点电压Solve the right RC node voltage

稳态时B在两个10Ω间分得5V，初值10V；电容看入电阻10Ω∥10Ω=5Ω，时间常数5×0.2=1s。40V下端源为恒定值，所以B与电容电压具有相同时间常数。B approaches 5V from its 10V initial value through the two 10Ω resistors. The capacitor sees 10Ω∥10Ω=5Ω, giving τ=5×0.2=1s. Its lower terminal remains at 40V, so B and capacitor voltage share this time constant.

vB(t)=5+5e−t,iright(t)=10−vB10=0.5−0.5e−t

由节点KCL还原所求电流Recover the requested current by KCL

A点流入电感电流，流出右支路与向下i。因此所求i等于左电流减右电流。At A, inductor current enters, while right-branch current and downward i leave. Hence i is left current minus right current.

i(t)=iL−iright=2.5−2e−10t+0.5e−t(A),t≥0

i(t)=2.5−2e−10t+0.5e−tA，t≥0，按图向下为正。i(t)=2.5−2e−10t+0.5e−tA for t≥0, with downward positive.

易错点Common errors

  • 电容初始电压是10−40=−30V，不是节点B的10V。Initial capacitor voltage is 10−40=−30V, not B’s10V.
  • 所求i不是电感电流；必须扣除流向右侧的电流。The requested i is not the inductor current; subtract current going right.

核验依据Verification

独立原支路方程：0.5diLdt+5iL=15，和(B−10)10+B10+0.2d(B−40)dt=0，代入两个响应严格成立；节点A的i=iL−(10−B)10给出同式。初值i(0+)=1A、最终i(∞)=2.5A。另将所有电阻耗散、25V10V40V源吸收功率及电感电容储能变化率按指数系数精确相加，恒等于0。书第336页、PDF345页5-27一致。Independent branch equations are 0.5diLdt+5iL=15 and (B−10)10+B10+0.2d(B−40)dt=0. Both responses satisfy them exactly, and A−node KCL i=iL−(10−B)10 reproduces the result. Initial i(0+) is 1A and final i is 2.5A. An exact exponential-coefficient audit also sums all resistor losses, absorbed source powers and storage-energy rates to zero for every t. Answer 5-27 on printed p. 336 and PDF p. 345 agrees.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第143页／PDF第152页。范围状态：要求学习：5.4–5.9（初值与一阶响应）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152. Coverage: Required: §§5.4–5.9 (initial states and first-order responses).

开关闭合把两个储能支路分开Closing separates the two storage branches

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-24所示电路在开关S闭合前已达稳态，求开关闭合后流过开关的电流i(t)。The circuit in Fig. 5-24 is steady before S closes. Find the switch current afterward.

Us经L、R1到中点，中点经R2、C回地；开关将中点接地，i沿开关向下。Us feeds L and R1 to the midpoint, then R2 and C to ground. The switch grounds the midpoint, with i downward.

本题图在书第143页／PDF第152页。The source figure is on printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
原直流电流为零，电容充至Us。闭合后左侧RL建立电流，右侧RC放电，两者都流入开关。Initially DC current is zero and C is charged to Us. After closure, the left RL current builds while the right RC discharges; both enter the switch.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

分别保留初始储能Keep the two initial states

电感初流0，电容初压Us，闭合后两支路互不耦合。The initial inductor current is zero and capacitor voltage Us. The branches are uncoupled after closure.

iL(t)=UsR1(1−e−R1tL),uC(t)=Use−t(R2C)

开关节点相加Sum currents at the switch node

右侧电流从带正电的电容经R2流回中点，与左支路一起沿开关向下。The right current returns from the charged capacitor through R2 to the midpoint, adding to the left branch current.

i(t)=UsR1(1−e−R1tL)+UsR2e−t(R2C)

i(t)=UsR1(1−e−R1tL)+UsR2e−t(R2C)。i(t)=UsR1(1−e−R1tL)+UsR2e−t(R2C).

易错点Common errors

  • 两个指数均应衰减，附录第一项指数漏印负号，不能照抄成增长；开关电流可从0跳到UsR2，不能把电感连续性错误套给开关总电流。Both exponentials decay; the appendix omits the first exponent’s minus sign. Switch current can jump from zero to UsR2; inductor continuity does not apply to their sum.

核验依据Verification

5-29指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第143页／PDF第152页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-29Assigned requirement: 5-29

二次换路：第二段从实际换路值重新开始Two switching events: restart from the actual second-switch state

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-25所示电路中，开关S原来处于端钮1时，电路已经达到稳态，t=0时刻开关S从端钮1接到端钮2，t=2s时刻开关S又从端钮2接到端钮1，求t≥0时的u(t)。In Fig. 5-25, the circuit is initially in steady state with S at terminal 1. At t=0, S moves from 1 to 2; at t=2s, it returns from 2 to 1. Find u(t) for t≥0.

左5mA电流源向上注入节点A，A经顶端2kΩ到输出节点B。A另经2kΩ到开关端钮1；B另经1kΩ到端钮2，开关公共端接底部地。B经50μF电容再经上正下负3V源接地。电容电压uC上正下负，输出u从B到地上正下负，所以u=uC+3V。A5mA upward source injects node A. Upper 2kΩ joins A to output B. A also connects through 2kΩ to switch terminal 1; B through 1kΩ to terminal 2. The switch common is grounded. B connects to ground through a50μF capacitor followed by a top-positive 3V source. Capacitor voltage uC and output u are top-positive, with u=uC+3V.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

分段一阶响应；电容电压连续；每次换路重新求时间常数与最终值。Piecewise first-order responses, capacitor-voltage continuity and new final values and time constants at each switch.
输出u不是单独的电容电压，但3V恒定，所以它也连续。第二段必须从第一段在2s的实际值开始，并将时间原点移到2s。Output u is not the capacitor voltage alone, but its 3V offset is constant, so u is continuous too. Start the second segment from the actual first-segment value at 2s and shift its time origin to 2s.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

初始稳态Initial steady state

S在1时，电容开路，顶端2kΩ无电流，5mA全流过左竖直2kΩ，所以A、B均为10V。电容初始电压为10−3=7V。With S at 1 and the capacitor open in steady state, upper 2kΩ carries no current. All 5mA flows through the left vertical 2kΩ, giving A=B=10V. Initial capacitor voltage is 10−3=7V.

u(0−)=u(0+)=10V

第一段：S在2First segment: S at 2

此时左竖直2kΩ下端悬空，电流源通过顶端2kΩ向B送入5mA。最终u=5mA×1kΩ=5V。源置零开路后电容看到1kΩ，故τ1=0.05s。The left vertical 2kΩ ends open. The source sends 5mA through upper 2kΩ into B. Final u is 5mA×1kΩ=5V. Opening the zeroed current source leaves a1kΩ resistance seen by the capacitor, so τ1=0.05s.

u(t)=5+5e−20t(V),0≤t≤2

精确保留2s的状态Retain the exact state at 2s

两秒相当于40个时间常数，虽已极接近5V，严格初值仍为5+5e−40V。电容电压与输出在换路时都连续。Two seconds is 40 time constants, so u is extremely close to 5V, but exactly 5+5e−40V. Both capacitor voltage and output remain continuous at switching.

u(2+)=u(2−)=5+5e−40(V)

第二段：S回到1Second segment: S returns to 1

最终u回到10V。源置零后电容经顶端2kΩ和左竖直2kΩ串联放电，τ2=4kΩ×50μF=0.2s。以t−2为新时间变量，从精确换路值出发。The final output returns to 10V. After source suppression, the capacitor sees upper 2kΩ in series with left vertical 2kΩ, giving τ2=4kΩ×50μF=0.2s. Use t−2 and the exact switching value.

u(t)=10−5(1−e−40)e−5(t−2)(V),t>2

说明书后近似式Explain the appendix approximation

书后第二段写10−5e−5(t−2)V，相当于把e−40舍去。它在工程精度下足够准确，但这里保留小项以严格满足连续性。The appendix writes 10−5e−5(t−2)V for the second segment, dropping e−40. This is excellent numerically, but the retained term enforces exact continuity.

5e−40≈2.12×10−17V

0≤t≤2s：u=5+5e−20tV。 t>2s：u=10−5(1−e−40)e−5(t−2)V。 第二段可近似为书后答案10−5e−5(t−2)V。For 0≤t≤2s: u=5+5e−20tV. For t>2s: u=10−5(1−e−40)e−5(t−2)V. The appendix’s second segment, 10−5e−5(t−2)V, is the approximation dropping the tiny residual.

易错点Common errors

  • 第二段指数是t−2，不是t；时间常数从0.05s变为0.2s。The second exponent uses t−2, not t; the time constant changes from 0.05s to 0.2s.
  • 不能把输出u与电容电压uC混用；二者相差恒定3V。Do not confuse output u with capacitor voltage uC; they differ by a constant 3V.

核验依据Verification

独立原方程：第一段50μFdudt+u1000=5mA；第二段50μFdudt+(u−10)4000=0。两个分段式逐项代入残差均为0，2s左右极限均为5+5e−40V，最终u=10V。对应电容电压从7V趋向2V，再趋向7V。书第336页、PDF345页5-29第一段完全一致；第二段是舍去5e−40V残余的近似，相差最大约2.12×10−17V，并非第二次换路可令电容跳变。Independent equations: the first segment satisfies 50μFdudt+u1000=5mA; the second satisfies 50μFdudt+(u−10)4000=0. Both residuals vanish identically, both limits at 2s equal 5+5e−40V, and the final output is 10V. Capacitor voltage goes from 7V toward 2V, then toward 7V. Answer 5-29 on printed p. 336 and PDF p. 345 matches the first segment exactly; its second is the approximation dropping the residual 5e−40V, with maximum difference about 2.12×10−17V. Switching does not permit a capacitor-voltage jump.

第二次换路从第一段的实际末值接续Start the second switching stage at the actual first-stage endpoint

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图5-26所示，开关S1和S2分别处于断开和闭合状态，此时电路已达到稳态。t=0时S1闭合；经过1s后S1和S2同时断开，此后一直保持这一状态。试求0≤t≤1s和t>1s时的i(t)。In Fig. 5-26, S1 is initially open and S2 closed at steady state. S1 closes at t=0. After 1s both S1 and S2 open and remain open. Find i(t) on both time intervals.

左10V经2Ω到节点（3Ω接地），再经0.8Ω、S1到电感2H上端A；A有3Ω到地。A到B有9Ω及A→B的8A源并联，S2跨A、B，B以6Ω接地。The left 10V source feeds 2Ω, a node shunted by 3Ω, then 0.8Ω and S1 to node A above 2H. A has 3Ω to ground. Between A and B are 9Ω, an 8A source A→B and S2 in parallel. B has 6Ω to ground.

本题图在书第143页／PDF第152页。The source figure is on printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
每个开关区间重新求戴维南电路，电感电流在1s连续。第二段终值为负，不能丢掉8A源的方向。Recompute the Thevenin equivalent in each switch state and enforce current continuity at 1s. The second final current is negative.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

初态及第一段Initial state and first interval

原S2短路使右源局部循环，电感初流为0。S1闭合、S2仍闭合时，电感端Uth=3V、Rth=1Ω。Initially the right source circulates through S2 and i(0)=0. With both switches closed, the inductor sees Uth=3V, Rth=1Ω.

i(t)=3(1−e−t2)A(0≤t≤1s),i1=3(1−e−12)A

第二段的新等效New equivalent for the second interval

左侧已隔离。电流源置零后看入电阻为3Ω并联(9+6)Ω；原源方向使最终电感电流向上4.8A。The left network is disconnected. Zeroing the current source gives 3Ω in parallel with 15Ω. The source direction produces a final upward 4.8A current.

Rth=52Ω,τ=45s,i(∞)=−245A

用精确接续值写第二段Keep the exact joining value

时间必须改用t−1；不提前把指数幅值舍入为5.98。Use elapsed time t−1 and retain the exact amplitude rather than rounding it to 5.98.

i(t)=[−245+(245+3(1−e−12))e−5(t−1)4]A(t>1s)

解析式波形，时间与纵轴单位分别标明；分段边界和储能变量连续性可直接对照。Analytic waveforms with explicit time and vertical-axis units, showing segment boundaries and storage-state continuity.

第一段3(1−e−t2)A；第二段见上式。i(1)=1.180408A，之后连续下降并反向到−4.8A。First interval: 3(1−e−t2)A. The second expression above joins at i(1)=1.180408A, then falls continuously and reverses toward −4.8A.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把1s时电流当成第一段终值3A；若用附录舍入的5.98，会在接续处产生小的不连续。Do not replace i(1) by the first-stage asymptote 3A. The appendix’s rounded 5.98 creates a small artificial joining discontinuity.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第143页／PDF第152页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-31Assigned requirement: 5-31

阶跃波形：由跳变时刻与方向写函数Step waveforms: encode transition time and direction

题目原文Transcribed question

用单位阶跃函数表示题图5-27所示的3个电压波形。Express the three voltage waveforms in Fig. 5-27 using the unit-step function.

(a)u1在t<1s时为0，在t>1s时为5V；(b)u2在t<−1s时为0，在t>−1s时为5V；(c)u3在t<1s时为5V，在t>1s时为0。图中跳变点单点取值未指定。(a)u1 is 0 for t<1s and 5V for t>1s. (b)u2 is 0 for t<−1s and 5V for t>−1s. (c)u3 is 5V for t<1s and 0 for t>1s. Values exactly at the jumps are unspecified.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

单位阶跃ϵ(t)；平移；时间反向；下降阶跃。The unit step ϵ(t), time translation, time reversal and falling steps.
把“什么时候跳、跳多大、向上还是向下”分开判断。ϵ(t−t0)在t0后开启；ϵ(t0−t)在t0前开启。Identify when the jump occurs, its size and its direction separately. ϵ(t−t0) is on after t0; ϵ(t0−t) is on before t0.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) 延迟1s的上升阶跃(a) Rising step delayed by 1s

t−1在1s前为负、1s后为正，因此乘5V得到图(a)。t−1 is negative before 1s and positive afterward; multiplying by 5V gives waveform (a).

u1(t)=5ε(t−1)V

(b) 提前1s的上升阶跃(b) Rising step advanced by 1s

跳变在−1s，所以函数参数为t−(−1)=t+1。The jump is at −1s, so the argument is t−(−1)=t+1.

u2(t)=5ε(t+1)V

(c)1s后的下降阶跃(c) Falling step at 1s

在1s前应开启、之后关闭，因此使用反向参数1−t；也可写5[1−ϵ(t−1)]，但跳点取值须使用一致约定。It must be on before 1s and off afterward, so use 1−t. One can also write 5[1−ϵ(t−1)], with a consistent convention at the jump.

u3(t)=5ε(1−t)V

(a)5ϵ(t−1)V；(b)5ϵ(t+1)V；(c)5ϵ(1−t)V。(a)5ϵ(t−1)V; (b)5ϵ(t+1)V; (c)5ϵ(1−t)V.

易错点Common errors

  • 提前到−1s的阶跃是t+1，不是t−1。A step advanced to −1s uses t+1, not t−1.
  • 下降阶跃需要反向或相减，不能直接再用正的5ϵ(t−1)。A falling step requires reversal or subtraction, not another positive 5ϵ(t−1).

核验依据Verification

独立区间取值核验：在t=−2、0、2s代入三式，依次得到(0,0,5)、(0,5,5)、(5,5,0) V，与图的左右平台一致；跳变量分别+5、+5、−5V。图未规定跳点取值，采用同一ϵ(0)约定即可。书第336页、PDF345页5-31三式一致。Independent interval checks: at t=−2, 0 and 2s, the three expressions give (0,0,5), (0,5,5) and (5,5,0) V, matching the plotted plateaus. Jump sizes are +5, +5 and −5V. The graph does not specify point values at the jumps; use one consistent ϵ(0) convention. All three expressions match answer 5-31 on printed p. 336 and PDF p. 345.

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5−28(a)所示电路，iL(0−)=0.5A，is(t)的波形如题图5−28(b)所示。求0+≤t<1s和1s≤t<2s时的iR(t)并绘出其波形。In Fig. 5-28, iL(0−)=0.5A and is(t) is given in (b). Find and plot iR for 0≤t<1s and 1≤t<2s.

向上源与3Ω、3H并联，电阻和电感电流向下；is在0～1s为2A，1～2s为−1A。An upward current source is parallel with 3Ω and 3H, with both passive branch currents downward. is=2A on 0–1s and −1A on 1–2s.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

第一段First interval

LR=1s，电感从0.5A趋向2A。LR=1s and the inductor approaches 2A from 0.5A.

iL=2−1.5e−tA,iR=1.5e−tA(0≤t<1s)

第二段从连续电流开始Join with continuous inductor current

在1s保留iL=2−1.5e，新终值为−1A。At 1s retain iL=2−1.5e; the new final value is −1A.

iL=−1+(3−1.5e)e−(t−1)A

输出并画跳变Find the output and its jump

第二段电阻电流为负。精确幅值约−2.44818A，附录−2.45A为舍入。The second resistor current is negative. Its exact amplitude is about −2.44818A; the listed −2.45A is rounded.

iR=−(3−1.5e)e−(t−1)A(1≤t<2s)

解析式波形，时间与纵轴单位分别标明；分段边界和储能变量连续性可直接对照。Analytic waveforms with explicit time and vertical-axis units, showing segment boundaries and storage-state continuity.

iR=1.5e−tA（0～1s）；iR=−(3−1.5e)e−(t−1)A（1～2s）。iR=1.5e−tA on 0–1s, then iR=−(3−1.5e)e−(t−1)A on 1–2s.

输入经串联C到R上端，R接下端公共线，uo跨R；正矩形脉冲幅度U、周期T、宽度0.01T。Input passes through series C to R, with output across R. Positive rectangular pulses have amplitude U, period T and width 0.01T.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

T=5τ,d=0.05τ,duodt+uoτ=0between edges

给出零初始能量首脉冲示例Show the first pulse from zero initial energy

原题未给初始电容电压，图示首脉冲取零储能作为明确示例；不把它冒充唯一初始波形。No initial capacitor voltage is specified. The first-pulse illustration explicitly assumes zero initial energy.

uo={Ue−tτ0≤t<d−U(1−e−dτ)e−(t−d)τd≤t<T

长期周期波形Long-time periodic waveform

正脉冲顶只从约U降到0.951U，落沿后有约−0.049U尾巴；下一个脉冲前尾巴接近零。任意有限初态会逐周期衰减。The positive top falls only to about 0.951U, followed by an approximately −0.049U tail that nearly decays before the next rise. Finite initial-state effects decay each period.

a=e−0.05,b=e−4.95,uo,rise+=1−b1−abU,uo,fall+=a1−b1−abU−U

用脉宽和RL时间常数比较波形Compare pulse width with the RL time constant

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图5−30(a)所示，uin为题图5−30(b)所示的矩形脉冲。试针对下列3种情况，定性绘出i(t)和u(t)的波形：(1) T≫LR；(2) T=LR；(3) T≪LR。For the series−RL circuit and rectangular input in Fig. 5-30, sketch i(t) and inductor voltage u(t) for (1)T≫LR, (2)T=LR, and (3)T≪LR.

输入矩形脉冲幅度U，从0持续到T；R、L串联，i流入电感正端，u跨L上正。A pulse of amplitude U lasts from 0 to T across series R and L; i enters the positive inductor terminal and u is across L.

本题图在书第144页／PDF第153页。The source figure is on printed p. 144 · PDF p. 153.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
先用一个分段公式，再改变Tτ观察。图前输入为零并取已稳态的无初能电感；若另有初始电流需另加自然分量。Use one piecewise formula and vary Tτ. The plotted zero-before-pulse steady state has zero initial current; another initial current would add a natural component.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

脉冲内外统一表达One expression for both pulse intervals

τ=LR。电感电流在0与T连续，电感电压在两边沿可跳变。Let τ=LR. Current is continuous at both edges, while inductor voltage can jump.

i(t)={UR(1−e−tτ)0≤t<TUR(1−e−Tτ)e−(t−T)τt≥T

用KVL求电感电压Use KVL for inductor voltage

脉冲撤去后u=−Ri，所以出现负向尾巴。After pulse removal, u=−Ri, producing the negative tail.

u(t)={Ue−tτ0≤t<T−U(1−e−Tτ)e−(t−T)τt≥T

三种极限分别认图Recognize the three regimes

(1)电流充分接近UR，电压先降到近零，落沿跳到近−U；(2)脉冲末电流0.632UR，落沿电压从0.368U跳到−0.632U；(3)电流近似线性小幅上升，脉冲内电感电压近U，随后小负尾巴。(1) Current nearly reaches UR and voltage decays near zero before jumping near −U. (2) At T=τ, current is 0.632UR and voltage jumps from 0.368U to −0.632U. (3) Current rises almost linearly by a small amount, with voltage near U followed by a small negative tail.

T≪τ:i(T)≈UTL,u(T+)≈−UTτ

三种情形均由上述分段式确定，附图分别画Tτ=10、1、0.1的电流与电压归一化波形。The piecewise expressions cover all cases. The plot compares normalized current and voltage for Tτ=10, 1 and 0.1.

易错点Common errors

  • 脉冲结束时电感电流不能立即归零；电压负向尾巴对应磁能释放，不是符号错误。Inductor current cannot vanish instantly at pulse removal. Negative voltage represents release of magnetic energy.

跟随器隔离源电阻，输出按RC高通响应The follower isolates source resistance from the high-pass load

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图5-31所示电路中的电压ux(t)。设电容初始电压为零。Find ux(t) in Fig. 5-31 with zero initial capacitor voltage.

5ϵ(t)mA向上电流源与250Ω并联，接理想电压跟随器同相端；输出经0.5μF串联到200Ω上端，ux跨200Ω上正。An upward 5ϵ(t)mA source and parallel 250Ω feed an ideal voltage follower. Its output passes through 0.5μF to a200Ω grounded load, with ux top-positive.

本题图在书第144页／PDF第153页。The source figure is on printed p. 144 · PDF p. 153.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
先求高输入阻抗跟随器的输出阶跃，再求串联C、取R输出的高通响应。First find the unloaded follower step, then apply the series−C, resistor-output high-pass response.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

输入阶跃的单位核对Check the input-step units

理想运放输入不吸电流，因此5mA全部流过250Ω。The ideal input draws no current, so all 5mA flows through 250Ω.

ub(t)=(5mA)(250Ω)ε(t)=1.25ε(t)V

初终值与时间常数Determine endpoints and time constant

零初压电容使ux(0+)=1.25V；终态电容开路使ux∞=0。跟随器理想输出阻抗为零。The initially uncharged capacitor gives ux(0+)=1.25V, and the final open capacitor gives zero. The ideal follower has zero output resistance.

τ=(200Ω)(0.5μF)=100μs

输出并纠正附录单位Write the output and identify the appendix unit error

原图得伏特，不是毫伏。附录1.25e−104tϵ(t)mV的mV与原参数不相符。The original data give volts, not millivolts. The appendix prints mV, inconsistent with the source and resistance.

ux(t)=1.25e−104tε(t)V

解析式波形，时间与纵轴单位分别标明；分段边界和储能变量连续性可直接对照。Analytic waveforms with explicit time and vertical-axis units, showing segment boundaries and storage-state continuity.

ux(t)=1.25e−104tε(t)V。附录mV为单位差异，按原图应为V。ux(t)=1.25e−104tε(t)V. The appendix mV unit conflicts with the original data; V is required.

易错点Common errors

  • 250Ω在缓冲器输入侧，不计入输出RC时间常数；输出电容电压连续，但电阻电压可跳变。The input-side 250Ω does not enter the buffered output time constant. Capacitor voltage stays continuous while resistor voltage may jump.

串联反馈阻容产生比例项加积分项Series resistor-capacitor feedback adds proportional and integral terms

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-32所示电路，已知电容初始储能为零，us(t)=4e−2×104tε(t)V，求电压uo(t)。In Fig. 5-32 the capacitor initially stores zero energy and us(t)=4e−2×104tε(t)V. Find uo(t).

理想运放同相端接地，输入经10kΩ到反相端；反馈从反相端经1kΩ再经0.1μF串联到输出。The ideal op-amp non-inverting input is grounded. Input reaches the inverting node through 10kΩ; feedback is a series 1kΩ and 0.1μF path to the output.

本题图在书第144页／PDF第153页。The source figure is on printed p. 144 · PDF p. 153.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
理想负反馈使反相端虚地；反馈电流等于输入电流。反馈阻抗为电阻加电容，输出是比例项与积分项之和。Ideal feedback gives virtual ground. Feedback current equals input current, and the series impedance produces proportional plus integral terms.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由反馈电流推输出Derive output from feedback current

初始电容电压为零，电容电压从输入电流积分得到。The capacitor starts uncharged and its voltage follows the integral of input current.

uo(t)=−RfRinus(t)−1RinC∫0tus(ξ)dξ

代入指数并积分Insert and integrate the exponential

RfRin=0.1，1(RinC)=1000s−1，输入指数系数为20000s−1。The gain ratio is 0.1 and the integral coefficient 1000s−1; input decay rate is 20000s−1.

uo=−0.4e−20000t−0.2(1−e−20000t)=−0.2(1+e−20000t)V

检查初瞬及保持终值Check the initial jump and retained final voltage

初瞬电容等压短接伴随模型留下1kΩ反馈，输出−0.4V；积分后电容保留电荷，输入归零而输出停在−0.2V。Initially the zero-voltage capacitor leaves a1kΩ feedback path, giving −0.4V. Stored feedback charge retains −0.2V after input decays.

uo(0+)=−0.4V,uo(∞)=−0.2V

解析式波形，时间与纵轴单位分别标明；分段边界和储能变量连续性可直接对照。Analytic waveforms with explicit time and vertical-axis units, showing segment boundaries and storage-state continuity.

uo(t)=−0.2(1+e−2×104t)ε(t)V。uo(t)=−0.2(1+e−2×104t)ε(t)V.

易错点Common errors

  • 反馈中的R与C是串联，不能误用普通并联一阶低通；初始储能为零不要求运放输出在0+为零。Feedback R and C are in series, not parallel. Zero initial capacitor energy does not require zero op-amp output at 0+.
