继电器周期由两段阈值穿越时间相加Add the two threshold-crossing intervals for the relay period

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-33电路中，S表示一个电路继电器。假设电路已经处于S反复开关的稳定工作状态，若要使iL=0.9A时继电器开关闭合，iL=0.25A时继电器开关打开，试确定开关从闭合到打开、再从打开到闭合的时间周期T。In Fig. 5-33, S is a relay in stable repeated switching. It closes when iL reaches 0.9A and opens at 0.25A. Find the period from closing to opening and back to closing.

100V经30Ω到中点，中点经70Ω和111H电感接地；S闭合时中点经3Ω接地。iL向下。A100V source feeds 30Ω, then a node feeding 70Ω and 111H to ground. Closing S adds a3Ω shunt at the midpoint. iL is downward.

本题图在书第144页／PDF第153页。The source figure is on printed p. 144 · PDF p. 153.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

初始状态、动态元件连续性、KCL、KVL及理想元件模型。Initial state, storage-element continuity, KCL and KVL and ideal-element models.
不是一个固定拓扑的周期正弦。分别用闭合、打开两套终值与时间常数求阈值穿越时间，再相加。按理想无延迟继电器模型。This is a two-topology cycle. Compute each threshold-crossing interval using its own final value and τ, then add them, assuming an ideal delay-free relay.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

闭合段从0.9A降到0.25AClosed interval: decay from 0.9 to 0.25A

闭合时从电感看入，戴维南电压10011V，电阻70+30∥3=80011Ω。When closed, the inductor sees Uth=10011V and Rth=70+(30∥3)=80011Ω.

i∞,c=18A,τc=1800s,tc=1800ln0.9−0.1250.25−0.125=ln6.2800s

打开段从0.25A升到0.9AOpen interval: rise from 0.25 to 0.9A

打开后30Ω与70Ω串联，终值1A，τ=11100s。When open, the 30Ω and 70Ω are in series, giving final current 1A and τ=11100s.

to=11100ln1−0.251−0.9=ln7.51100s

求完整周期Sum for the complete period

每段都从上一个阈值起算，连续达到另一个阈值，形成稳定往复。Each interval starts at the preceding threshold and reaches the next continuously.

T=tc+to=ln6.2800+ln7.51100s≈4.112417ms

解析式波形，时间与纵轴单位分别标明；分段边界和储能变量连续性可直接对照。Analytic waveforms with explicit time and vertical-axis units, showing segment boundaries and storage-state continuity.

T=ln6.2800+ln7.51100s≈4.11ms。T=ln6.2800+ln7.51100s≈4.11ms.

易错点Common errors

  • 闭合时3Ω是中点对地的分流支路，不能与30Ω、70Ω全串联；两个区间的τ不同。The 3Ω branch shunts the midpoint when closed; it is not in series with both other resistors. The two intervals have different time constants.

7-1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第186页／PDF第195页。范围状态：要求学习：7.1–7.5（正弦量、相量及电路分析）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 186 · PDF p. 195. Coverage: Required: §§7.1–7.5 (sinusoids, phasors and circuit analysis).

正弦先转余弦，再读初相角Convert sine to cosine before reading phase

题目原文Transcribed question

求下列正弦电流的幅值、有效值和初相角：(1) i(t)=10sin(ωt+10∘)A；(2) i(t)=cos(2t+60∘)A。Find peak, RMS and initial phase: (1) i(t)=10sin(ωt+10∘)A; (2) i(t)=cos(2t+60∘)A.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
本教材7.1明确采用余弦形式，正弦初相角须减90°；有效值是幅值除根号2。Section 7.1 uses cosine. Subtract 90° from a sine phase; divide peak by √2 for RMS.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

第(1)问统一余弦基准Part (1): adopt cosine

sinθ=cos(θ−90°)，因此不是10°而是−80°。Use sinθ=cos(θ−90°), giving −80°.

i=10cos(ωt−80∘)A,Im=10A,I=52A≈7.07107A,ϕ=−80∘

第(2)问直接读数Part (2): read directly

余弦幅值为1A，不是零；2t给角频率2 rads。The cosine peak is 1A and angular frequency is 2 rads.

Im=1A,I=12A≈0.707107A,ϕ=60∘

第(1)问10A、52A、−80°；第(2)问1A、12A、60°，均用余弦初相角。Part (1): 10A, 52A, −80°. Part (2): 1A, 12A, 60°. Phases use cosine.

易错点Common errors

  • 相位必须先统一函数基准；峰值与有效值不能混用。独立周期采样和时域重构均通过。Unify sine and cosine convention before comparing phase. Peak and RMS are different; cycle sampling and time reconstruction verify both.

核验依据Verification

独立用时域重构、周期采样有效值、原图节点、回路方程或复功率核验；舍入条件与参数限制单独列明。Independently checked using time reconstruction, sampled cycle RMS, original-topology equations or complex power, with precision and parameter limits stated explicitly.

7-2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第186页／PDF第195页。范围状态：要求学习：7.1–7.5（正弦量、相量及电路分析）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 186 · PDF p. 195. Coverage: Required: §§7.1–7.5 (sinusoids, phasors and circuit analysis).

从给定角频率保留周期精度Retain period precision from the stated angular frequency

题目原文Transcribed question

已知正弦电压u=100sin(628t−30∘)V，试求该正弦电压的幅值、有效值、角频率、周期和初相角。Given u=100sin(628t−30∘)V, find peak, RMS, angular frequency, period and initial phase.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
先转为cos(628t−120°)。628并非严格的200π，周期应先写2π628再近似。Convert to cos(628t−120°). Since 628 is not exactly 200π, retain 2π628 before rounding.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

幅值、有效值与初相角Peak, RMS and phase

正弦到余弦减90°。Subtract 90° for the cosine convention.

Um=100V,U=502V≈70.7107V,ϕ=−120∘

角频率和周期Angular frequency and period

角频率单位rads，周期单位s。附录0.01s为近似。Use rads and s. The appendix 0.01s is rounded.

ω=628rads,T=2π628s≈0.0100051s

幅值100V，有效值502V，ω=628 rads，T=2π628s≈10.0051ms，余弦初相−120°。Peak 100V; RMS 502V; ω=628 rads; T=2π628s≈10.0051ms; cosine phase −120°.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要把角频率628直接当Hz；T≈0.01s不应写成由628严格算得0.01s。628 is angular frequency, not Hz. The 0.01s period is an approximation.

峰值和角频率给出精确的有效值与频率Compute RMS and frequency from the supplied peak and angular frequency

题目原文Transcribed question

已知正弦电流i=141.4cos(314t+30∘)A，试求该正弦电流的幅值、有效值、角频率和初相角。Given i=141.4cos(314t+30∘)A, find peak, RMS, angular frequency and initial phase.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

逐项识别Identify each quantity

保留题设数值，先写精确代数式再取近似。Retain the supplied numbers before rounding.

Im=141.4A,I=141.42A≈99.9849A,ω=314rads,ϕ=30∘

附带换算频率Also convert to frequency

附录列50Hz，对应314(2π)的近似；题干要求角频率，答案不能只报Hz。The listed 50Hz approximates 314(2π). The requested angular frequency must also be given.

f=3142πHz≈49.9747Hz

幅值141.4A；有效值141.42A≈100A；角频率314 rads；初相30°。Peak 141.4A; RMS 141.42A≈100A; angular frequency 314 rads; phase 30°.

第一次过零先确定最近的相位Find the first zero by its nearest future phase

题目原文Transcribed question

已知某正弦电流i=Imcos(ωt+π3)A，当t=13ms时电流波形第一次过零点，试求该正弦电流的频率和周期。A current i=Imcos(ωt+π3)A first crosses zero at t=13ms. Find frequency and period.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
初相π3位于正余弦段，ω>0时最近过零是π2；不能随便取3π2。Starting at π3 with ω>0, the nearest zero is π2, not 3π2.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

用第一次约束消除多周期Use the first-zero condition

假设幅值非零、角频率为正；从π3前进π6到第一次零点。Assume nonzero amplitude and positive ω. The first zero requires a phase advance of π6.

ω(13000s)+π3=π2⇒ω=500πrads

换算频率和周期Convert to frequency and period

以秒换算13ms，避免千倍误差。Convert 13ms to seconds.

f=ω2π=250Hz,T=1f=0.004s=4ms

f=250Hz，T=4ms。f=250Hz and T=4ms.

易错点Common errors

  • 若不使用“第一次”，会出现多个相位分支；毫秒必须换算。Ignoring “first” creates multiple branches; keep the millisecond conversion.

比较相位前统一正弦余弦Use the same trigonometric convention before comparing phase

题目原文Transcribed question

若正弦电压u1=60sin(ωt−30∘)V,u2=10cosωtV，试判断两者的相位关系。For u1=60sin(ωt−30∘)V and u2=10cosωtV, determine their phase relation.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
两者同频，幅值不影响相位关系；先把u1改成余弦。They have the same frequency and amplitude does not affect phase relation. Convert u1 to cosine.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一基准求差Convert and subtract phases

u1余弦初相−120°，u2为0°。u1 has cosine phase −120° and u2 phase 0°.

u1=60cos(ωt−120∘)V,ϕ2−ϕ1=120∘

u2超前u1120°，等价地u1滞后u2120°。u2 leads u1 by 120°, equivalently u1 lags u2 by 120°.

易错点Common errors

  • 直接拿−30°与0°相减会错90°。Directly comparing −30° with 0° introduces a90° error.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第186页／PDF第195页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 186 · PDF p. 195. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-6Assigned requirement: 7-6

有效值相量：先统一余弦形式，再除以√2RMS phasors: convert to cosine, then divide by √2

题目原文Transcribed question

写出下列正弦量的有效值相量。 (1)u1(t)=cosωt；(2)u2(t)=−sinωt；(3)u3(t)=−cosωt；(4)u4(t)=sinωt。Write the RMS phasors of the following sinusoidal quantities: (1)u1(t)=cosωt; (2)u2(t)=−sinωt; (3)u3(t)=−cosωt; (4)u4(t)=sinωt.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准有效值相量；正弦与余弦相差90°；负号等价于180°相移。Cosine-reference RMS phasors, the 90° sine and cosine shift and the 180° phase reversal for a negative sign.
本书采用余弦基准。每个波形幅值为1，故有效值均为12。相量的相角必须从化为正幅值余弦后的初相角读取。The book uses a cosine reference. All amplitudes are 1, so every RMS magnitude is 12. Read the phase after converting to a positive-amplitude cosine.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一变换规则Use one consistent conversion rule

若u=Umcos(ωt+ϕ)，有效值相量为(Um2)∠ϕ。不要把相量幅值仍写成原波形的峰值。For u=Umcos(ωt+ϕ), the RMS phasor is (Um2)∠ϕ. Do not retain the waveform’s peak magnitude in an RMS phasor.

u=Umcos(ωt+φ) ⟺ U˙=Um2∠φ

(1)、(3)处理余弦及负号(1), (3): cosine and its negative

cosωt的相角为0°；−cosωt=cos(ωt+180°)。负号进入相角，有效值大小保持非负。cosωt has phase 0°. Also −cosωt=cos(ωt+180°). Move the negative sign into the phase and keep the RMS magnitude nonnegative.

U˙1=12∠0∘,U˙3=12∠180∘

(2)、(4)处理正弦(2), (4): sine waveforms

−sinωt=cos(ωt+90°)，sinωt=cos(ωt−90°)。所以负正弦对应+90°，正正弦对应−90°。−sinωt=cos(ωt+90°) and sinωt=cos(ωt−90°). Thus negative sine gives +90° and positive sine gives −90°.

U˙2=12∠90∘,U˙4=12∠(−90∘)

(1)(12)∠0°V；(2)(12)∠90°V；(3)(12)∠180°V；(4)(12)∠−90°V。12≈0.707。(1)(12)∠0°V; (2)(12)∠90°V; (3)(12)∠180°V; (4)(12)∠−90°V, with 12≈0.707.

易错点Common errors

  • 使用余弦基准时sinωt对应−90°，不是+90°。Under a cosine reference, sinωt has phase −90°, not +90°.
  • 有效值相量的模为12，不是1。An RMS phasor has magnitude 12 here, not 1.

核验依据Verification

独立逆变换核验：将四个相量分别代入u(t)=2Re{U˙eʲωt}，还原为cosωt、−sinωt、−cosωt、sinωt；多组时间点数值核验相符。各相量模平方均为12，与单位幅值正弦波的周期均方值相同。书第337页、PDF346页7-6给出的0.707及四个相角一致。Independent inverse-transform check: u(t)=2ReU˙ejωt reconstructs cosωt, −sinωt, −cosωt and sinωt. Numerical checks at multiple times agree. Every squared magnitude is 12, the cycle mean-square value of a unit-amplitude sinusoid. The 0.707 magnitudes and all four angles match answer 7-6 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346.

边界KCL不需要内部RLC参数Boundary KCL does not require the internal RLC values

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-1所示为某正弦交流电路的一部分，已知i1=32cos(ωt+45∘)A,i2=42cos(ωt−45∘)A，试求i3。For the network portion in Fig. 7-1, i1=32cos(ωt+45∘)A and i2=42cos(ωt−45∘)A. Find i3.

R、L、C组成三角网络，i1、i2从左两端输入，i3从右端流出。RLC form a triangle; i1 and i2 enter at the left terminals and i3 exits at the right.

本题图在书第187页／PDF第196页。The source figure is on printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
两输入箭头流入、i3流出整个网络，因此i3=i1+i2。峰值带√2，转相量后模为3和4A。Both input arrows enter and i3 leaves the region, so i3=i1+i2. The √2 peak factors give RMS magnitudes 3 and 4A.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先矩形式相加Add rectangular phasors

不用把R、L、C内部支路全部求出。Internal RLC branch solutions are unnecessary.

I˙3=3∠45∘+4∠(−45∘)=72−j12A

还原时域Reconstruct the time waveform

相量模为5A，相角−arctan(17)。还原峰值需再乘√2。The phasor magnitude is 5A and angle −arctan(17); multiply by √2 to recover peak.

i3(t)=52cos(ωt−8.13010∘)A

i3=52cos(ωt−8.13010∘)A。i3=52cos(ωt−8.13010∘)A.

易错点Common errors

  • 3+4不是总有效值7A，因为两输入相差90°。The RMS result is not 3+4=7A because the inputs differ by 90°.

按下标顺序写电压差Use voltage subscripts as ordered potential differences

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-2所示正弦交流电路中，已知U˙AD=U˙AB=−j10V,U˙BC=10∠0∘V，求U˙DC。In Fig. 7-2, U˙AD=U˙AB=−j10V and U˙BC=10∠0∘V. Find U˙DC.

电阻支路沿A→B→C→D成U形，四节点端点标明。Resistor branches follow the U−shaped path A→B→C→D.

本题图在书第187页／PDF第196页。The source figure is on printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
沿D→A→B→C串起电压；UDA=−UAD。Follow the path D→A→B→C and use UDA=−UAD.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

路径电压相加Sum along a path

UAD与UAB相等，意味着D、B等电位。Equal UAD and UAB mean D and B have the same potential.

U˙DC=−U˙AD+U˙AB+U˙BC=10∠0∘V

U˙DC=10∠0∘V。U˙DC=10∠0∘V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把UAD直接作为D到A电压相加，否则会多出−j20V。Do not use UAD as D−to−A voltage or an extra −j20V appears.

并联支路箭头相反，要先处理负号Opposite branch references require a sign change

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-3所示为某正弦交流电路的一部分，已知I˙R=2∠(−π3)A，求I˙L。For Fig. 7-3, I˙R=2∠(−π3)A. Find I˙L.

10Ω和j5Ω并联，IR向左、IL向右。Parallel 10Ω and j5Ω branches have IR leftward and IL rightward.

本题图在书第187页／PDF第196页。The source figure is on printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
电阻箭头右→左、电感箭头左→右。两支路共享端压，但iR不是左正右负端压的关联电流。The resistor current points right-to-left and inductor current left-to-right, so only the latter follows a left-positive port reference.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

同一左正端压写两支路Use one left-positive voltage for both branches

10Ω电阻电流取反，j5Ω电感按关联方向。Reverse the resistor reference before applying branch laws.

U˙left,right=−10I˙R=j5I˙L⇒I˙L=2jI˙R

乘j增加90°Multiplication by j adds 90°

初相−60°加90°得30°，幅值翻倍。−60°+90°=30°, and magnitude doubles.

I˙L=4∠30∘A

I˙L=4∠30∘A。I˙L=4∠30∘A.

  • 若忽略电阻反向箭头，会把答案相位错180°。Ignoring the reversed resistor arrow shifts the result by 180°.

总有效值是相量模，不是支路模的代数和Total RMS is a phasor magnitude, not a scalar sum

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-4所示正弦交流电路中，已知电流有效值分别为I=5A,IR=5A,IL=3A，求IC。若I=5A,IR=4A,IL=3A，此时IC又为多少？For Fig. 7-4, find IC given RMS currents I=5A, IR=5A, IL=3A. Then find it for I=5A, IR=4A, IL=3A.

R、L、C并联，输入I分成三个向下的支路电流。Parallel RLC share the voltage, with total I splitting into three downward branch currents.

本题图在书第187页／PDF第196页。The source figure is on printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
以共同电压为0°，电阻电流为实部，电容、电感电流分别为+jIC和−jIL。With voltage phase zero, resistor current is real, capacitor current +jIC and inductor current −jIL.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

用正交关系求第一组Use orthogonality for the first set

总模平方等于实部平方加虚部平方。第一组虚部必须为零。Magnitude squared equals the sum of real and imaginary squares. The first set requires zero net imaginary current.

I2=IR2+(IC−IL)2⇒IC=3A

第二组排除退化根Exclude the degenerate second-set root

第二组给|IC−3|=3。形式根0和6A；图示实际电容在非零端压、非零频率下电流非零，因此取6A。0A对应C=0的退化支路。The second set gives |IC−3|=3, with formal roots 0 and 6A. A finite nonzero capacitor at nonzero frequency and voltage has nonzero current, so use 6A; zero corresponds to a degenerate absent capacitance.

IC=6A

第一组IC=3A；第二组在图示非零电容条件下IC=6A。IC=3A for the first set and 6A for the second with the drawn nonzero capacitor.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能用IC=I−IR+IL直接计算有效值；分支平方根须结合元件条件。Do not add RMS magnitudes as signed scalars. Resolve square-root branches using component conditions.

核验依据Verification

给定相角有舍入，先检查实部KCLCheck real-part KCL when a phase angle is rounded

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-5所示正弦交流电路中，已知U˙=12∠0∘V,I˙=5∠(−36.9∘)A,R=3Ω，求I˙L及ωL。For Fig. 7-5, U˙=12∠0∘V, I˙=5∠(−36.9∘)A and R=3Ω. Find IL and ωL.

3Ω与jωL并联，电压上正，总I流入，电感电流向下。3Ω and jωL are parallel under a top-positive voltage; total I enters and IL points downward.

本题图在书第187页／PDF第196页。The source figure is on printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
电阻支路固定4A实部，纯电感支路只能提供虚部。36.9°是常用36.8699°的舍入，严格给值有微小实部不一致。The resistor fixes the real current at 4A and the pure inductor contributes only imaginary current. 36.9° is rounded from 36.8699°; literal data have a small real-part mismatch.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先求电阻并量化舍入Compute resistor current and quantify rounding

5cos36.9°≈3.99842A，与4A差约0.00158A，不能宣称所有十进制数据严格一致。5cos36.9°≈3.99842A, differing from 4A by about 0.00158A; the decimal data are not exactly consistent.

I˙R=123=4A,ϕconsistent=−arccos45≈−36.8699∘

按给定精度取相容相量Use the consistent phasor at the stated precision

把36.9°按舍入值理解，得到总电流4−j3A，再求电感支路。Interpreting 36.9° as rounded gives I=4−j3A.

I˙L=−j3A,jωL=12−j3=j4Ω⇒ωL=4Ω

按相角舍入精度，IL≈−j3A，ωL≈4Ω；若36.9°视为数学精确值，原图理想R∥L条件无严格同时解。At the angle’s stated precision, IL≈−j3A and ωL≈4Ω. Literal exact 36.9° data have no simultaneous ideal R∥L solution.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把复数差中约−0.00158A的实部称为纯电感电流；应明确这是舍入残差。A small real residual must not be described as ideal-inductor current; identify it as rounding.

7-12指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第187页／PDF第196页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-12Assigned requirement: 7-12

并联RC电流正交：有效值用勾股关系Orthogonal parallel−RC currents: use the RMS right triangle

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-6所示正弦交流电路中，已知I=10A，I2=6A，求电流I1。For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-6, I=10A and I2=6A are RMS magnitudes. Find I1.

输入电流I向右，经串联jωL后进入并联电容与电阻R。电容阻抗−j(ωC)，支路电流I1向下；电阻支路电流I2向下。下方为公共返回线。Input current I goes right through series jωL, then splits into parallel capacitor and resistor R. The capacitor impedance is −j(ωC), with I1 downward. The resistor branch has I2 downward. The bottom is the common return.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

相量KCL；并联共电压；电容电流超前电压90°，电阻电流同相。Phasor KCL, common parallel voltage, capacitor current leading by 90° and in-phase resistor current.
电容支路和电阻支路共有电压，两个电流相差90°。因此10A不是两个支路有效值的算术和，必须对正交相量求模。The capacitor and resistor share a voltage, so their currents are 90° apart. The 10A total is not the arithmetic sum of branch RMS magnitudes; take the magnitude of orthogonal phasors.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

选择方便的相位基准Choose a convenient phase reference

取并联两端电压为0°基准。电阻电流I2=6∠0°A，电容电流I1=jI1。上游串联电感不改变这两个并联支路电流之间的90°关系。Choose the parallel voltage as the 0° reference. The resistor current is 6∠0°A and capacitor current is jI1. The upstream series inductor does not change the 90° relation between the two parallel currents.

I˙2=6,I˙1=jI1,I˙=6+jI1

用总电流的模求支路有效值Use the total magnitude to recover the branch RMS value

相量实部、虚部正交，所以总电流有效值平方为两支路平方和。Real and imaginary components are orthogonal, so the squared total RMS magnitude is the sum of the squared branch magnitudes.

102=62+I12⇒I1=100−36=8A

区分相对相角与绝对相角Distinguish relative and absolute phase

在所选并联电压基准下，可写I˙1=j8A、I˙=6+j8A。题目未提供全电路的绝对相位，确定的数值答案是I1的有效值8A。Relative to the chosen parallel-voltage reference, I˙1=j8A and I˙=6+j8A. The problem gives no overall absolute phase; the determined numerical answer is the RMS magnitude I1=8A.

I˙=10∠53.13∘(relative to the parallel voltage)

I1=8A（有效值）。取并联电压为0°时，I˙1=8∠90°A。I1=8A RMS. With parallel voltage chosen as 0°, I˙1=8∠90°A.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能写I1=10−6=4A；只有相量而非模满足直接相加。Do not write I1=10−6=4A; phasors, not their magnitudes, add directly.
  • 题目未给绝对相位，不能把自选参考角当作已知绝对相角。Do not present a chosen reference phase as an externally given absolute phase.

核验依据Verification

独立复数核验：6+j8的模为√(36+64)=10，电阻与电容电流的均方交叉项2Re6·(j8)*=0，所以总均方值为100A2。相量KCL与周期均方关系独立吻合。书第337页、PDF346页7-12为8A。Independent complex check: |6+j8|=36+64=10. The RMS cross term is 2Re6·(j8)*=0, so the total mean square is 100A2. Phasor KCL and the cycle mean-square relation agree independently. Answer 7-12 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346 is 8A.

LC两支路电流反相相减Subtract the opposing LC branch currents

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-7所示正弦交流电路中，已知I1=4A、I2=3A，求电流I。In Fig. 7-7, I1=4A and I2=3A are RMS values. Find I.

串联R后分成jωL和−j(ωC)两并联支路。Series R feeds parallel inductive and capacitive branches.

本题图在书第187页／PDF第196页。The source figure is on printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

R后面L、C并联，I1是感性支路、I2是容性支路，二者相差180°。After series R, L and C are parallel. Their branch currents oppose by 180°.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

选并联电压作相位参考Use the shared voltage as phase reference

感性电流−j4，容性电流+j3，求和后取模。Inductive current is −j4 and capacitive current +j3.

I˙=−j4+j3=−j1A,I=1A

总电流有效值I=1A，方向相位与感性支路一致。Total RMS current is 1A, with the inductive branch phase.

易错点Common errors

  • 此处不是正交4与3，不能用勾股算5A；两支路为反相。These currents oppose rather than form perpendicular components, so the result is not 5A.

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图7-8所示单口网络的导纳Y。Find the admittance Y of the one-port in Fig. 7-8.

5Ω电阻与j5Ω电抗串联接端口。A5Ω resistor and j5Ω reactance are in series at the port.

本题图在书第187页／PDF第196页。The source figure is on printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

5Ω与j5Ω串联，总阻抗5+j5Ω。The 5Ω and j5Ω are in series, giving 5+j5Ω.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

乘共轭有理化Rationalize using the conjugate

阻抗感性虚部为正，导纳感性虚部为负。Inductive impedance has positive imaginary part; inductive admittance has negative imaginary part.

Y=15+j5=5−j550=0.1−j0.1S

Y=(0.1−j0.1)S。Y=(0.1−j0.1)S.

易错点Common errors

  • 串联导纳不能直接相加；单位为S，不是Ω。Do not add series admittances; the unit is S.

RL串联阻抗虚部为正A series−RL impedance has positive imaginary part

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-9所示RL串联电路中，已知R=1Ω,L=1H,ω=1rads，求该电路的阻抗Z。For the series−RL circuit in Fig. 7-9, R=1Ω, L=1H and ω=1 rads. Find Z.

R与L串联。R and L are in series.

本题图在书第187页／PDF第196页。The source figure is on printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
先求ωL=1Ω，串联相加，再按需转极坐标。Find ωL=1Ω, add series impedances and optionally convert to polar form.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

矩形式与极形式Rectangular and polar forms

实部和虚部同为1，模√2、相位45°。Equal real and imaginary parts give magnitude √2 and phase 45°.

Z=R+jωL=1+j=2∠45∘Ω

Z=(1+j)Ω=2∠45∘Ω。Z=(1+j)Ω=2∠45∘Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 电感阻抗是jωL，不能漏j而变成普通2Ω电阻。Do not omit j and turn the circuit into a real 2Ω resistance.

低频高频分别替换储能元件Reduce storage elements in the low- and high-frequency limits

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图7-10所示电路分别在ω=0和ω=∞时的阻抗Zab。Find Zab in Fig. 7-10 at ω=0 and in the limit ω→∞.

a到中点为10kΩ与10μF并联，中点到b为40mH与40kΩ并联。10kΩ and 10μF parallel between a and midpoint; 40mH and 40kΩ parallel from midpoint to b.

本题图在书第187页／PDF第196页。The source figure is on printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
上半段10kΩ∥10μF，下半段40mH∥40kΩ，两半段串联。The upper 10kΩ∥10μF and lower 40mH∥40kΩ groups are in series.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

零频极限Zero-frequency limit

C开路、L短路，上段保留10kΩ，下段为零。C opens and L shorts, leaving 10kΩ above and zero below.

Zab(0)=10kΩ

无穷频率极限Infinite-frequency limit

C短路、L开路，上段零，下段保留40kΩ。C shorts and L opens, leaving zero above and 40kΩ below.

limω→∞Zab=40kΩ

Zab(0)=10kΩ，高频极限40kΩ。Zab(0)=10kΩ and the high-frequency limit is 40kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • 先认清两组是串联，而不是把四个元件全部并联；∞频率表示极限。Identify the two series groups rather than putting all four components in parallel. Infinite frequency denotes a limit.

7-17指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第187页／PDF第196页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-17Assigned requirement: 7-17

串联未知元件：相量相减后求阻抗An unknown series element: subtract phasor voltages, then divide

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-11所示正弦交流电路中，已知U˙=10∠53.1°V，U˙1=6∠0°V，求I˙、U˙2及未知元件的复阻抗Z2，并说明该元件是什么元件。For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-11, U˙=10∠53.1°V and U˙1=6∠0°V. Find I˙, U˙2 and the unknown element impedance Z2, and identify the element.

左电压源U˙上正下负，串联上方3Ω电阻与右侧Z2。电流I˙顺时针；电阻电压U˙1左正右负，Z2电压U˙2上正下负，均为关联参考方向。The left source U˙ is positive at the top and drives series upper 3Ω and right Z2. Current I˙ is clockwise. U˙1 across 3Ω is positive on the left; U˙2 across Z2 is positive at the top. Both use passive references.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量；串联KVL；矩形式复数相减；阻抗虚部判别。RMS phasors, series KVL, rectangular complex subtraction and impedance classification by reactance.
电阻电压先给出电流相量。再把总电压化为矩形式与6V相减，最后除以电流。给定53.1°是6−8−10三角形角度53.130…°的一位小数近似。The resistor voltage directly gives the current phasor. Convert total voltage to rectangular form, subtract 6V, then divide by the current. The given 53.1° is the one-decimal approximation to the 6−8−10 triangle angle 53.130…°.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由电阻电压求电流Find current from the resistor voltage

3Ω为纯电阻，电流与U˙1同相，大小为63。The 3Ω resistor gives current in phase with U˙1 and magnitude 63.

I˙=U˙13=2∠0∘A

矩形式做KVL相减Use rectangular KVL subtraction

按题目相角精度，10∠53.1°≈6+j8V。因此U˙2≈(6+j8)−6=j8V；不是10−6=4V。To the precision of the given angle, 10∠53.1°≈6+j8V. Thus U˙2≈(6+j8)−6=j8V, not the scalar difference 10−6=4V.

U˙2=U˙−U˙1≈j8=8∠90∘V

求阻抗并识别元件Find impedance and identify the element

U˙2除以I˙得到正的纯虚阻抗，按本题精度为电感元件，感抗ωL≈4Ω；题目未给ω，不能单独求L数值。Dividing U˙2 by I˙ gives a positive imaginary impedance. To the problem’s precision it is an inductor with ωL≈4Ω. No numerical L can be found without ω.

Z2=U˙2I˙≈j4Ω,L≈4ωH

保留题目角度舍入的含义Respect the rounded input angle

若把53.1°当作完全精确数，计算得到U˙2≈0.004202+j7.996847V，Z2≈0.002101+j3.998423Ω。其极小实部来自给定角度舍入；教材标准答案j4Ω对应理想6−8−10关系。If 53.1° is treated as mathematically exact, U˙2≈0.004202+j7.996847V and Z2≈0.002101+j3.998423Ω. The tiny real part results from the rounded input angle; the textbook j4Ω answer uses the ideal 6−8−10 relation.

I˙=2∠0°A；U˙2≈8∠90°V；Z2≈j4Ω，为电感元件（按题目相角精度）。I˙=2∠0°A; U˙2≈8∠90°V; Z2≈j4Ω, an inductor to the stated phase precision.

易错点Common errors

  • 相量减法应先化矩形式，不能直接相减电压有效值。Convert to rectangular form for subtraction; do not subtract RMS magnitudes directly.
  • 纯虚阻抗j4Ω不等于电感4H；还需角频率。Reactance j4Ω does not mean an inductance of 4H; angular frequency is also required.

核验依据Verification

独立回代：I˙(3+j4)=2(3+j4)=6+j8，其模为10V、相角arctan(86)=53.130102…°，按一位小数正好53.1°。复功率为U˙I˙*=12+j16VA，3Ω消耗12W，电感吸收无功16var，功率一致。同时保留按53.1°字面计算的微小实部以避免伪称完全精确。书第337页、PDF346页7-17的2∠0°、8∠90°、j4Ω与此精度解释一致。Independent substitution: I˙(3+j4)=2(3+j4)=6+j8, with magnitude 10V and angle arctan(86)=53.130102…°, rounding to 53.1°. Complex power is U˙I˙*=12+j16VA: 3Ω consumes 12W and the inductor absorbs 16var. The tiny real part obtained from a literal 53.1° calculation is retained explicitly rather than claiming exact equality. Answer 7-17 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346 gives 2∠0°, 8∠90° and j4Ω, consistent with this precision.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第187页／PDF第196页。范围状态：要求学习：7.1–7.5（正弦量、相量及电路分析）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196. Coverage: Required: §§7.1–7.5 (sinusoids, phasors and circuit analysis).

输出电感超前角由总阻抗相位决定The inductor-output lead depends on total impedance phase

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-12所示RLC串联电路中，已知角频率ω=103rads，电容C可调。欲使u2超前u1 36.9°，则C应取何值？In the series−RLC circuit in Fig. 7-12, ω=1000 rads and C is adjustable. Find C so the inductor voltage u2 leads the input u1 by 36.9°.

60Ω、0.1H和可调C串联，输入u1跨全回路，输出u2只跨0.1H。60Ω, 0.1H and adjustable C are in series; u1 spans the loop and u2 only the inductor.

本题图在书第188页／PDF第197页。The source figure is on printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
原图R=60Ω、L=0.1H，输出只跨电感，因此相对电流超前90°。The original R=60Ω and L=0.1H; output is across the inductor, leading current by 90°.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由电压相位转阻抗角Convert the phase requirement to impedance angle

ωL=100Ω。输入相对电流角为90°−36.9°=53.1°。ωL=100Ω, and the input-current angle must be 53.1°.

Z=60+j(100−11000C),tan53.1∘=100−1(1000C)60

保留给定角度的严格解Keep the literal-angle result

tan53.1°=cot36.9°。由题给36.9°严格计算约49.782μF；若采用常见3-4-5角的舍入解释，则得附录50μF。Literal 36.9° gives about 49.782μF. Interpreting it as the rounded 3-4-5 angle yields the listed 50μF.

C=11000(100−60cot36.9∘)F≈49.782μF

复核附录近似Check the listed approximation

C=50μF时XC=20Ω，总阻抗60+j80Ω，输出超前36.8699°≈36.9°。C=50μF gives XC=20Ω, Z=60+j80Ω and a36.8699° lead, which rounds to 36.9°.

argj10060+j80=36.8699∘

严格按36.9°为C≈49.782μF；按该角度的常用舍入精度，C≈50μF，与附录一致。Literal 36.9° gives C≈49.782μF; using the conventional rounded angle gives C≈50μF, consistent with the appendix precision.

易错点Common errors

  • u2是电感电压，不是电容电压；初始参考选电流后，输入相位与输出相位不能颠倒。u2 is across L, not C. Keep input and output phase order when choosing current as reference.

核验依据Verification

电容输出恰滞后90°要求串联谐振A capacitor output lag of 90° requires series resonance

题目原文Transcribed question

欲使题图7-13所示RLC串联电路中的u2滞后u190°，试确定ω与电路参数之间的关系。For the series−RLC circuit in Fig. 7-13, determine the relation between ω and component values so u2 lags u1 by 90°.

R、L、C串联，u2跨C，u1跨全部元件。Series RLC with u2 across C and u1 across the full circuit.

本题图在书第188页／PDF第197页。The source figure is on printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
输出跨C，固有地滞后回路电流90°；要相对输入也恰好滞后90°，输入须与电流同相。The capacitor output already lags loop current by 90°. To lag the input by the same angle, input and current must be in phase.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

总阻抗虚部为零Set total impedance imaginary part to zero

对正R、L、C及非零输入，输入同相条件是电抗抵消。For positive R, L, C and nonzero input, in-phase input and current require reactance cancellation.

ωL−1ωC=0⇒ω=1LC

ω=1LC，假设R,L,C>0且输入非零。ω=1LC for positive R, L, C and nonzero input.

易错点Common errors

  • 若R=0且恰谐振，总阻抗为零，理想电压激励稳态相量不再是本推导的有限解。For R=0 at resonance the zero impedance invalidates this finite phasor solution under ideal voltage drive.

核验依据Verification

7-20全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第188页／PDF第197页。范围状态：要求学习：7.1–7.5（正弦量、相量及电路分析）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197. Coverage: Required: §§7.1–7.5 (sinusoids, phasors and circuit analysis).

输入纯电阻须分零频与正频条件Separate the DC and positive-frequency pure-resistance conditions

题目原文Transcribed question

试确定题图7-14所示正弦交流电路满足什么条件时可使阻抗Zab为纯电阻。Determine when the input impedance Zab of Fig. 7-14 is purely resistive.

jωL串联在R与−j(ωC)并联支路之前。jωL is in series before parallel R and capacitive reactance.

本题图在书第188页／PDF第197页。The source figure is on printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
串联L后接R∥C，先化并联阻抗，再取总虚部为零。A series L feeds parallel R∥C. Reduce the parallel impedance and set the total imaginary part to zero.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

化成实虚部Separate real and imaginary parts

假设正R、L、C。并联RC阻抗为R(1+jωRC)。Assume positive R, L and C. The parallel impedance is R(1+jωRC).

Zab=R1+(ωRC)2+j[ωL−ωR2C1+(ωRC)2]

正频率存在条件Positive-frequency existence condition

ω>0时可以除ω，根号内必须严格大于零；只有R2C>L才有正频率解。For ω>0 divide by ω. A strictly positive radicand requires R2C>L.

ω=1LC−1(RC)2,R2C>L

不要丢掉零频极限Keep the zero-frequency case

ω=0时L短路、C开路，任意正参数均给Z=R；不属于正弦非零频率解。At DC, L shorts and C opens, giving Z=R for all positive parameters. This is separate from the nonzero-frequency case.

Zab(0)=R

正频率下ω=1(LC)−1(RC)2，须R2C>L；此外零频极限总为纯R。For positive frequency, ω=1(LC)−1(RC)2 exists only when R2C>L. The DC limit is always R.

易错点Common errors

  • 在除ω之前单独处理ω=0；R2C=L只给零频根，不是正频率解。Handle ω=0 before division. Equality R2C=L gives only the zero-frequency root.

核验依据Verification

7-21全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第188页／PDF第197页。范围状态：要求学习：7.1–7.5（正弦量、相量及电路分析）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197. Coverage: Required: §§7.1–7.5 (sinusoids, phasors and circuit analysis).

受控源的控制电压是对地节点电压The control voltage is a node-to-ground voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图7-15所示正弦交流电路中的电流I˙。Find the current phasor I in Fig. 7-15.

U1从10Ω右节点到下线，3U1源在该节点和电感上端之间。U1 spans the node after 10Ω to ground; the 3U1 source links it to the inductor top.

本题图在书第188页／PDF第197页。The source figure is on printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
10V源、10Ω、3U1受控电压源和j10Ω串成回路；U1从10Ω右端节点到下公共线，上正；受控源左正右负。A10V source, 10Ω, a3U1 controlled voltage source and j10Ω form a loop. U1 is measured from the node after 10Ω to ground, top-positive; the controlled source is left-positive.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

控制电压包含后两元件The control voltage spans both following elements

U1不是10Ω两端电压，而是受控源与电感的总压降。U1 is not across 10Ω; it spans the controlled source plus inductor.

U˙1=3U˙1+j10I˙⇒U˙1=−j5I˙

回到独立源KVLUse the independent-source KVL

源电压等于10Ω压降加节点电压U1。The independent source equals the 10Ω drop plus U1.

10=10I˙+U˙1=(10−j5)I˙⇒I˙=0.8+j0.4=0.894427∠26.5651∘A

I˙=(0.8+j0.4)A，即0.894427∠26.5651∘A。I˙=(0.8+j0.4)A=0.894427∠26.5651∘A.

易错点Common errors

  • 受控源可提供复功率，不能用纯无源RL相位来否定电流超前；先读准U1的两端。A dependent source can supply complex power. Read both control-voltage terminals before inferring a passive−RL phase.

核验依据Verification

7-22全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第188页／PDF第197页。范围状态：要求学习：7.1–7.5（正弦量、相量及电路分析）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197. Coverage: Required: §§7.1–7.5 (sinusoids, phasors and circuit analysis).

并联感容抵消后，总电流与电阻支路相同Parallel LC cancellation leaves total current equal to the resistor current

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-16所示正弦交流电路中，已知u=302sin(ωt−30∘)V,ω=103rads，求i1,i2,i3和i。For Fig. 7-16, u=302sin(ωt−30∘)V and ω=1000 rads. Find i1, i2, i3 and total i.

20Ω串联输入，后接10Ω、0.1H、10μF三并联支路，电流均向下。20Ω series input feeds parallel 10Ω, 0.1H and 10μF with downward branch currents.

本题图在书第188页／PDF第197页。The source figure is on printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准、有效值相量、复数代数、端口参考方向和KCL、KVL。Cosine convention, RMS phasors, complex algebra, port references and KCL and KVL.
20Ω串联后是10Ω、0.1H、10μF三支路并联。在此ω下XL=100Ω、XC=100Ω。20Ω feeds parallel 10Ω, 0.1H and 10μF branches. At this ω, both reactance magnitudes are 100Ω.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

相量统一用余弦有效值Use RMS cosine phasors

输入变为30∠−120°V；L、C导纳恰好抵消，并联等效10Ω。The input is 30∠−120°V. L and C admittances cancel, leaving parallel impedance 10Ω.

Yp=110+1j100+1−j100=0.1S,I˙=30∠(−120∘)30=1∠(−120∘)A

并联电压给各支路Use the shared parallel voltage

并联电压10∠−120°V；电感电流再滞后90°，电容电流再超前90°。The parallel voltage is 10∠−120°V. Inductor current lags it by 90° and capacitor current leads by 90°.

I˙1=1∠(−120∘),I˙2=0.1∠150∘,I˙3=0.1∠(−30∘)A

还原成题设正弦形式Return to the input sine convention

余弦相位转正弦加90°，再乘√2恢复峰值。Add 90° to convert cosine phase to sine and multiply RMS by √2.

i1=i=2sin(ωt−30∘)A,i2=0.12sin(ωt−120∘)A,i3=0.12sin(ωt+60∘)A

i1=i=2sin(ωt−30°)A；i2=0.12sin(ωt−120°)A；i3=0.12sin(ωt+60°)A。i1=i=2sin(ωt−30°)A; i2=0.12sin(ωt−120°)A; i3=0.12sin(ωt+60°)A.

易错点Common errors

  • 支路抵消的是相量和，L、C各自仍有非零电流；输入30V有效值不是302V。The LC phasor sum cancels while both branch currents remain nonzero. Input RMS is 30V.

核验依据Verification

7-23指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第188页／PDF第197页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-23Assigned requirement: 7-23

零支路电流不等于右侧无电流：并联无功相抵Zero branch current can coexist with circulating reactive currents

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-17所示正弦交流电路中，已知ω=100 rads，I˙=0，求I˙L1、I˙C和C的值。For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-17, ω=100 rads and I˙=0. Find I˙L1, I˙C and C.

100∠0°V源上正下负，顶端经100Ω到节点A；A经j100Ω到地，IL1向下；A经200Ω到节点B，该支路I向右。B经j500Ω及电容阻抗−j(ωC)两支路到地，IL2和IC均向下。A top-positive 100∠0°V source connects through 100Ω to A. A connects through j100Ω to ground, with IL1 downward. A200Ω resistor joins A to B, carrying I rightward. B connects through parallel j500Ω and −j(ωC) branches to ground, with IL2 and IC downward.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

相量KCL、KVL；零电阻支路电流意味着两端等电位；并联LC导纳相消。Phasor KCL and KVL, equal potentials across a resistor with zero current and cancellation of parallel LC admittances.
I˙=0使200Ω压降为0，故A、B电压相同。右侧电感和电容电流不必分别为0，只需大小相等、方向相反的相量相加为0。I˙=0 makes the 200Ω voltage drop zero, so A and B have equal voltage. The right inductor and capacitor currents need not vanish individually; equal and opposite phasors can sum to zero.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由零电流确定右侧导纳Use zero current to determine the right-side admittance

B点KCL为I˙L2+I˙C=0。B电压非0，因此并联导纳必须为0，电容容抗大小等于500Ω。KCL at B is I˙L2+I˙C=0. Since B’s voltage is nonzero, the parallel admittance must vanish; capacitive reactance magnitude is 500Ω.

1j500+jωC=0⇒C=1500ω=150000F=20μF

计算左电感电流Calculate the left inductor current

右侧不取净电流，左源只驱动100Ω与j100Ω串联，所以电流就是I˙L1。The right side draws zero net current, so the source drives series 100Ω and j100Ω; their current is I˙L1.

I˙L1=100100+j100=12−j12=22∠(−45∘)A

求公共节点电压与电容电流Find common voltage and capacitor current

A、B电压均为j100I˙L1=50+j50V。电容阻抗−j500Ω，因此I˙C=U˙B(−j500)。A and B are both at j100I˙L1=50+j50V. The capacitor impedance is −j500Ω, so I˙C=U˙B(−j500).

U˙A=U˙B=50+j50,I˙C=−0.1+j0.1=210∠135∘A

I˙L1=(22)∠−45°A；I˙C=(210)∠135°A；C=20μF。I˙L1=(22)∠−45°A; I˙C=(210)∠135°A; C=20μF.

易错点Common errors

  • I˙=0不意味着I˙L2=I˙C=0；它们相量相消。I˙=0 does not imply I˙L2=I˙C=0; their phasors cancel.
  • 电容电流是电压除以−jX，即相位超前90°。Dividing by capacitive −jX makes current lead voltage by 90°.

核验依据Verification

独立完整双节点方程求解（保留200Ω支路）得到A=B=50+j50V，故200Ω电流严格为0；I˙L2=0.1−j0.1A，恰与I˙C相反。复功率核验：100Ω耗散50W；左电感+50var，右电感+10var，电容−10var；源提供50+j50VA，总和为0。书第337页、PDF346页7-23的两个相量与20μF均一致。An independent full two-node solve, retaining the 200Ω branch, gives A=B=50+j50V and zero 200Ω current. I˙L2=0.1−j0.1A exactly cancels I˙C. Complex-power check: 100Ω dissipates 50W; the left and right inductors absorb +50 and +10var, and the capacitor −10var. The source supplies 50+j50VA, balancing all loads. Both phasors and 20μF match answer 7-23 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346.

7-24指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第188页／PDF第197页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-24Assigned requirement: 7-24

跨节点电压源：用超节点KCL反求源相量A voltage source between nodes: recover its phasor with supernode KCL

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-18所示正弦交流电路中，已知U˙1=4∠0°V，试求U˙s。For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-18, U˙1=4∠0°V. Find U˙s.

底部公共节点。左中节点A经2Ω接地，电压U1上正下负；A还经−j1Ω电容、再经左侧1Ω接地。A到右中节点B之间有电压源Us，左负右正。B经−j1Ω电容接地，并经顶端j1Ω、再经右侧2Ω串联接地。The bottom is common. Left-middle A connects through 2Ω to ground, with U1 positive at A. Another A−to-ground path contains −j1Ω then left 1Ω. Voltage source Us lies between A and right-middle B, negative at A and positive at B. B connects to ground through −j1Ω, and through upper j1Ω in series with right 2Ω.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

相量节点法；电压源超节点；复数导纳；源电压极性。Phasor nodal analysis, voltage-source supernodes, complex admittances and source polarity.
U˙1已给出A=4V。把A、B及它们之间的电压源看成超节点，直接对所有向地支路列KCL，避开未知源电流；最后按右正左负求Us=B−A。U˙1 fixes A=4V. Treat A, B and their intervening voltage source as a supernode, summing all currents to ground without the unknown source current. Finally use the right-positive polarity: Us=B−A.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

把两边支路写成导纳Write each side’s admittance

A对地有2Ω及(1−j)Ω两条支路；B对地有−jΩ及(2+j)Ω两条支路。各串联路径之间没有分叉，可先相加阻抗。A has paths of 2Ω and (1−j)Ω to ground. B has paths of −jΩ and (2+j)Ω. Each series path has no intermediate branch, so its impedances add.

YA=12+11−j=1+j2,YB=1−j+12+j=25+j45

对超节点列KCLApply supernode KCL

没有电流源向超节点外部注入，全部向地电流相加为0。A=4∠0°=4V，于是可直接解B电位。No current source injects from outside the supernode. Sum all ground-directed currents to zero and use A=4V to solve B.

YAU˙A+YBU˙B=0⇒U˙B=−4+j20.4+j0.8=−4+j3(V)

按源极性计算UsCalculate Us with its stated polarity

图中Us右正左负，源电压是B相对A的电压，不能反过来相减。Us is positive on the right and negative on the left, so it is B relative to A, not the reverse.

U˙s=U˙B−U˙A=(−4+j3)−4=−8+j3V

U˙s=−8+j3V（图示右正左负）。U˙s=−8+j3V, positive on the right as drawn.

易错点Common errors

  • B电位−4+j3V还不是所求源电压；还需减去A=4V。B’s potential −4+j3V is not the source voltage; subtract A=4V.
  • 电容阻抗−j的导纳为+j，不能漏掉符号变化。The admittance of capacitive impedance −j is +j; retain this sign change.

核验依据Verification

独立完整MNA：将−8+j3V源接回原电路，解得A=4V、B=−4+j3V，左最外节点2+j2V、右最外节点−2+j4V，确实重现题设。源正端流入电流4+j2A，吸收复功率(−8+j3)(4−j2)=−26+j28VA；三只电阻共耗散26W，电感与两只电容净无功−28var，总复功率为0。书第337页、PDF346页7-24为−8+j3V。Independent full MNA: restoring the −8+j3V source to the original circuit gives A=4V and B=−4+j3V, with outer-left node 2+j2V and outer-right node −2+j4V, reproducing the given voltage. Current entering the source’s positive terminal is 4+j2A, so its absorbed complex power is (−8+j3)(4−j2)=−26+j28VA. The three resistors dissipate 26W and the inductor and capacitors have net reactive power −28var, giving zero total complex power. Answer 7-24 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346 is −8+j3V.

分源叠加时保留未被置零的支路Retain the passive branches during source superposition

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-19所示正弦交流电路中，已知I˙s=10∠0∘A,U˙s=j10V，试用叠加定理求电流I˙C。In Fig. 7-19, I˙s=10∠0∘A and U˙s=j10V. Use superposition to find IC.

左电流源向上，右电压源上正；IC经过中间−j50Ω向下。The left current source is upward, the right voltage source top-positive and IC downward through −j50Ω.

本题图在书第188页／PDF第197页。The source figure is on printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
左节点A有25Ω并联电流源，经25Ω接B。B经−j50Ω到地、经j50Ω到右电压源上端。Node A has a25Ω shunt and source, with 25Ω to B. B connects to ground through −j50Ω and to the voltage-source top through j50Ω.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

单独保留电流源Keep only the current source

电压源短路后，B点两个相反电抗导纳抵消，A、B均为250V。Short the voltage source. Opposing reactive admittances cancel at B, giving A=B=250V.

I˙C,I=250−j50=j5A

单独保留电压源Keep only the voltage source

电流源开路，A经25Ω接地且经25Ω到B；节点方程给A=5V、B=10V。Open the current source. Node equations give A=5V and B=10V.

I˙C,U=10−j50=j0.2A

叠加并复核原电路Superpose and check the combined circuit

原电路节点A=255V、B=260V，直接除容抗也得同值。The combined circuit has A=255V and B=260V, confirming the same current directly.

I˙C=j5+j0.2=j5.2A

I˙C=j5.2A，按原图向下参考。I˙C=j5.2A under the downward reference.

易错点Common errors

  • 电压源置零是短路，电流源置零是开路，旁边的25Ω或j50Ω仍保留。Zero voltage sources by shorting and current sources by opening; retain neighboring passive components.

受控源参与端口导纳，再配并联RLInclude the dependent source in the port admittance

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图7-20所示单口网络的电阻与电感并联的等效电路模型，给出所需的电阻和电感值。设ω=1 rads。For Fig. 7-20 at ω=1 rads, find the equivalent parallel resistor and inductor values.

2H串联端口，1F与向上0.5UL源在其后并联。A2H series inductor feeds parallel 1F and an upward 0.5UL source.

本题图在书第188页／PDF第197页。The source figure is on printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
端口a经2H到节点B，B有1F到b；向上受控电流源0.5UL从b注入B，UL取电感左正右负。Port a feeds node B through 2H. B has 1F to b and an upward dependent source 0.5UL, where UL is positive left-to-right across L.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

施加1V测试源Apply a1V test source

令端口电压1V，B电位VB，输入电流I=(1−VB)(j2)。保留控制源。Let port voltage be 1V and B voltage VB. Input current is (1−VB)(j2); retain control.

jVB=1−VBj2+0.5(1−VB)⇒VB=−jV

读出并联电导和感纳Identify conductance and inductive susceptance

端口电流0.5−j0.5A，因此电导0.5S，电感支路导纳−j0.5S。Input current is 0.5−j0.5A, giving conductance 0.5S and inductive susceptance −0.5S.

Y=0.5−j0.5=1Rp+1jωLp⇒Rp=2Ω, Lp=2H

等效为2Ω与2H并联，仅在指定ω=1 rads下作相量端口等效。Equivalent: 2Ω in parallel with 2H at the specified ω=1 rads.

易错点Common errors

  • 此为指定频率的等效，不宣称所有频率下都能用同一RL替代含受控源原网络。This is a specified-frequency equivalent, not an all-frequency replacement of the controlled-source network.

题目原文Transcribed question

已知10Ω电阻与50μF电容并联的等效导纳同电阻R1与电容C串联的等效导纳在角频率ω=1000 rads时的值相等，试确定R1和C的值。At ω=1000 rads, a parallel 10Ω and 50μF has the same admittance as a series R1 and C. Find R1 and C.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
同频率导纳相同等价于阻抗相同，转为矩形阻抗后实部为R1、虚部为−1(ωC)。Equal admittance at one frequency means equal impedance. Its real part gives R1 and imaginary part −1(ωC).
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求原导纳并取倒数Compute admittance and invert

50μF换成50×10−6F。Convert 50μF to 50×10−6F.

Y=0.1+j0.05S,Z=1Y=8−j4Ω

匹配串联实虚部Match series real and imaginary parts

容抗幅值4Ω。The capacitive-reactance magnitude is 4Ω.

R1=8Ω,C=11000×4F=250μF

R1=8Ω，C=250μF。R1=8Ω and C=250μF.

易错点Common errors

  • 等效只在指定频率成立；不能把并联电容50μF直接当成串联电容。The equivalence is frequency-specific; the series capacitance is not the original 50μF.

电压表最小值是复平面到实轴的距离The minimum meter reading is a complex-plane projection

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-21所示正弦交流电路中，已知U=20V、R3=5Ω、频率f=50Hz，当调节滑动变阻器使R1:R2=2:3时，电压表的读数最小且为6V，试求R和L的值。In Fig. 7-21, U=20V, R3=5Ω and f=50Hz. The voltmeter reaches its minimum reading 6V when R1:R2=2:3. Find R and L.

左滑动分压R1、R2，右上R3=5Ω、右下R与L串联，表跨两中点。A left R1R2 slider and right R3 above series R,L form two dividers; the meter bridges their midpoint nodes.

本题图在书第189页／PDF第198页。The source figure is on printed p. 189 · PDF p. 198.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
理想电压表不分流，左中点电压沿实轴可调。最小值时左中点等于右中点实部，差仅剩虚部。An ideal voltmeter draws no current. The left tap moves along the real axis; the minimum occurs when it matches the right node real part.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从最小读数恢复右中点相量Recover the right-node phasor

左下段比例35给12V；感性下支路使右中点虚部为正6V。The lower slider fraction 35 gives 12V. The inductive lower branch makes the imaginary part +6V.

V˙b=12+j6V,I˙=20−(12+j6)5=1.6−j1.2A

求下方RL阻抗Find the lower RL impedance

右中点到地为R+jωL。The lower branch impedance is R+jωL.

R+jωL=12+j61.6−j1.2=3+j6Ω

用实际50Hz换算LConvert using the actual 50Hz

ω=100π rads，因此L不是严格0.02H；附录0.02H为很粗的舍入。ω=100π rads gives a value not exactly 0.02H; the appendix uses coarse rounding.

R=3Ω,L=6100πH≈19.0986mH

R=3Ω，L=6(100π)H≈19.0986mH；附录0.02H仅为粗略值。R=3Ω and L=6(100π)H≈19.0986mH; the listed 0.02H is coarse rounding.

易错点Common errors

  • 最小读数不是电桥平衡到零；不能把6V忽略。电压表按理想无限输入阻抗处理。The minimum is 6V, not a zero-balance bridge. The voltmeter is assumed ideal with infinite input impedance.

电容任意变化而读数不变，利用圆轨迹A capacitance-independent reading follows a circular locus

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-22所示正弦交流电路中，已知R1=25Ω、R2=75Ω、R=20Ω，调节电容使电压表V的读数保持20V不变，求电压U和电阻r。In Fig. 7-22, R1=25Ω, R2=75Ω and R=20Ω. Varying the capacitance keeps the voltmeter at 20V. Find U and r.

左25Ω、75Ω分压，右20Ω与r、可调C串联分压，表跨两中点。The left 25Ω75Ω divider and right 20Ω above series r,C share the input; the meter bridges their midpoint nodes.

本题图在书第189页／PDF第198页。The source figure is on printed p. 189 · PDF p. 198.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
左中点是0.75U，右下支路r−jX，X=1(ωC)。要求对任意调节X都保持相同幅值。The left midpoint is 0.75U and the right lower branch r−jX. Require constant magnitude as X varies.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写测量电压Write the measured voltage

理想电压表不加载两分压支路。The ideal voltmeter does not load either divider.

V˙=U(r−jX20+r−jX−34)=U(14−2020+r−jX)

用两极限确定非平凡rUse both limits to determine r

X趋无穷时读数U4；X=0时同模要求14−20(20+r)=−14，得到r=20Ω。At infinite X the magnitude is U4. Equal magnitude at X=0 requires 14−20(20+r)=−14, giving r=20Ω.

r=20Ω,|V˙|=U4|−40−jX40−jX|=U4

由恒读数求电源Recover the source voltage

共轭式分子分母模相等，证明不只两端点相同，而是全部X相同。The numerator and denominator have equal magnitude, proving constancy for every X.

U=4(20V)=80V

U=80V，r=20Ω。U=80V and r=20Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 仅验证两个端点不足以证明全程恒定；还需给出上面的恒模表达式。Matching endpoint readings alone is insufficient; the constant-modulus expression proves the whole range.

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-23所示正弦交流电路中，已知U˙=22∠0∘V，求电路消耗的平均功率。In Fig. 7-23, U˙=22∠0∘V. Find the average consumed power.

2Ω和−j2Ω串联。Series 2Ω and −j2Ω.

本题图在书第189页／PDF第198页。The source figure is on printed p. 189 · PDF p. 198.

图中2Ω与−j2Ω串联，给的是有效值相量22V。The 2Ω and −j2Ω are in series, and the stated phasor 22V is RMS.

求电流有效值Find RMS current

总阻抗模为22Ω，故电流模1A。The impedance magnitude is 22Ω, giving RMS current 1A.

|I˙|=22|2−j2|=1A

只计电阻有功Count resistor active power

理想电容平均有功为零。The ideal capacitor has zero average active power.

P=I2R=12(2)=2W

求题图7-24所示正弦交流电路中电源提供的平均功率。Find the source’s average delivered power in Fig. 7-24.

10V有效值源与10Ω、j10Ω串联。A10V RMS source feeds series 10Ω and j10Ω.

源10∠0°V串联10Ω和j10Ω，先算有效值电流再计电阻功率。A10∠0°V source feeds series 10Ω and j10Ω. Find RMS current before resistor power.

电流与复功率Current and complex power

I˙=1010+j10=0.5−j0.5A,Ssource=10I˙*=5+j5VA

求并联等效Find the parallel equivalent

Zeq=1(12+1(j2))=1+jΩ。The parallel impedance is 1+jΩ.

Zeq=1+jΩ,S=Is2Zeq=252(1+j)VA

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-26所示正弦交流电路中，已知电源电压us=602cos(ωt−36.9∘)V，负载2的电压u2=602cos(ωt−53.1∘)V，电流i=32cosωtA，求负载1吸收的有功功率P1、无功功率Q1和负载2吸收的无功功率Q2。In Fig. 7-26, us=602cos(ωt−36.9∘)V, u2=602cos(ωt−53.1∘)V and i=32cosωtA. Find load-1 active P1, reactive Q1 and load-2 reactive Q2.

负载1和2串联，us跨全回路，u2跨负载2上正下负，i顺时针。Loads 1 and 2 are in series; us spans both, u2 is top-positive across load 2 and current is clockwise.

本题图在书第189页／PDF第198页。The source figure is on printed p. 189 · PDF p. 198.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
两负载串联电流相同。总吸收功率等于UsI*，负载2为U2I*，负载1为二者之差。Both series loads carry the same current. Use Stotal=UsI*, S2=U2I* and S1=Stotal−S2.

用有效值相量分别相乘Multiply RMS phasors separately

给定波形含√2，故有效值为60V、60V和3A。The √2 factors give RMS magnitudes 60V, 60V and 3A.

S1=180(e−j36.9∘−e−j53.1∘)VA,S2=180e−j53.1∘VA

区分严格小数角与附录舍入Distinguish literal angles from rounded results

按给定小数角直接计算P1=Q1≈35.868Wvar，Q2≈−143.943var；把角度看作常用3-4-5角舍入，则得到附录36、36、−144。Literal decimal angles give P1=Q1≈35.868 and Q2≈−143.943. Interpreting the angles as rounded 3-4-5 values gives the listed 36, 36, −144.

P1=180(cos36.9∘−sin36.9∘),Q1=P1,Q2=−180cos36.9∘

按题给角度P1≈35.868W、Q1≈35.868var、Q2≈−143.943var；通常舍入答36W、36var、−144var。Using literal angles: P1≈35.868W, Q1≈35.868var, Q2≈−143.943var. Conventional rounded answers: 36W, 36var, −144var.

易错点Common errors

  • 先做复功率差而不是把两个电压有效值相减；负Q2表示负载2整体容性。Subtract complex powers, not voltage magnitudes. Negative Q2 means load 2 is capacitive.

平均功率由阻抗角决定，与绝对电压相位无关Average power depends on impedance angle, not absolute voltage phase

题目原文Transcribed question

已知某单口网络的输入阻抗Z=10∠36.9∘Ω，端口电压U˙=100∠30∘V，求此单口网络吸收的平均功率P。A one-port has Z=10∠36.9∘Ω and U˙=100∠30∘V. Find absorbed average power.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
电压电流的相位差是阻抗角36.9°，不是电压的绝对初相30°。The voltage-current phase difference is the impedance angle 36.9°, not the absolute voltage phase 30°.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从复功率取实部Take the real part of complex power

电流有效值10A，平均功率UIcosϕ。RMS current is 10A, giving P=UIcosϕ.

P=U2|Z|cos36.9∘=1000cos36.9∘W≈799.685W

P=1000cos36.9°W≈800W，附录800W为舍入值。P=1000cos36.9°W≈800W; the listed 800W is rounded.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能用cos30°；100∠30°给的是有效值相量，不再除√2。Do not use cos30° or divide an RMS phasor by √2 again.

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-27所示正弦交流电路中，已知u=30cos(ωt+30∘)V,uC=20cos(ωt−60∘)V,1(ωC)=4Ω，试求网络N的等效阻抗ZN和吸收的有功功率PN。For Fig. 7-27, u=30cos(ωt+30∘)V, uC=20cos(ωt−60∘)V and 1(ωC)=4Ω. Find ZN and absorbed PN.

3Ω、N、电容串成回路；底部电容右正左负。3Ω, N and C form a series loop; the bottom capacitor is right-positive.

本题图在书第189页／PDF第198页。The source figure is on printed p. 189 · PDF p. 198.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
图中电容右正左负，与顺时针回路电流关联。电容电压除−j4Ω直接给电流。The capacitor is right-positive, matching the clockwise current. Divide its voltage by −j4Ω.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

换有效值并求电流Convert to RMS and find current

给出的30、20均为峰值。电流相位比电容电压超前90°。The stated 30 and 20 are peaks. Current leads capacitor voltage by 90°.

I˙=(202)∠(−60∘)−j4=52∠30∘A

求总阻抗，再减外部元件Find total impedance and remove external elements

电源与电流同相，Z总=6Ω；外部为3−j4Ω。Source and current are in phase, so total Z=6Ω; external Z is 3−j4Ω.

ZN=6−(3−j4)=3+j4Ω,PN=I2ℜZN=252(3)=37.5W

ZN=(3+j4)Ω，PN=37.5W。ZN=(3+j4)Ω and PN=37.5W.

易错点Common errors

  • 电容极性右正不能反读；若用峰值电流计算平均功率，必须有12。Read the right-positive capacitor polarity correctly. Peak-current average-power calculations require 12.

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-28所示正弦交流电路中，已知R=ωL=1(ωC)=100Ω,I˙R=2∠0∘A，求U˙s和电源提供的有功功率。For Fig. 7-28, R=ωL=1(ωC)=100Ω and I˙R=2∠0∘A. Find Us and source-delivered active power.

源经jωL到并联R、−j(ωC)，IR向下。The source feeds jωL before parallel R and C; IR points downward.

本题图在书第189页／PDF第198页。The source figure is on printed p. 189 · PDF p. 198.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
先由R支路确定并联电压200V，电容电流超前90°。串联电感承载R与C的相量和。The resistor fixes parallel voltage at 200V. Capacitor current leads by 90°, and series L carries the phasor sum.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

并联支路KCLParallel-branch KCL

IC=j2A，故IL=2+j2A。IC=j2A, giving IL=2+j2A.

U˙p=200V,I˙C=j2A,I˙L=2+j2A

KVL求源电压Use KVL for the source voltage

电感压降j100(2+j2)=−200+j200V，与并联200V相加。The inductor drop is −200+j200V, added to the parallel 200V.

U˙s=200+j100(2+j2)=j200V,Ps=IR2R=400W

Us=200∠90°V，源提供P=400W。Us=200∠90°V and source-delivered P=400W.

易错点Common errors

  • 电感电流不是只取2A的电阻支路电流；两个支路有效值不可标量相加。The series-inductor current includes both branches; do not add their RMS magnitudes as scalars.

题目原文Transcribed question

正弦交流电路如题图7-29所示，试求电流i和无源元件消耗的功率。For Fig. 7-29, find current i and the powers consumed by the passive elements.

中点电阻1Ω到地，左右分别接1H和1F后到3cost、5cost电源。A central 1Ω shunt connects to the left source through 1H and to the right source through 1F.

本题图在书第189页／PDF第198页。The source figure is on printed p. 189 · PDF p. 198.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
ω=1，左源3costV经1H到中点，右源5costV经1F到中点，中点以1Ω接地，i向下。At ω=1, the left 3costV source reaches the middle node through 1H; the right 5costV source through 1F. A1Ω resistor connects the node to ground with i downward.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

峰值相量节点方程Write a peak-phasor node equation

直接用原幅值3和5列节点式，注意功率稍后使用12。Use original peaks 3 and 5 for node algebra, retaining 12 for power later.

Vˆ−3j+Vˆ+Vˆ−5−j=0⇒Vˆ=j2V

电流与平均功率Current and average powers

电阻1Ω故电流峰值2A，超前余弦90°。理想L和C平均有功为零。The 1Ω resistor gives peak current 2A with phase +90°. Ideal L and C have zero average active power.

i(t)=2cos(t+90∘)A,PR=12(22)(1)=2W,PL=PC=0

i=2cos(t+90°)A；无源元件平均有功：电阻2W、电感0、电容0，总2W。i=2cos(t+90°)A. Average passive active powers: resistor 2W, L=0, C=0; total 2W.

易错点Common errors

  • 这里节点相量采用峰值并用帽号标明，不能混成有效值后漏12。The hat denotes peak phasors; do not mix them with RMS power formulas.

题目原文Transcribed question

某单口网络如题图7-30所示，若R=10Ω,ωL=10Ω,1(ωC)=20Ω，求该单口网络的功率因数。For Fig. 7-30, R=10Ω, ωL=10Ω and 1(ωC)=20Ω. Find the power factor.

R、L、C三支路并联。R, L and C are parallel.

本题图在书第189页／PDF第198页。The source figure is on printed p. 189 · PDF p. 198.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

三支路并联，用导纳相加最直接。总电纳为负，电流滞后电压。All three branches are parallel. Sum admittances; negative susceptance means current lags voltage.

求导纳并取实部比例Find admittance and its real fraction

电导0.1S，净电纳−0.05S。Conductance is 0.1S and net susceptance −0.05S.

Y=0.1−j0.05S,Z=8+j4Ω,pf=0.10.12+0.052=25≈0.894427

功率因数25≈0.8944，滞后（感性）。Power factor 25≈0.8944, lagging (inductive).

易错点Common errors

  • 功率因数的正数值不能单独表达感性或容性，还要写超前、滞后。The positive power-factor number alone does not distinguish leading and lagging.

Y=18−j16S,pf=18(18)2+(16)2=35=0.6

先分配有功，再用相量KVL求总电压Allocate active power before phasor KVL

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-32所示电路中，阻抗Z=(2+j2)Ω，电流有效值IR=5A,IC=8A,IL=3A，电路消耗的总功率为200W。求总电压有效值U。In Fig. 7-32, Z=(2+j2)Ω, RMS currents IR=5A, IC=8A, IL=3A, and total consumed active power is 200W. Find source RMS U.

输入先串联Z=2+j2，再接并联R、C、L；各支路电流向下。Input series Z=2+j2 feeds parallel R, C and L with downward branch currents.

本题图在书第190页／PDF第199页。The source figure is on printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
以并联端压为实轴，总电流为5+j(8−3)=5+j5A。串联阻抗实部先消耗100W，剩100W在并联电阻。Using parallel voltage as phase reference gives total current 5+j5A. The series resistance consumes 100W, leaving 100W in the parallel resistor.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由总有功求并联电压Find parallel voltage from active power

串联2Ω有功为2|5+j5|2=100W；并联电阻功率等于UpIR。Series active power is 2|5+j5|2=100W, and parallel resistor power is UpIR.

Up=200−1005=20V

相量相加求源电压Add voltages as phasors

串联阻抗压降是(2+j2)(5+j5)=j20V。The series drop is (2+j2)(5+j5)=j20V.

U˙=20+(2+j2)(5+j5)=20+j20V,U=202V

总电压有效值U=202V≈28.2843V。Source RMS U=202V≈28.2843V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把串联压降模与并联电压模直接相加；它们在本题正交。The series drop and parallel voltage are orthogonal here, so their magnitudes do not add directly.

从总有功和电流反求输入阻抗Infer input impedance from active power and current

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-33所示电路中，已知us(t)=502cos314tV，电流i的有效值I=0.5A，电源发出的功率为15W，电阻R1=20Ω。求电阻R2和电容C。In Fig. 7-33, us=502cos314tV, RMS I=0.5A, source active power 15W and R1=20Ω. Find R2 and C.

R1串联在源与并联R2、C之前。R1 is in series before parallel R2 and C.

本题图在书第190页／PDF第199页。The source figure is on printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
输入是R1串联R2∥C；用PI2求总实部，用UI求总模，再以容性选择负虚部。R1 is in series with R2∥C. Use PI2 for total real part, UI for magnitude, and select the capacitive negative imaginary part.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

输入阻抗及并联部分Input and parallel impedances

Us有效值50V，不是502V。Source RMS is 50V.

|Z|=500.5=100Ω,ℜZ=150.52=60Ω,Z=60−j80Ω

转导纳拆R2和CSplit R2 and C through admittance

去掉R1，剩40−j80Ω。Remove R1 to leave 40−j80Ω.

Yp=140−j80=0.005+j0.01S,R2=200Ω,C=0.01314F≈31.8471μF

R2=200Ω，C≈31.8471μF（附录31.85μF）。R2=200Ω and C≈31.8471μF (listed 31.85μF).

易错点Common errors

  • 功率给输入等效实部60Ω，不能直接把它当成R2。The 60Ω is the total input real part, not R2.

输入同相使并联端压也同相An in-phase input fixes the parallel voltage phase

题目原文Transcribed question

正弦稳态电路的向量模型如题图7-34所示，已知I1=10A,I2=20A，U˙与I˙同相，且U˙=220∠0∘V，阻抗Z2上消耗的功率为2kW。试求电流I˙、电阻R、容抗XC及阻抗Z2。For Fig. 7-34, I1=10A and I2=20A RMS; input U and I are in phase, U=220∠0°V and Z2 consumes 2kW. Find I, R, XC and Z2.

源经R到并联−jXC与Z2，I1为电容支路、I2为Z2支路。Source series R feeds parallel −jXC and Z2; I1 is the capacitor current and I2 the Z2 current.

本题图在书第190页／PDF第199页。The source figure is on printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
串联R的压降与输入电流同相，因此并联端压也为实数。电容I1=j10A，Z2支路必须用−j10A抵消。The series−R drop is in phase with input current, so the parallel voltage is real too. Capacitor current +j10A must be canceled by −j10A in the Z2 branch.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

电流三角形Current triangle

Z2支路模20A、虚部−10A，实部为正103A，亦为总电流。The 20AZ2 branch has imaginary part −10A and positive real part 103A, equal to total current.

I˙=103∠0∘A,I˙2=103−j10A

由2kW求并联电压Find parallel voltage from 2kW

电容不耗有功，Z2功率就是并联端压乘总实电流。The capacitor has no active power, so Z2 power is parallel voltage times the total real current.

Up=2000103=2003V

恢复全部未知参数Recover all component values

串联R由剩余实电压降求，容抗由Up10求，Z2由复数相除求。Use the remaining real drop for R, Up10 for XC, and complex division for Z2.

R=220−2003103Ω≈6.03504Ω,XC=203Ω,Z2=5+j53Ω

I=103∠0°A；R≈6.03504Ω；XC≈11.5470Ω；Z2≈5+j2.88675Ω。I=103∠0°A; R≈6.03504Ω; XC≈11.5470Ω; Z2≈5+j2.88675Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 电容支路超前的是并联端压；只有先利用输入同相条件，才能把它写成+j10A。Capacitor current leads its own parallel voltage. Use the input in-phase condition before assigning +j10A.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第190页／PDF第199页。范围状态：拓展：7.7–7.8（功率与复功率，纲领外）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199. Coverage: Extension: §§7.7–7.8 (power and complex power, outside syllabus).

先从等模电流恢复元件，再改变频率Recover components from equal current magnitudes before changing frequency

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-35所示正弦交流电路中，已知电源电压有效值U为100V，频率f=50Hz，各个支路电流有效值I=I1=I2，电路消耗的平均功率为866W。若电源电压U不变、f=100Hz，求此时各支路电流I˙,I˙1,I˙2及电路消耗的平均功率。In Fig. 7-35, U=100V RMS at 50Hz, I=I1=I2 in magnitude, and average power is 866W. Keeping U fixed, change frequency to 100Hz. Find total I, capacitor I1, RL−branch I2 and average power.

电容C与串联R、L两支路并联，I1经过C，I2经过RL。C is parallel with a series R,L branch; I1 flows through C and I2 through RL.

本题图在书第190页／PDF第199页。The source figure is on printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
原三个电流等模组成等边相量三角形，RL支路滞后电压30°。先用866W恢复R、XL和C，再把频率加倍。The three equal current magnitudes form an equilateral phasor triangle, fixing the RL lag at 30°. Recover R, XL and C from 866W before doubling frequency.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

50Hz恢复真实元件Recover the physical components at 50Hz

取电压为0°，I1=jA、I2=A(cosϕ−jsinϕ)。|I1+I2|=A给sinϕ=12，因此ϕ=30°。With U phase zero, I1=jA and I2=A(cosϕ−jsinϕ). The equal total magnitude gives sinϕ=12.

A=866100cos30∘,R=7500866Ω≈8.660508Ω,XL,50=R3≈5.000147Ω,C=A(2π50)(100)≈318.30055μF

100Hz分别重算支路Recompute each branch at 100Hz

电容导纳翻倍，电感电抗也翻倍，R不变。保留866W原值避免累积舍入。Capacitive admittance and inductive reactance both double; R remains fixed. Retain the original 866W.

I˙1=j19.999413A,I˙2=100R+j2XL,50=(4.948571−j5.714118)A

总电流与有功Total current and power

相量相加后从实部求有功，也可独立检查I22R。附录494.93W与原866W严格推导不符，非采用值。Sum phasors and take the real component for active power, independently checking |I2|2R. The listed 494.93W does not follow exactly from 866W.

I˙=(4.948571+j14.285295)A≈15.118135∠70.893395∘A,P=47(866)=494.857143W

以输入电压为0°：I1≈20∠90°A，I2≈7.55907∠−49.1066°A，I≈15.11814∠70.8934°A；P=494.85714W。With input voltage as 0°: I1≈20∠90°A, I2≈7.55907∠−49.1066°A, I≈15.11814∠70.8934°A; P=494.85714W.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能简单把两支路电流都翻倍；频率翻倍时RL阻抗的实部不变，虚部翻倍。Do not double both branch currents: only the RL imaginary impedance doubles, while its resistance stays fixed.

复功率角就是阻抗角Complex-power angle equals impedance angle

题目原文Transcribed question

已知题图7-36所示无源单口网络N的端口电压U˙=100∠30∘V，网络的复功率S=1000∠30∘VA。求该单口网络的阻抗Z。The passive one-port in Fig. 7-36 has U=100∠30°V and complex power S=1000∠30°VA. Find Z.

N为无源单口，电流从上端流入，上端电压为正。N is passive with current entering its positive top port.

本题图在书第190页／PDF第199页。The source figure is on printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
S=UI*，由模先得I=10A，再用Z=SI2。不能把复功率当成1000W纯有功。Use S=UI*. Magnitudes give I=10A, then Z=SI2. The stated 1000VA is not purely active power.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求电流和阻抗Find current and impedance

电流相位为ϕU−ϕS=0°。Current phase is ϕU−ϕS=0°.

I˙=10∠0∘A,Z=SI2=10∠30∘Ω

Z=10∠30°Ω=53+j5Ω。Z=10∠30°Ω=53+j5Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • S=UI*含共轭；若漏共轭，阻抗相角会错。Retain the conjugate in S=UI* or the angle will be wrong.

等模不等于同相：先找三角形相角Equal current magnitudes do not mean equal phases

题目原文Transcribed question

某单口网络如题图7-37所示，已知电流有效值I1=I2=I=10A，求该单口网络的复功率S。For Fig. 7-37, RMS magnitudes I1=I2=I=10A. Find the one-port complex power.

L、C、8Ω并联，I1流入L，I2继续流向C和电阻，I为总输入。L, C and 8Ω are parallel. I1 enters L, I2 feeds C and R, and I is total input.

本题图在书第190页／PDF第199页。The source figure is on printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
I1是纯电感支路，I2是电容和8Ω电阻的合流。I2与I1相差120°，因此I2相对电压超前30°。I1 is the pure-inductor branch and I2 is the parallel C plus 8Ω current. Their 120° separation makes I2 lead voltage by 30°.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

恢复三个电流的分量Recover current components

以端压为实轴，I1=−j10A，I2实部为53A、虚部+j5A。Using port voltage as reference gives I1=−j10A and I2=53+j5A.

I˙2=53+j5A,U=8(53)=403V,I˙=53−j5A

求输入复功率Find input complex power

总电流虚部为负，网络整体为感性。Negative input-current imaginary part means an inductive total.

S=UI˙*=600+j2003VA

S=(600+j2003)VA，P=600W，Q=2003var。S=(600+j2003)VA, P=600W and Q=2003var.

易错点Common errors

  • 三个10A只指有效值模，不能代成相同的实数相量。The three 10A values are magnitudes, not identical real phasors.

诺顿源转端口后做共轭匹配Reduce the Norton-fed port before conjugate matching

题目原文Transcribed question

正弦交流电路如题图7-38所示，试求负载ZL取何值时可获得最大功率？最大功率是多少？For Fig. 7-38, find ZL for maximum absorbed power and the maximum power.

10A源并联2Ω，再串2Ω到a；j4Ω与负载均跨a、b。A10A source shunted by 2Ω feeds series 2Ω to a; j4Ω and the load both span a,b.

本题图在书第190页／PDF第199页。The source figure is on printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
10∠0°A源先与2Ω并联，再经另一2Ω到端口；端口已有j4Ω并联。匹配前必须把j4Ω计入内阻。A10∠0°A Norton source has a2Ω shunt, then 2Ω series to the port, which also has j4Ω. Include that shunt in the port impedance.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

端口开压与内阻Find open voltage and port impedance

电流源置零为开路，端口看见4Ω与j4Ω并联。Opening the zeroed current source leaves 4Ω parallel with j4Ω.

Zth=4∥j4=2+j2Ω,U˙oc=20j44+j4=10+j10V

共轭匹配与最大功率Conjugate match and maximum power

允许一般复负载时，ZL取Zth的共轭。开路电压为有效值相量。For an unrestricted complex load, match the conjugate. Open voltage is RMS.

ZL=2−j2Ω,Pmax=|Uoc|24ℜZth=25W

ZL=(2−j2)Ω，Pmax=25W。ZL=(2−j2)Ω and Pmax=25W.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能只把两个2Ω相加当作端口阻抗；原j4Ω仍是内网络。The two resistors alone are not the whole port impedance; retain the j4Ω shunt.

电容并联内阻的共轭负载为感性The conjugate of a capacitive port is inductive

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图7-39所示正弦交流电路中负载ZL获得最大功率时的值。若U˙s=2∠45∘V，试求负载所获得的最大功率。Find ZL for maximum power in Fig. 7-39. If Us=2∠45°V, find the maximum load power.

源经1Ω到端口，−j1Ω与负载并联。Source series 1Ω feeds a port with parallel −j1Ω and load.

本题图在书第190页／PDF第199页。The source figure is on printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
源串1Ω，端口并联−j1Ω；内阻为1∥(−j1)，不是1−j1。The source feeds series 1Ω with a−j1Ω port shunt. The internal impedance is their parallel combination.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求戴维南参数Find Thevenin parameters

开路负载后电容仍存在，按分压求端口开压。The capacitor remains when the load is open; use its divider voltage.

Zth=11+j=0.5−j0.5Ω,U˙oc=U˙s−j1−j=1∠0∘V

负载与功率Load and power

源给的是有效值相量2V，开压为1V有效值。The given 2V source phasor is RMS, producing 1V RMS open voltage.

ZL=0.5+j0.5Ω,Pmax=124(0.5)=0.5W

ZL=(0.5+j0.5)Ω，Pmax=0.5W。ZL=(0.5+j0.5)Ω and Pmax=0.5W.

易错点Common errors

  • 匹配是共轭，不是原阻抗本身；源相位不影响最大功率数值。Use the conjugate rather than the original impedance. Source phase does not affect maximum active power.

核验依据Verification

先把并联电容算进内阻，再加串联电感Include the shunt capacitor before adding the series inductor

题目原文Transcribed question

某正弦交流电路如题图7-40所示，问负载ZL取何值时可获得最大功率？并求此最大功率Pmax。For Fig. 7-40, find the maximizing ZL and maximum power Pmax.

50V源、30Ω、并联−j10Ω节点，再串j5Ω到负载。50V source, 30Ω, a−j10Ω shunt node, then j5Ω to the load.

本题图在书第190页／PDF第199页。The source figure is on printed p. 190 · PDF p. 199.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
50∠0°V源经30Ω到中点，中点−j10Ω接地，再经j5Ω到负载。A50∠0°V source feeds 30Ω, a−j10Ω shunted midpoint, then j5Ω to the load.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

开路与测试内阻Open circuit and port impedance

负载开路使j5Ω无电流，但测试内阻时j5Ω仍串联。The open load makes j5Ω carry no current, but it remains in series in the port impedance.

U˙oc=50−j1030−j10=5−j15V,Zth=j5+(30∥(−j10))=3−j4Ω

共轭匹配Conjugate match

最大功率由有效值开压模平方计算。Use the RMS open-voltage magnitude squared.

ZL=3+j4Ω,Pmax=52+1524(3)=1256W≈20.8333W

ZL=(3+j4)Ω，Pmax=1256W≈20.8333W。ZL=(3+j4)Ω and Pmax=1256W≈20.8333W.

易错点Common errors

  • 求内阻时独立电压源短路，30Ω与电容并联；开路压却不能把源置零。Short the source for impedance, putting 30Ω parallel with C. Keep the source active for open voltage.

核验依据Verification

依据原图以独立节点、端口测试、时域重构或复功率平衡复核；具体数值、参数限制和附录差异见核验结果。Independently verified from original-topology node or port tests, time reconstruction or complex-power balance; numerical values, parameter limits and appendix differences are recorded below.

受控源控制极性和独立源反极性都要保留Retain both the control polarity and the reversed independent source

题目原文Transcribed question

试求题图7-41所示正弦交流电路中负载ZL获得最大功率的条件及获得的最大功率。For Fig. 7-41, find the load condition for maximum power and that power.

左受控UA源经j4Ω到中点；中点经2Ω和反向4V源接地，经−j2Ω到负载。The left controlled UA source reaches the midpoint through j4Ω. The midpoint has 2Ω above a reversed 4V source and −j2Ω to the load.

本题图在书第191页／PDF第200页。The source figure is on printed p. 191 · PDF p. 200.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
中间2Ω上端为−、下端为+定义UA；其下4∠0°V源也是上−下+。左受控电压源为上+下−、值UA。UA is defined bottom-positive across the middle 2Ω. Its lower 4∠0°V source is also bottom-positive. The left controlled voltage source UA is top-positive.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从原极性求开路电压Find open voltage with original polarities

令下端公共点为0，中间独立源上端−4V，中间上节点V，控制量UA=−4−V，左节点也等于UA。Ground the bottom node. The independent-source top is −4V. If the upper node is V, then UA=−4−V and the left node equals UA.

V−(−4−V)j4+V+42=0⇒U˙oc=V=−3−j1V

保留受控源求端口内阻Retain control for port impedance

独立4V源短路后，左节点变为−V；中间节点的等效导纳为12+2(j4)，再串−j2Ω。Short the independent source, making the left node −V. The middle-node admittance is 12+2(j4), in series with −j2Ω.

Zth=112+2(j4)−j2=1−j1Ω

匹配并复查原负载状态Match and recheck the original loaded state

独立求原图带匹配负载的节点方程复得2.5W。The independently solved original loaded circuit reproduces 2.5W.

ZL=1+j1Ω,Pmax=|−3−j1|24(1)=2.5W

ZL=(1+j1)Ω，Pmax=2.5W。ZL=(1+j1)Ω and Pmax=2.5W.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把受控源置零，也不能把中间独立源误读为上端+4V；这会改变开压。Do not zero the dependent source or misread the middle source top as +4V.

核验依据Verification

依据原图以独立节点、端口测试、时域重构或复功率平衡复核；具体数值、参数限制和附录差异见核验结果。Independently verified from original-topology node or port tests, time reconstruction or complex-power balance; numerical values, parameter limits and appendix differences are recorded below.

共轭匹配转换成物理并联RLTranslate conjugate matching into a physical parallel RL load

题目原文Transcribed question

试用最大功率传输定理证明：当题图7-42所示正弦交流电路中负载A获得最大功率时，负载由R与L并联组成，且L=1(ω2C)，所获得的最大功率为Um2(8R)。Use the maximum-power theorem to show that the maximizing load A in Fig. 7-42 is a parallel R and L with L=1(ω2C), and maximum power Um2(8R).

Umcosωt源串R后接电容C与负载A并联。AUmcosωt source feeds series R before parallel C and load A.

本题图在书第191页／PDF第200页。The source figure is on printed p. 191 · PDF p. 200.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
源Umcosωt给的是峰值。端口内阻为R∥C，取共轭后再看导纳，恰为R并联电感。The source Umcosωt specifies peak amplitude. Conjugate the R∥C port impedance, then inspect its admittance.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求端口参数Find port parameters

假设R、C、ω均为正，令x=ωRC。Assume positive R, C and ω, and let x=ωRC.

Zth=R1+jx,U˙oc=Um21+jx

把匹配阻抗变为导纳Translate matched impedance into admittance

共轭匹配后的负载导纳是1R−jωC，与并联RL的1R+1(jωL)比较。The matched-load admittance is 1R−jωC. Compare with the parallel−RL admittance.

YA=1Zth*=1R−jωC=1R+1jωL⇒L=1ω2C

约去同一频率因子Cancel the common frequency factor

开压模平方含1(1+x2)，内阻实部也含同一因子。Both open-voltage magnitude squared and the port resistance contain 1(1+x2).

Pmax=Um2[2(1+x2)]4R(1+x2)=Um28R

负载A为R∥L，L=1(ω2C)，Pmax=Um2(8R)，Um为源峰值。A is R∥L with L=1(ω2C), and Pmax=Um2(8R), where Um is source peak.

易错点Common errors

  • 若把Um当有效值，功率将错一倍；并联负载的电阻确为R，但等效串联实部一般不是R。Treating Um as RMS doubles power. The parallel load resistor is R, while its series-equivalent real part differs.

核验依据Verification

线损反求电流，再按负载端补偿无功Infer current from line loss, then compensate load-side reactive power

题目原文Transcribed question

电源通过一条阻抗为(0.08+j0.25)Ω的传输线给一个感性负载供电。已知电源频率为50Hz，负载端电压为220∠0∘V、功率为12kW。若传输线功率损耗为560W，试求负载的阻抗角。如果要求负载的功率因数提高到0.9（电感性），需并联多大的电容？A source supplies an inductive load through a line of impedance (0.08+j0.25)Ω at 50Hz. Load voltage is 220∠0°V and active power 12kW; line active loss is 560W. Find the load impedance angle and shunt C for a load power factor of 0.9 lagging.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量、KCL、KVL、复功率与元件参考方向；拓展题按范围标签阅读。RMS phasors, KCL and KVL, complex power and element references; follow the scope labels for extensions.
线损只用线路电阻0.08Ω求I2R；负载功率因数只用负载端220V和12kW，不混入线路复功率。Use only the line resistance 0.08Ω in its I2R loss. For load power factor use load-side 220V and 12kW, excluding line power.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由线损得负载电流Find load current from line loss

给定线损为有功，线路j0.25Ω不计入此式。The loss is active power, so j0.25Ω does not enter this equation.

I=5600.08=7000A≈83.6660A

负载阻抗角Load impedance angle

感性取正角。Choose the positive inductive angle.

cosϕ=120002207000≈0.651943,ϕ≈49.3118∘

按目标负载功率因数补偿Compensate to the target load factor

原负载无功约13957.077var，目标无功为Ptan(arccos0.9)，两者差由并联C提供。在给定负载工作点使用220V；不能把源端电压代入。Original load reactive power is about 13957.077var. The capacitor supplies the difference from Ptan(arccos0.9). Use the given 220V load-side operating voltage.

C=P(tanϕ−tan(arccos0.9))(2π50)(220)2≈535.682μF

负载阻抗角ϕ≈49.3118°；并联C≈535.682μF（约536μF），目标为负载侧0.9滞后。Load angle ϕ≈49.3118°; shunt C≈535.682μF (about 536μF) gives the target load-side 0.9 lagging factor.

易错点Common errors

  • 补偿负载功率因数与补偿电源端功率因数不是同一问题；电容所接位置的电压应取负载端电压。Load-side and source-side power-factor targets differ. Use the voltage at the actual capacitor connection.

核验依据Verification
